title: सेन्सेक्समध्ये 1426 अंकांची मोठी वाढ; ‘या’ दोन कारणांमुळे शेअर बाजारात तेजी
description: बाजार उघडताच जोरदार खरेदीचा मारा पाहायला मिळाला आणि बीएसई सेन्सेक्स 1,426.44 अंकांच्या उसळीसह 83,862.43 अंकांवर पोहोचला.
author: Bhakti Sanap
content:
एका दिवसाच्या सुट्टीनंतर बुधवारी सकाळी भारतीय शेअर बाजाराने गुंतवणूकदारांना मोठा दिलासा दिला. बाजार उघडताच जोरदार खरेदीचा मारा पाहायला मिळाला आणि बीएसई सेन्सेक्स 1,426.44 अंकांच्या उसळीसह 83,862.43 अंकांवर पोहोचला. दुसरीकडे, एनएसई निफ्टी 50 नेही 25,700 चा टप्पा ओलांडत 389.50 अंकांच्या वाढीसह 25,739.15 अंकांची पातळी गाठली. सलग 4 आठवड्यांच्या तेजीनंतर सोमवारी नफावसुलीमुळे बाजारात सुमारे 1.8 टक्के घसरण झाली होती आणि मंगळवारी सुट्टी होती. त्यानंतर बुधवारी बाजाराने दणक्यात पुनरागमन करत मागील पडझड भरून काढली.
जागतिक एआय शेअर्समधून पैसा काढून भारतात गुंतवणूक
सध्याच्या या तेजीमागे परदेशी संस्थात्मक गुंतवणूकदारांचा (FIIs) मोठा वाटा आहे. जगभरातील महागड्या कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता (AI) शेअर्समधून गुंतवणूक काढून परदेशी गुंतवणूकदार भारतीय बाजाराकडे वळत आहेत. सोमवारी बाजार घसरला असतानाही त्यांनी सुमारे 5,673 कोटी रुपयांची खरेदी केली होती. नोव्हेंबरमध्ये आतापर्यंत परदेशी गुंतवणूकदारांनी भारतीय शेअर बाजारात तब्बल 14.28 अब्ज डॉलर्स ओतले असून, त्यावरून भारताप्रती असलेला विश्वास स्पष्ट होतो.
कच्च्या तेलाच्या दरात मोठी घसरण; महागाईचा ताण कमी होण्याची आशा
कच्च्या तेलाच्या घसरत्या किमती हा देखील बाजारासाठी मोठा सकारात्मक घटक ठरला आहे. आंतरराष्ट्रीय बाजारात ब्रेंट क्रूडचा दर 90.8 डॉलर्स प्रति बॅरलवर आला आहे. केवळ नोव्हेंबर महिन्यात कच्च्या तेलात सुमारे 23 टक्के घसरण नोंदवली गेली आहे. वाढता पुरवठा आणि भविष्यात तेलाचा अतिरिक्त साठा उपलब्ध होण्याची शक्यता ही यामागची प्रमुख कारणे आहेत. भारत बहुतांश कच्चे तेल आयात करत असल्याने, किमती कमी झाल्याने महागाईचा दबाव घटण्यास मदत होते आणि गुंतवणूकदारांचा उत्साह द्विगुणित होतो.
हेही वाचा –
घाईघाईचे निर्णय टाळून मूलभूत तत्त्वांवर लक्ष केंद्रित करण्याचा सल्ला
परदेशी गुंतवणुकीचा ओघ आणि स्वस्त कच्चे तेल यांमुळे बाजारातील तेजीला भक्कम आधार मिळाला आहे. तरीही बाजारातील चढउतार पाहता गुंतवणूकदारांनी केवळ एका दिवसाच्या तेजीच्या प्रभावाखाली येऊन तातडीचे निर्णय घेऊ नयेत. मजबूत आर्थिक स्थिती आणि चांगली मूलभूत तत्त्वे असलेल्या कंपन्यांचे शेअर्स निवडून दीर्घकालीन नियोजनावर लक्ष केंद्रित करणे अधिक हिताचे ठरते.

title: बँकेची महत्त्वाची कामे आधीच उरकून घ्या! ‘या’ दिवशी देशभरातील 2.5 लाख कर्मचारी संपावर; जाणून घ्या काय आहेत मागण्या
description: देशभरातील तब्बल 2.5 लाख बँक कर्मचारी 3 डिसेंबर रोजी संपावर जाणार असून, IDBI बँकेच्या खासगीकरणाला विरोध दर्शवण्यासाठी 3 प्रमुख कर्मचारी संघटनांनी हा निर्णय घेतला आहे.
author: Bhakti Sanap
content:
डिसेंबरच्या सुरुवातीच्या काळात बँकेशी निगडित अत्यावश्यक व्यवहार करायचे असल्यास ग्राहकांनी आत्ताच नियोजन करणे हिताचे ठरेल. देशभरातील तब्बल 2.5 लाख बँक कर्मचारी 3 डिसेंबर रोजी संपावर जाणार असून, IDBI बँकेच्या खासगीकरणाला विरोध दर्शवण्यासाठी 3 प्रमुख कर्मचारी संघटनांनी हा निर्णय घेतला आहे. या आंदोलनामुळे त्या दिवशी बँकांच्या कामकाजावर परिणाम होण्याची शक्यता आहे.
कोणकोणत्या संघटनांचा संपात सहभाग?
संपात सहभागी होण्याचा निर्णय ऑल इंडिया बँक एम्प्लॉईज असोसिएशन (AIBEA), ऑल इंडिया बँक ऑफिसर्स असोसिएशन (AIBOA) आणि बँक एम्प्लॉईज फेडरेशन ऑफ इंडिया (BEFI) या संघटनांनी घेतला आहे. केंद्र सरकारने IDBI बँकेतील आपला हिस्सा विकण्याचे पाऊल उचलल्याच्या निषेधार्थ हा संप केला जात असून, केंद्र शासन आणि LIC मिळून या बँकेतील एकूण 60.72 टक्के भागभांडवल कॅनडाच्या Fairfax समूहाकडे सोपवणार आहेत; 14 ऑक्टोबर रोजी झालेल्या आर्थिक व्यवहारविषयक मंत्रिमंडळ समितीच्या बैठकीत या प्रस्तावाला हिरवा कंदील दाखवण्यात आला होता.
हिस्सा विक्रीचे आर्थिक गणित
प्रस्तावित करारानुसार केंद्र सरकार आपला 30.48 टक्के हिस्सा तर LIC आपला 30.24 टक्के हिस्सा विक्रीस काढणार आहे. Fairfax समूहाने प्रति शेअर 81 रुपये अशी बोली लावली असून, त्यानुसार केंद्राच्या हिस्स्याची किंमत सुमारे 26620 कोटी रुपये तर LIC च्या हिस्स्याची किंमत जवळपास 26440 कोटी रुपये होते; सर्व नियामक परवानग्या मिळाल्यानंतर हा सौदा चालू आर्थिक वर्षाच्या अखेरीस पूर्ण होण्याचा अंदाज व्यक्त केला जात आहे.
खासगीकरण रोखण्याची ठाम भूमिका
खासगीकरणाचा निर्णय मागे घ्यावा आणि IDBI बँकेची विक्री तातडीने थांबवावी, अशी आग्रही मागणी कर्मचारी संघटनांनी लावून धरली आहे. संघटनांच्या म्हणण्यानुसार IDBI बँकेकडे सर्वसामान्य खातेदारांच्या ठेवींचे अंदाजे 3.5 लाख कोटी रुपये जमा आहेत, शिवाय बँकेने सुमारे 2.5 लाख कोटी रुपयांचे कर्ज वितरित केले आहे.
हेही वाचा –
ग्राहकांच्या ठेवींची चिंता आणि आवाहन
परदेशी खासगी कंपनीच्या हाती बँकेची सूत्रे गेल्यास नागरिकांच्या ठेवींच्या सुरक्षिततेवर परिणाम होऊ शकतो, अशी भीती संघटनांनी व्यक्त केली आहे. 3 डिसेंबरच्या देशव्यापी संपामुळे शाखांमधील दैनंदिन कामकाज विस्कळीत होऊ शकते, त्यामुळे ग्राहकांनी आपली महत्त्वाची कामे त्यापूर्वीच पूर्ण करून घ्यावीत.

title: Accident : युएईमध्ये भीषण अपघात; 13 जणांचा मृत्यू, मृतांमध्ये भारतीयांचा समावेश
description: National and International News संयुक्त अरब अमिरातीमध्ये भीषण अपघात झाल्याची माहिती मिळत आहे.  बस-ट्रक यांच्यात हा अपघात झाला असून प्रवासी बसची ट्रकला जोरदार धडक
author: Siddhi Naringrekar
content:
Accident : युएईमध्ये भीषण अपघात; 13 जणांचा मृत्यू, मृतांमध्ये भारतीयांचा समावेश 
संयुक्त अरब अमिरातीमध्ये भीषण अपघात झाल्याची माहिती मिळत आहे. बस-ट्रक यांच्यात हा अपघात झाला असून प्रवासी बसची ट्रकला जोरदार धडक लागल्याने हा अपघात झाल्याची माहिती मिळत आहे.
या भीषण अपघातात 13 जणांचा मृत्यू झाल्याची माहिती मिळत आहे. मृतांमध्ये भारतीय नागरिकांचाही समावेश असल्याची माहिती मिळत असून अल वतन रोडवर मंगळवारी ही दुर्घटना घडली.
उपचारादरम्यान आणखी दोघांचा मृत्यू झाल्याने मृतांचा आकडा 13वर गेला. भारतीय दूतावासाकडून मृतांच्या कुटुंबीयांशी संपर्क साधण्यात येत असून भारतीय दूतावास स्थानिक प्रशासनाच्या देखील संपर्कात आहेत. मृत आणि जखमी भारतीयांची नेमकी संख्या अद्याप स्पष्ट नसल्याची माहिती मिळत आहे.
Short Summery 
संयुक्त अरब अमिरातीतील रास अल खैमाह येथे भीषण बस-ट्रक अपघात झाला.
अल वतन रोडवर मंगळवारी ही दुर्घटना घडली.
प्रवासी बसची रस्त्याच्या कडेला उभ्या असलेल्या ट्रकला जोरदार धडक बसली.
या अपघातात एकूण १३ जणांचा मृत्यू झाला.
सुरुवातीला ११ जणांचा मृत्यू झाला होता, उपचारादरम्यान आणखी दोघांनी प्राण गमावले.
मृतांमध्ये भारतीय नागरिकांचाही समावेश आहे.
अपघातात अन्य १४ जण जखमी झाल्याचे वृत्त आहे.
भारतीय दूतावास मृतांच्या कुटुंबीयांच्या संपर्कात आहे.
मृत आणि जखमी भारतीयांची नेमकी संख्या अद्याप समोर आलेली नाही.

title: Donald Trump : डोनाल्ड ट्रम्प यांचा पुन्हा  टॅरिफ बॉम्ब? 'या' १६ देशांवर नवीन आयात शुल्क वाढवण्याच्या तयारीत
description: National and International News डोनाल्ड ट्रम्प यांचा पुन्हा  टॅरिफ बॉम्ब वाढवण्याच्या तयारीत असल्याची माहिती मिळत आहे.
author: Siddhi Naringrekar
content:
Donald Trump : डोनाल्ड ट्रम्प यांचा पुन्हा टॅरिफ बॉम्ब? 'या' १६ देशांवर नवीन आयात शुल्क वाढवण्याच्या तयारीत
डोनाल्ड ट्रम्प यांचा पुन्हा  टॅरिफ बॉम्ब वाढवण्याच्या तयारीत असल्याची माहिती मिळत आहे. अमेरिकेचे राष्ट्राध्यक्ष डोनाल्ड ट्रंप पुन्हा एकदा भारत, चीन आणि युरोपियन युनियनसह अनेक देशांवर आयात शुल्क वाढवण्याची शक्यता वर्तवण्यात येत आहे. 
याच्याआधी देखील डोनाल्ड ट्रम्प यांनी भारत आणि चीनसह अनेक देशांवर मोठे टॅरिफ लादले होते. भारतासह 16 देशांतील टॅरिफ शुल्क वाढवण्याच्या तयारीमध्ये असल्याचे कळत आहे. ट्रम्प प्रशासनाने प्रस्तावित केलेले शुल्क अर्थव्यवस्थांमधून निर्यात होणाऱ्या बहुतांश उत्पादनांना लागू केले जाणार आहे.
मिळालेल्या माहितीनुसार अमेरिकेचे व्यापार प्रतिनिधी जेमिसन ग्रीअर 11 मार्चपासून सुरू असलेल्या चौकशीचे निष्कर्ष जाहीर करू शकतात.सरकारी सबसिडी आणि इतर आर्थिक मदतीद्वारे देशांतर्गत उद्योगांना बळ दिल्याच्या आरोपामुळे या देशांवर नवे किंवा अधिकचे टॅरिफ लादण्याचा विचार सुरू असल्याची माहिती 'द वॉल स्ट्रीट जर्नल'च्या अहवालानुसार मिळते आहे.
Short Summery 
अमेरिकेचे राष्ट्राध्यक्ष डोनाल्ड ट्रम्प पुन्हा आयात शुल्क वाढवण्याच्या तयारीत असल्याचे वृत्त आहे.
भारत, चीन आणि युरोपियन युनियनसह १६ अर्थव्यवस्थांवर अतिरिक्त टॅरिफ लागू होण्याची शक्यता आहे.
अमेरिकेच्या व्यापार प्रतिनिधी कार्यालयाने ११ मार्चपासून औद्योगिक अतिरिक्त उत्पादन क्षमतेबाबत चौकशी सुरू केली होती.
सरकारी अनुदाने आणि आर्थिक मदतीमुळे परदेशी उद्योगांना अनुचित फायदा मिळत असल्याचा अमेरिकेचा आरोप आहे.
या चौकशीचे निष्कर्ष व्यापार प्रतिनिधी जेमिसन ग्रीअर जाहीर करण्याची शक्यता आहे.
प्रस्तावित शुल्क संबंधित देशांतून अमेरिकेत निर्यात होणाऱ्या बहुतांश उत्पादनांवर लागू होऊ शकते.
टॅरिफचे नेमके दर आणि अंमलबजावणीची तारीख अद्याप निश्चित झालेली नाही.
भारताच्या अमेरिकेसोबतच्या व्यापार संबंधांवर या संभाव्य निर्णयाचा परिणाम होऊ शकतो.

title: Asia Power Index 2026 : आशियातील सर्वात शक्तिशाली देशांच्या यादीत भारत तिसरा; अमेरिका पहिल्या स्थानी, दुसऱ्या क्रमांकावर चीन
description: आशियातील सर्वात शक्तिशाली देशांच्या यादीत भारत तिसऱ्या क्रमांकावर; अमेरिका पहिल्या स्थानी | National and International News
author: Shraddha Malap
content:
Asia Power Index 2026 : आशियातील सर्वात शक्तिशाली देशांच्या यादीत भारत तिसरा; अमेरिका पहिल्या स्थानी, दुसऱ्या क्रमांकावर चीन
ऑस्ट्रेलियातील प्रतिष्ठित लोवी इन्स्टिट्यूट ने प्रसिद्ध केलेल्या 2026 आशिया शक्ती निर्देशांक (Asia Power Index) मध्ये भारताने आशियातील सर्वात शक्तिशाली देशांच्या यादीत तिसरे स्थान पटकावले आहे. या यादीत अमेरिका (us) पहिल्या, तर चीन (china) दुसऱ्या क्रमांकावर आहे. विशेष म्हणजे, भारताने सलग तिसऱ्या वर्षी आपले तिसरे स्थान कायम राखले आहे.
या निर्देशांकानुसार, भारताला 40.5 गुण मिळाले आहेत. मागील वर्षाच्या तुलनेत भारताच्या गुणांमध्ये वाढ झाली आहे. आर्थिक क्षमता, लष्करी सामर्थ्य, राजनैतिक प्रभाव आणि आंतरराष्ट्रीय संबंध या क्षेत्रांमध्ये भारताची कामगिरी महत्त्वपूर्ण ठरली आहे. विशेषतः भारताची वाढती अर्थव्यवस्था, संरक्षण क्षेत्रातील क्षमता आणि जागतिक स्तरावरील वाढता सहभाग यामुळे भारताचे स्थान अधिक मजबूत झाले आहे.
अमेरिका आशियाच्या यादीत पहिल्या क्रमांकावर का?
या यादीत अमेरिका पहिल्या क्रमांकावर असल्याने अनेकांच्या मनात प्रश्न निर्माण होऊ शकतो की अमेरिका आशिया खंडात नसतानाही तिचा समावेश या यादीत का करण्यात आला आहे? याचे कारण म्हणजे लोवी इन्स्टिट्यूट चा Asia Power Index केवळ भौगोलिक सीमांवर आधारित नाही. आशिया-पॅसिफिक आणि इंडो-पॅसिफिक क्षेत्रातील देशांवर असलेला प्रभाव, लष्करी उपस्थिती, आर्थिक संबंध, राजनैतिक भागीदारी आणि सुरक्षेतील भूमिका या निकषांवर अमेरिकेचे मूल्यमापन केले जाते. त्यामुळे अमेरिका या निर्देशांकात समाविष्ट आहे.
Lowy Institute चा Asia Power Index नेमका काय आहे?
लोवी इन्स्टिट्यूट ही ऑस्ट्रेलियातील स्वतंत्र आंतरराष्ट्रीय संशोधन संस्था आहे. या संस्थेकडून आशियातील देशांच्या सामर्थ्याचे मूल्यमापन करण्यासाठी Asia Power Index प्रसिद्ध केला जातो. आर्थिक क्षमता, लष्करी ताकद, संरक्षण संबंध, राजनैतिक प्रभाव आणि भविष्यातील संसाधने अशा विविध निकषांचा यात विचार केला जातो.
एकूणच, अमेरिका आणि चीननंतर भारताने तिसरे स्थान कायम राखणे ही देशासाठी महत्त्वाची बाब मानली जात आहे. भारताची वाढती ताकद आणि जागतिक राजकारणातील प्रभाव या क्रमवारीतून अधोरेखित होत आहे.
टॉप 10 देशांची क्रमवारी:
1. अमेरिका – 78.9 गुण
2. चीन – 73.6 गुण
3. भारत – 40.5 गुण
4. जपान – 38.6 गुण
5. रशिया – 32.2 गुण
6. ऑस्ट्रेलिया – 31.7 गुण
7. दक्षिण कोरिया – 31.0 गुण
8. सिंगापूर – 26.9 गुण
9. इंडोनेशिया – 21.7 गुण
10. मलेशिया – 20.5 गुण
Short Summary
- लोवी इन्स्टिट्यूट चा Asia Power Index 2026 जाहीर.
- आशियातील शक्तिशाली देशांच्या यादीत भारत तिसऱ्या क्रमांकावर.
- अमेरिका पहिल्या तर चीन दुसऱ्या स्थानावर.
- भारताला 40.5 गुण मिळाले.
- जपान चौथ्या आणि रशिया पाचव्या क्रमांकावर.
- भारताची आर्थिक आणि लष्करी ताकद वाढत असल्याचे अहवालातून स्पष्ट.

title: Video: ઉલુંદુરપેટ ખાતે આદિ દ્રવિડર છાત્રાલયમાં અકસ્માત સર્જાયો
description: તમિલનાડુના કલ્લાકુરિચી જિલ્લાના ઉલુંદુરપેટ ખાતે આવેલી આદિ દ્રવિડર ગર્લ્સ હોસ્ટેલની કમ્પાઉન્ડ વોલ અચાનક ધરાશાયી થવાની ઘટના સામે આવી છે. દીવાલ તૂટી પડવાના કારણે…
author: Hiren
content:
Video: ઉલુંદુરપેટ ખાતે આદિ દ્રવિડર છાત્રાલયમાં અકસ્માત સર્જાયો
તમિલનાડુના કલ્લાકુરિચી જિલ્લાના ઉલુંદુરપેટ ખાતે આવેલી આદિ દ્રવિડર ગર્લ્સ હોસ્ટેલની કમ્પાઉન્ડ વોલ અચાનક ધરાશાયી થવાની ઘટના સામે આવી છે. દીવાલ તૂટી પડવાના કારણે હોસ્ટેલ પરિસરમાં રહેતી વિદ્યાર્થિનીઓ અને સ્ટાફમાં ભારે ભયનો માહોલ ફેલાઈ ગયો હતો. ઘટનાની જાણ થતા જ સ્થાનિક વહીવટીતંત્ર અને પોલીસના ઉચ્ચ અધિકારીઓ તાત્કાલિક ઘટનાસ્થળે દોડી ગયા હતા અને પરિસ્થિતિનું નિરીક્ષણ કર્યું હતું. સદનસીબે આ દુર્ઘટના સમયે દીવાલની નજીક કોઈ વિદ્યાર્થિની હાજર ન હોવાથી મોટી જાનહાનિ ટળી હતી. તંત્ર દ્વારા કાટમાળ હટાવવાની કામગીરી શરૂ કરીને હોસ્ટેલની ઇમારતની સુરક્ષા અંગે તપાસ હાથ ધરાઈ છે.

title: Video: 410_DELHI_FIRE BREAK_AV_HIREN
description: રાષ્ટ્રીય રાજધાની દિલ્હીના ગીતા કોલોની વિસ્તારના જંગલોમાં અચાનક ભીષણ આગ ફાટી નીકળતા સમગ્ર પંથકમાં ભારે અફરાતફરી મચી ગઈ હતી. આગ એટલી વિકરાળ હતી કે આસપાસના…
author: Hiren
content:
Video: 410_DELHI_FIRE BREAK_AV_HIREN
રાષ્ટ્રીય રાજધાની દિલ્હીના ગીતા કોલોની વિસ્તારના જંગલોમાં અચાનક ભીષણ આગ ફાટી નીકળતા સમગ્ર પંથકમાં ભારે અફરાતફરી મચી ગઈ હતી. આગ એટલી વિકરાળ હતી કે આસપાસના વિસ્તારોમાં આકાશમાં કાળા ધુમાડાના ગોટેગોટા દૂર-દૂર સુધી જોવા મળ્યા હતા. ઘટનાની જાણ થતા જ ફાયર બ્રિગેડની ગાડીઓ તાત્કાલિક ઘટનાસ્થળે પહોંચી ગઈ હતી અને આગ પર કાબૂ મેળવવાની કામગીરી યુદ્ધના ધોરણે શરૂ કરી હતી. સૂકા પાંદડા અને ઝાડીઓના કારણે આગ ઝડપથી ફેલાઈ રહી હતી, જોકે ફાયર ફાઇટરોની સતત જહેમત બાદ પરિસ્થિતિને નિયંત્રણમાં લેવાના પ્રયાસો હાથ ધરાયા છે. આ દુર્ઘટનામાં હાલ કોઈ જાનહાનિના સમાચાર નથી.

title: CJPના અભિજીત દીપકેએ હનુમાન ચાલીસાની મજાક ઉડાવી, વિવાદ વધુ વકર્યો
description: 'કોકરોચ જનતા પાર્ટી' (CJP) ના અભિજીત દીપકેએ ફરી એકવાર વિવાદ ઊભો કર્યો છે—આ વખતે આ વિવાદ હિન્દુઓની ધાર્મિક લાગણીઓ સાથે જોડાયેલો છે. બુધવારે, તેમની પાર્ટી CJP એ…
author: Pratik Shah
content:
CJPના અભિજીત દીપકેએ હનુમાન ચાલીસાની મજાક ઉડાવી, વિવાદ વધુ વકર્યો
'કોકરોચ જનતા પાર્ટી' (CJP) ના અભિજીત દીપકેએ ફરી એકવાર વિવાદ ઊભો કર્યો છે—આ વખતે આ વિવાદ હિન્દુઓની ધાર્મિક લાગણીઓ સાથે જોડાયેલો છે. બુધવારે, તેમની પાર્ટી CJP એ મોદીના નેતૃત્વવાળી કેન્દ્ર સરકારને નિશાન બનાવવા માટે એક પત્રકાર પરિષદ યોજી હતી. દીપકેએ કાર્યક્રમની શરૂઆત 'મોદી ચાલીસા' નામનું ગીત વગાડીને કરી હતી. ગીત વાગવાનું શરૂ થતાં જ એવા આક્ષેપો થયા કે તેનાથી 'હનુમાન ચાલીસા'નું અપમાન થયું છે. જ્યારે આ અંગે તેમને પૂછવામાં આવ્યું, ત્યારે દીપકે ખૂબ જ ઉશ્કેરાઈ ગયા હતા.
નાગપુરમાં આયોજિત આ પત્રકાર પરિષદ દરમિયાન, અભિજીત દીપકેએ સોશિયલ મીડિયા પર સરકાર દ્વારા લાદવામાં આવેલા સેન્સરશિપ (પ્રતિબંધો) સામે નારાજગી વ્યક્ત કરી હતી. મીડિયા સાથે વાત કરતા તેમણે દાવો કર્યો કે સોશિયલ મીડિયા પ્લેટફોર્મનો ઉપયોગ માત્ર વડાપ્રધાન મોદીના પ્રચાર માટે જ કરવામાં આવી રહ્યો છે. તેમણે વધુમાં આરોપ લગાવ્યો કે જાન્યુઆરીથી જૂન વચ્ચે ઇન્સ્ટાગ્રામ પરથી ૫૦ લાખ (૫ મિલિયન) થી વધુ પોસ્ટ્સ હટાવી દેવામાં આવી છે.
આ પરિસ્થિતિ પર કટાક્ષ કરતા દીપકેએ કહ્યું, "આ દેશમાં સેન્સરશિપ એટલી વ્યાપક છે કે ઇન્સ્ટાગ્રામ અને મેટા પર વડાપ્રધાન મોદીની તસવીરો સિવાય અન્ય રાજકીય બાબતોને લગતી કોઈપણ સામગ્રીને દબાવી દેવામાં આવી રહી છે. આ વાતને ધ્યાનમાં રાખીને, અમે ઇન્સ્ટાગ્રામ અને મેટાના લાભ માટે વડાપ્રધાનનો ફોટો અને 'મોદી ચાલીસા' પ્રદર્શિત કર્યા છે." તેમણે ઉમેર્યું કે તેમને આશા છે કે મીડિયા સાથેની વાતચીત દરમિયાન વડાપ્રધાન મોદીની તસવીર સામે રાખવાથી, કદાચ ઇન્સ્ટાગ્રામ આ પત્રકાર પરિષદના વીડિયોને પોતાના પ્લેટફોર્મ પરથી હટાવશે નહીં. આ પ્રસંગે CJP ના સહ-સંયોજક આશુતોષ રાંકા પણ હાજર હતા.
એક પ્રશ્ન પર તીખી પ્રતિક્રિયા
પત્રકાર પરિષદ દરમિયાન, એક પત્રકારે દીપકેને પૂછ્યું કે શું 'મોદી ચાલીસા' ઓડિયોથી હિન્દુઓની ધાર્મિક લાગણીઓને ઠેસ પહોંચી શકે છે? દીપકેએ ગુસ્સામાં પ્રતિક્રિયા આપતા ગીત બનાવનાર વ્યક્તિ અને ભાજપ (BJP) ના સોશિયલ મીડિયા હેન્ડલ્સ બંને સામે કાર્યવાહી કરવાની માંગ કરી. દીપકેએ કહ્યું, "આ ગીત ગાનાર ગાયક સામે તાત્કાલિક FIR દાખલ થવી જોઈએ. તેઓ આવું ગીત કેવી રીતે બનાવી શકે? તેમને તરત જ જેલમાં નાખો!" તેમણે વધુમાં કહ્યું, "ભાજપની સોશિયલ મીડિયા ટીમ સામે પણ FIR દાખલ થવી જોઈએ, કારણ કે અમને આ ગીત ત્યાંથી જ મળ્યું છે." નોંધનીય છે કે CJP પર અગાઉ પણ સનાતન ધર્મના અપમાનના આરોપો લાગ્યા છે. આ પહેલાં, NEET પેપર લીક વિરુદ્ધના વિરોધ પ્રદર્શન દરમિયાન 'સીતાના પતિ'નો ઉલ્લેખ કરતા નારા લગાવવામાં આવ્યા ત્યારે મોટો વિવાદ થયો હતો.
શું અભિજીત દીપકે ચૂંટણી લડશે?
દરમિયાન, અભિજીત દીપકે સ્પષ્ટ કર્યું છે કે તેઓ ચૂંટણી લડશે નહીં. ચૂંટણી લડવાની કે નવો રાજકીય પક્ષ રચવાની શક્યતાને નકારી કાઢતા તેમણે સ્પષ્ટ કર્યું કે CJPની કોઈ રાજકીય પક્ષ સ્થાપવાની યોજના નથી. તેમણે કહ્યું, "અમે અહીં કોઈ રાજકીય પક્ષનો પક્ષ લેવા માટે નથી આવ્યા." દીપકે વધુમાં ઉમેર્યું કે આગામી UP ચૂંટણીમાં તેઓ કોઈ પણ પક્ષને સમર્થન આપશે નહીં.

title: Three Arrested After Woman Gang-Raped by Colleagues at East Delhi Cafe - News Live
description: Three persons, including two women, have been arrested after a 22-year-old woman was allegedly gang-raped at a closed cafe in east Delhi's Preet Vihar.
author: Hasid Khan
content:
Delhi Police have arrested three persons, including two women, after a 22-year-old woman was allegedly gang-raped by her male colleagues inside a cafe in east Delhi’s Preet Vihar. The incident took place during a late-night gathering in the early hours of Tuesday, November 24.
Deputy Commissioner of Police Rajeev Kumar stated that the victim and all six accused worked as attendants and waiters at a cafe inside a mall near Karkardooma Court. All six suspects are residents of Delhi who knew the woman through work.
The group decided to party after their workplace closed on Monday night and consumed alcohol together. They later travelled to the residence of one of the colleagues in Mandawali, where they continued their gathering past midnight.
Also Read: Man Accused of Dragging Woman in Viral Meerut Video Injured in Police Encounter
Around 2:30 am, the group returned to Preet Vihar and went to Saltanate Cafe, which had shut for customers at 11:30 pm. One of the men, who had worked there earlier, checked with the caretaker to locate the keys and let the group inside to drink.
Inside the closed cafe, two male colleagues allegedly sexually assaulted the woman while the others in the group assisted them in the crime. Around 3:30 am, the women left when a male friend of the victim arrived to pick her up, while the men returned home.
Accompanied by her friend, the victim approached the police station around 6:00 am to report the sexual assault. Officers registered a gang-rape case, arrested three suspects, and launched a search to trace the three remaining accused who are currently on the run.

title: Man Accused of Dragging Woman in Viral Meerut Video Injured in Police Encounter - News Live
description: Meerut police injured accused Salman in an encounter after a viral video showed him chasing and dragging a woman through a market.
author: Hasid Khan
content:
Police in Uttar Pradesh‘s Meerut injured an accused named Salman in an encounter on Wednesday. The action followed a viral video showing him chasing, grabbing, and dragging a woman through a busy city market.
The disturbing CCTV footage emerged from the Abu Lane market area, sparking public outrage on social media. In the clip, the woman is seen rushing out of a local hotel before the man chases her, grabs her, and drags her against her will.
The incident took place at Hotel Square, located within the Abu Lane police outpost under the Sadar Bazar police station. The woman told police that Salman had held her hostage inside the hotel room and pressured her to marry him before assaulting her.
Investigators stated that the woman, who comes from Ghaziabad, had known Salman for about two-and-a-half to three years. The two previously worked together at a private coaching institute in Meerut where they first became friends.
Their relationship reportedly turned bitter after the woman’s family finalised her wedding with another person. Angered by the decision, Salman, a resident of Kankerkhera in Meerut, called her to the hotel where their disagreement turned violent.
Also Read: Assam Police Warn Against Chinese Apps Making Fake Aadhaar and PAN Cards
Circle Officer Cantt Sanjay Gupta clarified that this was an assault stemming from a personal dispute rather than a kidnapping case. During formal questioning, the woman confirmed to officers that she had not been kidnapped by the man.
Following the street assault, Meerut police launched a targeted manhunt to catch Salman. Officers tracked him down and carried out a half-encounter, leaving the accused with bullet injuries to his legs before taking him into custody.

title: Class 9 Student Shot After Country-Made Gun Goes Off Inside Kerala School - News Live
description: A Class 9 student was injured after a country-made gun brought by another student went off inside a government school in Kerala's Palakkad.
author: Hasid Khan
content:
A Class 9 student was injured on Tuesday after a country-made gun went off inside a government school in Kerala‘s Palakkad district. The firearm was allegedly brought onto the school premises by another student, causing panic among teachers and classmates.
The alarming incident occurred around 11:45 am at a government school located in Paruthur, near Thrithala. School authorities and staff quickly stepped in after hearing the sudden gunfire during regular school hours.
Police officers stated that the student suffered a gunshot wound in his armpit area, right between his shoulder and arm. He was immediately rushed to a private hospital in Kottakkal for urgent medical treatment.
Doctors attending to the injured boy confirmed that his wounds are not serious. The student remains in the hospital and is currently receiving medical care while recovering under observation.
Preliminary police inquiries indicate that the country-made firearm was secretly carried into the school by another student. Investigators are questioning people to find out where the weapon came from and how a child managed to obtain it.
The exact circumstances leading to the gun firing remain unclear as police look into what caused the shot to go off. Senior officers are examining the sequence of events, and a detailed investigation is underway to establish the facts.

title: Constitution Day 2026: PM Modi Pays Tribute to Ambedkar, Congress Plans Nationwide Marches
description: National: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Thursday extended greetings to citizens on Constitution Day, describing the Indian Constitution as a “priceless heritage
author: PratidinTime National Desk
content:
Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Thursday extended greetings to citizens on Constitution Day, describing the Indian Constitution as a “priceless heritage of Indian democracy” and paying tribute to Dr BR Ambedkar and the members of the Constituent Assembly.
In a message shared on X, the Prime Minister said the Constitution would continue to guide the country towards fulfilling its vision of a developed India.
“Best wishes to all the countrymen on Constitution Day. On this auspicious occasion, I pay my respects and obeisances to respected Babasaheb and all the great personalities of the Constituent Assembly,” PM Modi wrote.
सभी देशवासियों को संविधान दिवस की हार्दिक शुभकामनाएं। 
इस पावन अवसर पर पूज्य बाबासाहेब एवं संविधान सभा की समस्त महान विभूतियों को मेरा नमन और वंदन। 
संविधान के रूप में उनके द्वारा दी गई सौगात भारतीय लोकतंत्र की अनमोल धरोहर है, जो विकसित भारत के संकल्प को साकार करने में हमारा… pic.twitter.com/QBOcpyfuIU
— Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) November 26, 2026
Highlighting the importance of the Constitution, he said the document was an invaluable legacy of Indian democracy and would continue to inspire the nation in its journey towards development.
The Prime Minister also described Constitution Day as an occasion to honour the makers of the Constitution and reaffirm the country's commitment to the principles enshrined in it. He shared Sanskrit verses in a video message marking the occasion.
Why is Constitution Day observed on November 26?
India observes Constitution Day, also known as Samvidhan Diwas, every year on November 26 to commemorate the adoption of the Constitution by the Constituent Assembly in 1949.
The Constitution came into effect on January 26, 1950, marking India's transition into a republic. Beginning with the words “We, the People of India”, the document establishes the country's democratic framework and safeguards the principles of justice, liberty, equality and fraternity.
Congress to organise Samvidhan Raksha Marches across states
Meanwhile, the Congress has announced nationwide Samvidhan Raksha Marches on Thursday to mark Constitution Day and reaffirm its commitment to protecting the Constitution.
Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge and Leader of Opposition in the Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi are scheduled to participate in the march in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, ahead of the 2027 Assembly elections.
According to an official release, every Pradesh Congress Committee (PCC) will organise a march in its respective state. AICC general secretary KC Venugopal said the programmes would begin at statues of Dr BR Ambedkar or Mahatma Gandhi.
Following tributes to the leaders, participants will collectively read the Preamble of the Constitution and take an oath to protect its values.
The party will also continue its Vote Rakshak campaign, under which Congress workers will reach polling booths to verify cases of voters whose names have allegedly been deleted from electoral rolls and assist them in reclaiming their voting rights.
‘Save Democracy, Save Constitution’ rally in Nagpur
Separately, Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) activist Abhijeet Dipke announced a Save Democracy, Save Constitution rally in Nagpur, Maharashtra, on November 26.
The rally is being organised to protest against the Election Commission of India (ECI) and the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls, according to Dipke's announcement on Wednesday.

title: Union Cabinet Okays Rs 2,014 Crore Doloo Greenfield Airport in Assam's Silchar
description: National | Silchar greenfield airport gets Rs 2,014 crore Cabinet approval. The Doloo project in Assam will handle 1.01 million passengers annually.
author: PratidinTime National Desk
content:
The Union Cabinet on Wednesday approved a new greenfield airport at Doloo in Silchar, Assam, to be built by the Airports Authority of India (AAI) at an estimated cost of Rs 2,014 crore, as the existing facility in the town has little room left to grow.
The proposal was cleared by the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs, chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi. The current Silchar airport operates only as a civil enclave inside a defence-controlled airfield, which restricts its space and operations at a time when passenger numbers are rising steadily.
Union minister Ashwini Vaishnaw, briefing reporters after the meeting, said the project will be funded entirely from AAI's own internal resources. He added that the airport will have an annual capacity of 1.01 million passengers.
The new terminal building will cover 12,351 square metres and handle 800 passengers during peak hours. It will include modern passenger facilities and sustainable green building features, and can be expanded in modules as traffic grows. The project also includes a 2,705-metre-long, 45-metre-wide Code-4C runway suitable for A-320 aircraft, a new apron that can park six A-320 aircraft, and a separate isolation bay.
Doloo lies in Cachar district and sits at the heart of the Barak Valley, a region known for its tea gardens and agro-based industries, and with strong potential for eco and cultural tourism.
The government said the airport will serve growing air traffic in southern Assam and parts of neighbouring states, ease pressure on the existing infrastructure and give a boost to trade and tourism. It is also expected to better link Northeast India to national and international growth corridors.

title: After Spate of Deaths, MP Deploys Medical Teams Outside Liquor Shops
description: National | Medical teams in Madhya Pradesh's Sagar district have begun screening regular liquor consumers outside liquor outlets to identify people.
author: PratidinTime News Desk
content:
Medical teams in Madhya Pradesh's Sagar district have begun screening regular liquor consumers outside liquor outlets to identify people at risk of health complications due to prolonged alcohol consumption.
The initiative follows a series of deaths in the district, including 20 fatalities in a suspected spurious liquor tragedy in September. The campaign involves doctors conducting health check-ups, collecting blood samples and providing medical advice to customers.
According to district authorities, liquor shop operators have been asked to identify their most frequent customers, including those who arrive before outlets open at 8 am. These lists are being used to identify chronic drinkers for medical examinations.
Over the first two days of the campaign, medical teams screened 147 people and collected 144 blood samples for liver and kidney function tests. The screenings were conducted across Sagar, Deori, Rahli, Khurai and Bina.
Chief Medical and Health Officer Dr Devesh Pateria said the exercise had identified several cases of chronic alcoholism and possible liver damage. Medical teams are also providing Vitamin B1 and multivitamin supplements to address nutritional deficiencies.
Collector Dilip Kumar Yadav said the initiative aims to create awareness about the health risks associated with excessive alcohol consumption and encourage people to seek timely medical care.
The administration is also reaching out to habitual drinkers through health centres and village-level visits to expand the screening exercise.

title: Meta Delegation Meets Congress As Protests Intensify Over Content Curbs
description: Senior Meta officials in India met the Congress leaders in a secret meeting here at the party headquarters on Tuesday I National I Top Stories
author: DY365
content:
Meta Delegation Meets Congress As Protests Intensify Over Content Curbs
Sources said the meeting, which lasted for over 40 minutes, marked the first direct interaction between the US technology company and the opposition party since the Youth Congress launched protests against it on Friday.
NEW DELHI: Senior Meta officials in India met Congress leaders in a secret meeting here at the party headquarters on Tuesday in a bid to de-escalate conflict over the social media company's content moderation issues, four sources familiar with the discussions said.
Sources said the meeting, which lasted for over 40 minutes, marked the first direct interaction between the US technology company and the opposition party since the Youth Congress launched protests against it on Friday. The sources did not wish to be identified as the talks were private.
According to one of the sources, Aman Jain and Natasha Jog – who are leaders of Meta's India business – attended.
Concerns on both sides
The Meta executives noted protests around the company's offices and the posters depicting chief executive Mark Zuckerberg in an RSS style uniform, according to the sources.
The Congress leaders had complained of increasing curbs on the accounts and posts of their party leaders. They also made accusations against Meta of having a pro-BJP bias, which the company has refuted.
A source said Meta explained to Congress that some of the removals were due to its policy on AI- generated content. Congress rebutted by referring to AI-generated BJP posts still on the platform and claimed the takedown policy seemed inconsistent.
The Meta spokesperson also said the company made no promises to the party, according to a second source. The executives told Congress that it was obliged to obey local laws, and that it applied these equally to all political parties.
Meta stated that it moderates content in India within the framework of the law. Congress did not respond to a request for comment immediately, while Jain and Jog were not immediately reachable.
Protests spread
The Youth Congress has called on Meta to reinstate accounts that have been removed at the government's instruction and to respond to how its algorithms restrict the dissemination of content. Its activists have also faced off with police outside Meta offices in Hyderabad, Gurugram and Mumbai.
Posters and banners in the familiar RSS attire of grey khaki shorts and black cap showing Zuckerberg in a white shirt have surfaced in Delhi, Kolkata, Patna, Mumbai and Bengaluru. The RSS is the ideological parent of the BJP.
BJP national spokesperson Pradeep Bhandari wrote on X on Saturday that the "Congress model" was to attack offices of private companies.
Sharp rise in takedowns
The row comes as content restrictions surge in Meta's most important market, India, in terms of user numbers. Meta censored over 5.4 million posts or accounts under Indian law in the first half of 2026, according to the company's filings, compared with around 70,000 for all of 2025.
Meta ties the rise to amended IT rules under which it is expected to remove the content at a faster pace and with a greater frequency. The change has sparked a free speech debate as the government increases the pressure to remove the content it finds to be illegal.
Also Read: Assam: Only Part Justice After 19 Years, Says Wife of Murdered PWD Engineer

title: Indian Railways May Scrap RAC Ticket System Amid Digital Changes
description: Indian Railways may scrap the 40-year-old RAC system, which allows two passengers to share a single berth at full fare, citing advancements in digital ticketing. |National | Top Stories|
author: DY365
content:
Indian Railways May Scrap RAC Ticket System Amid Digital Changes
Indian Railways may scrap the 40-year-old RAC system, which allows two passengers to share a single berth at full fare, citing advancements in digital ticketing.
New Delhi: The Indian Railways may discontinue its Reservation Against Cancellation (RAC) facility as senior railway officials believe that digital technology has made the system less important.
Introduced in 1983-84, the RAC system allows two passengers to share a single berth while paying the full ticket fare. It was originally introduced to help waiting-list passengers get accommodation if confirmed ticket holders failed to board their trains.
However, railway officials now believe that digital ticketing systems can manage vacant berths more efficiently without the need for RAC.
According to officials, Train Ticket Examiners (TTEs) use Hand Held Terminals (HHTs), which are directly connected to the railway reservation system. If a passenger does not board the train, the TTE can update the status digitally, making the vacant berth available for another passenger from the next station.
Officials also believe that removing RAC could reduce the chances of irregularities in berth allocation by TTEs. They would be required to complete ticket verification within a fixed time and update the system about passengers who fail to turn up.
The Railways also does not lose revenue when confirmed passengers fail to board, as such passengers are not eligible for refunds under the rules introduced in 2015. The vacant berth can then be offered to another passenger at the full fare.
The Railway Ministry is reportedly examining the proposal. The Parliamentary Public Accounts Committee had earlier recommended giving partial refunds to RAC passengers.

title: Rahul Gandhi Alleges Rajiv Gandhi’s Security Was Withdrawn to Get Him Killed
description: Rahul Gandhi has alleged that his father, former Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi’s security was deliberately withdrawn to facilitate his assassination, during a discussion with Sonia and Priyanka Gandhi.|  Top Stories | Politics|
author: DY365
content:
Rahul Gandhi Alleges Rajiv Gandhi’s Security Was Withdrawn to Get Him Killed
Rahul Gandhi has alleged that his father, former Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi’s security was deliberately withdrawn to facilitate his assassination, during a discussion with Sonia and Priyanka Gandhi about Sonia’s memoir.
New Delhi: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi has alleged that security was deliberately withdrawn from his father, former Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi, which he believes was intentional to get him killed.
Rahul made the statement during a family discussion with his mother, Sonia Gandhi along with sister, Priyanka Gandhi Vadra. They were talking about Sonia Gandhi’s recently released memoir, Belonging: A Journey of Love, which shares personal experiences and important moments from her life.
During the conversation, Sonia Gandhi recalled an incident from Rajiv Gandhi’s visit to Bihar when he was the Leader of the Opposition. She said Rajiv travelled in an open jeep and faced protests, stone-pelting and angry crowds during the tour.
Rahul was with his father during the visit and became very worried about his father's safety. Sonia recalled that after returning home, Rahul warned her that something terrible could happen to his father if his security was not upgraded. He even feared that he might soon have to return home for his father's funeral.
Speaking about the incident, Rahul said he had been concerned about his father's security even before the Bihar visit. He had repeatedly raised the issue and also argued with his father Rajiv Gandhi about it.
Rahul described the Bihar tour as the final warning sign and alleged that the withdrawal of his father's security was a deliberate decision, not an accident.

title: India Transforms from Technology Consumer to Creator, Telecom Sector Leads the Way
description: Union Minister for Communications Jyotiraditya M. Scindia said on Tuesday that over the last decade India has moved from "being a consumer of technology to becoming a creator of technology" with the telecom sector being the most profound example of this achievement.
author: Sentinel Digital Desk
content:
New Delhi: Union Minister for Communications Jyotiraditya M. Scindia said on Tuesday that over the last decade India has moved from "being a consumer of technology to becoming a creator of technology" with the telecom sector being the most profound example of this achievement.
Addressing the Telecom Startups and MSME Conclave 2026 here, the minister said, "Under the leadership of Prime Minister Narendra Modi, today India has risen as the 4th largest economy and market in the world.
From a country that had only a few hundred startups in 2014, India has now gone beyond 2,00,000 startups." (IANS)

title: PM Modi and German Chancellor Friedrich Merz discuss strengthening India-Germany ties in trade, defence, and technology
description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Tuesday received a telephone call from German Chancellor Friedrich Merz, during which the two leaders reviewed the "growing momentum" in the India-Germany Strategic Partnership and discussed avenues for collaboration across multiple domains.
author: Sentinel Digital Desk
content:
New Delhi: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Tuesday received a telephone call from German Chancellor Friedrich Merz, during which the two leaders reviewed the "growing momentum" in the India-Germany Strategic Partnership and discussed avenues for collaboration across multiple domains.
Sharing details on X after the call, PM Modi wrote, "Had a productive conversation with Chancellor Friedrich Merz. We reviewed the growing momentum in the India-Germany Strategic Partnership and discussed ways to unlock new opportunities in trade and investment, defence and advanced technologies."
As per the Prime Minister's Office (PMO), both sides noted with satisfaction the steady progress in bilateral ties and reiterated their resolve to deepen collaboration in priority areas such as defence and advanced technologies, coinciding with the milestone of 75 years of diplomatic relations between India and Germany this year. (ANI)

content:
Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar: Ahead of the forthcoming assembly elections in more than five states, Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) activist Abhijeet Dipke on Tuesday said the public pressure group would ensure that the political discourse remains about issues concerning youth, including eliminating unemployment.
He also announced a major public gathering in Nagpur on November 26 (Constitution Day) against the "compromised" Election Commission of India (ECI) to demand accountability over repeated allegations of "vote theft". Our only goal will be to ensure that the politics of this country and the upcoming elections focus on issues of the youth. (ANI)

title: Maharashtra awards Adani company a contract to supply power using power from another Adani company
description: The government overruled objections from competitors that the group’s company would have access to advantageous information.
author: Shreegireesh Jalihal
content:
In March 2026, the Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Company Limited, or MSEDCL, invited bids for the supply of 2,500 MW of electricity from companies willing to supply uninterrupted power, with a minimum of 51% drawn from traceable green energy.
On the surface, this appeared to be a routine tender. Uninterrupted, or round-the-clock, power packages are becoming increasingly popular in India because, rather than only focus on power generation, they ensure that end users receive a reliable electricity supply.
But documents accessed by Scroll reveal that several competing bidders raised concerns over a possible conflict of interest in the Maharashtra tender.
One of the companies in the fray was Adani Power. Other competing bidders objected to a clause in the tender that said that the winning bidder, as part of its round-the-clock supply package, would be bound to use solar power generated by another Adani-owned firm – Adani Renewable Energy Fifty-Five, which had an existing power-supply contract with MSEDCL.
In a pre-bid meeting that MSEDCL held with interested companies, one of the bidders stated: “We request not to allow the participation of any affiliate or Group company of M/s Adani Renewable Energy Fifty-Five Ltd… as it will create conflict of interest towards bidding in this tender and would provide an unfair advantage to their Affiliate and Group companies.”
Rather than lay out an argument for why this concern was unfounded, MSEDCL merely asserted that “no preferential treatment is provided to Adani Renewable Energy Fifty Five Ltd., or its Affiliate or Group Companies, under the bid documents. Therefore, there is no conflict of interest or unfair advantage to such companies, in case they participate in the bid process.”
It added that “there is no bid related information which is solely available to Adani Renewable Energy Fifty Five Ltd, or its Affiliate or Group Companies”.
Adani Power won the bid. This led to a tripartite agreement between two Adani Group companies and the Maharashtra state-owned firm.
Independent observers echoed concerns raised by the other firms. “When one of the competitors of the auction is responsible for supplying solar power which is part of the auction, then it raises questions about how fair the auction is,” said Dr Priyanshu Gupta, a researcher on coal and energy.
However, an Adani Power spokesperson dismissed these concerns, noting that they “were raised during the pre-bid discussions and were duly clarified by the competent authorities at that stage”.
The spokesperson stated that “Any suggestion that Adani enjoyed an advantageous position vis-à-vis other competing bidders is entirely misconceived and unsupported by the facts. Neither the solar generation profile nor the source of input power from an already-contracted solar project, merely because it happened to be associated with an Adani entity, conferred any advantage to Adani or disadvantage to competitors.”
Calculations by Scroll show that the cost of power to MSEDCL under the triangular arrangement is significantly higher than the cost under a conventional round-the-clock contract awarded earlier this year by a central government-run company to several bidders. It is also significantly higher than a cost estimate for uninterrupted solar power published by the State Bank of India.
MSEDCL did not respond to a request for comment.
The Adani spokesperson stated that the tendering and contracting process were “subject to adjudication by” the Maharashtra Electricity Regulatory Commission, “an independent quasi-judicial regulatory body”. The commission’s “assessment of the process is publicly available and open to scrutiny and challenge through the appropriate legal and regulatory mechanisms”, it added.
Tender-on-tender
The contract to which the March 2026 tender was linked dates back to October 2024. Under that deal, MSEDCL contracted the Adani Group to supply 5,000 MW solar power and 1,600 MW coal-powered electricity to Maharashtra for 25 years.
The solar power component was signed by Adani Renewables Energy Fifty-Five Limited. This firm, wholly owned by Adani Energy Solutions, was incorporated in December 2023, just four months before MSEDCL issued this tender.
Around a year-and-a-half later, MSEDCL issued a fresh tender. This one was for supplying a “round-the-clock” electricity package of 2,500 MW. When a company is contracted to provide such power, even if they rely on solar power, they are obligated to ensure that supply is continuous even when the weather is not sunny.
In this instance, while the deal would bind the winning bidder to supply 51% of the electricity from traceable green energy, the company was free to decide on the source for the remaining 49%. It could, for instance, use a renewable source, battery-stored power, or even thermal power.
Ahead of the bidding, MSEDCL held a meeting with interested companies, at which they could seek clarifications on the process and recommend changes to it. The details of these discussions were published online, with company names redacted – thus concealing information about which companies raised specific queries and concerns.
“The problem with this tripartite tender is that it potentially creates a vexed loop on a tender from two years ago,” Gupta said. “It also raises the question: did companies participating in the 2024 tender know that there will be another tender on top of that one? By issuing another tender on top of that one, the government runs the risk of vitiating the original auction as well.”
Competitors’ objections
MSEDCL’s 2026 tender specified that it would “make available” to the winning bidder 5,000 MW of solar power generated by Adani Renewable Energy Fifty-Five under an earlier contract, which the winning bidder would have to use to put together its round-the-clock supply package.
Overruling concerns about the participation of Adani group companies in the bid, the distributor stated, “the ability to source power under the Executed PPA is available to all bidders and there is no bid related information which is solely available to Adani Renewable Energy Fifty Five Ltd., or its Affiliate or Group Companies that would give rise to a conflict of interest”.
In the pre-bid meeting, some companies specifically asked whether they could use solar power from their own plants instead of Adani’s to fulfill the tender. The distributor overruled this request, making the use of Adani’s solar power supply mandatory for the winning bidder.
Companies also asked for more information about the “generation profile” of the Adani solar power plant that they would be tied down to under the tender. Such a profile comprises data about the amount of power that a plant produces over specific time periods. The information allows competitors to tailor their bids based on cost estimates and other factors dependent on the nature of the supply available to them.
MSEDCL turned down all such requests. It only stated that the Adani company had issued the “relevant consent/no objection” for the use of its power supply.
“How does a company bid without basic information like generation profile?” said Gupta. “If a company does not have access to data like generation profile, then it would not be an open tender anymore. Which will raise questions on whether a truly competitive price was discovered.”
No liability for Adani
Apart from questions about being tied down to Adani’s power supply, competing companies also raised a range of other concerns pertaining to the deal with Adani.
Many noted objections about a clause in the tender that appeared to free the Adani company of any liability if it did not supply the solar power to which the tender was linked. “As per the tender, bidders are permitted to enter into a tripartite agreement with Adani and MSEDCL for the supply of solar power,” one company stated. “However, Clause 5.1.6 absolves the solar supplier (Adani) of any liability on account of non-supply of solar power.”
This clause of the tender document states that “the bidder shall unconditionally commence power supply” from the determined date – but it adds, “In case Solar Power … from MSEDCL is not available due to any transmission constraints by such SSD,” referring to the scheduled supply date, “bidder shall still ensure supply of power under this PPA from the above SSD.”
Many companies pointed out that this was patently unfair – and that, on the one hand, the distributor was tying the companies down to using Adani’s solar power, but on the other hand, not guaranteeing that supply.
The companies demanded that the distributor “allow back-to-back liability sharing with the solar generator for its respective scope” – that is, that if they were obligated to use that supply, the Adani company bear liability for providing the solar power to the winning bidder, who would then bear the responsibility of providing the final supply to MSEDCL.
This was shot down with no explanation, and the line, “Tender conditions will prevail.” Driving this point home, the distributor noted that the bidding company would bear “complete responsibility for meeting RTC supply obligations as per Tender conditions, irrespective of the input solar power availability (5 GW)”.
Battery supply also linked to Adani
This was not the only clause of the tender document that tied bidders to the Adani group. In fact, the highest number of queries pertained to another condition – that if any bidder chose to supply part of the round-the-clock package through a “battery energy storage system”, this system would have to be located “at the same location as the Solar plant” which provided the allocated 5,000 MW of power, Adani’s plant in the village of Khavda, in Gujarat’s Kachchh district.
One company sought to know whether the distributor would provide land for such a plant under the contract if they needed it, “or if the developer is required to arrange the land”.
Another sought to know, “If land at the Adani site is not available, whether BESS” – a battery energy storage system – “installation at an alternate location on the Selected Bidder’s land is permissible while charging from the Adani solar plant, subject to applicable regulations.”
Here too, the power distributor stuck to its terms. It noted that such a storage system would have to be located at Adani’s Gujarat-based plant, and that procuring land to install this technology was “under Supplier’s scope”.
The cost
A closer analysis of the round-the-clock power deal also raises questions about the price that the state distributor agreed to pay for the electricity.
After winning the 2026 tender, Adani Power passed on contractual obligations to Powerpulse Trading Solutions – this was a subsidiary incorporated in February 2024, two months before MSEDCL issued the original tender, to which the 2026 tender was linked.
The resulting 2026 tripartite contract is between MSEDCL, Adani Renewable Energy Fifty-Five Limited and the Adani-owned Powerpulse Trading Solutions.
Under this contract, Adani Renewable Energy Fifty-Five supplies solar power to Adani Power. MSEDCL pays for this power, at Rs 2.7 per kWH, a price discovered from the 2024 auction.
Adani Power’s subsidiary, Powerpulse Trading Solutions, then delivers a round-the-clock package to MSEDCL. This supply is priced at Rs 5.9 per kWH, discovered in the 2026 auction – but since MSEDCL has already paid for the solar component to Adani Power, it subtracts Rs 2.7 per kWH from this payment.
The total cost to MSEDCL, then, is the same contracted rate of Rs 5.9 per kWH. Powerpulse is bound under the deal to guarantee a minimum of 80% of the contracted supply each year.
In June 2026, the Maharashtra Electricity Regulatory Commission issued an order approving of this tariff. The regulator noted that the tender in question was “unique and bespoke” and that “there are no recent tenders of similar construct, scale, risk allocation and performance obligations that have been awarded through tariff‑based competitive bidding”.
It compared the discovered tariff of Rs 5.90/kWh with one earlier Adani Group round-the-clock renewable energy tariff, of Rs 6.38 Rs/kWh, as well as numerous other thermal power supply tariffs. Referring to the latter, the regulator noted, “The discovered tariff of Rs. 5.90/kWh under the subject tender compares favorably with the above approved thermal levelized tariffs ranging from Rs 6.31/kWh to Rs 8.90/kWh, despite higher risk obligations on the supplier.” Thus, the regular granted its approval to the tariff.
But another recent round-the-clock tender resulted in a significantly lower price, even compared to the round-the-clock tariff the regulator considered. This tender was issued by the central government company the Solar Energy Corporation of India, for 1,000 MW of round-the-clock solar power – the price discovered in the process was between Rs 5.25 and Rs 5.26 per unit.
After that tender, contracts were awarded to seven developers. Juniper Green Energy and Hexa Climate Solutions were contracted to supply 230 MW and 150 MW respectively at Rs 5.26 per unit. Five other companies – Kengeri Prime Solar Power, Resolven Four Energy, Hero Solar Energy, EMIF II Holding and Purvah Green Power – were contracted for the remaining 620 MW at Rs 5.25 per unit. Under this tender, companies have to specifically use battery storage systems to ensure round-the-clock supply, and are bound to guarantee that they will supply at least 90% of the contracted energy each year.
The rate of Rs 5.9 per kWH under the tripartite agreement is 12.38% higher than the Rs 5.25 tariff discovered in SECI’s tender.
Using the 80% annual supply requirement in the MSEDCL contract as a basis for comparison, 2,500 MW would correspond to around 17.52 billion units of electricity a year. At MSEDCL’s Rs 5.90 tariff, that would amount to roughly Rs 2,58,400 crore over 25 years – the duration of the contract. At SECI’s Rs 5.25-Rs 5.26 tariff, the same quantity of electricity would cost around Rs 2,30,000 crore – approximately Rs 28,400 crore less.
An April 2026 analysis by the State Bank of India’s Centre of Excellence provides another figure for comparison. The analysis examines the economics of supplying renewable electricity around the clock using combinations of solar, wind and storage. The report presents such systems as an emerging way of providing reliable renewable power, rather than simply selling intermittent solar or wind electricity.
The SBI analysis provides an even lower benchmark under one of the round-the-clock configurations it examines, of Rs 4.70 per unit. At that price, the same 2,500 MW contract and assumed volume would cost roughly Rs 2,06,000 crore over 25 years – around Rs 52,000 crore less than the cost at the Rs 5.90 tariff approved for MSEDCL.
Gupta argued that the SBI calculations provided a reasonable estimate of the cost of round-the-clock power supply. “Costs for generating solar round-the-clock have fallen considerably,” he said. “I agree with the price estimate that SBI Centre for Excellence calculated.”
Power for data centres
In its order approving the tender, the electricity regulator noted that a key factor that MSEDCL cited in support of its request was that the state was “promoting data centres and other sunshine industries to support economic growth”. It noted, “Data centers, cloud computing, and AI have a massive energy footprint.”
It also explicitly singled out data centres as the intended consumers of this renewable power. “Expected end consumers of this RTC power are Data Centres for which the Traceable Green Power supply is mandatory for sustainability reporting and/or public disclosure,” it said.
The Adani Group has emerged as India’s largest player in setting up data centres. These include centres in Maharashtra – in 2024 and 2026, the group signed deals with the government to set up large renewable-energy-powered data centres in the state.
Adani Group’s disclosures to stock markets record electricity purchases by the group data centre arm from Powerpulse Trading Solutions, the Adani Power subsidiary that is fulfilling the Maharashtra round-the-clock tender. Scroll was unable to independently verify if these power purchases are from the tripartite agreement or from other Adani Group contracts.

title: Founder’s story: How Harsh Parikh cofounded DRiefcase, an online platform for saving health records
description: An excerpt from ‘Strivers: Balancing Success and Meaningfulness’, by Upasna A Agarwal, Arvind N Agrawal, and Usha Sunderarajan.
author: Upasna A Agarwal
content:
Harsh Parikh is a CA-turned-MBA from IIM-Bangalore. After working with Merrill Lynch as an investment banker for ten years, he co-founded DRiefcase Health Tech Pvt. Ltd. The mission of the organisation is to help citizens with safe and on-the-go access to their health records. Having online health records saves a lot of time for patients when they visit their doctors, resulting in an increase in productivity. DRiefcase has now partnered with Google Wallet to make ABHA (Ayushman Bharat Health Account) cards easily accessible to users.
Harsh was born into a business family and neither parent was a graduate. Because of this, his parents were very keen that he study well. Harsh was an academically bright student in school. While studying for a graduate degree, he also decided to become a CA (Chartered Accountant) because CA could be done alongside graduation. The fact that both his brothers-in-law were CAs also pushed him in that direction. Thus, Harsh completed his CA and internship along with his graduation.
However, Harsh was not too impressed with the CA degree – he believed that it “existed in the sixties” and had not evolved. Besides, he was not interested in audit or taxation. He knew that in 2002–03, there were not too many exciting jobs available to CAs. The next option was a management degree. Harsh appeared for the CAT and joined IIM Bangalore in 2004.
After IIM, Harsh was inclined towards a job in investment banking or consulting. His family wanted him to be in India, so unlike many of his classmates who were opting to go abroad, he looked for opportunities in India. Harsh got an offer from Merrill Lynch and joined them. He had a reason for choosing investment banking over consulting.
As a consultant rose in seniority, they would be required to get business for the company, and this would involve a lot of travel. Harsh wanted to make life easier for himself, not harder, as he grew older, and that tilted the decision in favour of investment banking.
A typical career path for an investment banker is to start as an analyst, and then become an associate, a vice president, a director and finally a managing director within a period of 11 to 12 years.
In 2006, Harsh, being an MBA, joined as a third-year analyst. He received a good rating every year and was in the top two or three in his batch. Between 2006 and 2008, several investment banking companies set up shop in India. Some of the vice presidents working with Merrill Lynch left to join these companies. Therefore, a lot of work that the seniors had handled was now available to juniors like Harsh.
He got an opportunity to perform high-level jobs and rose quickly in the organisation. He was doing well financially too and earning large bonuses and increments – not 10–15%, but 40–50%. Despite this, Harsh would tell himself every year that he was “done” and wanted to hang up his boots but continued working only for the money.
In Harsh’s words, though he was “not born with a silver spoon”, his father had started doing well and by the time he was 15, he realised the advantages of having money. So he stayed on for ten years, earned well and spent freely on himself and his family, like taking impromptu holidays. As he progressed in the organisation, he also had the freedom to choose his projects and that made work interesting for him.
By 2014, he had become a director in the bank. Harsh had enough savings and realised that money has diminishing marginal utility. He felt burnt out. He also knew that in a pyramidal organisational structure, he would have to “play games” and keep some people happy to rise further, and he did not like doing that. To him, it seemed like internal canvassing with people at the top. He states that he could have done that, but did not because, by his own admission, he was not ambitious and needed very little to be happy.
He had no vision of becoming the CEO of a Fortune 500 company at the age of 50. Given a task, he would do it well, but it was not to gain something for himself. He wanted to be with his family, keep himself fit and have his share of “me time”. In 2013, his father had a heart attack, and he had to look after him while delivering results at the office. All these experiences nudged him towards quitting his job. He had also reached a phase where he had stopped comparing himself with other batchmates and what they were doing.
When the time came to take a decision about his job and set up DRiefcase with Sohit, he jumped at the chance. Sohit was his senior from IIMB and a colleague at Merrill Lynch. Harsh admits that had Sohit not approached him, he might have joined another organisation. DRiefcase was established with the objective of maintaining online medical records for individuals, which were secure and easy to access. This ensured that a person’s full medical history was available when they went to visit a doctor.
Between December 2015 and May 2016, Harsh and Sohit spent time working out a strategy for DRiefcase. It was also the time his daughter was born, and he was happy spending time with the newborn. When Harsh started the business, he got a lot of support from family and friends, especially when times were bad. Co-founding DRiefcase was a humbling experience for him.
In his own words, he was a “CEO and chaprasi”. He had to get off his high horse and do everything with his own hands. Earlier, his colleagues were management graduates, IIT gold medallists and CA rankers. Harsh believes that the start-up experience has made him a better person. The Harsh of Merrill Lynch had a bad temper and believed in perfection. Today, he believes in Wabi-sabi and that one should not seek perfection at any cost. He is now patient and more willing to listen to others and interact with them. Besides, he has the advantage of being able to spend more time with his family.
Harsh and Sohit have now managed DRiefcase for more than nine years. He was never worried about the business not working out and having to go back to corporate life because he had enough savings and a good CV. He had invested his money wisely and the stock market had done well. He did not need to dip into his savings and spent only what he earned. Other classmates were doing better financially and professionally but that did not affect Harsh.
His experience at Merrill Lynch has stood Harsh in good stead. It has given him a sense of perspective in DRiefcase and how to deal with people and business. Harsh states that it is with good reason that Harvard Business School accepts people with work experience because that ensures that they have experienced organizational life before they study business management.
Today, DRiefcase is growing and many teething problems have been sorted out. Harsh and Sohit have done well for their employees and customers. Every day, one lakh tokens are generated. This means that they are saving 1–2 hours of time for one lakh people, especially hourly paid workers, resulting in better productivity for the country. The software is also very useful and has been deployed by the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission. DRiefcase is now at a critical juncture, having been through three rounds of funding.
Harsh gives himself 4 on success and according to him, it can never be a 5. This is because he wants to “give back to society”, which he has not been able to do so far. His next venture is likely to be in the social sector – either starting an NGO or joining an NGO to do social work.
On meaningfulness, he gives himself a 5. They have employees in DRiefcase who joined them on day one, straight out of college, with not a care in the world. Today, they are married, have taken loans to buy vehicles and have settled down in life. Harsh states that he and the company played a role in making that happen, and that makes life meaningful for him.
Harsh would like to tell fresh graduates that perseverance is important and one should not look for instant gratification. One needs to be “at it” because results do not appear instantaneously. A lesson Harsh’s father had taught him early in life was that one should focus on one’s responsibilities before claiming one’s rights. The reward for doing one’s job will eventually come. You just need to be patient. This advice has remained with him till date.
Also, while it is good to rise quickly in an organisation and make money, because it allows you to have options, Harsh warns that eventually, life catches up and one needs to slow down. If you achieve everything by the time you are 40, then what would you do for the rest of your career?
Excerpted with permission from Strivers: Balancing Success and Meaningfulness, Upasna A Agarwal, Arvind N Agrawal, and Usha Sunderarajan, Penguin India.

title: The nine best books with yearning protagonists for readers who are pining
description: Yearning is a tradition that has flourished in English literature since 18th-century romanticism, a movement that celebrated the personal and the emotional.
author: Sarah Olive, The Conversation
content:
There is nothing like the agonising yet delicious slow burn of wanting someone you cannot have. Yearning is behind many great romance tropes, from the tragedy of “right person, wrong time” to the tension of “will they, won’t they”.
The cultural critic bell hooks saw yearning as a universal human condition, which could range from a “passionate collective longing for peace and justice” to an individual longing for a lover.
Yearning is a tradition that has flourished in English literature since 18th-century romanticism, a movement that celebrated the personal and the emotional. For such bittersweet desire to take root, there must be a significant hurdle that makes togetherness seem unattainable. That obstacle can take many forms: unrequited affection, painful shyness, or forces external to the pair.
In literature, these commonly include social stigma, geographical distance and mortality. Whatever the barrier, both it and the longing between the two characters must endure. Suspended between memory and fantasy, caught between a lost past and an imagined future, yearning should consume vast amounts of time and energy. The author must allow the reader to access the inner workings of the pining protagonist, so we can sit with their ache and share it.
If you are ready to luxuriate in the angst, here are nine books to pine over.
Eugene Onegin by Alexander Pushkin (1833)
Two of the book’s characters experience yearning and rejection: cosmopolitan Onegin and country girl Tatyana. Moreover, both characters get a turn at being the pursuer and the pursued in their taut encounters.
Pushkin wrote in Russian. English-language translations variously convey the book’s historic and contemporary qualities.
But if they smack too much of the 19th-century for you, try Clémentine Beauvais’ young adult reimagining, In Paris with You (2018). It transposes the story to 21st-century France. Like the original, it tells the story through the medium of poetry, rather than prose.
Love in the Time of Cholera by Gabriel García Márquez (1985)
García Márquez won the Nobel Prize for Literature in 1982. But the yearning in this Colombian novel deserves an endurance award of its own.
Rejected by the beautiful, young Fermina Daza, trainee telegraph operator Florentino Ariza nevertheless continues to love her for 51 years, nine months and four days.
This does not, however, prevent him from having an enjoyable sex life over the decades. In depicting this, the book underscores that yearning and sexual desire are not synonymous. It is just one way in which the book offers an ultimately hopeful take on an initially tortuous experience.
Bel Canto by Ann Patchett (2001)
Also set in South America, the action of Bel Canto is condensed into a few months rather than half a century. Events feel further compressed as they occur under a single roof, in an embassy full of guests taken hostage by revolutionaries.
The hostages are initially kept in cramped conditions, under the watchful eyes of the guards. Language barriers abound as captives from an array of nations work through a single translator. For these reasons, the relationships smoulder before consummation.
Some of the yearnings arise within the group of hostages, others between hostages and their captors. However, they are not limited to the sexual or romantic. They include longings for freedom, home and the characters’ previously mundane lives.
The Gift of Rain by Tan Twan Eng (2007)
Malaysian novelist Tan Twan Eng should earn a triple entry in this list because yearning is a staple of his writing.
The longings in three of his books (The Gift of Rain, The Garden of Evening Mists and The House of Doors) eschew yearning that is narrowly romantic or erotic for something more ambiguous.
The stories are steeped in the complex social and political contexts of their setting in colonial and wartime Malaya. The yearnings are straight and queer, familial and national, and treacherous for the characters in both political and personal ways.
The Painted Veil by Somerset Maugham (1925)
Eng’s novel The House of Doors takes inspiration from Somerset Maugham’s life and works. These include The Letter (1926) and The Painted Veil (1925). That book gets its own entry here for its plot of yearning that jumps tracks from the selfish to the selfless, the unworthy to the worthwhile.
That may sound moralistic, but the novel mines many grey areas as young socialite Kitty Fane searches for meaning in her life as a doctor’s wife in cholera-ridden rural China.
There’s also a gorgeous film adaptation from 2006 to enjoy once you’ve read the book.
Under the Udala Trees by Chinelo Okparanta (2015)
Yearning is a characteristic strongly associated with queer literature. This is unsurprising given the legal, religious and cultural prohibitions of, and discrimination against, same-sex relationships.
The publication of homoerotic literature in such contexts required that authors finely balance expression and suppression. Building on hooks’ work, literature professor Elleke Boehmer argues that a “rarefied intensity of desire” emerges in repressive contexts.
Under the Udala Trees is set in one such context, the 1960s Nigerian civil war. The protagonist, Ijeoma, pines first for a classmate, then for a customer. Yet arguably her greatest longing is for self-acceptance and her mother’s acceptance of her sexuality.
The End of the Affair by Graham Greene (1951)
The heart-wrenching yearning in this novel comes in the aftermath of an ecstatic affair, with writer Maurice still pining for married Sarah Miles.
Maurice assumes Sarah has forsaken him for her dutiful but dull husband, Henry. But the eventual plot twist that follows is sharper than a hairpin bend.
The novel is one of several by Greene with a strong Catholic focus. As such, the lovers’ relationships with God form a second triangle in this book. Ultimately, Maurice discovers his true rival is not Henry, but the Almighty himself, transforming an obsessive tale of earthly adultery into an agonising collision between human desire and divine grace.
Wuthering Heights by Emily Brontë (1847)
“Haunt me then … drive me mad! Only do not leave me in this abyss, where I cannot find you!”
Wuthering Heights is a tale of dark, destructive yearning across several generations of the same two families. It is also widely found on school curricula, so film versions abound. These include Emerald Fennell’s 2026 movie released to coincide with Valentine’s Day, proving that the novel’s afterlife is as perverse as its plot and characters.
If you’re looking for a barrier to true love rooted more explicitly in the supernatural, Stephanie Meyer’s third novel in the Twilight saga, Eclipse (2007), draws strongly on Brontë’s love-triangle classic.
Mr Loverman by Bernadine Evaristo (2013)
This novel is a reminder that you are never too old to yearn. Or perhaps, that age is a spur to acting on your feelings. Mr Loverman vies with Love in a Time of Cholera for endurance but exhibits a lighter, more worldly-wise tone throughout.
It spans greater distances, from Antigua to Hackney. Barrington’s wife suspects he is consumed with extramarital passion. She manages to indict most of their acquaintances, except the real object of his affection. The book is unashamedly humorous and poignant. The BBC adapted it as a miniseries in 2024.
This article first appeared on The Conversation.
Sarah Olive, Senior Lecturer in Literature, Aston University.

title: MP के रीवा में जमीन, जल और भविष्य की लड़ाई के बीच ग्रामीणों ने नहीं मनाई दीपावली, घरों में नहीं जले दीये!
description: प्रस्तावित न्यूक्लियर प्लांट के विरोध में रोझौही और सरई कला के ग्रामीणों का अनोखा विरोध; विमला कोल की मौत के बाद परिवार की पहली दीपावली रही सूनी, ग्रामीण बोले- जमीन और आने वाली पीढ़ियों का भविष्य ज्यादा अहम
author: Ankit Pachauri
content:
भोपाल। दीपावली पर जहां हर घर रोशनी से जगमगा रहा था, बच्चे पटाखे चला रहे थे और परिवार त्योहार की खुशियां बांट रहे थे, वहीं मध्य प्रदेश के रीवा जिले के रोझौही और सरई कला क्षेत्र में इस बार दीपावली का माहौल बिल्कुल अलग रहा। यहां कई घरों में न तो दीपावली की तैयारियां हुईं और न ही दीये जलाकर त्योहार मनाया गया। प्रस्तावित न्यूक्लियर प्लांट के विरोध में आंदोलन कर रहे ग्रामीणों ने अपनी जमीन, पानी और आने वाली पीढ़ियों के भविष्य की चिंता को त्योहार से ऊपर रखा और दीपावली नहीं मनाने का फैसला किया।
ग्रामीणों का यह विरोध सिर्फ प्रस्तावित परियोजना के खिलाफ नहीं, बल्कि अपने जल, जंगल, जमीन और पर्यावरण को बचाने की चिंता से भी जुड़ा है। इस बीच विमला कोल की मौत ने आंदोलन के दर्द को और गहरा कर दिया। परिवार के लिए यह पहली दीपावली थी, जब घर में विमला मौजूद नहीं थीं।
पत्नी की यादों के बीच जमुना कोल की सूनी दीपावली
विमला कोल के पति जमुना कोल के लिए इस बार दीपावली का त्योहार बेहद दुखद रहा। जिस घर में पत्नी के साथ त्योहार की खुशियां बांटनी थीं, वहां इस बार उनकी यादें ही रह गईं। आंदोलन के दौरान विमला की तबीयत बिगड़ने के बाद अस्पताल में मौत हो गई थी।
परिवार और ग्रामीणों का दावा था कि विमला जल सत्याग्रह में शामिल थीं और कई दिनों से तालाब में उतरकर प्रस्तावित परियोजना का विरोध कर रही थीं। हालांकि, उनकी मौत की परिस्थितियों को लेकर प्रशासन और परिवार के अलग-अलग दावे सामने आए थे।
तत्कालीन कलेक्टर नरेंद्र सूर्यवंशी ने कहा था कि विमला जल सत्याग्रह में शामिल नहीं थीं और नित्यकर्म के दौरान गिरने से उनकी मौत हुई थी। वहीं, परिवार और ग्रामीणों ने उनकी मौत को आंदोलन के दौरान हुई परेशानियों से जोड़कर देखा। विमला की मौत के बाद नेता प्रतिपक्ष उमंग सिंघार ने परिवार से मुलाकात कर एक लाख रुपये की आर्थिक सहायता भी दी थी।
बच्चों के भविष्य की चिंता
आंदोलन में शामिल संदीप कोल ने कहा कि दीपावली ऐसा त्योहार है, जिसे हर परिवार अपने घर में खुशियों के साथ मनाना चाहता है। लेकिन जब अपनी जमीन और भविष्य को लेकर चिंता हो, तो त्योहार मनाने का मन नहीं होता। हमारी आजीविका जमीन से जुड़ी है। हम चाहते हैं कि आने वाली पीढ़ियों के लिए यह जमीन सुरक्षित रहे।
रावेंद्र कोल ने कहा कि गांव के लोगों के लिए जमीन और पानी सबसे जरूरी हैं। प्रस्तावित प्लांट से इन पर क्या असर पड़ेगा, इसकी स्पष्ट जानकारी ग्रामीणों को नहीं दी गई है। जब तक लोगों की आशंकाओं का समाधान नहीं होता, तब तक विरोध जारी रहेगा।
वहीं, बबली कोल ने कहा कि दीपावली बच्चों के लिए खुशियों का त्योहार है, लेकिन इस बार गांव के लोगों ने अपने भविष्य की चिंता को प्राथमिकता दी है। हम नहीं चाहते कि आने वाली पीढ़ियों को अपनी जमीन और अधिकार बचाने के लिए संघर्ष करना पड़े।
440 मेगावाट की प्रस्तावित परियोजना
रोझौही और सरई कला क्षेत्र में टाटा पावर से जुड़ी 2×220 मेगावाट क्षमता की प्रस्तावित न्यूक्लियर परियोजना को लेकर ग्रामीणों में नाराजगी है। परियोजना की शुरुआती तकनीकी जांच के लिए एमएस फुग्रो की दो बोरिंग मशीनें क्षेत्र में पहुंची थीं।
योजना के तहत कुल आठ बोरहोल किए जाने थे। इनमें से चार बोरहोल करीब 100 मीटर गहराई तक प्रस्तावित थे। हालांकि, ग्रामीणों ने सर्वे का विरोध करते हुए काम रुकवा दिया था।
9 अक्टूबर को कंपनी, प्रशासन और ग्रामीणों के बीच हुई बैठक भी बेनतीजा रही थी। ग्रामसभा में भी परियोजना के प्रस्ताव पर ग्रामीणों ने असहमति जताई थी। ग्रामीणों का कहना है कि परियोजना को लेकर उनकी आशंकाओं और सवालों का जवाब दिए बिना आगे की प्रक्रिया नहीं बढ़ाई जानी चाहिए।
कोटी जलप्रपात को बचाने की मांग, आंदोलन जारी
सामाजिक कार्यकर्ता और आंदोलनकारी शिवानंद द्विवेदी ने बताया कि ग्रामीणों का विरोध किसी भी विकास कार्य के खिलाफ नहीं है। उनकी चिंता जल, जंगल, जमीन और पर्यावरण को लेकर है। ग्रामीण चाहते हैं कि परियोजना से होने वाले संभावित प्रभावों की जानकारी सार्वजनिक की जाए और उनकी आपत्तियों का समाधान किया जाए।
उन्होंने कहा कि ग्रामीण अपने अधिकारों और आने वाली पीढ़ियों के भविष्य को लेकर चिंतित हैं। प्रस्तावित न्यूक्लियर प्लांट को निरस्त करने और क्षेत्र के प्राकृतिक महत्व वाले कोटी जलप्रपात को बचाने की मांग के साथ आंदोलन जारी है।
द मूकनायक की प्रीमियम और चुनिंदा खबरें अब द मूकनायक के न्यूज़ एप्प पर पढ़ें। Google Play Store से न्यूज़ एप्प इंस्टाल करने के लिए यहां क्लिक करें.
'द मूकनायक' जनवादी पत्रकारिता करता है. यह संविधान, लोकतंत्र और सामाजिक न्याय पर चलने वाला मीडिया समूह है। अगर आप भी चाहते हैं कि 'द मूकनायक' हमेशा हाशिए पर खड़े लोगों की आवाज बुलंद करता रहे, बेजुबानों की पीड़ा दिखाते रहें तो सब्सक्राइब करें।
