title: Tanker carrying 8 Indians sinks near Spain, all crew rescued before vessel goes down
description: Eight Indian seafarers were evacuated to a hospital in Spain before MT MED AMRE sank Authorities are monitoring their medical care and remain in contact with the crew manager
author: India Today News Desk
content:
Tanker carrying 8 Indians sinks near Spain, all crew rescued before vessel goes down
Eight Indian seafarers were evacuated to a hospital in Spain before MT MED AMRE sank. Authorities are monitoring their medical care and remain in contact with the crew manager.
A tanker carrying eight Indian seafarers sank near Spain on Wednesday, with all crew members safely evacuated and taken to a hospital for medical care, Union Shipping Minister Sarbananda Sonowal said on Thursday.
The vessel, MT MED AMRE, sank after the crew abandoned it, Sonowal said, confirming that all eight Indian seafarers aboard were safe.
"All 8 Indian crew members are safe and have been evacuated to the nearest hospital in Spain for medical care," the minister said in a post on X.
INDIAN CREW EVACUATED BEFORE TANKER SANK
The seafarers abandoned the tanker before it sank, ensuring that all eight crew members were rescued safely, according to Sonowal.
The minister said authorities were closely monitoring the situation and were in contact with the crew manager to ensure the seafarers continued to receive medical assistance and support.
"We are continuously monitoring the situation and remain in close contact with the crew manager to ensure the ongoing safety, medical assistance and wellbeing of our seafarers," he added.
OTHER RECENT INCIDENTS INVOLVING INDIAN SEAFARERS
A tanker carrying three Indian seafarers was targeted in a projectile attack in the Persian Gulf while approaching the Strait of Hormuz on November 18. The Liberia-flagged crude oil tanker, MT NAVIG8 MESSI, came under attack, but all three Indians and the vessel's entire crew were reported safe.
Union Shipping Minister Sarbananda Sonowal said one Indian officer was shifted to a hospital for first-aid treatment and medical evaluation. He said the government was monitoring the situation and remained in contact with the ship management company to ensure the crew's safety, medical care and well-being.
The incident was among several attacks involving vessels carrying Indian seafarers in the region. On November 16, Panama-flagged LPG tanker MT TARA GAS, carrying 24 Indians, was targeted in a missile attack in the Strait of Hormuz. Twenty-one Indian nationals were evacuated to Khasab in Oman, two injured crew members were hospitalised, and one seafarer remained missing, according to the Ministry of External Affairs.

title: Hindi-Chini bhai-bhai to bye-bye: Tharoor's 1962 reference to jab China-Pak collab
description: Shashi Tharoor invoked the 1962 India-China war and the collapse of the 039Hindi-Chini bhai-bhai039 bonhomie to caution India against drawing lessons from the growing China-Pakistan friendship following Islamabad039s space collaboration with Beijing
author: India Today News Desk
content:
Hindi-Chini bhai-bhai to bye-bye: Tharoor's 1962 reference to jab China-Pak collab
Shashi Tharoor invoked the 1962 India-China war and the collapse of the 'Hindi-Chini bhai-bhai' bonhomie to caution India against drawing lessons from the growing China-Pakistan friendship following Islamabad's space collaboration with Beijing.
As China and Pakistan marked a new chapter in their space partnership, and a section of the Internet celebrates ties, the Congress MP Shashi Tharoor took a swipe at the narrative around the bonhomie, recalling how the once-celebrated 'Hindi-Chini bhai-bhai' slogan gave way to hostility after the 1962 war.
Responding to a post on X about Pakistani astronaut Zeeshan Ali's arrival at China's Tiangong space station, which suggested India should "learn a lesson" from the China-Pakistan bonhomie, Tharoor said India had "been there, done that", adding that no relationship was worth surrendering one's self-respect.
The post, which shared a video of the Pakistani astronaut singing the Chinese pop anthem The Same Song, celebrated the China-Pakistan partnership and suggested that India, described as an "estranged neighbour", should learn a lesson or two from the relationship.
Responding to it, Tharoor said India had once witnessed a similar bonhomie with China.
"We've 'been there, done that'. It was called 'Hindi-Chini bhai-bhai'. That's before 1962, when it became 'Hindi-Chini bye-bye'. No relationship is worth the surrender of your self-respect," the Thiruvananthapuram MP said.
Tharoor's remarks appeared to draw a parallel between the enthusiasm surrounding China-Pakistan cooperation and India's own history of diplomatic engagement with Beijing.
The slogan "Hindi-Chini bhai-bhai", meaning Indians and Chinese are brothers, was popularised during a period of warmth between New Delhi and Beijing in the 1950s. However, the relationship suffered a major rupture following the 1962 India-China war, turning the slogan into a symbol of the collapse of diplomatic goodwill.
His remark was a caution against viewing strategic partnerships solely through the lens of diplomatic symbolism, stressing that relations with another country should not come at the cost of national dignity or self-respect.
The comments came after Zeeshan Ali became the first Pakistani to reach orbit, travelling aboard China's Shenzhou 24 spacecraft to the Tiangong space station.
Ali, a 40-year-old Pakistan Air Force pilot and payload specialist, was welcomed by the Chinese crew in what Beijing described as its first foreign "space handshake". His arrival marked a significant step in China's efforts to expand international participation in its space programme as the International Space Station approaches the end of its operational life.
China-Pakistan cooperation has increasingly extended into space, with Beijing having launched Pakistani satellites and the two countries pursuing further joint projects. A Pakistani-built rover is also expected to fly on a Chinese lunar mission around 2028.

title: Bihar man shot dead in revenge after his brother elopes with village woman
description: Four armed men entered victim Alok Kumar Singh039s home in Saran and shot him dead Protecting him his father was also injured Police suspect the attack arose from a prolonged dispute over his brother039s love marriage
author: India Today News Desk
content:
Bihar man shot dead in revenge after his brother elopes with village woman
Four armed men entered victim Alok Kumar Singh's home in Saran and shot him dead. Protecting him, his father was also injured. Police suspect the attack arose from a prolonged dispute over his brother's love marriage.
A 30-year-old man was shot dead by four armed assailants who barged into his house in Bihar's Saran district on Wednesday, over a dispute linked to a love affair that began two-and-a-half years ago. His father was also injured in the attack.
The incident took place in Naini village. The deceased was identified as Alok Kumar Singh. His father Jitendra Kumar Singh, also sustained injuries and is undergoing treatment at Chhapra Sadar Hospital.
According to the victim's family, Alok was cleaning his house at around 11 am on Wednesday when four armed men entered and opened fire at him. His father, Jitendra Singh, was shot when he tried to intervene. He was also seriously injured in an attack with a sharp-edged weapon.
Hearing the gunshots, villagers rushed to the spot and took the two injured men to Chhapra Sadar Hospital, where doctors declared Alok dead. Jitendra Singh is undergoing treatment.
LOVE AFFAIR AT THE CENTRE OF DISPUTE
The family said the dispute stemmed from a love affair involving Alok's younger brother, Abhishek Kumar, which began around two-and-a-half years ago. Abhishek later left home with a girl from the village, and the two got married. They also have a child.
The relationship and marriage reportedly led to a prolonged dispute between the two families. Following the conflict, other members of Abhishek's family also left the village and began living elsewhere.
Jitendra Singh, who works in Gujarat, had returned to his ancestral home around two years after the family left the village to attend a marriage ceremony. While Abhishek works in Noida, Alok was employed at a hotel in Agra.
POLICE INVESTIGATING, SEARCH ON FOR ACCUSED
Following the incident, SDPO Sadar Sumit Shekhar reached Chhapra Sadar Hospital and spoke to the deceased's family about the attack. He assured them of action.
The SDPO said preliminary information suggested the murder was linked to a dispute over a love affair. Alok had sustained two bullet injuries, while his father was seriously injured.
Police teams are investigating the incident and are stationed at the scene and the hospital. Efforts are underway to identify and arrest the accused.

title: 4 killed, 6 injured as van carrying wedding guests crashes into lorry in Andhra Pradesh
description: Four people were killed and six injured after a van carrying 11 wedding guests rammed into a parked lorry on NH-67 in Andhra Pradesh’s Anantapur district. | India News
author: Srinivasa Rao Apparasu
content:
Srinivasa Rao is Senior Assistant Editor based out of Hyderabad covering developments in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana . He has over three decades of reporting experience.
4 killed, 6 injured as van carrying wedding guests crashes into lorry in Andhra Pradesh
Four people were killed and six injured after a van carrying 11 wedding guests rammed into a parked lorry on NH-67 in Andhra Pradesh’s Anantapur district.
At least four people were killed and six others seriously injured after a van carrying 11 people rammed into a stationary lorry on National Highway-67 in Andhra Pradesh’s Anantapur district in the early hours of Thursday, police said.
The accident took place near Rayalacheruvu village in Yadiki mandal. The occupants were returning to their native villages in Tadipatri mandal after attending a wedding in Hyderabad.
“The group comprised 11 people, including family members, relatives and friends from Kaveti Samudram and Nandalapadu villages,” Tadipatri deputy superintendent of police (DSP) M Chandrasekhar told reporters.
According to preliminary information, the group attended the wedding in Hyderabad and began their return journey in a Toofan vehicle on Wednesday night.
“When the vehicle reached the Rayalacheruvu stretch of NH-67 in the early hours of Thursday, it rammed into a lorry parked on the roadside. The impact was severe, leaving four occupants dead on the spot and injuring six others,” he said.
The deceased were identified as Midde Hanumantha Reddy (31), Suhasini (26), Mallikarjuna Shetty (30) and Midde Veeranjaneyulu Reddy (52). The injured were shifted to a nearby hospital for treatment, while the bodies were taken to a government hospital for postmortem examinations.
Police personnel rushed to the spot after receiving information about the accident and launched rescue operations.
“We have registered a case at Tadipatri police station and launched an investigation into the circumstances leading to the accident,” Chandrasekhar said.
State roads and buildings minister Mandipalli Ramprasad Reddy expressed shock and grief over the incident and conveyed his condolences to the bereaved families.
The minister also sought details from officials about the treatment being provided to the injured. He directed them to ensure that the victims received the best possible medical care and that all necessary facilities were made available without delay.

title: 'Abdul Will Be Deputy CM': Chandrashekhar Azad's Big Promise To Muslims If Morcha Wins UP
description: Chandrashekhar Azad promised a Muslim leader and a backward community leader Deputy CM posts if his alliance wins the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections.
author: Yimkumla Longkumer, News Desk
content:
'Abdul Will Be Deputy CM': Chandrashekhar Azad's Big Promise To Muslims If Morcha Wins UP
Chandrashekhar Azad promised a Muslim leader and a backward community leader Deputy CM posts if his alliance wins the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections.
Azad Samaj Party (Kanshi Ram) president and Nagina MP Chandrashekhar Azad on Thursday promised that a Muslim leader, whom he referred to as ‘Abdul’, would become Deputy Chief Minister if the Samajik Parivartan Morcha forms the next government in Uttar Pradesh after the 2027 Assembly elections. He also promised a Deputy CM post to a leader from the backward communities.
Addressing the alliance’s ‘Bahujan Swaraj Sankalp Maharally‘ in Lucknow on Constitution Day, Azad said the Muslim leader would share power with him, adding that the community would no longer have to remain politically dependent on others.
- Of Beards, Biryani And 'B Teams': Owaisi's 'Pledge' To Azam Khan's Jibe, How The UP Poll Battle Is Shaping Up
- 'Hyderabadi Biryani Is Not Preferred Here': Azam Khan's Swipe At Owaisi As UP Poll Battle Heats Up
- UP Elections 2027: Allies Turn Up The Heat As NDA, INDIA Bloc Begin Seat-Sharing Talks
- Congress Boasts Of ‘Strong Alliance’ With Samajwadi Party After First Seat-Sharing Meeting Ends In 15 Minutes
“Bring our rule, and Abdul will sit alongside Chandrashekhar Azad as Deputy Chief Minister and become the strength of the underprivileged… Abdul will not lay carpets for anyone anymore; he will sit alongside Chandrashekhar Azad. Power will be in his hands, and he will resolve your grievances," Azad said.
He added that a leader from the most backward or backward communities would also be made Deputy Chief Minister. Azad has been named the Morcha’s chief ministerial candidate.
Rs 25,000 For Women, Attack On BJP
Azad also promised a direct bank transfer of Rs 25,000 to every woman if the alliance comes to power. Claiming that a rival party might offer Rs 20,000, he said his alliance would provide Rs 5,000 more.
He said the money would come from the Rs 7,000 crore that the state government allegedly spends on publicity and self-advertisement, which his government would redirect to women.
Targeting the BJP-led state government, Azad claimed that around five crore people in Uttar Pradesh remained poor and more than 25,000 schools had shut down over the past decade. He also accused the government of failing to create jobs and forcing young people to migrate to other states.
Owaisi Targets PM Modi, CM Yogi
Azad urged Muslim voters to assert their political identity and described the 2027 election as a fight for their political existence and self-respect. He also warned people against falling for attempts to create divisions among communities.
AIMIM chief Asaduddin Owaisi, who shares the alliance with Azad, also targeted Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath at the rally.
Azad and Owaisi announced their alliance on November 12, with Azad as its chief ministerial face. The Samajik Parivartan Morcha has announced plans to contest all 403 Assembly seats in the 2027 Uttar Pradesh elections.
(With inputs from ANI)
Quick Answers
Chandrashekhar Azad promised that if the Samajik Parivartan Morcha forms the government in Uttar Pradesh following the 2027 Assembly elections, a Muslim leader and a representative from the backward communities will each be appointed as Deputy Chief Minister.

19-Year-Old Woman Confesses Love For Cousin To Father Day Before Engagement, He Kills Her
A 19-year-old woman was allegedly strangled by her father in Telangana after revealing her relationship with a cousin.
A man killed his 19-year-old daughter after she told him she was in love with her cousin, a day before her engagement. The incident took place in Telangana’s Adilabad.
The victim, Kalyani, was supposed to get engaged to a man from Narnoor on November 25. However, the celebrations never took place after her father, Kailas Ade, allegedly strangled her to death on November 24.

title: On Constitution Day, Amit Shah Says BJP-Ruled States Are Going To Implement UCC
description: Amit Shah said Constitution framers had included the UCC in the Directive Principles of State Policy and envisioned a uniform law for every citizen, irrespective of religion.
author: Saurabh Verma
content:
On Constitution Day, Amit Shah Says BJP-Ruled States Are Going To Implement UCC
Amit Shah said Constitution framers had included the UCC in the Directive Principles of State Policy and envisioned a uniform law for every citizen, irrespective of religion.
Union Home Minister Amit Shah on Thursday announced that all BJP-ruled states will implement the Uniform Civil Code (UCC), asserting that laws should not be framed on the basis of religion.
Speaking at an event in New Delhi, Shah said the framers of the Constitution had included the UCC in the Directive Principles of State Policy and envisioned a uniform law for every citizen, irrespective of religion.
- 'Makes Me Smile': Amit Shah's Jibe At Congress On Modi Govt's 'Golden' Contribution To Northeast
- SAD 'Big Brother' In Alliance: Amit Shah Says NDA's Punjab CM Face Will Be From Shiromani Akali Dal
- Akali Dal Returns To NDA Fold After 6 Years, To Contest 2027 Punjab Elections In Alliance With BJP
- BJP And Akali Dal To Reunite After Six-Year Split? Amit Shah-Sukhbir Singh Badal's Joint Presser At 1 PM
“Our Constitution framers included the UCC in our Directive Principles. Every single citizen in this country—irrespective of religion, whether Hindu, Sikh, Muslim, Christian, or Parsi—must get the right to live under one uniform law. Laws should not be framed on the basis of religion, which your party, Rahul ji, outright rejects. Today, I have come to state with clarity that in the coming days, wherever there are BJP-ruled governments, we are going to implement the UCC," he said.
Goa, Uttarakhand, Gujarat, Assam and Madhya Pradesh have implemented the UCC so far.
The Home Minister also spoke about the constitutional framework governing the transfer and exercise of political power, saying the Constitution gave citizens the right to decide who would govern while making it mandatory for elected governments to function within constitutional limits.
“They gave the public the right to decide whom to grant power to, and for those who receive power, they laid down the path that governance must be run within the bounds of the Constitution," Shah said.
He added that every word of the Preamble was intended to lay the foundation for building a great India.
Shah further said India had witnessed several transfers of power without bloodshed, with each transition taking place in accordance with the constitutional process.
Taking a dig at the Opposition, Shah urged its leaders to examine the original copy of the Constitution to understand its spirit.
“The original copy of the Constitution begins its chapters with illustrations depicting the arrival of Lord Shri Ram in Ayodhya, Lord Buddha, Lord Mahavira, Dasham Pita Guru Gobind Singh ji, Rani Lakshmibai, the Dandi March, and Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose," he said.
“It is my humble request to those who walk around carrying the Constitution in their hands to go to the Parliament library, spare 15 minutes for the Constitution, and look at Nandalal Bose’s illustrations to understand its spirit," he added.
Shah On Naxalism
Shah also credited the Narendra Modi government with eradicating Naxalism and said it had worked towards ensuring that people affected by the insurgency received their constitutionally guaranteed rights.
Recalling his visit to Bastar, the Home Minister said he had encountered an 80-year-old family elder who did not have a ration card, whose name was missing from the voter list and whose house lacked electricity and drinking water.
“When I go to Bastar and see an 80-year-old family elder who still does not have a ration card, whose name is not on the voter list, whose house has no electricity and no drinking water facility, then I realise how much damage Naxalism has caused," he said.
Quick Answers
Goa, Uttarakhand, Gujarat, Assam, and Madhya Pradesh have implemented the Uniform Civil Code so far.

title: UP election 2027: SP promises 25 lakh government jobs, ₹5,000 monthly allowance for unemployed graduates
description: The party also announced an annual cash transfer of ₹40,000 for women, elderly people and needy members of families living below the poverty line (BPL).
author: CNBCTV18.com
content:
UP election 2027: SP promises 25 lakh government jobs, ₹5,000 monthly allowance for unemployed graduates
- Published OnNov 26, 2026 | 18:26 IST
- Last Updated OnNov 26, 2026 | 18:26 IST
The opposition party is banking on aggressive youth employment guarantees and direct cash transfers to marginalized groups to reshape its electoral prospects. Proposals include streamlining recruitment timelines, revivin
Samajwadi Party (SP) chief Akhilesh Yadav on Thursday unveiled the party's 92-page manifesto for the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections, making employment, education, healthcare and social welfare key poll promises.
Among the major announcements, the party has promised to provide 25 lakh government jobs over five years and create employment opportunities for 2-3 crore youth in other sectors. Graduates unable to find jobs will receive a monthly allowance of ₹5,000 until they secure employment.
The manifesto also promises an annual calendar of government vacancies and timely recruitment examinations. The party has proposed completing recruitment through a single examination within three months and multi-stage recruitment processes within six months.
On welfare, the SP has promised to launch Samajwadi Canteens offering meals at ₹5 per plate. It has also proposed an annual pension of ₹40,000 for elderly men and women and persons with disabilities, with payments made directly to bank accounts.
Yadav said the party would conduct a caste-based census in Uttar Pradesh to assess the economic and social status of different communities and formulate development plans accordingly.
In education, the party has promised to reopen 26,000 primary schools that Yadav claimed were shut down by the current government. It has also proposed distributing 20 lakh laptops across the state and bringing back the laptop scheme for students passing Class 12.
The manifesto promises a State Education Policy aimed at ensuring equal access to quality education, with particular focus on PDA (Pichhde, Dalit and Alpsankhyak) students and underprivileged youth.
For Dalits and PDA communities, the party has proposed setting up a Dalit Development Council under the chairmanship of the chief minister. It has also promised 50% reservation for Dalits and PDA communities in government contracts worth up to ₹50 crore.
On infrastructure and healthcare, the SP has proposed building three world-class stadiums, 10 sports colleges and five super-speciality hospitals across Uttar Pradesh. It has also promised to develop IT hubs in four major cities, a Bhojpuri Film City in the Purvanchal region and riverfronts in cities along rivers.
Yadav also promised a zero-tolerance policy towards crime, particularly heinous offences against Dalits, backward classes, minorities, Muslims, women and children. He said the party would soon release two additional manifestoes, including one focused on women.

title: Nitin Gadkari announces ₹1 lakh cr road projects for Bengal, promises 250-km Kolkata ring road
description: Union Minister Nitin Gadkari on Thursday announced road infrastructure projects worth ₹1 lakh crore for West Bengal, including a 250km ring road around Kolkata, and assured Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari that funds would not be a constraint in improving the state's connectivity and economic development.
author: PTI
content:
Nitin Gadkari announces ₹1 lakh cr road projects for Bengal, promises 250-km Kolkata ring road
- Published OnNov 26, 2026 | 17:06 IST
- Last Updated OnNov 26, 2026 | 17:06 IST
The Centre is backing a massive regional transport overhaul, featuring multi-lane corridors, greenfield expressways, and a sprawling metropolitan ring road to slash travel times and curb urban congestion. Discover how st
Union Minister Nitin Gadkari on Thursday announced road infrastructure projects worth ₹1 lakh crore for West Bengal, including a 250-km ring road around Kolkata, and assured Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari that funds would not be a constraint in improving the state’s connectivity and economic development.
Declaring that the Centre would back Bengal’s infrastructure push with all necessary financial resources, Gadkari said projects worth around ₹40,000 crore had already been completed in the state, while works worth ₹35,000 crore, covering approximately 450 km, were under implementation.
”Today, I am announcing projects worth ₹1 lakh crore for Bengal. I am not among those who make announcements and leave. Whatever I promise, I will deliver,” he said at an event organised by the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) at Kolaghat in Purba Medinipur district.
The announcement comes as the newly formed BJP government in West Bengal seeks to accelerate infrastructure development and improve connectivity across the state, with the Centre promising a major expansion of road networks, expressways and bridges.
Gadkari, who described the Centre-state partnership as a ”double-engine government”, said Bengal would witness rapid development under Adhikari’s leadership, with Prime Minister Narendra Modi providing direction and financial backing from the Centre.
”Do not worry about money. You will get tired of asking for projects, but I will not get tired of providing funds,” he told the chief minister.
Unveiling his vision for transforming Kolkata’s road infrastructure, Gadkari announced a 250-km ring road around the metropolis, saying the proposed project would ease traffic congestion, improve connectivity with adjoining cities and help make Kolkata a modern urban centre.
”This is just a teaser. Prepare a detailed project report (DPR) for Kolkata. I am willing to construct bridges across the city, on the lines of Pune, to improve connectivity,” he said.
The minister for road transport and highways said the proposed infrastructure expansion would help make Kolkata free from pollution and traffic congestion, while improving regional connectivity and facilitating economic growth.
Gadkari also promised dedicated road infrastructure to improve connectivity to Gangasagar, an important pilgrimage destination in the state.
Among the major projects announced were the four-lane Siliguri-Guwahati corridor, estimated to cost ₹26,000 crore, the Siliguri-Darjeeling corridor worth ₹6,000 crore and the Kolkata ring road project pegged at ₹14,000 crore.
He said the Centre was also developing greenfield expressways to strengthen Bengal’s road network and referred to the Delhi-Mumbai Highway, 80% of which, he said, had been completed.
The detailed project report for the Varanasi-Kolkata Highway had also been completed and submitted to the Cabinet, Gadkari said, adding that the highway, once operational, would reduce travel time between the two cities to around five hours.
The minister said infrastructure development was the foundation of economic growth, arguing that improved connectivity would boost industry, trade, agriculture and rural development, attract investments and generate employment.
”Water, power, transport and communication are the four pillars of infrastructure. If these are strengthened, industries and businesses will grow, agricultural productivity will improve, investment will come, and employment opportunities will increase. This will ultimately help eradicate poverty,” he said.
Recalling the infrastructure push initiated by the Narendra Modi government after coming to power in 2014, Gadkari said the Prime Minister’s vision was to make India one of the most powerful countries in the world and that this would require sustained investment in infrastructure.
”Our Prime Minister’s vision is to make India one of the most powerful countries in the world. To achieve this, we must focus on developing our infrastructure,” he said.
Gadkari expressed confidence that West Bengal would emerge as a major contributor to India’s economic ambitions, including the country’s goal of becoming the world’s third-largest economy and eventually a developed nation.
”The double-engine government, with Narendra Modi at the Centre and Suvendu Adhikari in West Bengal, will accelerate the state’s development like a bullet train and help it achieve the goal of becoming prosperous and self-reliant,” he said.
The minister also drew upon Bengal’s historical and cultural legacy, referring to Swami Vivekananda, Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose, Syama Prasad Mookerjee and other national figures, and said the state had made immense contributions to India’s intellectual, cultural and nationalist movements.
Adhikari sought the Centre’s support for a series of new road and bridge projects.
He said the Centre stood firmly with the West Bengal government in its mission to transform infrastructure and economy.
Earlier, projects worth more than ₹8,700 crore were unveiled at the Kolaghat programme, marking another push towards strengthening road connectivity in the state.

title: Infra projects see cost overrun of ₹3.28 lakh crore in October: MoSPI
description: Across 1,862 central infrastructure projects worth over ₹50 crore each, cumulative cost overruns reached ₹3.28 lakh crore in October 2026, pushing total revised costs to ₹38.11 lakh crore—even as MoSPI data shows 35% of projects have crossed 80% physical completion.
author: PTI
content:
Infra projects see cost overrun of ₹3.28 lakh crore in October: MoSPI
- Published OnNov 26, 2026 | 16:47 IST
- Last Updated OnNov 26, 2026 | 16:47 IST
Across 1,862 central infrastructure projects worth over ₹50 crore each, cumulative cost overruns reached ₹3.28 lakh crore in October 2026, pushing total revised costs to ₹38.11 lakh crore—even as MoSPI data shows 35% of projects have crossed 80% physical completion.
Infrastructure projects worth more than ₹50 crore each recorded a cumulative cost overrun of approximately ₹3,28,452 crore, according to a monthly government report for October 2026.
About 1,862 ongoing infrastructure projects across 17 central ministries and departments were monitored, and it was found that the total revised cost was ₹38,11,292 crore compared to the original cost of ₹34,82,840 crore.
However, the report did not specify the actual number of projects that faced cost overrun.
The cumulative expenditure incurred on these projects stands at ₹17.87 lakh crore, accounting for approximately 46.88% of the project cost, indicating steady progress in project implementation, the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI) said in its monthly report for October on Wednesday.
A significant proportion of projects are at advanced stages, with 649 projects (35% achieving over 80% physical progress, while 326 (18%) have crossed 80% financial completion.
The data also reflects a balanced pipeline, with projects distributed across early and advanced stages of implementation.
Out of 1,862 ongoing infrastructure projects, there are 790 Mega projects (project cost of ₹1,000 crore & above), and 1,072 Major projects (below ₹1,000 crore).
Also read: India's earnings to grow at high-teens pace for 3 years, new-age sectors to lead: Trust Group
The Transport & Logistics sector accounts for the highest number of ongoing projects (1,324), with a cumulative cost of ₹20.37 lakh crore, underscoring the priority given to connectivity-driven infrastructure growth.
The report said that the physical and financial progress broadly move in tandem, with a large number of projects clustered at the initial (0–20%) and advanced (81–100%) stages, indicating a pipeline of newly started projects alongside many nearing completion.
While physical progress exceeds financial advancement in the 81–100% range, financial progress is relatively higher in the early stages, reflecting upfront expenditure patterns in project implementation.
Ministry of Road Transport & Highways accounts for the highest number of projects at 972 (52% of total 1,862 projects), and a share of total revised project cost of ₹9.55 lakh crore (25% of total project cost ₹38.11 lakh crore), highlighting its central role in national infrastructure development.
The Ministry of Railways has 288 ongoing projects (15%), with a total revised project cost of ₹7.38 lakh crore (19%).
The Coal Ministry accounts for 121 ongoing projects (7%), with a total revised project cost of ₹2.22 lakh crore (6%).
The Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas, Ministry of Power, Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs, and the Department of Water Resources, River Development & GR are implementing 117, 108, 50, and 33 projects, with associated project costs of ₹4.42 lakh crore, ₹6.55 lakh crore, ₹3.44 lakh crore, and ₹1.93 lakh crore, respectively.
The remaining 173 projects (9%), with a total project cost of ₹2.63 lakh crore (7%), are distributed across various Ministries and Departments, including Higher Education, Civil Aviation, Steel, Telecommunications, Labour & Employment, Ports, Shipping & Waterways, Health & Family Welfare, Mines, DPIIT and Sports.

title: सौरव दास, अभिजीत और रांका के खिलाफ LOC जारी, देश नहीं छोड़ सकते, क्यों जारी हुआ लुकआउट सर्कुलर?
description: मुंबई पुलिस ने 'कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी' (CJP) के तीन बड़े नेताओं सौरव दास, अभिजीत दीपके और आशुतोष रांका के देश छोड़ने पर रोक लगा दी है. इन तीनों के खिलाफ ही लुकआउट सर्कुलर (LOC) जारी किया है. यह कार्रवाई गांधी जयंती पर शिवाजी पार्क में बिना इजाजत प्रदर्शन करने के मामले में की गई है. इस प्रदर्शन को लेकर इन तीनों नेताओं समेत 400 से ज़्यादा समर्थकों पर पहले से ही FIR दर्ज है.
author: भूपेंद्र राय
content:
मुंबई पुलिस ने 26 नवंबर को 'कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी' (CJP) के नेताओं पर शिकंजा कसा है. सीजेपी के सह-संयोजक सौरव दास के अलावा संस्थापक अभिजीत दीपके और आशुतोष रांका के खिलाफ 'लुकआउट सर्कुलर' (LOC) जारी किया गया है. यह जानकारी मुंबई पुलिस ने दी है. मुंबई पुलिस की तरफ से बताया गया है कि 2 अक्टूबर को गांधी जयंती पर शिवाजी पार्क में बिना अनुमति किए गए विरोध प्रदर्शन को लेकर दर्ज की गई एफआईआर के तहत यह कार्रवाई की गई है.
अब सवाल ये है कि आखिर'लुकआउट सर्कुलर' क्या होता है? तो जान लीजिए कि यह एक तरह का अलर्ट नोटिस है. जांच एजेंसियां या पुलिस इस तब जारी करती हैं जब उन्हें किसी अपराधी या संदिग्ध के देश छोड़कर भागने का शक होता है. इसकी जानकारी सभी एयरपोर्ट और बॉर्डर पर भेज दी जाती है. ताकि जैसे ही वो शख्स विदेश जाने के लिए एयरपोर्ट पर अपना पासपोर्ट दिखाए तो कंप्यूटर तुरंत अलर्ट दे दे. फिर अधिकारी उसे वहीं रोकककर पुलिस के हवाले कर देते हैं.
Mumbai Police has issued Look Out Circulars (LOC) against CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke, Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka for holding a protest without prior permission on Gandhi Jayanti. A case was registered against them to prevent them from leaving the country: Mumbai Police https://t.co/BzvPjyrjOg
— IANS (@ians_india) November 26, 2026
इसी 'लुकआउट सर्कुलर' की वजह से 23 नवंबर की रात सौरव दास को दिल्ली एयरपोर्ट पर लंदन जाने से रोका गया था. जिसके बाद उन्होंने दिल्ली हाईकोर्ट का दरवाजा खटखटाया. उनकी याचिका पर गुरुवार को सुनवाई भी हुई. सुनवाई के दौरान केंद्र सरकार के वकील ने अदालत को बताया कि मुंबई पुलिस ने 23 नवंबर को दास के खिलाफ LOC जारी किया था और उन्हें कारण बताओ नोटिस भी भेजा गया है, जिसका उन्होंने अभी तक जवाब नहीं दिया है.
सुनवाई के दौरान सौरव दास के वकील ने दलील दी कि अधिकारियों ने उन्हें सर्कुलर की कोई जानकारी या वजह नहीं बताई. इसके बाद जस्टिस अमित महाजन की बेंच ने केंद्र सरकार को नोटिस जारी कर जवाब मांगा है. इस मामले की अगली सुनवाई अब 9 दिसंबर को होना है.
इधर मुंबई पुलिस का कहना है कि सीजेपी के तीनों नेताओं अभिजीत दीपके, आशुतोष रांका और सौरव दास के देश छोड़कर बाहर जाने की आशंका थी. इसी को देखते हुए उन पर मामला दर्ज कर लुकआउट सर्कुलर जारी किया गया है, ताकि वे देश से बाहर न जा सकें.
दरअसल, यह पूरा मामला सीजेपी के 2 अक्टूबर को मुंबई के दादर स्थित शिवाजी पार्क में हुए 'चलो मुंबई' प्रदर्शन से जुड़ा है. उस दिन परमिशन नहीं होने के बावजूद प्रदर्शन में 400 से ज्यादा लोग जुटे थे और नारेबाजी की थी. जिसके बाद 3 अक्टूबर को गैर-कानूनी तरीके से भीड़ जुटाने के आरोप में एक एफआईआर दर्ज की गई. जिसमें अभिजीत दीपके, सौरव दास, आशुतोष रांका, प्रणव अहिरे, अजिंक्य शिंदे, आफरीन नवाज, सौम्या कोर्डे, अंकित भारद्वाज, विजय मलंगी और योगेश इंगले समेत 400 से अधिक समर्थकों को आरोपी बनाया गया था.
सौरव दास को दिल्ली एयरपोर्ट पर लंदन जाने से रोके जाने पर बुधवार को विदेश मंत्रालय के प्रवक्ता रणधीर जायसवाल ने भी जवाब दिया था. उन्होंने बताया था कि सौरव के पासपोर्ट में दर्ज जन्मस्थान की जानकारी को लेकर स्पष्टीकरण मांगा गया है. चेन्नई के रीजनल पासपोर्ट कार्यालय ने 23 नवंबर को उन्हें कारण बताओ नोटिस जारी कर 7 दिन में जवाब देने को कहा है. इस दौरान उन्हें पासपोर्ट का यूज न करने की सलाह दी गई है.
सौरव दास का कहना है कि उन्हें 'कॉकरोच मूवमेंट' विषय पर बोलने के लिए ब्रिटेन जाना था, लेकिन 23 नवंबर की रात 1 बजे लंदन की फ्लाइट पकड़ने से पहले ही उन्हें दिल्ली एयरपोर्ट के इमिग्रेशन काउंटर पर रोक लिया गया. फिर उन्होंने सोशल मीडिया प्लेटफॉर्म एक्स पर एक वीडियो पोस्ट कर कहा था, 'इस कायर सरकार ने मुझे दिल्ली एयरपोर्ट पर रोक लिया, जबकि मैं ऑक्सफोर्ड यूनिवर्सिटी में लेक्चर देने के लिए लंदन जा रहा था. इस कायर सरकार ने मुझे लंदन जाने वाली फ्लाइट में नहीं चढ़ने दिया. मुझे ऑक्सफोर्ड, कैम्ब्रिज, LSE और एडिनबर्ग जैसे प्रतिष्ठित विश्वविद्यालयों से 'कॉकरोच मूवमेंट' पर बोलने के लिए आमंत्रित किया गया था. भारतीय छात्रों ने इन कार्यक्रमों को आयोजित करने में अपनी पूरी जान लगा दी थी, लेकिन यह 'बुद्धिजीवी-विरोधी' सरकार मेरे इन प्रतिष्ठित संस्थानों में जाने से डर गई.'

title: 'आजादी के बाद भुला दी गई थी संविधान की भावना, पीएम मोदी ने हर स्कूल-कॉलेज तक इसे पहुंचाया': अमित शाह
description: केंद्रीय गृह मंत्री अमित शाह ने संविधान दिवस के अवसर पर नई दिल्ली में आयोजित 'संविधान गौरव दिवस' कार्यक्रम को संबोधित किया. इस दौरान उन्होंने क्या कुछ कहा, आइए जानते हैं....
author: भूपेंद्र राय
content:
नई दिल्ली में आयोजित 'संविधान गौरव दिवस' कार्यक्रम में केंद्रीय गृह मंत्री अमित शाह ने संविधान के सर्वोच्च मूल्यों को लेकर बड़ी बात कही. उन्होंने बताया कि कैसे 2015 में पीएम मोदी के एक फैसले ने देश के हर स्कूल, कॉलेज और नागरिक तक संविधान की भावना को पहुंचाने का काम किया.
#WATCH | Delhi: Union Home Minister Amit Shah says, "Respecting the Constitution is a very important and proud responsibility for all of us Indians. However, it is unfortunate that after Independence, an attempt was made to treat the Constitution merely as a guidebook for running the government, and the process of instilling and strengthening its spirit among the country's adolescents, youth, and citizens was forgotten. When Narendra Modi ji became the Prime Minister of this country in 2014, in 2015 he decided that every November 26 would be celebrated as Constitution Pride Day, so that the highest values of our Constitution could be carried to every school, college, and all citizens."
— ANI (@ANI) November 26, 2026
केंद्रीय गृह मंत्री अमित शाह ने कहा, 'संविधान का सम्मान करना हम सभी भारतीयों के लिए एक बेहद अहम और गौरवपूर्ण जिम्मेदारी है. हालांकि, यह दुर्भाग्यपूर्ण है कि आजादी के बाद संविधान को सिर्फ सरकार चलाने की एक गाइडबुक मानने की कोशिश की गई और देश के युवाओं व नागरिकों के मन में इसकी असली भावना को जगाने और मजबूत करने के प्रोसेस को भुला दिया गया.
अमित शाह ने आगे कहा, 'जब 2014 में नरेंद्र मोदी जी देश के प्रधानमंत्री बने, तो उन्होंने 2015 में यह फैसला लिया कि हर साल 26 नवंबर को 'संविधान गौरव दिवस' के रूप में मनाया जाएगा, ताकि हमारे संविधान की टॉप वैल्यूज को हर स्कूल, कॉलेज और आम नागरिक तक पहुंचाया जा सके.'
Live: केंद्रीय गृह एवं सहकारिता मंत्री श्री @AmitShah जी संविधान दिवस के अवसर पर नई दिल्ली में आयोजित 'संविधान गौरव दिवस' कार्यक्रम को संबोधित कर रहे है। @hdmalhotra @gupta_rekha #SamvidhanGauravDiwas https://t.co/sVFoFf1SSU
— BJP Delhi (@BJP4Delhi) November 26, 2026
अमित शाह ने बिना किसी का नाम लिए उन विपक्षी नेताओं पर निशाना साधा है, जो  रैलियों और संसद में संविधान की लाल प्रति हाथ में लेकर दिखाते हैं. 
उन्होंने कहा, 'जो लोग हमारी सभ्यता का विरोध कर रहे हैं, मैं उनसे कहना चाहता हूं कि यदि आपके जीवन में संविधान के लिए 10 से 15 मिनट का समय है, तो कृपया एक बार संविधान की मूल प्रति को जरूर देखें.'
अमित शाह ने विपक्ष को नसीहत देते हुए शाह ने कहा, 'जो लोग हाथों में संविधान लेकर घूमते हैं, उनसे मेरा विनम्र निवेदन है कि वे संसद की लाइब्रेरी में जाएं, संविधान के लिए 15 मिनट का समय निकालें और इसकी असली भावना को समझने के लिए नंदलाल बोस के बनाए चित्रों को जरूर देखें.'
गृह मंत्री अमित शाह ने याद दिलाया कि प्रख्यात चित्रकार नंदलाल बोस द्वारा सजाई गई संविधान की मूल प्रति भारतीय संस्कृति और इतिहास की झलक पेश करती है, उन्होंने कहा, 'संविधान की मूल प्रति के अध्यायों की शुरुआत उन चित्रों से होती है, जिनमें भगवान श्री राम के अयोध्या आगमन, भगवान बुद्ध, भगवान महावीर, दशम पिता गुरु गोबिंद सिंह जी, रानी लक्ष्मीबाई, दांडी मार्च और नेताजी सुभाष चंद्र बोस को दर्शाया गया है.'
खबर अपडेट हो रही है...

title: इस राज्य में पहली बार पुरुष कर्मियों को मिलेगी 15 दिन की पैटरनिटी लीव, जानिए कब और कैसे लाभ उठा सकेंगे मर्द
description: तमिलनाडु में अब बच्चे का जन्म होने पर पुरुष सरकारी कर्मियों को भी 15 दिन का अवकाश मिल सकेगा. वहां पर महिला सरकारी कर्मियों को पूरे एक साल के मातृत्व अवकाश की सुविधा पहले से हासिल थी.
author: देवेंद्र कुमार
content:
तमिलनाडु के मुख्यमंत्री सी. जोसेफ विजय ने पहली बार तमिलनाडु सरकार में काम करने वाले पुरुष कर्मचारियों के लिए 15 दिनों का पितृत्व अवकाश यानी पैटरनिटी लीव शुरू करने की घोषणा की है. यह अवकाश सरकारी सेवा में कार्यरत शादीशुदा पुरुष कर्मचारियों को ही मिलेगा. इस नीति के तहत राज्य के सरकारी विभागों में तैनात कोई भी पुरुष कर्मचारी बच्चे के जन्म से 15 दिन पहले या जन्म के 6 महीने के भीतर कभी भी यह अवकाश ले सकता है.
सरकार की ओर से जारी बयान में कहा गया, 'तमिलनाडु में महिला सरकारी कर्मचारी वर्तमान में 365 दिनों के मातृत्व अवकाश (मैटर्निटी लीव) की हकदार हैं, वहीं सरकार को पुरुष सरकारी कर्मचारियों से भी पितृत्व अवकाश शुरू करने के अनुरोध प्राप्त हुए हैं. बच्चे के जन्म के आसपास की अवधि मां और बच्चे दोनों के लिए बेहद महत्वपूर्ण होती है. इस दौरान, मां को शारीरिक और भावनात्मक सहारा देने के साथ-साथ नवजात शिशु की देखभाल करने में भी पिता का सहयोग जरूरी होता है.'
Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay has announced the introduction of paternity leave for male employees working in the Tamil Nadu Government for the first time. While female government employees in Tamil Nadu are currently entitled to 365 days of maternity leave, the government has received requests from male government employees seeking the introduction of paternity leave. The period surrounding childbirth is extremely important for both the mother and the child. During this time, the father’s support is essential not only in providing physical and emotional support to the mother but also in taking care of the newborn.
— ANI (@ANI) November 26, 2026
रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, तमिलनाडु सरकार के इस फैसले को दूरगामी और महिला-पुरुष समानता की नजर में अहम माना जा रहा है. इससे नवजात शिशु की देखभाल में बच्चे की मां का हाथ बंटाने में पिता भी मदद कर सकेगा.
बताते चलें कि तमिनलनाडु में महिलाओं को पूरे एक साल का मातृत्व अवकाश मिलता है, लेकिन पुरुषों को इस तरह की कोई सुविधा नहीं थी. राज्य के सरकारी कर्मचारियों के संगठन लंबे वक्त से पुरुषों के लिए भी ऐसी सुविधा शुरू करने की मांग उठा रहे थे. उनका कहना था कि नवजात की देखभाल में मां के साथ पिता की भी अहम भूमिका होती है. लिहाजा उन्हें भी यह अवकाश मिलने चाहिएं.
तमिनाडु सरकार ने यह पहल भले ही अब शुरू की हो, लेकिन केंद्र सरकार के पुरुष कर्मचारियों को यह सुविधा पहले से हासिल है. केंद्र के पुरुष कर्मचारियों को 15 दिनों का पितृत्व अवकाश मिलता है. इसी तरह, हरियाणा, सिक्किम और केरल समेत कई अन्य राज्यों में पुरुष कर्मचारियों को भी पितृत्व अवकाश दिया जाता है. जिससे वे अपने नवजात बच्चे की देखभाल में सहयोग कर सकें.

title: IRCTC Scam: Delhi High Court Rejects Pleas of Lalu Prasad Yadav, Rabri Devi, Tejashwi Yadav Against Framing of Charges
description: Delhi HC rejects pleas by Lalu Prasad Yadav, Rabri Devi and Tejashwi Yadav challenging the framing of charges against them in the alleged IRCTC hotel corruption case.
author: Asian News International
content:
IRCTC Scam: Delhi High Court Rejects Pleas of Lalu Prasad Yadav, Rabri Devi, Tejashwi Yadav Against Framing of Charges
The Delhi High Court has dismissed pleas filed by Lalu Prasad Yadav, Rabri Devi and Tejashwi Yadav challenging the trial court's decision to frame charges against them in the alleged IRCTC hotel corruption case linked to tender irregularities during 2004-2009.
- India News
- 2 min read
New Delhi: The Delhi High Court on Thursday rejected the pleas of former Railway Minister Lalu Prasad Yadav, Former Bihar CM Rabri Devi and former Deputy CM Tejaswi Yadav in the IRCTC hotel corruption case. They have challenged the framing of charges by the trial court in the CBI case.
Justice Swarana Kanta Sharma dismissed the petition challenging the order of framing of charges.
The detailed order of judgement is to be uploaded by the High Court.
The High Court issued notice on January 5, 2026, on the plea of Lalu Prasad Yadav. Thereafter, notices were issued on other petitions.
Senior advocate Kapil Sibal, Senior advocate Maninder Singh assisted by Ekta Vats, advocates Varun Jain and Navin Kumar had appeared for Lalu Prasad Yadav.
ASG DP Singh alongwith Advocate Manu Mishra had appeared for the CBI.
Advertisement
Former Bihar Chief Minister and Rashtriya Janata Dal (RJD) chief Lalu Prasad Yadav had moved the Delhi High Court challenging a trial court order that framed corruption and criminal conspiracy charges against him in the alleged IRCTC scam.
In October, 2025, the trial court had framed charges against Lalu Prasad Yadav in connection with alleged irregularities in the award of tenders by the Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation.
Advertisement
His wife, former Bihar Chief Minister Rabri Devi, and their son Tejashwi Yadav had also been charged in the case for offences including criminal conspiracy and cheating.
While framing the charges, Special Judge (Prevention of Corruption Act) Vishal Gogne of the Rouse Avenue Courts had observed that Lalu Prasad Yadav, during his tenure as Union Minister for Railways, had allegedly abused his official position to manipulate eligibility conditions in a land tender process.
The court had held that he was fully aware of the alleged conspiracy and had actively intervened in the decision-making process, resulting in substantial loss to the public exchequer.
The case originates from a 2017 FIR lodged by the Central Bureau of Investigation against Yadav, members of his family, officials of the Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation, and other private individuals. The CBI has alleged that between 2004 and 2009, when Yadav was the Railway Minister, a criminal conspiracy was hatched to award IRCTC hotel tenders in Patna and Puri to favoured parties in return for bribes in the form of prime land and shares.
Following completion of the investigation, the CBI filed a chargesheet against Lalu Prasad Yadav and other accused persons.

title: Not Just Saurav Das: Mumbai Police Issues Lookout Circulars Against CJP's Abhijeet Dipke and Ashutosh Ranka
description: Mumbai Police has issued Lookout Circulars against CJP leaders Abhijeet Dipke, Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Das over an FIR linked to a prohibited protest at Shivaji Park on October 2. Das was recently stopped from travelling to the UK at Delhi airport.
author: Asian News International
content:
Not Just Saurav Das: Mumbai Police Issues Lookout Circulars Against CJP's Abhijeet Dipke and Ashutosh Ranka
Mumbai Police has issued Lookout Circulars against CJP leaders Abhijeet Dipke, Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Das over an FIR linked to a prohibited protest at Shivaji Park on October 2. Das was recently stopped from travelling to the UK at Delhi airport.
- India News
- 2 min read
Mumbai: Mumbai Police on Thursday has issued Lookout Circulars against Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) National-Convener Abhijeet Dipke and co-conveners Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Das in connection with an FIR linked to the CJP protest after the October 2 protest at Shivaji Park in Mumbai.
This came to light after Das was barred from boarding an overseas flight at Delhi’s Indira Gandhi International Airport earlier this week, prompting him to petition the Delhi High Court.
During court proceedings on Thursday, the central government confirmed before Justice Amit Mahajan that the travel restriction against Das was initiated at the specific request of the Maharashtra Police.
Das, who was scheduled to fly to the United Kingdom on the night of November 23 to attend an Oxford panel discussion, approached the court after immigration authorities stopped him, revealing that an active alert had been placed on his passport.
Advertisement
Representing the Union government, Additional Solicitor General Chetan Sharma told the bench that discrepancies regarding Das’s educational background, residential address, and parentage had surfaced during record checks, suggesting these inconsistencies could have implications regarding his citizenship status.
Opposing the restriction, Senior Advocate Akhil Sibal, counsel for Das, argued that his client had received neither prior intimation nor formal documentation regarding any travel curbs before arriving at the airport. Contending that a show-cause notice was presented only on-site, Sibal questioned the legality of detaining a citizen without providing the underlying order or explaining the grounds of the restriction.
Advertisement
‘’He was not given time to respond to the show-cause notice few hours before travel. He has a valid passport and has a valid visa. He cannot be stopped from travelling as it is his fundamental right,’’ Sibal said.
When the petitioner’s counsel requested a copy of the LOC along with the date and specific charges under which it was authorised, the Additional Solicitor General stated that the document could not be furnished directly in the ongoing hearing, adding that the petitioner remained free to initiate separate legal challenges against the circular.
The underlying First Information Report (FIR) was lodged on October 3 at the Shivaji Park police station. It names the event's organisers and cites between 400 and 500 unnamed attendees under Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) Sections 189 (unlawful assembly) and 223 (disobedience to an order lawfully promulgated by a public servant).

title: Rs 5,000 Monthly Allowance For Unemployed Graduates, 25 Lakh Jobs: Akhilesh Yadav Unveils SP's PDA Manifesto For 2027 UP Polls
description: Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav unveiled the PDA manifesto for the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections, promising 25 lakh government jobs, Rs 5,000 monthly allowance for unemployed graduates, Rs 40,000 annual aid for women and several welfare measures.
author: Melvin Narayan
content:
Rs 5,000 Monthly Allowance For Unemployed Graduates, 25 Lakh Jobs: Akhilesh Yadav Unveils SP's PDA Manifesto For 2027 UP Polls
Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav unveiled the PDA manifesto for the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections, promising 25 lakh government jobs, Rs 5,000 monthly allowance for unemployed graduates, Rs 40,000 annual aid for women and several welfare measures.
- India News
- 5 min read
Lucknow: Samajwadi Party (SP) chief Akhilesh Yadav on Thursday unveiled the party's manifesto for the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections, promising 25 lakh government jobs, a monthly unemployment allowance of Rs 5,000 for graduates who remain unemployed and several welfare measures for women, youth and marginalised communities.
Titled 'Sattais Ka Sankalp: PDA Ka Prannpatra' and also referred to as the 'Jan-Man Ka Manifesto', the document was released in Lucknow on Constitution Day in the presence of senior party leaders, including SP leader Azam Khan, MP Dimple Yadav, general secretary Shivpal Singh Yadav, party general secretary Rajendra Chaudhary, former Uttar Pradesh Chief Secretary Alok Ranjan and Ayodhya MP Awadhesh Prasad.
Among the key announcements, Akhilesh Yadav promised 25 lakh government jobs for young people and a monthly allowance of Rs 5,000 for unemployed graduates until they secure employment. The party also promised to create employment opportunities across other sectors.
The manifesto places considerable emphasis on education and employment. The SP has promised a special state education policy to improve access to higher education for young people belonging to the PDA communities. It has also pledged measures to prevent examination paper leaks, conduct examinations on schedule and ensure transparency in the declaration of results.
Advertisement
The party has promised free schooling and the reopening of government primary schools that were shut down. It has also proposed permanent jobs and salary increases for Shiksha Mitras, who work as contractual teachers in the state.
The manifesto also includes a promise to provide free healthcare and ambulance services. The SP has proposed the introduction of AI-based technology in policing, stronger measures for women's safety and faster justice through fast-track courts. It has also promised to restore the Old Pension Scheme.
Advertisement
On women's welfare, Akhilesh Yadav announced an annual financial assistance of Rs 40,000 for women, with the amount to be transferred directly to their bank accounts. Women workers above a specified age would also be eligible for financial assistance under the proposal.
The party has further promised to establish Samajwadi canteens across the state, where meals would be available for Rs 5 per plate. Another significant proposal is to provide 50 per cent reservation to Dalits and members of the PDA communities in government contracts worth up to Rs 50 crore.
The SP has also promised to conduct a caste census across Uttar Pradesh to formulate policies aimed at the targeted development of different social groups.
PDA refers to Pichhda (backward classes), Dalit and Alpsankhyak (minorities), a social coalition that has been central to the Samajwadi Party's political outreach under Akhilesh Yadav.
The party has indicated that the manifesto exercise will extend beyond the statewide document. Separate manifestos are also being prepared for individual districts and cities, along with a dedicated document focusing on women.
Speaking at the release event, Akhilesh Yadav took a swipe at the BJP, saying, "Achhe din aaye nahin, bure din jaane wale hain" (The good days never came, but the bad days are about to end).
He also invoked the Constitution on the occasion of Constitution Day, asserting that the country would be governed by the Constitution and not by individual whims. He said the PDA communities would stand together against any attempt to make changes to the Constitution that could adversely affect them.
The manifesto release comes amid ongoing seat-sharing discussions between the Samajwadi Party and the Congress ahead of the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections. The two parties are expected to contest the polls together, but negotiations over the distribution of seats have continued.
According to sources, the SP has initially offered 26 seats to the Congress, while the latter has sought 120 seats and is unwilling to accept a lower number. The discussions are continuing as both parties attempt to arrive at an agreement.
Meanwhile, SP leader Azam Khan met Akhilesh Yadav at his residence ahead of the manifesto release. Khan was accompanied by his son Abdullah Azam.
Speaking to reporters before the meeting, Khan hinted at a new political phase, saying, "A new dawn is coming. Welcome it."
When asked about AIMIM chief Asaduddin Owaisi's remark that Uttar Pradesh could have a Muslim Deputy Chief Minister after the next Assembly elections, Khan responded sarcastically, saying that Owaisi should announce his name for the post of Prime Minister instead.
"Announce my name, make me the Prime Minister, or at least add 'Wazir' in my name. I am already Azam," he said.
Uttar Pradesh Leader of Opposition Mata Prasad Pandey also attended the manifesto-related programme, along with several other party leaders and spokespersons.
The Samajwadi Party is seeking to return to power after losing the 2017 and 2022 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections. In the 2022 polls, the party won 111 seats and emerged as the principal opposition party in the 403-member Assembly.
With the manifesto being released several months ahead of the 2027 elections, the SP has outlined its proposed commitments on employment, education, women's welfare, social justice and healthcare as it prepares for the next electoral contest in the state.

title: Days after border ‘tranquility’ talks, China again describes Arunachal Pradesh as ‘Zangnan’
description: Beijing's latest assertion comes days after Indian and Chinese military commanders held 10 days of talks to ease tensions along the Line of Actual Control (LAC)
author: FP News Desk
content:
Days after border ‘tranquility’ talks, China again describes Arunachal Pradesh as ‘Zangnan’
Beijing's latest assertion comes days after Indian and Chinese military commanders held 10 days of talks to ease tensions along the Line of Actual Control (LAC)
China has once again asserted its claim over Arunachal Pradesh, referring to the Indian state as 'Zangnan' or 'South Tibet'. The development comes days after military commanders from India and China held talks to address tensions along the eastern sector of the Line of Actual Control (LAC), the Global Times reported.
Citing Chinese Ministry of National Defense spokesperson Chen Xi, the report said Beijing considers the Zangnan region part of its territory and does not recognise what it described as the 'so-called Arunachal Pradesh' set up by India.
Indian has consistently rejected these claims, maintaining that the state is an integral and inalienable part of India.
The latest exchange comes after a 10-day round of Corps Commander-level discussions between the Indian Army and China's People's Liberation Army (PLA). The talks were aimed at maintaining peace along the frontier, preventing local confrontations and strengthening coordination between troops, particularly as the region prepares for harsh winter conditions.
Military talks focus on preventing border escalation
The discussions involved commanders from the Indian Army's III Corps and their Chinese counterparts. The extended engagement was intended to reinforce existing mechanisms for managing tensions and ensure that local incidents do not escalate into larger confrontations.
Maintaining communication between troops on both sides is particularly important in the eastern sector, where difficult terrain, high-altitude conditions and severe winter weather can complicate military operations and logistics.
The talks also come against the backdrop of localised face-offs and overlapping patrolling claims in sensitive areas, including Taksing in Arunachal Pradesh's Upper Subansiri district. Such situations can lead to friction when patrols from both sides operate in areas claimed by both countries.
While military-level engagement is intended to prevent misunderstandings and maintain stability on the ground, China's repeated references to Arunachal Pradesh as 'Zangnan' underline the continuing political and territorial differences between the two neighbours.
India has repeatedly dismissed Beijing's claims over Arunachal Pradesh and objected to China's attempts to give Indian locations new names. It has also argued that assigning new names to places in the state does not change the ground reality or establish any territorial claim.
Additionally, the Ministry of External Affairs has stressed that the maintenance of peace along the LAC is essential for progress in bilateral ties.

title: 26/11 attacks: How Cama Hospital nurses saved pregnant women and newborns amid gunfire
description: As terrorists stormed Cama & Albless Hospital during the 2008 Mumbai attacks, nurses switched off lights, hid pregnant women and helped deliver babies amid gunfire. Their courage ensured that some of the most vulnerable patients survived the night
author: FP News Desk
content:
26/11 attacks: How Cama Hospital nurses saved pregnant women and newborns amid gunfire
As terrorists stormed Cama & Albless Hospital during the 2008 Mumbai attacks, nurses switched off lights, hid pregnant women and helped deliver babies amid gunfire. Their courage ensured that some of the most vulnerable patients survived the night
Eighteen years after the 26/11 terror attacks, the events of those horrific days remain etched in the memories of survivors and those who watched the horror unfold on television. On November 26, 2008, as Mumbai came under attack, a hospital meant to welcome new life became a scene of terror.
At Cama & Albless Hospital, a government-run facility in south Mumbai specialising in women's and children's healthcare, doctors and nurses were preparing for another night shift. Pregnant women were waiting to deliver, mothers were recovering after childbirth and newborns were in the wards.
But gunfire from nearby Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (CST) soon brought the violence to their doorstep.
Two heavily armed terrorists, Ajmal Kasab and Abu Ismail Khan, entered the hospital after shooting dead two security guards. As they moved through the multi-storey building, patients and staff scrambled to find shelter.
For the medical team, the priority was now to protect those in their care.
Switching off the lights, hiding pregnant women
Among those on duty was staff nurse Anjali Kulthe, who was responsible for 20 pregnant women in the antenatal ward, as per a Times of India report.
When she realised armed men had entered the hospital, Kulthe shut the ward's heavy double doors and moved the women and some of their family members into a small pantry. The lights were switched off and mobile phones silenced to avoid drawing attention.
The group remained hidden for hours as gunfire and grenade explosions echoed through the building.
The situation became more difficult when one of the pregnant women, who had hypertension, went into labour. Despite the danger, Kulthe escorted her to a delivery room on another floor, walking along the staircase wall to avoid being exposed to the gunmen.
The woman delivered safely, while the others remained in hiding.
Babies were born as gunfire echoed through the hospital
The nurses faced an added challenge in the maternity ward, where they had to care for new mothers and newborns while keeping their location hidden.
The hospital's then superintendent, Dr Saroj Maheshgouri, later recalled in an interview with The Indian Express, that staff conducted two deliveries during the attack. With the lights switched off, medical personnel used the glow from mobile phone screens to assist the mothers. They also tried to keep the newborns quiet.
In one instance, a nurse had to use plastic bags as gloves because proper medical supplies were not readily available.
One of the babies born that night was Tejaswini Chavan, who would later become known as the 'Bullet Girl'. She was born at Cama Hospital on November 26, 2008, as the terror attack unfolded, as reported by The Hindu.
The women who protected patients
Around 400 people were inside the hospital when the attack began, according to Maheshgouri's account. Around 15 nurses were on duty, helping protect more than 150 patients as the gunmen exchanged fire with security personnel.
Two security guards, Bhanu Narkar and Baban Walu, were killed at the hospital entrance. The threat continued for hours, with patients and staff able to breathe a sigh of relief only after security forces completed their search operation in the early hours of November 27.
In later interviews with The Quint and The Better India, nurses recalled reassuring frightened patients and trying to prevent panic from spreading through the wards.
The attack led to changes in the hospital's security arrangements, including additional guards, surveillance cameras and stricter access controls.
Eighteen years later, the story of Cama Hospital is a reminder that courage during a crisis does not always come from those carrying weapons. Sometimes, it comes from people who refuse to abandon those in their care, even when danger is just outside the door.

title: Saurav Das stopped at Delhi airport: What discrepancies were found in his passport?
description: Cockroach Janata Party co-convenor Saurav Das was stopped at Delhi airport from boarding his London-bound flight on November 24. The Centre has found multiple discrepancies in his passport, including questions over his place of birth, address and parentage. A show-cause notice was issued, and a Look Out Circular was also issued
author: FP Explainers
content:
Saurav Das stopped at Delhi airport: What discrepancies were found in his passport?
Cockroach Janata Party co-convenor Saurav Das was stopped at Delhi airport from boarding his London-bound flight on November 24. The Centre has found multiple discrepancies in his passport, including questions over his place of birth, address and parentage. A show-cause notice was issued, and a Look Out Circular was also issued
Co-convenor of the Cockroach Janata Party (CJP), Saurav Das, was stopped at the airport before his flight to London on Tuesday (November 24) in Delhi. He was scheduled to speak at the Oxford Union, but the Regional Passport Office (RPO) in Chennai issued a show-cause notice over alleged discrepancies in his identity documents.
Why exactly was he stopped from boarding the flight, and what discrepancies did the government flag in his passport? We explain.
Why Saurav Das was stopped at Delhi airport
Das was stopped by immigration officials at Delhi’s Indira Gandhi International Airport (IGI) while attempting to board a 1 am flight to London. He was scheduled to travel to the UK for engagements at Oxford, Cambridge, the London School of Economics (LSE) and the University of Edinburgh.
Immigration authorities flagged discrepancies in his passport details.
Das told PTI that immigration officials informed him that his passport had been flagged. He was not allowed to board the flight. According to his lawyer, advocate Krishnesh Bapat, the officials did not show Das any written order prohibiting him from travelling.
Meanwhile, the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal confirmed that the Regional Passport Office (RPO) in Chennai had issued a show-cause notice to Das. The ministry said he had also been advised not to use his passport until he submitted his response to the notice.
What discrepancies the government flagged in Das's passport
According to the MEA, the discrepancy concerned the place of birth declared in Das’s passport application. The RPO Chennai sought clarification from him on this information after receiving reports from law enforcement authorities.
The RPO Chennai issued a show-cause notice, asking Das to clarify his place of birth within seven days.
Jaiswal explained the government’s position on discrepancies in passport applications, saying: “If at any stage a discrepancy is noted or reported by authorities which amounts to suppression of facts, then we issue a show cause notice to the applicant to explain his or her point of view.”
What the Indian law says about impounding a passport
Under Section 10(3) of the Passports Act, 1967, passport authorities can initiate proceedings to impound or revoke a passport if it was obtained by suppressing material information or furnishing incorrect details. The passport holder can be asked to explain the discrepancies before a final decision is taken.
In Das’s case, the show-cause notice was emailed at 7:30 pm on November 23, giving him seven days, until November 30, to submit supporting documents and explain the discrepancies.
Das said he first saw the email at the immigration counter and alleged that the timing was intended to prevent him from travelling to the UK.
He has challenged the restriction before the Delhi High Court.
How an RPO show-cause notice affects passport holders
A Regional Passport Office (RPO) can issue a show-cause notice when post-issuance verification, court directions or reports from law enforcement agencies raise questions about information furnished in a passport application.
These may include discrepancies in personal details, place of birth, address or other material information. In Das’s case, the re-verification reportedly followed a September 2026 Madras High Court order in connection with a Public Interest Litigation (PIL) questioning his documents.
The notice gives the passport holder an opportunity to explain the discrepancies and submit supporting documents to the issuing RPO within the stipulated deadline. These may include a birth certificate, educational records or other officially verified documents relevant to the disputed details.
The RPO examines the explanation and supporting records before deciding the matter. If the authorities are satisfied with the response, the passport-related restrictions can be cleared. If the explanation is found unsatisfactory, the authorities can proceed with action under the Passports Act, including impounding or revoking the passport, subject to the applicable legal requirements.
What the Centre told the Delhi HC
The Centre informed the Delhi High Court that a Look Out Circular (LOC) had been issued against Das by the Mumbai Police on the intervening night of Sunday (November 22. Additional Solicitor General (ASG) Chetan Sharma, appearing for the Centre, told Justice Amit Mahajan that Das would have to challenge the LOC before the appropriate forum.
The Centre said the LOC had been issued at the request of the Maharashtra Police.
During the hearing, the ASG also said that an inquiry into the veracity of Das’s place of birth, address and parentage had been initiated by the Senior Superintendent of Police (SSP) of Puducherry on August 20. He pointed out that Das had left the column for his father’s name blank in his passport application.
The Centre told the court that the discrepancies in Das’s passport could have a bearing on his Indian citizenship.
The government also maintained that there was no order invalidating or suspending his passport at that stage and that he was required to respond to the show-cause notice issued by the passport authorities.
The ASG argued that Das had not yet responded to the show-cause notice.
He also said that if the passport officer found his explanation unsatisfactory, the passport could be impounded, potentially leaving Das in an uncertain position regarding his travel documents. The Centre maintained that the advisory asking him not to use the passport was in his interest.
The Centre also opposed the maintainability of Das’s plea.
Justice Amit Mahajan sought the government’s response to the petition and listed the matter for further hearing on December 9, 2026.
With input from agencies

title: Coal gasification scheme attracts just two bids in its third round
description: Limited participation in the third round highlights financing and technology challenges, with industry calling for credit guarantees and greater lender confidence to attract investment
author: Saket Kumar
content:
Coal gasification scheme attracts just two bids in its third round
Limited participation in the third round highlights financing and technology challenges, with industry calling for credit guarantees and greater lender confidence to attract investment
Listen to This Article
With just two bids received in its third round, the Centre’s ₹37,500-crore coal gasification incentive scheme has continued to see limited industry participation, highlighting the challenges of attracting investment into a capital-intensive industry despite substantial government support.
According to a notice issued by the Ministry of Coal, one bid each was received under Category 2, meant for private-sector companies and government public sector undertakings (PSUs), and Category 3, which covers demonstration projects using indigenous technology and/or small-scale product-based plants.
Talcher Chemicals Private Limited, the sole bidder under Category 2, and Carbon Chemical Private Limited, the sole bidder under Category 3, have been declared technically qualified and made eligible to open their financial bids.
The response follows seven applications in the first round and two in the second, both submitted by state-run NTPC. The limited participation across three rounds raises questions about what it will take to attract a wider pool of investors to India’s coal gasification sector.
Coal gasification converts coal into synthesis gas, or syngas, which can be used to manufacture products such as methanol, ammonia, synthetic natural gas, hydrogen, fertilisers, and other chemicals.
Also Read
The scheme, approved by the Union Cabinet in May 2026, has an outlay of ₹37,500 crore and aims to support projects that gasify around 75 million tonnes of coal and lignite. It is intended to contribute towards India’s target of achieving 100 million tonnes of coal gasification capacity by 2030. The government expects the initiative to attract investments of ₹2.5-3 trillion and reduce dependence on high-value imported industrial feedstock.
Atanu Mukherjee, chief executive officer of Dastur Energy, said the limited response should not necessarily be interpreted as a lack of industry interest, but rather as a reflection of the challenges in translating interest into commercially viable and financeable projects. Dastur Energy provides coal gasification consultancy to companies.
“Viability Gap Funding (VGF) is an excellent mechanism for improving project economics and incentivising capital investment. However, improving project economics and making a project bankable are two different things,” Mukherjee said.
Financial institutions remain cautious about lending to capital-intensive projects of this nature, particularly where domestic commercial operating precedents are limited, and technology and implementation risks are perceived to be high, Mukherjee said. Equity investors seek greater visibility on the availability and cost of debt, while lenders require certainty around technology performance, project execution and long-term commercial viability, he added.
He said the government could complement the existing incentive framework with a partial credit guarantee mechanism to reduce lenders’ risks and encourage greater participation from financial institutions.
Technology suited to India’s high-ash coal and the availability of assured buyers for the products are other important considerations for prospective investors, he said.
Mukherjee suggested that India facilitate the licensing of proven international technologies, including suitable Chinese technologies, through domestic technology companies to build engineering, equipment manufacturing and execution capabilities.
He also called for the development of standardised modular gasification systems processing around 500-1,500 tonnes of coal per day, depending on feedstock and industrial application. Such projects could widen participation beyond a handful of large industrial groups, while generating operating experience and improving confidence among lenders, he said.
Long-term offtake arrangements with fertiliser, chemical, steel and energy companies could improve revenue visibility for projects. However, assured buyers alone would not ensure commercial viability, Mukherjee said, adding that coal-derived products would need to remain competitive with imported alternatives.

title: Cooking with firewood, dung cakes top PM2.5 source in Indo-Gangetic Plain
description: Cooking with firewood, dung cakes and coal accounts for 36-49% of primary PM2.5 emissions in the most polluted parts of the Indo-Gangetic Plain, a CEEW study found.
author: Press Trust of India
content:
Cooking with firewood, dung cakes top PM2.5 source in Indo-Gangetic Plain
Cooking with firewood, dung cakes and coal accounts for 36-49% of primary PM2.5 emissions in the most polluted parts of the Indo-Gangetic Plain, a CEEW study found.
Listen to This Article
A new study has revealed that cooking with firewood, dung cakes and coal, among others, is the single largest source of PM2.5 emissions in the most polluted areas of the Indo-Gangetic Plain (IGP).
 It added that cooking through such methods contributes 36-49 per cent of the total primary PM2.5 emissions in the IGP's most polluted parts, stretching from Punjab in the west through Haryana, Delhi, Uttar Pradesh and Bihar to West Bengal in the east.
 The study, released by the Council on Energy, Environment and Water (CEEW) on Thursday, comes at a time when Delhi-NCR continues to witness bad air quality, and much of the focus is on how stubble burning and Diwali firecrackers drive spikes in pollution.
 Cooking's contribution to PM2.5 emissions remains high despite the progress made by the Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) in recent years.
 The scheme was launched in May 2016 to provide economically weaker households with free LPG connections.
Also Read
 According to the study, the PMUY helped avert 15 per cent of India's household PM2.5 emissions in financial year 2025-2026.
In a statement, Abhishek Kar, a fellow at the CEEW, said, "Many families still cook with firewood alongside LPG because the next refill is hard to afford, and in the Indo-Gangetic Plain's most polluted areas, cooking is the single largest source of PM2.5 emissions."
 The study highlighted that residential combustion takes place year-round and increases every winter, as households also burn fuel for heating.
 Cooking accounts for about 80 per cent of household energy use, so transitioning from polluting to cleaner cooking fuels is the only way to cut most of the residential emissions, according to the study.
 It recommended a winter top-up under the PMUY that would make the next LPG refill affordable when pollution is at its worst.
 The study also suggested that India's 25,000-plus LPG distributors sell certified induction cooktops and electric pressure cookers at a discount to households that give up two of their four subsidised cylinders
