title: पीएम मोदी ने बालेन शाह को गले लगाया, रेड कार्पेट बिछाकर किया स्वागत, भारत ने नेपाल के लिए खोला खजाना!
description: नेपाल के प्रधानमंत्री बालेन शाह सोमवार को भारत दौरे पर दिल्ली पहुंचे. राष्ट्रपति भवन में प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी ने उनका गर्मजोशी से स्वागत किया और गले लगाकर उनका अभिवादन किया.
author: Bharat24live
content:
Balen Shah PM Modi Meeting: नेपाल के प्रधानमंत्री बालेन शाह सोमवार को भारत दौरे पर दिल्ली पहुंचे. राष्ट्रपति भवन में प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी ने उनका गर्मजोशी से स्वागत किया और गले लगाकर उनका अभिवादन किया. इस मौके पर उनके स्वागत के लिए रेड कार्पेट बिछाया गया और उन्हें गार्ड ऑफ ऑनर भी दिया गया. इसके बाद दोनों देशों के प्रतिनिधिमंडलों ने मुलाकात की.
बालेन शाह और प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी के बीच हैदराबाद हाउस में द्विपक्षीय बैठक हुई. इसमें भारत और नेपाल के रिश्तों को मजबूत करने, व्यापार बढ़ाने और आपसी सहयोग से जुड़े मुद्दों पर चर्चा हुई. इस बैठक में दोनों देशों के बीच तीन बड़े फैसले होने की जानकारी सामने आई है. इनमें नेपाल को विशेष आर्थिक पैकेज देना, भारतीय बंदरगाहों तक पहुंच और अयोध्या-जनकपुर के बीच ट्रेन सेवा शुरू करना शामिल है.
मोदी और बालेन शाह के बीच द्विपक्षीय बैठक
दिल्ली के हैदराबाद हाउस में प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी और नेपाली प्रधानमंत्री बालेन शाह के बीच बैठक हुई. दोनों नेताओं ने भारत और नेपाल के पुराने संबंधों को और मजबूत बनाने पर चर्चा की.
बैठक का मुख्य उद्देश्य दोनों देशों के बीच आर्थिक और व्यापारिक सहयोग को बढ़ाना है. इसके साथ ही परिवहन, संपर्क और दूसरे अहम मुद्दों पर भी बातचीत हुई.
राष्ट्रपति भवन में बालेन शाह को मिला गार्ड ऑफ ऑनर
भारत दौरे पर पहुंचे नेपाली प्रधानमंत्री का राष्ट्रपति भवन में औपचारिक स्वागत किया गया. इस दौरान प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी ने उन्हें गले लगाकर स्वागत किया. उनके सम्मान में रेड कार्पेट बिछाया गया और गार्ड ऑफ ऑनर दिया गया.
इसके बाद दोनों देशों के अधिकारियों और प्रतिनिधियों के बीच मुलाकात हुई. इस दौरे को भारत और नेपाल के संबंधों के लिहाज से काफी अहम माना जा रहा है.
बैठक में हुए ये 3 बड़े फैसले
1. नेपाल को विशेष आर्थिक पैकेज देगा भारत
भारत की ओर से नेपाल को विशेष आर्थिक पैकेज देने का फैसला किया गया है. इसे दोनों देशों के बीच आर्थिक सहयोग बढ़ाने की दिशा में बड़ा कदम माना जा रहा है. हालांकि, इस पैकेज के तहत नेपाल को कितनी आर्थिक मदद मिलेगी, इसकी पूरी जानकारी अभी सामने नहीं आई है.
2. कांडला और पारादीप बंदरगाहों तक मिलेगी पहुंच
भारत नेपाल को गुजरात के कांडला और ओडिशा के पारादीप बंदरगाहों के इस्तेमाल की सुविधा देगा. इससे नेपाल को दूसरे देशों के साथ व्यापार करने में आसानी होगी. वह इन बंदरगाहों के जरिए सामान मंगा और दूसरे देशों तक भेज सकेगा.
नेपाल ने भारत से गुजरात के मुंद्रा बंदरगाह तक पहुंच देने की मांग भी की थी, लेकिन भारत ने इस मांग को मंजूरी नहीं दी.
3. अयोध्या और जनकपुर के बीच चलेगी नई ट्रेन
भारत और नेपाल के बीच धार्मिक पर्यटन को बढ़ावा देने के लिए अयोध्या और जनकपुरधाम के बीच नई साप्ताहिक ट्रेन सेवा शुरू की जाएगी. इसका नाम 'सरयू-कमला एक्सप्रेस' रखा गया है. प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी और बालेन शाह इस ट्रेन सेवा को हरी झंडी दिखाएंगे.
इस ट्रेन के शुरू होने से अयोध्या और जनकपुरधाम आने वाले श्रद्धालुओं को काफी सुविधा मिलेगी. अयोध्या को भगवान राम की जन्मस्थली और जनकपुरधाम को माता सीता की जन्मस्थली माना जाता है. ऐसे में दोनों धार्मिक स्थलों के बीच रेल संपर्क शुरू होना भारत और नेपाल के लोगों के लिए अहम माना जा रहा है.

title: कसाब: एक आतंकी की पूरी कहानी… चौथी पास लड़के से मुंबई के खूनी हमले तक, और फिर फांसी के तख्ते तक!
description: 26/11 Mumbai Attack Story: पाकिस्तानी आतंकी अजमल कसाब के पकड़े जाने की पूरी कहानी. जानिए कैसे फरीदकोट के एक मजदूर से आतंकी बना कसाब, 658 गवाहों की गवाही और 'ऑपरेशन एक्स' के जरिए फांसी तक का सफर.
author: अतुल यादव (रवि), एडिटर क्राइम
content:
प्रतीकात्मक तस्वीर, AI से बनाई गई.
मुंबई: 26 नवंबर 2008 की रात मुंबई के छत्रपति शिवाजी महाराज टर्मिनस पर लगे सीसीटीवी कैमरों में एक तस्वीर कैद हुई, हाथ में AK-47, पीठ पर बैग और चेहरे पर बेखौफ भाव लिए एक युवक यात्रियों पर गोलियां बरसा रहा था. कुछ ही घंटों में उसकी तस्वीर दुनिया के अखबारों के पहले पन्ने पर थी, वह युवक था मोहम्मद अजमल आमिर कसाब. उस वक्त शायद किसी ने नहीं सोचा था कि इस एक तस्वीर के पीछे छिपी कहानी आने वाले वर्षों में अंतरराष्ट्रीय आतंकवाद, पाकिस्तान स्थित आतंकी संगठनों और भारत की न्यायिक व्यवस्था के लिए एक बड़ी मिसाल बन जाएगी.
कसाब कोई सैन्य अधिकारी नहीं था, वह किसी बड़े राजनीतिक या प्रभावशाली परिवार से भी नहीं आता था लेकिन उसे जिस संगठन ने अपने नेटवर्क में शामिल किया, उसने उसे ऐसी हिंसक साजिश का हिस्सा बना दिया, जिसकी कीमत 166 निर्दोष लोगों को अपनी जान देकर चुकानी पड़ी.
पाकिस्तान के एक छोटे से गांव से शुरू हुई थी अजमल कसाब की कहानी
भारतीय अदालतों में दर्ज रिकॉर्ड के मुताबिक, कसाब पाकिस्तान के पंजाब प्रांत के ओकारा जिले के फरीदकोट गांव का रहने वाला था, उसने उर्दू माध्यम के एक स्कूल में चौथी कक्षा तक पढ़ाई की थी और वर्ष 2000 में वह अपने पिता के साथ काम की तलाश में लाहौर आ गया था. वहां उसने मजदूरी की, बाद में पारिवारिक विवाद के कारण अजमल कसाब अलग रहने लगा था, उसकी जिंदगी में एक मोड़ तब आया, जब वह लाहौर में टेंट लगाने के काम से जुड़ा. इसी दौरान उसका संपर्क ऐसे लोगों से हुआ, जिनके तार लश्कर-ए-तैयबा से जुड़े थे. बाद में वह मुजफ्फराबाद और पाकिस्तान के अन्य प्रशिक्षण ठिकानों पर आतंकवादी प्रशिक्षण लेने पहुंचा,
यहां समझने वाली बात यह है कि आतंकवादी संगठन केवल हथियार चलाना नहीं सिखाते, वे युवाओं की सोच, उनकी पहचान और उनके सामाजिक संबंधों को प्रभावित करके उन्हें अपने मकसद का हथियार भी बनाते हैं, कसाब के मामले में भी अदालत के सामने ऐसे प्रशिक्षण और भर्ती की कड़ियां रखी गईं.
10 लड़के, 1 साजिश और मुंबई को निशाना बनाने की तैयारी
26/11 के हमले में शामिल दसों आतंकवादियों को अलग-अलग समूहों में तैयार किया गया था, कसाब का साथी अबू इस्माइल था और बाकी हमलावरों की पहचान अबू अका्शा, अबू उमर, अब्दुल रहमान बड़ा, अब्दुल रहमान छोटा, फहाद उल्लाह, जावेद अबू अली और अबू शोएब जैसे नामों से हुई. अलग-अलग दस्तावेजों में उनके उपनामों की वर्तनी में अंतर मिलता है, इन दस लोगों को पांच जोड़ों में बांटा गया था और उनके निशाने भी अलग-अलग थे. किसी को ताज होटल, किसी को ओबेरॉय-ट्राइडेंट, किसी को नरीमन हाउस और किसी को भीड़भाड़ वाले सार्वजनिक ठिकानों पर भेजा गया था. इस साजिश की एक विशेषता यह थी कि आतंकवादी सिर्फ हथियार लेकर नहीं निकले थे, उनके पास मोबाइल फोन, जीपीएस उपकरण, नक्शे, गोला-बारूद और पाकिस्तान में बैठे हैंडलरों से संपर्क के साधन थे, उन्हें निर्देश देने वाले लोग हमले के दौरान भी उनके संपर्क में रहे.
समुद्र में छिपी थी साजिश की एक बड़ी गलती
आतंकियों ने कराची से समुद्री रास्ते से भारत की ओर यात्रा शुरू की, इस यात्रा में भारतीय मछली पकड़ने वाले जहाज एमवी कुबेर का अपहरण किया गया और जहाज के कप्तान अमर सिंह सोलंकी और चालक दल के अन्य सदस्यों की हत्या कर दी गई लेकिन इस पूरी साजिश में आतंकियों से एक ऐसी गलती हुई, जिसने बाद में जांच एजेंसियों को महत्वपूर्ण सबूत उपलब्ध कराए. मुंबई पहुंचने से पहले आतंकवादी कुबेर को छोड़कर छोटी नाव से तट की ओर बढ़े,जहाज पर एक सैटेलाइट फोन और अन्य सामान छूट गया,जिससे जांच एजेंसियों को वहां से मिले सबूतों, डीएनए नमूनों, जीपीएस रिकॉर्ड और अन्य तकनीकी सामग्री ने समुद्री रास्ते और पाकिस्तान से जुड़े नेटवर्क की कड़ियां जोड़ने में मदद की. यानी जिन लोगों ने समुद्र के रास्ते अपनी पहचान छिपाकर भारत में घुसने की योजना बनाई थी, वे अपने पीछे ऐसे निशान छोड़ गए, जिन्हें बाद में अदालत में पेश किया गया.
कसाब की तस्वीर जिसने पाकिस्तान के इनकार को चुनौती दी
26 नवंबर की रात कसाब और अबू इस्माइल ने सीएसटी स्टेशन पर अंधाधुंध गोलीबारी की, इसके बाद दोनों ने कई अन्य स्थानों पर भी हमले किए. इस दौरान महाराष्ट्र एटीएस प्रमुख हेमंत करकरे, पुलिस अधिकारी अशोक कामटे और विजय सालस्कर सहित कई सुरक्षाकर्मियों की हत्या हुई लेकिन कसाब की पहचान केवल सीसीटीवी फुटेज से नहीं हुई. फोटो पत्रकार सेबेस्टियन डिसूजा की तस्वीरें भी जांच और मुकदमे में महत्वपूर्ण साक्ष्य साबित हुईं, कसाब ने अदालत में तस्वीरों को फर्जी बताने की कोशिश की, लेकिन प्रत्यक्षदर्शियों की पहचान, तकनीकी साक्ष्य और अन्य सबूतों ने उसकी दलीलों को टिकने नहीं दिया. यह मामला इसलिए भी महत्वपूर्ण था क्योंकि पाकिस्तान की ओर से हमलावरों की राष्ट्रीयता को लेकर इनकार किया जा रहा था, कसाब के जिंदा पकड़े जाने से इस दावे को चुनौती देने के लिए भारत के पास प्रत्यक्ष सबूत मौजूद था.
तुकाराम ओंबले: वह पुलिसकर्मी जिसने साजिश का सबसे अहम चेहरा पकड़ लिया
गिरगांव चौपाटी के पास पुलिस ने नाकाबंदी की हुई थी, कसाब और अबू इस्माइल की कार वहां पहुंची तो पुलिस ने उन्हें रोकने की कोशिश की, जहां मुठभेड़ में अबू इस्माइल मारा गया लेकिन कसाब ने गोलीबारी जारी रखी.
तभी सहायक पुलिस उप निरीक्षक तुकाराम ओंबले ने निहत्थे ही कसाब को पकड़ने के लिए उस पर छलांग लगा दी, कसाब की गोलियां उनके शरीर को छलनी करती रहीं, लेकिन उन्होंने हथियार की नली और कसाब के हाथों को मजबूती से पकड़ लिया, इसी दौरान बाकी पुलिसकर्मियों ने उसे काबू कर लिया. ओंबले शहीद हो गए, लेकिन कसाब जिंदा गिरफ्तार हो गया, यह गिरफ्तारी सिर्फ एक पुलिस कार्रवाई नहीं थी,बल्कि में तो कहूंगा कि इसने 26/11 की अंतरराष्ट्रीय साजिश के खिलाफ भारत को एक जीवित आरोपी, उसकी पहचान और पूछताछ के जरिए कई महत्वपूर्ण सुराग उपलब्ध कराए.
अदालत में 658 गवाह, 1,691 दस्तावेज और हजारों पन्नों के सबूत
- कसाब को पकड़ने के बाद भारत ने उसके खिलाफ कानूनी प्रक्रिया शुरू की, उसे वकील उपलब्ध कराया गया और सुनवाई के लिए आर्थर रोड जेल परिसर में विशेष अदालत बनाई गई.
- इस मुकदमे की गंभीरता का अंदाजा इसी बात से लगाया जा सकता है कि अभियोजन पक्ष ने 1,691 दस्तावेज पेश किए, कुल 658 गवाहों के बयान रिकॉर्ड हुए. अदालत में सीसीटीवी फुटेज, डीएनए रिपोर्ट, हथियार, जीपीएस से जुड़े साक्ष्य, फोन कॉल और प्रत्यक्षदर्शियों की गवाही रखी गई.
- कसाब ने शुरुआत में मजिस्ट्रेट के सामने अपराध स्वीकार किया, लेकिन बाद में अपना बयान वापस ले लिया और अलग-अलग चरणों में अपने बचाव की दलीलें बदलीं. उसने खुद को नाबालिग बताने की कोशिश भी की, लेकिन वैज्ञानिक और अन्य साक्ष्यों के आधार पर अदालत ने उसे वयस्क माना.
- 3 मई 2010 को विशेष अदालत ने उसे दोषी ठहराया और 6 मई को मौत की सजा सुनाई. बॉम्बे हाईकोर्ट ने 2011 में सजा बरकरार रखी और 29 अगस्त 2012 को सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने भी उसकी दोषसिद्धि और मृत्युदंड को कायम रखा.
फांसी से पहले कसाब ने मां को किया था याद
21 नवंबर 2012 की सुबह पुणे की यरवदा जेल में कसाब को फांसी दे दी गई, यह पूरी कार्रवाई बेहद गोपनीय तरीके से की गई थी. इस ऑपरेशन को ‘ऑपरेशन एक्स’ नाम दिया गया था और उसे मुंबई की आर्थर रोड जेल से कड़ी सुरक्षा में पुणे लाया गया था.
राष्ट्रपति द्वारा दया याचिका खारिज किए जाने के बाद फांसी की प्रक्रिया पूरी हुई, कसाब की इच्छा के मुताबिक पाकिस्तान में उसके परिवार को भी इसकी सूचना देने की कोशिश की गई, लेकिन परिवार ने उससे मिलने में की दिलचस्पी नहीं दिखाई. अंततः उसे जेल परिसर में ही दफनाया गया, उसकी मौत के साथ एक दोषी की जिंदगी खत्म हुई, लेकिन 26/11 के कई सवाल खत्म नहीं हुए.
कसाब मारा गया, लेकिन उसके पीछे खड़ा नेटवर्क?
कसाब को फांसी देना न्यायिक प्रक्रिया का अंतिम चरण था,लेकिन मुंबई हमले की साजिश केवल दस हमलावरों तक सीमित नहीं थी. उन्हें तैयार करने वाले, प्रशिक्षण देने वाले, समुद्री रास्ते की योजना बनाने वाले, तकनीकी सहायता देने वाले और हमले के दौरान निर्देश देने वाले लोग भी इस साजिश का हिस्सा थे. भारतीय जांच और अदालत के रिकॉर्ड में जकी-उर-रहमान लखवी, हाफिज सईद, जरार शाह और अन्य आरोपियों के नाम सामने आए, पाकिस्तान में कुछ गिरफ्तारियां भी हुईं, लेकिन साजिश के सभी जिम्मेदार लोगों को न्याय के कटघरे तक लाने का सवाल लंबे समय तक बना रहा.
26/11 की सबसे बड़ी सीख यही है कि आतंकवाद का चेहरा हमेशा वह व्यक्ति नहीं होता, जो हाथ में बंदूक लेकर सामने दिखाई देता है. कई बार असली साजिशकर्ता हजारों किलोमीटर दूर बैठकर निर्देश दे रहे होते हैं. कसाब की तस्वीर दुनिया ने देखी, तुकाराम ओंबले की शहादत ने उसे जिंदा पकड़ा.अदालत ने उसके अपराध साबित किए और देश ने उसे कानून के मुताबिक सजा दी लेकिन 26/11 की पूरी कहानी तब तक अधूरी रहेगी, जब तक उस रात के हर पीड़ित को न्याय और उस साजिश के हर जिम्मेदार व्यक्ति को जवाबदेही के दायरे में नहीं लाया जाता.
एक नजर में – 26/11 हमला और न्यायिक प्रक्रिया
यह भी पढ़िए: ‘2008 में जवाब नहीं दे पाए, अब मुंहतोड़ जवाब देते हैं’, 26/11 की बरसी पर बोले एयर चीफ मार्शल आशुतोष दीक्षित
इस तरह की अन्य खबरें पढ़ने के लिए भारत एक्सप्रेस न्यूज़ ऐप डाउनलोड करें.

title: कौन हैं अर्चना तिवारी? अनंत सिंह की बेटी की शादी में गिरे नोट लेने से इनकार कर बनीं चर्चा का केंद्र
description: Who is Archana Tiwari: अनंत सिंह की बेटी शिवांगी सिंह की शादी में नोट लेने से इनकार करने वाली डांसर अर्चना तिवारी सुर्खियों में हैं. जानिए बिहार और पूर्वांचल की चर्चित कलाकार अर्चना तिवारी का करियर, सोशल मीडिया मौजूदगी, विवाद और वायरल होने की पूरी कहानी.
author: Pankaj kumar Pandey
content:
कौन हैं अर्चना तिवारी?
Who is Archana Tiwari: बिहार के बाहुबली नेता और मोकामा विधायक अनंत सिंह की बेटी शिवांगी सिंह की शादी इन दिनों सोशल मीडिया पर खूब चर्चा बटोर रही है. भव्य इंतजाम, बड़ी संख्या में पहुंचे मेहमान और सांस्कृतिक प्रस्तुतियों के वीडियो लगातार वायरल हो रहे हैं. इसी बीच एक वीडियो ने लोगों का खास ध्यान खींचा, जिसमें मंच पर प्रस्तुति दे रहीं डांसर अर्चना तिवारी नजर आईं. हालांकि इस बार चर्चा उनके डांस की बजाय उनके व्यवहार को लेकर हो रही है.
नोटों की बारिश के बीच दिखाया अलग अंदाज
शादी समारोह के दौरान अर्चना तिवारी की प्रस्तुति पर लोगों ने जमकर नोट उड़ाए. कार्यक्रम के बाद जब एक व्यक्ति ने जमीन पर पड़े नोट उठाकर उन्हें देने की कोशिश की, तब अर्चना ने हाथ जोड़कर पैसे लेने से साफ इनकार कर दिया. उनका यही अंदाज सोशल मीडिया पर वायरल हो गया और लोग उनके बारे में जानने के लिए उत्सुक हो गए.
बिहार और पूर्वांचल में जानी-पहचानी कलाकार
अर्चना तिवारी बिहार और पूर्वांचल के कई इलाकों में लोकप्रिय स्टेज कलाकार के तौर पर जानी जाती हैं. वह डांस के साथ-साथ गायन से भी जुड़ी हुई हैं और विभिन्न सांस्कृतिक आयोजनों, निजी समारोहों तथा स्टेज शो में नियमित रूप से प्रस्तुति देती हैं. इंटरनेट और सोशल मीडिया के जरिए भी उन्होंने अपनी अलग पहचान बनाई है, जहां उनके वीडियो बड़ी संख्या में देखे जाते हैं.
बचपन का शौक बना पेशा
अर्चना तिवारी का कहना है कि उन्हें शुरुआत से ही नृत्य में गहरी रुचि थी. कम उम्र में ही उन्होंने डांस सीखना शुरू कर दिया था. समय के साथ उनकी रुचि पेशेवर दिशा में बढ़ती गई और यही कला उनके करियर का मुख्य आधार बन गई. लगातार अभ्यास और मंचीय अनुभव ने उन्हें पहचान दिलाने में अहम भूमिका निभाई.
कथक से लेकर मंचीय प्रस्तुतियों तक
अर्चना अपने आपको प्रशिक्षित कलाकार बताती हैं. उनके अनुसार उन्होंने नृत्य विषय में ग्रेजुएशन किया है और कथक सहित शास्त्रीय नृत्य की शिक्षा भी प्राप्त की है. वह मानती हैं कि डांस केवल मनोरंजन नहीं बल्कि एक गंभीर कला है, जिसे उन्होंने अपने जुनून और पेशे दोनों के रूप में अपनाया है. इसी वजह से वह अलग-अलग प्रकार के मंचों पर प्रस्तुति देती रहती हैं.
मुंबई में रहकर आगे बढ़ा रहीं करियर
फिलहाल अर्चना तिवारी मुंबई में रहकर अपने पेशेवर कामकाज को आगे बढ़ा रही हैं. हालांकि उनकी गतिविधियां सिर्फ मुंबई या बिहार तक सीमित नहीं हैं. उन्हें देश के विभिन्न राज्यों में आयोजित विवाह समारोहों, निजी आयोजनों और सांस्कृतिक कार्यक्रमों में आमंत्रित किया जाता है, जहां वह अपनी प्रस्तुति देती हैं.
विदेशों में भी दिखा चुकी हैं हुनर
अर्चना के मुताबिक उन्हें अंतरराष्ट्रीय मंचों पर भी अपनी कला दिखाने का अवसर मिला है. वह भारत के बाहर दुबई, रूस और मॉरीशस जैसे देशों में आयोजित कार्यक्रमों में भी भाग ले चुकी हैं. इन मंचों ने उनकी पहचान को और व्यापक बनाने में मदद की है.
सोशल मीडिया पर भी मजबूत मौजूदगी
अर्चना डिजिटल प्लेटफॉर्म पर काफी सक्रिय रहती हैं. इंस्टाग्राम और फेसबुक पर वह अपने कार्यक्रमों, रिहर्सल और नई प्रस्तुतियों से जुड़ी तस्वीरें और वीडियो साझा करती रहती हैं. सोशल मीडिया पर उनका अकाउंट ‘tiwari7744’ नाम से बताया जाता है. डांस के अलावा उनकी रुचि ड्रेस डिजाइनिंग और अभिनय में भी है.
पहले भी अनंत सिंह के कार्यक्रमों से जुड़ा नाम
अनंत सिंह के परिवार से जुड़े आयोजनों में अर्चना का नाम पहले भी सामने आ चुका है. मई 2026 में गोपालगंज में आयोजित एक कार्यक्रम में उन्होंने प्रस्तुति दी थी. उस दौरान अनंत सिंह की मौजूदगी में किया गया उनका डांस सोशल मीडिया पर तेजी से वायरल हुआ था और इसके बाद उनकी लोकप्रियता काफी बढ़ गई थी.
विवाद और FIR के बाद भी रहीं सुर्खियों में
गोपालगंज वाले कार्यक्रम को लेकर विवाद भी सामने आया था. उस मामले में FIR दर्ज होने की चर्चा हुई थी. अर्चना ने अपने ऊपर लगाए गए अश्लीलता और हथियारों से जुड़े आरोपों को अस्वीकार कर दिया था. उनका कहना था कि उन्होंने केवल एक कलाकार के रूप में मर्यादित और पेशेवर प्रस्तुति दी थी. साथ ही उन्होंने यह भी कहा था कि कलाकारों का मूल्यांकन उनके काम के आधार पर किया जाना चाहिए.
ये भी पढ़ें-103 दिन बाद अचानक बुलाया विशेष सत्र, क्या है सरकार का इरादा? जानें पूरा शेड्यूल
‘वायरल गर्ल’ के नाम से मिली पहचान
गोपालगंज कार्यक्रम के बाद सोशल मीडिया पर उनकी लोकप्रियता तेजी से बढ़ी और कई लोग उन्हें ‘वायरल गर्ल’ के नाम से पहचानने लगे. इसके बाद अनंत सिंह के परिवार के अन्य समारोहों में भी उनकी प्रस्तुतियां चर्चा का विषय बनीं. शिवांगी सिंह की शादी में भी उन्होंने अपनी प्रस्तुति से लोगों का ध्यान खींचा, लेकिन इस बार चर्चा का कारण उनका डांस नहीं, बल्कि नोट लेने से किया गया विनम्र इनकार बन गया.

title: अमेरिका दौरे पर राहुल गांधी के बयानों से छिड़ा सियासी घमासान: ‘मेक इन इंडिया’, चुनाव और विदेश नीति पर सरकार को घेरा
description: अमेरिका दौरे पर Rahul Gandhi ने भारत की अर्थव्यवस्था, 'मेक इन इंडिया', चुनाव और विदेश नीति पर सवाल उठाए हैं. इसपर भाजपा ने पलटवार किया.
author: Vaibhav Gupta
content:
कांग्रेस नेता और लोकसभा में नेता प्रतिपक्ष राहुल गांधी जब भी विदेशी विश्वविद्यालयों या अंतरराष्ट्रीय मंचों पर भारतीय राजनीति, अर्थव्यवस्था और लोकतंत्र पर अपनी बात रखते हैं, देश में सियासी पारा चढ़ना तय माना जाता है. नवंबर 2026 में हुए उनके अमेरिका दौरे ने एक बार फिर इसी बहस को हवा दे दी है. न्यूयॉर्क की कोलंबिया यूनिवर्सिटी और शिकागो यूनिवर्सिटी में छात्रों व शिक्षाविदों से संवाद के दौरान राहुल गांधी ने रोजगार, चुनावी प्रक्रिया और कूटनीति को लेकर केंद्र सरकार पर तीखे हमले किए. इसके बाद भाजपा ने उन पर विदेशी धरती से भारत को बदनाम करने का आरोप लगाया, जबकि कांग्रेस ने इसे सरकार की नीतियों की लोकतांत्रिक आलोचना करार दिया.
कोलंबिया यूनिवर्सिटी में ‘मेक इन इंडिया’ और चुनावी प्रक्रिया पर घेरा
कोलंबिया यूनिवर्सिटी में बातचीत के दौरान राहुल गांधी ने कहा कि भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था गंभीर संकट के दौर से गुजर रही है और पिछले एक दशक से मौजूदा आर्थिक मॉडल अपेक्षित नतीजे नहीं दे पा रहा है. उन्होंने बेरोजगारी, उद्योगों की सुस्ती और शिक्षा व्यवस्था की खामियों का जिक्र करते हुए केंद्र सरकार की ‘मेक इन इंडिया’ और ‘स्टार्टअप इंडिया’ जैसी योजनाओं पर सवाल उठाए.
इसके साथ ही उन्होंने मतदाता सूची से बड़ी संख्या में नाम काटे जाने का दावा करते हुए ‘वोट चोरी’ के अपने पुराने आरोप दोहराए और चुनाव आयोग की निष्पक्षता पर भी प्रश्नचिह्न लगाया. इस पर पलटवार करते हुए भाजपा ने कहा कि भारत दुनिया की सबसे तेजी से बढ़ती प्रमुख अर्थव्यवस्था है और अंतरराष्ट्रीय संस्थाएं भी इसकी रफ्तार की सराहना कर रही हैं, ऐसे में राहुल गांधी विदेश में भ्रामक तथ्य पेश कर देश की छवि कमजोर कर रहे हैं.
शिकागो में विदेश नीति की आलोचना
दूसरी तरफ, यूनिवर्सिटी ऑफ शिकागो के कार्यक्रम में राहुल गांधी ने प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी की विदेश नीति को निशाने पर लिया. उन्होंने कहा कि वैश्विक मामलों में भारत की सक्रियता पहले के मुकाबले घटी है और अमेरिका-ईरान संवाद या अंतरराष्ट्रीय घटनाक्रमों में पाकिस्तान की भूमिका का हवाला देते हुए उन्होंने भारत की कूटनीतिक स्थिति पर सवाल उठाए. राहुल के मुताबिक, वैश्विक नेताओं के साथ व्यक्तिगत संबंधों पर आधारित नीति देश की व्यापक रणनीतिक भूमिका को प्रभावित कर सकती है.
पहले भी विदेशी मंचों से छिड़ चुका है सियासी घमासान
विदेश में राहुल गांधी के बयानों पर विवाद का यह पहला मामला नहीं है. इससे पहले मार्च 2023 में ब्रिटेन के कैम्ब्रिज विश्वविद्यालय में भारतीय लोकतंत्र, संसद और मीडिया पर की गई उनकी टिप्पणियों पर भी भारी बवाल मचा था. वहीं, दिसंबर 2025 में जर्मनी के बर्लिन में भी उन्होंने लोकतांत्रिक संस्थाओं और चुनावी प्रक्रिया पर सवाल उठाए थे, जिस पर भाजपा ने कड़ा ऐतराज जताया था.
यह भी पढ़ें: नहटौर सीट पर बीजेपी को झटका, इलाहाबाद हाईकोर्ट ने विधायक ओम कुमार का चुनाव किया रद्द
-भारत एक्सप्रेस
इस तरह की अन्य खबरें पढ़ने के लिए भारत एक्सप्रेस न्यूज़ ऐप डाउनलोड करें.

title: Women Must Convince Men in Their Families to Vote for AAP: Arvind Kejriwal
description: At the Aam Aadmi Party's Foundation Day rally in Moga, Arvind Kejriwal launched the campaign for the 2027 Punjab Assembly elections.
author: Times Now Digital
content:
Addressing a historic gathering at Aam Aadmi Party (AAP)’s ‘Khushhaal Punjab Maha Rally’ in Moga on the party’s Foundation Day, National Convenor Arvind Kejriwal sounded the poll bugle for the 2027 Punjab Assembly elections, calling for another AAP government led by CM Bhagwant Singh Mann. Urging women to persuade the men in their families to vote for AAP, he emphasised the continuation of Mawan-Dheeyan Satkar Yojna, ₹10 lakh health insurance, free electricity and ‘tirth yatra’ schemes depended on Bhagwant Singh Mann returning as Chief Minister.
The AAP Chief highlighted the ₹1,000 assistance provided by the Bhagwant Mann government to help women deal with inflation under the Modi government and asserted that CM Bhagwant Singh Mann had fulfilled all his election guarantees within five years. Warning voters against Congress, Akali Dal and BJP, he pointed out these parties had announced that they would discontinue the Bhagwant Mann government's existing schemes if voted to power, pointing to Delhi where people were regretting voting for the BJP after it shut down all schemes introduced by the AAP government.
AAP National Convenor Arvind Kejriwal stated, “I do not think Punjab has ever witnessed such a massive rally in its history. Today is 26 November. On 26 November 1949, Babasaheb Ambedkar gave us our Constitution, and on 26 November 2012, the Aam Aadmi Party was founded. It is no coincidence that the Constitution was adopted on 26 November and the Aam Aadmi Party was also founded on the same date.”
The AAP Chief continued, “It is a sign from the Almighty that, at a time when the Constitution is being trampled upon, crushed and disrespected in our country, the Almighty entrusted the Aam Aadmi Party with the responsibility of saving the Constitution by ensuring that the party was founded on the same day. Now, the responsibility of protecting the Constitution in this country rests with the Aam Aadmi Party.”
Recalling Babasaheb Ambedkar's message of equality, Arvind Kejriwal stated, “In 1949, Babasaheb Ambedkar gave the message of equality for all. And on 26 November 2012, the Aam Aadmi Party took up that responsibility and declared that now it is the ‘Aam Aadmi’s (ordinary citizen)'s turn. Leaders and politicians will no longer run this country. The ‘Aam Aadmi’ will run the country.”
Addressing the people of Punjab, the AAP Chief stated, “It has been almost 5 years since we took charge of the government in Punjab. Five years ago, when I came here to seek your votes in the 2022 elections, I ensured people certain guarantees. They were called ‘Kejriwal's Guarantees’. Kejriwal's Guarantee means a firm guarantee. They are not eyewash but guarantees that will certainly be fulfilled.”
Arvind Kejriwal asserted, “I am standing before people of Punjab today because my ‘Chota Bhai', CM Bhagwant Singh Mann, has fulfilled all of Kejriwal's Guarantees. We promised free electricity and people are getting free electricity. We promised to organise ‘tirth yatra,’ and now devotees are going on the ‘yatra.’ We promised to open Aam Aadmi Clinics and now people are receiving great treatment. We promised free treatment, and everyone has been provided with a health insurance card worth ₹10 lakh.”
He continued, “We promised to improve education. Most schools have been transformed, although more are yet to be improved. Over the next 5 years, we will transform the remaining schools as well. We will provide children of Punjab with the best possible education.”
Referring to the Mawan Dheeyan Satkar Yojna, the AAP Chief stated, “We promised that every woman would receive ₹1,000 directly into her bank account under the Mawan Dheeyan scheme. I am extremely happy that this was our biggest guarantee, and I have come before you today after fulfilling this guarantee as well.”
“It took us a few years to start depositing ₹1,000 under this scheme. The reason is that all the governments before us looted Punjab's entire treasury and left. They opened bank accounts in Switzerland for their children. They built huge properties, enormous bungalows and acquired expensive cars. When we took charge of the government, Punjab's treasury was empty,” he pointed out.
The AAP Chief added, “It took us 4 years to replenish Punjab's treasury. We saved every single rupee of government money with complete honesty and rebuilt the state's finances. That is why it took time. We wanted us to start providing this aid to women as soon as our government came to power, but the previous governments had emptied the entire treasury. We completed all the prerequisites and have now implemented our final guarantee as well.”
Highlighting the hurdles faced in implementing the scheme, he said, “The Modi government withheld Punjab's funds. We had to take the matter to court. They tried every possible way to stop the scheme. But we are strong, and CM Bhagwant Singh Mann is very strong. He did not allow them to stop it. Now, the money under the Mawan Dheeyan scheme is reaching women every month.”
Addressing confusion among beneficiaries about the payments, Arvind Kejriwal explained, “Every woman receives ₹1,000 every month. The money for 3 months is deposited together in their accounts. Therefore, they receive ₹3,000 for three months. Women belonging to the Scheduled Caste community receive ₹1,500 per month, amounting to ₹4,500 in 3 months.”
The AAP Chief further clarified, “Women who registered earlier received their first ₹3,000 earlier, while the remaining women received their ₹3,000 later. Some women have already received 2 instalments, while others are still awaiting their balance amount. On 1 December, the remaining eligible women will receive their pending amounts of ₹4,500 and ₹3,000. After that, all women will receive their money together every 3 months, with ₹3,000 and ₹4,500.”
Emphasising the importance of the financial assistance, Arvind Kejriwal said, “₹1,000 may not be a huge amount, but it is not a small amount either. ₹1,000 will not cover the entire household expenditure, but inflation under the Modi government has made everything in this country so expensive. Petrol has become expensive, diesel has become expensive, cooking gas has become expensive, vegetables have become expensive and all essential food items have become expensive. Everything has become expensive.”
The AAP Chief added, “At a time when the Modi government has made life so expensive, CM Bhagwant Singh Mann has provided women of Punjab with ₹1,000 to give them some relief. He has extended a little help to you. When a household is struggling to meet its expenses and someone gives you even ₹1,000, it gives you a little more financial freedom. A woman can manage her household with greater ease, fulfil her wishes and spend the money on whatever she wants. PM Modi has made everything so expensive, but CM Bhagwant Singh Mann has provided Punjab families with some support by extending ₹1,000-₹1,500.”
Sharing his interactions with women beneficiaries, Arvind Kejriwal stated, “I have met several women, and all of them have such emotional stories. How are women using this money? What are they spending it on? There is one woman who is extremely poor. Her father is unwell. She goes to a medical store to purchase medicines for him. The shopkeeper is also a kind man who gives her medicines on credit and records the amount in a notebook against her name, noting how much the medicines cost. Whenever she gets some money, she clears her dues.”
He continued, “A few days ago, she went to buy medicines again. The shopkeeper gave her the medicines and started taking out his notebook to record the amount. She immediately pulled money out of her pocket and told him, ‘There is no need to write anything down now. Take this money for the medicines.’ The shopkeeper asked her where she got this money from. She replied, ‘Bhagwant Mann has sent it.’ Several women have purchased new clothes for themselves. Many have bought earrings.”
Arvind Kejriwal emphasised, “There are so many women and daughters whose education would have come to a halt if this ₹1,000 had not reached their accounts. That would have been extremely unfortunate. All these political parties have announced that if they form the government, the first thing they will do is shut down the Mawan Dheeyan scheme and discontinue free electricity.”
He added, “The opposition parties are saying this. A very senior Congress leader said in an interview, ‘What is the need for this scheme? It is putting a huge burden on the government. The Mawan Dheeyan scheme and free electricity should be discontinued.’ Congress has officially announced that if it forms the government, it will shut down the scheme. But your government will be formed only if someone votes for you. If nobody votes for you, how will you form the government?”
Targeting PM Narendra Modi over his criticism of welfare schemes, Arvind Kejriwal asserted, “PM Modi calls these benefits free ‘revdis’. He says these are freebies. Whose money is government money? It belongs to the people. Government money does not belong to anybody's father. The money that women are receiving under the Mawan Dheeyan scheme belongs to them. They have every right over that money.”
Arvind Kejriwal continued, “PM Modi says these welfare schemes should be stopped. Ever since the BJP government came to power in Delhi, it has shut down all the schemes that we had introduced. They have closed Mohalla Clinics in Delhi. They are going to discontinue free electricity. They have stopped the provision of free medicines in hospitals. They have also shut down the tirth yatra scheme in Delhi.”
The AAP Chief warned, “Beware of the other political parties. They have made it clear that these schemes can continue only on one condition. There is just one condition: Bhagwant Singh Mann must be made Chief Minister again. If the Aam Aadmi Party government returns to power, only then will these schemes continue. Do not make the mistake of voting for the other parties. Ask the people of Delhi. They are regretting their decision. Everything has been shut down there. They will shut everything down here as well.”
Arvind Kejriwal stated, “Congress, Akali Dal and BJP, all these parties will shut down these schemes. Therefore, I want to appeal to all the mothers, sisters and daughters who are receiving this money. Some of you may support the Akali Dal or BJP or Congress. But this time, CM Bhagwant Singh Mann has helped you. Never abandon the hand of someone who comes forward to help you. Hold on to that hand. CM Bhagwant Singh Mann has extended his support to you. This time every woman's vote, every mother's vote, every daughter's vote and every sister's vote should go to the Aam Aadmi Party. It should go to the ‘jhaadu’ (broom) symbol.”
Appealing directly to women voters, Arvind Kejriwal stated, “Today, I want to fold my hands and make a request to all the mothers and sisters. I trust you will vote for us, but you must also speak to the men in your families. Speak to your fathers and husbands. Tell them that they must also vote for the Aam Aadmi Party. When you speak to them, they may ask, ‘Why should I vote for the Aam Aadmi Party? CM Bhagwant Singh Mann is giving you ₹1,000. What is he giving me?’ I have heard that some men are unhappy. They say that women are receiving ₹1,000, but what are we getting?”
“So, I want to tell all the mothers and sisters to fold their hands and tell their husbands, younger brothers-in-law and brothers: ‘Did CM Bhagwant Mann not make your electricity free?’ Making electricity free benefited the men as well. Now, if the government is giving ₹1,000 to women, they will use that money to meet household expenses. They will buy groceries and essential supplies for you and the family. They will spend that money on you as well.”
Arvind Kejriwal urged women to remind their family members of the government's other initiatives, stating, “Ask them whether canal water has been delivered to their fields. Ask them whether they are getting electricity during the daytime for their agricultural use. Has the government benefited them or not? Has it provided them with ₹10 lakh in health insurance or not? Tell them that everyone must vote for the Aam Aadmi Party.”
Arvind Kejriwal asserted, “Nobody has done this before for people of Punjab. No political party before this has ever directly deposited ₹1,000 into women's bank accounts. No political party before this has provided health insurance to your families. No political party before this has taken you on ‘tirth yatras.’”
Appealing to women to convince their older family members, he stated, “Speak to your fathers. All women should speak to their fathers-in-law, fathers, maternal uncles, paternal uncles and elder paternal uncles. Tell them to vote for the Aam Aadmi Party because this government has organised ‘tirth yatra’ for you. You have to convince everyone. Every single vote, whether it belongs to a man or a woman, must go to the ‘jhaadu' symbol. Forget which political party someone belongs to. This time, every single vote must go to the ‘jhaadu’.”
Arvind Kejriwal urged women to speak to their sons as well, stating, “Speak to your sons as well. Tell them that under the Aam Aadmi Party government, more than 70,000 jobs have been provided without any bribery. Your son will also get a job. Jobs are being given purely on merit. Whoever deserves a job will get one. I had come to this very stage during the last elections and left after giving you 5 guarantees. Today, I am giving you the biggest guarantee of all.”
He asserted, “The other political parties are saying that if their government comes to power, they will shut this scheme down and that scheme down. But today, Kejriwal is giving you another guarantee that no welfare scheme will be discontinued in Punjab. No one has the courage to shut anything down. Everything will continue. Your tirth yatra scheme will continue. Your health insurance will continue. Your Mawan Dheeyan Satkar Yojna will continue. Your free electricity will continue. All your schemes will continue. There is just one condition: Give your blessings to CM Bhagwant Singh Mann.”
Making a final appeal to women voters, the AAP Chief stated, “Spend this money on whatever you wish. But please do one thing: Make sure you buy yourself a new set of clothes. On election day, wear those new clothes, go to the polling booth and press the button against the ‘jhaadu' symbol. Ensure that CM Bhagwant Singh Mann wins with a massive majority.”

title: From Free Laptops To Jobs: Akhilesh Yadav's Big Promise For Gen Z Ahead Of UP Polls
description: English News: Read here all the latest news from India and around the world on Times Now Website.
author: Apoorva Shukla
content:
Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav has made a series of promises aimed at young voters, particularly Gen Z, ahead of the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections. Unveiling the party's manifesto, Yadav promised 25 lakh government jobs over five years, employment opportunities for two to three crore youngsters, free laptops for students clearing Class 12 and an Urban Employment Guarantee Act for young people in cities.
"We will bring back the laptop-distribution scheme for students passing the Class-12 exam," Akhilesh Yadav said, adding that a state education policy would be introduced to ensure equal access to quality education.
The SP government would also reopen 26,000 primary schools allegedly shut by the current Bharatiya Janata Party-led regime in Uttar Pradesh, he said. Yadav promised 25 lakh government jobs for youngsters over the next five years, along with employment opportunities for another two to three crore young people across other sectors.
He promised a time-bound and transparent process, backed by an annual calendar of vacancies and examinations and a corruption-free recruitment system to prevent paper leaks.
"For vacancies requiring a single examination, the entire recruitment process will be completed within three months. For vacancies involving more than one examination, the process will be completed within six months," he said.
He said that officials and ministers would be held personally accountable for any lapses. The results would be declared on time and transparently, and no irregularities would be tolerated, he said.
"Achhe din aaye nahin, bure din jaane wale hain (The 'good days' never came, but the bad days are about to end)," he said at the release event in Lucknow, playing on "Achhe din aane wale hain" (Good days are coming), the slogan the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) campaigned on under Narendra Modi in the 2014 Lok Sabha election. Delivering on the aspirations of Gen-Z and Gen Alpha will be part of our commitment," Yadav said, speaking in Hindi.
"Today we talk about AI and digital platforms; our government (2012-17) brought HCL to Lucknow. We built an IT City in Lucknow for employment," he said.

title: Deepathoon Row: Tamil Nadu BJP Directs Lamp-Lighting At All Murugan Temples Every Friday
description: The Tamil Nadu BJP has initiated a campaign to light lamps at all Lord Murugan temples every Friday to encourage public participation.
author: Ananya Varma
content:
Amid the ongoing Thiruparankundram Deepam controversy, the Tamil Nadu BJP has called for lamps to be lit at all Lord Murugan temples across the state every Friday. The announcement follows a circular issued by state BJP president Nainar Nagendran.
In a post on X, the BJP Tamil Nadu said, “Lighting of lamps at all Murugan temples every Friday. Our state president, Mr. @NainarBJP,” while sharing the announcement.
According to the circular, the initiative aims to address the Tamil Nadu government’s stance regarding the Thirupparankundram temple issue and encourage devotees and the general public to visit Murugan temples across Tamil Nadu every Friday and light lamps in a peaceful manner.
The circular also announced the formation of a state-level committee to coordinate and implement the programme. The committee comprises former MP K Ramalingam as State Vice President, Vinay P Selvam as State Secretary, D Malarkodi as State Secretary, and C Dharmaj as State Executive Committee Member.
What is the dispute about?
The dispute over lighting the Karthigai Deepam lamp at the Deepathoon, an ancient stone pillar atop Thiruparankundram hill near Madurai, has escalated into a major political flashpoint involving the BJP, Sangh Parivar outfits, the Tamil Nadu government, and opposition parties.
The Maha Deepam was lit above the Uchi Pillayar temple at Thiruparankundram Hills as part of the annual Karthigai Deepam festival amid heavy security and escalating tensions. However, no deepam was lit at the Deepathoon stone pillar.
The Supreme Court was informed on Wednesday that the ceremonial lamp was not lit at the Deepathoon despite its
specific interim order permitting the ritual at the site, though the contempt petition is yet to be examined.
The top court, in its November 20 order, had permitted the lighting of the ceremonial lamp at Deepathoon on November 24 through a restricted team authorised by the Devasthanam. It had directed that the composition and number of team members be settled by the District Collector in consultation with the Temple Executive Officer, the Archaeological Survey of India and the Police Commissioner.
The opposition groups accused the BJP and Sangh Parivar of seeking to disturb communal harmony in Tamil Nadu.
(With agency inputs)

title: 26/11 acquitted Fahim Ansari moves SC after being denied police clearance to drive auto-rickshaw
description: Acquitted up to the Supreme Court in the 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks case, Fahim Ansari has approached the top court seeking a police clearance certificate to drive an auto-rickshaw after the Bombay High Court rejected his plea.
author: Ajay Awana
content:
26/11 acquitted Fahim Ansari moves SC after being denied police clearance to drive auto-rickshaw
Acquitted up to the Supreme Court in the 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks case, Fahim Ansari has approached the top court seeking a police clearance certificate to drive an auto-rickshaw after the Bombay High Court rejected his plea.
New Delhi: 18 years after being arrested and subsequently cleared of all charges in the 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks case, Fahim Ansari is struggling to earn a living and has approached the Supreme Court after authorities denied him the police clearance needed to operate an auto-rickshaw.
According to news agency Press Trust of India (PTI), Ansari challenged a Bombay High Court order that rejected his plea for a police clearance certificate on grounds of public safety and security. In his petition, he argued that denying him the document despite his acquittal is arbitrary, discriminatory, and violates his fundamental right to livelihood.
Ansari and Sabauddin Ahmed Shaikh were arrested shortly after the November 26, 2008 attacks, which killed 166 people, on allegations of preparing hand-drawn target maps of Mumbai locations for Lashkar-e-Taiba handlers. Mumbai Police claimed a map was recovered from slain terrorist Abu Ismail.
Past acquittal and UP conviction
In May 2010, a special court acquitted both men for lack of evidence, a decision later upheld by the Bombay High Court and the Supreme Court. Special Judge M L Tahaliyani dismissed the map theory, observing, “When sophisticated ways like Global Positioning System and from Google site maps of fixing topographical points are available, then the rustic method of hand-prepared maps being used was improbable.”
The Bombay High Court agreed, noting that a map recovered from Ismail’s pocket would have carried bloodstains and wrinkles from the gunfight. However, Ansari was later convicted by a Rampur court in Uttar Pradesh for possessing fake documents and served a 10-year prison sentence before being released in 2019.
Struggle for livelihood
Trying to support his wife and daughter, Ansari approached the Bombay High Court in January seeking police clearance to obtain a public service vehicle badge.
The Maharashtra government opposed the plea, citing character verification guidelines and submitting a confidential intelligence note. On April 30, the High Court dismissed his petition in the “larger interest of public safety and security,” prompting Ansari to seek the Supreme Court’s intervention.

title: Bhargavastra: India’s first indigenous system to counter drone swarms completes trials at Pokhran
description: Solar Defence and Aerospace Limited has completed in-house development trials of Bhargavastra, a vehicle-mounted system designed to counter drone swarms. The company tested the system at the Pokhran field firing ranges in Rajasthan from November 20 to 24. The next step is a prototype demonstration under the Indian Army’s procurement programme.
author: Adan Khan
content:
Bhargavastra: India’s first indigenous system to counter drone swarms completes trials at Pokhran
Solar Defence and Aerospace Limited has completed in-house development trials of Bhargavastra, a vehicle-mounted system designed to counter drone swarms. The company tested the system at the Pokhran field firing ranges in Rajasthan from November 20 to 24. The next step is a prototype demonstration under the Indian Army’s procurement programme.
New Delhi: Solar Defence and Aerospace Limited (SDAL) has completed in-house development trials of Bhargavastra at the Pokhran field firing ranges in Rajasthan. The company describes it as India’s first indigenously designed and developed two-layer, vehicle-mounted counter-swarm drone system. It is designed to detect, track and engage multiple hostile drones.
Two versions of Bhargavastra
SDAL developed two versions of the system. Version I uses air defence rockets. Version II adds guided micro-missiles, which the company developed on its own initiative. Both versions bring together equipment for detecting and tracking drones and a command system that coordinates the response.
#WATCH | Solar Defence and Aerospace Limited (SDAL) has successfully designed, developed and integrated Bhargavastra, a Vehicle-Mounted Counter Swarm Drone System (VMCSDS), and completed its in-house development trials at Pokaran field firing ranges from 20th to 24th November 2026. The system offers an effective, two-layer defence against enemy drone swarms, with the capability to engage multiple drones simultaneously. Bhargavastra is India’s first indigenously designed and developed two-layer vehiclemounted counter-swarm drone system, combining air defence rockets and guided micro-missiles to provide an integrated solution against this emerging threat.
(Video Source: Solar Defence and Aerospace Limited (SDAL)
— ANI (@ANI) November 26, 2026
SDAL said it developed the system and its software in India. It also said the rockets and micro-missiles were developed domestically and that it holds the intellectual property rights for the system.
What the trials tested
During the November 20 to 24 trials, SDAL carried out multiple firings of rockets and micro-missiles. The company said the system detected and tracked drones flying in a swarm before firing rockets at the targets. According to SDAL, the rocket warheads struck their designated points.
The company also conducted separate tests to assess whether the micro-missiles could track and home in on drones during flight. SDAL said those tests were successful. It plans further trials and refinements before the system moves through the Army’s evaluation process.
Army prototype demonstration next
The Ministry of Defence issued the Army’s requirement for a vehicle-mounted counter-swarm drone system on July 9, 2024, under the Make II programme. The original requirement called for a rocket-based system, which SDAL developed as Version I. The company developed the guided micro-missile version separately.
The programme calls for one prototype set and 12 additional sets after a successful prototype demonstration. It sets March 31, 2027, as the project completion date.
SDAL said Bhargavastra is ready for a prototype demonstration in the configuration it plans to deliver. That demonstration is the next step in the Army’s evaluation and must succeed before the additional sets are delivered under the programme.

title: Delhi Police busts international cyber slavery racket, rescues 164 foreign nationals
description: Delhi Police Crime Branch has dismantled a major human trafficking and cyber fraud syndicate, rescuing 164 Indonesian and Malaysian nationals held captive and arresting a Malaysian suspect after seizing hundreds of electronic devices.
author: Ajay Awana
content:
Delhi Police busts international cyber slavery racket, rescues 164 foreign nationals
Delhi Police Crime Branch has dismantled a major human trafficking and cyber fraud syndicate, rescuing 164 Indonesian and Malaysian nationals held captive and arresting a Malaysian suspect after seizing hundreds of electronic devices.
New Delhi: The Delhi Police Crime Branch has dismantled a major international human trafficking and cyber slavery syndicate that lured foreign nationals to India with promises of lucrative jobs before holding them captive to run online scams. During the operation, the Inter-State Cell rescued 164 foreign citizens-92 from Indonesia and 72 from Malaysia-from alleged illegal confinement.
Police also arrested a 25-year-old Malaysian national, Tan Guan Wei, and seized 549 digital devices, 174 passports, and servers from the premises.
Speaking at a press conference at the Delhi Police Headquarters, Joint Commissioner of Police (Crime Branch) Surendra Kumar stated that the raid was conducted under the supervision of DCP Aditya Gautam following specific intelligence inputs. Initial investigations revealed that victims were brought to India with false promises of high-paying jobs, after which their passports were confiscated, and they were forced into cyber fraud.
Fake profiles used to trap victims
Investigators found that the gang members created fictional female identities and fake profiles on social media and messaging platforms to target victims. After building trust through friendly conversations, they lured people into investing large sums on fraudulent trading and investment platforms.
Authorities suspect the scam operated through multiple websites and APK-based applications, including platforms named Gentrix and Quantvoro.
Massive seizure and role of local handlers
During the raid, officers recovered 355 mobile phones, comprising 335 used devices and 20 brand-new sealed units, alongside 168 desktop computers, 26 laptops, and 53 SIM cards, which included 31 foreign and 22 Indian numbers. Police also seized 95 Indonesian and 79 Malaysian passports.
The probe has further uncovered the involvement of two Indian handlers, identified as Sunil Kumar and Sushil Kumar, whose bank accounts were allegedly used to pay rent and fund the network’s daily operations.
A case was registered at the Crime Branch police station on November 26, 2026, under relevant sections of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, as police continue to trace money trails and other syndicate members.

title: Child Marriage: 2030 तक बाल विवाह मुक्त भारत बनाने का संकल्प, दिल्ली में 2,000 लोगों ने निकाला मशाल जुलूस
description: Child Marriage: दिल्ली में बाल विवाह के खिलाफ लोगों ने एकजुट होकर जागरूकता अभियान चलाया है. केंद्रीय मंत्री सावित्री ठाकुर की मौजूदगी में करीब 2,000 लोगों ने मशाल जुलूस निकाला है. इस दौरान 2030 तक देश से बाल विवाह खत्म करने का संकल्प लिया गया.
author: CNBC Awaaz Digital
content:
Child Marriage: देश को 2030 तक बाल विवाह मुक्त बनाने के संकल्प के साथ दिल्ली में जागरूकता मार्च निकाला गया है. केंद्रीय मंत्री सावित्री ठाकुर की अगुवाई में करीब 2,000 लोगों ने हिस्सा लिया और बाल विवाह के खिलाफ आवाज उठाते हुए बेटियों के सुरक्षित भविष्य का संदेश दिया है.
दिल्ली में 2,000 लोगों ने निकाला मशाल जुलूस
दिल्ली के कुसुमपुर पहाड़ी इलाके में संविधान दिवस और बाल, कम उम्र एवं जबरन विवाह के उन्मूलन के लिए पहले अंतरराष्ट्रीय दिवस की पूर्व संध्या पर यह कार्यक्रम आयोजित किया गया है.केंद्रीय महिला एवं बाल विकास राज्य मंत्री सावित्री ठाकुर ने महिलाओं, बच्चों, स्थानीय निवासियों और बाल विवाह से बचाई गई बेटियों के साथ मशाल जुलूस निकाला है. इस दौरान लोगों ने दीये जलाकर भी बाल विवाह के खिलाफ अपना समर्थन जताया है.
यह कार्यक्रम बच्चों के अधिकारों की सुरक्षा के लिए काम करने वाले संगठन जस्ट राइट्स फॉर चिल्ड्रेन ने आयोजित किया था. मार्च में करीब 2,000 लोगों ने हिस्सा लिया है. मंत्री ने सभी को शपथ दिलाई कि वे न तो बाल विवाह करेंगे और न ही इसमें किसी तरह की मदद करेंगे. अगर कहीं बाल विवाह की जानकारी मिलती है, तो तुरंत अधिकारियों को इसकी सूचना देंगे.
देश में बाल विवाह की दर घटी
सावित्री ठाकुर ने बताया कि प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी के नेतृत्व में 2024 में शुरू हुए 'बाल विवाह मुक्त भारत' अभियान के सकारात्मक नतीजे दिख रहे हैं. राष्ट्रीय परिवार स्वास्थ्य सर्वेक्षण के मुताबिक, देश में बाल विवाह की दर 2005-06 में 47.4 फीसदी थी, जो 2023-24 में घटकर 20.1 फीसदी रह गई है.
उन्होंने बताया कि 2024 से अब तक सरकार 6.86 लाख से ज्यादा जागरूकता कार्यक्रम कर चुकी है. इनके जरिए 12.5 करोड़ लोगों तक पहुंच बनाई गई है. 'बाल विवाह मुक्त भारत' पोर्टल पर 72 हजार से ज्यादा बाल विवाह निषेध अधिकारियों की जानकारी उपलब्ध है. इनमें करीब 60 हजार अधिकारी ग्राम पंचायत स्तर पर नियुक्त हैं.
27 नवंबर को पहली बार अंतरराष्ट्रीय दिवस
इस कार्यक्रम में जस्ट राइट्स फॉर चिल्ड्रेन के संस्थापक भुवन ऋभु ने कहा कि 2030 तक बाल विवाह खत्म करना अब एक ऐसा लक्ष्य है, जिसे हासिल किया जा सकता है, उन्होंने बताया कि संयुक्त राष्ट्र महासभा ने 4 सितंबर 2026 को सर्वसम्मति से 27 नवंबर को बाल, कम उम्र और जबरन विवाह के उन्मूलन के लिए अंतरराष्ट्रीय दिवस घोषित किया था.
इस पहल को भारत समेत 84 देशों का समर्थन मिला है. भुवन ऋभु ने कहा कि बाल विवाह बच्चों के अधिकारों का गंभीर उल्लंघन है और इसे खत्म करने के लिए सरकार के साथ समाज को भी मिलकर काम करना होगा.

title: BigBasket पर FDA का बड़ा एक्शन! गोदाम में चूहे, खाने के सामान के साथ मिली सिगरेट, फूड लाइसेंस सस्पेंड
description: BigBasket Food Licence Suspend: ऑनलाइन ग्रॉसरी खरीदने वालों के लिए महाराष्ट्र से बड़ी खबर सामने आई है. बिगबास्केट के नवी मुंबई गोदाम में जांच के दौरान सिगरेट, चूहों से खराब सामान और साफ-सफाई की कमियां मिलीं हैं. इसके बाद एफडीए ने फूड लाइसेंस सस्पेंड कर दिया है.
author: SHIVANI SHARMA
content:
BigBasket Food Licence Suspend: ऑनलाइन ग्रॉसरी खरीदने वालों के लिए बड़ी खबर है. महाराष्ट्र में बिगबास्केट के एक गोदाम में जांच के दौरान चूहों के निशान, खाने के सामान के साथ सिगरेट और साफ-सफाई में कई कमियां मिलीं हैं. जिसके बाद कंपनी का फूड लाइसेंस सस्पेंड कर दिया गया है.
बिगबास्केट के गोदाम में क्या मिला?
महाराष्ट्र के फूड एंड ड्रग एडमिनिस्ट्रेशन (FDA) ने नवी मुंबई के नेरुल में बिगबास्केट की स्टोरेज और डिस्ट्रीब्यूशन फैसिलिटी का फूड लाइसेंस सस्पेंड कर दिया है. यह फैसिलिटी इनोवेटिव रिटेल कॉन्सेप्ट्स प्राइवेट लिमिटेड चलाती है. 21 नवंबर को हुई जांच में यूनिट को 196 में से 127 अंक मिले, यानी कि 65 फीसदी है. इसे नियमों का पालन नहीं करने वाली कैटेगरी में रखा गया है.
एफडीए के मुताबिक, यहां खाने के सामान के साथ सिगरेट बेची जा रही थी. चूहों के निशान मिले, तेल के पैकेट फटे हुए थे और चूहों से खराब हुआ स्टॉक अलग रखा गया था. पर्याप्त रैट ट्रैप और पेस्ट कंट्रोल प्रोग्राम भी नहीं मिला है.
खाने का सामान, पेट फूड और दूसरे नॉन-फूड प्रोडक्ट एक ही रैक पर रखे थे. कुछ खाने-पीने की चीजे फर्श पर फटे पैकेट में मिली. इस दौरान सामान की खरीदारी के बिल और डिलीवरी चालान भी नहीं दिखाए गए. 34 फूड हैंडलर्स के मेडिकल जांच और वैक्सीनेशन सर्टिफिकेट भी उपलब्ध नहीं थे.
72 घंटे में खराब सामान नष्ट करने का आदेश
एफडीए ने चूहों से खराब स्टॉक, फटे तेल के पैकेट और फर्श पर रखे खाद्य पदार्थ 72 घंटे में नष्ट करने का आदेश दिया है. ये कार्रवाई फूड सेफ्टी अधिकारियों की निगरानी में होगी. सिगरेट और तंबाकू उत्पाद तुरंत हटाने को भी कहा गया है.
इलायची के चार सैंपल जांच के लिए लिए गए हैं. संबंधित बैच की बिक्री और सप्लाई रिपोर्ट आने तक रोक दी गई है. कंपनी को 15 दिन में जवाब देना होगा कि लाइसेंस क्यों न रद्द किया जाए. कम से कम 14 दिन बाद दोबारा जांच की जाएगी.

title: Samajwadi Party Manifesto 2027: अखिलेश यादव का बड़ा एलान, 25 लाख सरकारी नौकरी और बेरोजगार युवाओं को हर महीने ₹
description: अखिलेश यादव ने उत्तर प्रदेश में जातिगत जनगणना कराने का भी वादा किया. उन्होंने कहा कि इसके जरिए अलग-अलग जातियों की आर्थिक और सामाजिक स्थिति का आकलन किया जाएगा, ताकि उनके उत्थान के लिए योजनाएं बनाई जा सकें.
author: Samarth Saraswat
content:
Samajwadi Party Manifesto 2027: उत्तर प्रदेश में 2027 में होने वाले विधानसभा चुनाव से पहले समाजवादी पार्टी (SP) ने अपना चुनावी घोषणा पत्र जारी कर दिया है.
पार्टी प्रमुख अखिलेश यादव ने गुरुवार को घोषणा पत्र जारी करते हुए युवाओं, महिलाओं, किसानों और सामाजिक कल्याण से जुड़े कई बड़े वादे किए. समाजवादी पार्टी ने अगले पांच साल में 25 लाख सरकारी नौकरियां देने और बेरोजगार ग्रेजुएट युवाओं को हर महीने ₹5,000 भत्ता देने का वादा किया है.
अखिलेश यादव ने कहा कि जब तक ग्रेजुएट युवाओं को रोजगार नहीं मिलता, तब तक उन्हें हर महीने ₹5,000 की आर्थिक सहायता दी जाएगी. इसके अलावा, भर्ती परीक्षाओं को तय समय पर कराने का भी वादा किया गया है.
पेपर लीक होने पर अधिकारियों की तय होगी जिम्मेदारी
समाजवादी पार्टी ने अपने घोषणा पत्र में भर्ती परीक्षाओं और पेपर लीक के मुद्दे को भी प्रमुखता दी है. अखिलेश यादव ने कहा कि अगर किसी परीक्षा का पेपर लीक होता है तो संबंधित अधिकारियों की व्यक्तिगत जिम्मेदारी तय की जाएगी. उन्होंने सभी भर्ती परीक्षाएं निर्धारित समय पर कराने का वादा भी किया.
इसके अलावा, पार्टी ने ₹5 में भोजन उपलब्ध कराने के लिए समाजवादी कैंटीन शुरू करने का एलान किया है.
जातिगत जनगणना कराने का वादा
अखिलेश यादव ने उत्तर प्रदेश में जातिगत जनगणना कराने का भी वादा किया. उन्होंने कहा कि इसके जरिए अलग-अलग जातियों की आर्थिक और सामाजिक स्थिति का आकलन किया जाएगा, ताकि उनके उत्थान के लिए योजनाएं बनाई जा सकें.
उन्होंने कहा कि महिलाओं से जुड़ा एक अलग घोषणा पत्र भी जल्द जारी किया जाएगा. अखिलेश यादव ने राज्य में अपराध के खिलाफ जीरो टॉलरेंस नीति अपनाने की बात कही. उन्होंने दलितों, पिछड़े वर्गों, अल्पसंख्यकों, मुस्लिमों, महिलाओं और बच्चों के खिलाफ गंभीर अपराधों पर सख्त कार्रवाई का वादा किया.
तीन वर्ल्ड क्लास स्टेडियम और 10 स्पोर्ट्स कॉलेज बनाने का वादा
समाजवादी पार्टी ने उत्तर प्रदेश में खेल सुविधाओं को बढ़ावा देने के लिए तीन विश्वस्तरीय स्टेडियम और 10 स्पोर्ट्स कॉलेज बनाने का वादा किया है. इसके अलावा, पूर्वांचल में भोजपुरी फिल्म सिटी विकसित करने और राज्य में पांच सुपर स्पेशियलिटी अस्पताल बनाने की योजना भी घोषणा पत्र में शामिल है.
20 लाख लैपटॉप बांटने और चार शहरों में IT हब बनाने का एलान
टेक्नोलॉजी और डिजिटल शिक्षा के क्षेत्र में समाजवादी पार्टी ने उत्तर प्रदेश के चार बड़े शहरों में IT हब विकसित करने का वादा किया है. इसके साथ ही राज्य में 20 लाख लैपटॉप बांटने की भी घोषणा की गई है.
बुजुर्गों और दिव्यांगों को सालाना ₹40,000 पेंशन
समाजवादी पार्टी के घोषणा पत्र में सामाजिक सुरक्षा से जुड़े कई वादे भी शामिल हैं. पार्टी ने बुजुर्ग पुरुषों और महिलाओं के साथ दिव्यांगों को सालाना ₹40,000 पेंशन देने का प्रस्ताव रखा है. इसके अलावा, नदियों के किनारे बसे शहरों में रिवरफ्रंट विकसित करने का भी वादा किया गया है.
गौरतलब है कि उत्तर प्रदेश विधानसभा में कुल 403 सीटें हैं. राज्य में अगले विधानसभा चुनाव फरवरी-मार्च 2027 में होने की उम्मीद है. अखिलेश यादव के नेतृत्व में समाजवादी पार्टी ने रोजगार, शिक्षा, स्वास्थ्य और सामाजिक कल्याण को चुनाव के प्रमुख मुद्दे बनाने की रणनीति अपनाई है.

title: Bhargavastra trials completed: How India's new system can destroy drone swarms
description: Bhargavastra is a mobile, multi-layered defence system designed to destroy hostile drones, weaponised unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), loitering munitions and autonomous drone swarms
author: Manjeet Negi
content:
READ THIS: India's Tejas is getting a major upgrade: What makes the Mk1A a more dangerous fighter?
Bhargavastra is a mobile, multi-layered defence system designed to destroy hostile drones, weaponised unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), loitering munitions and autonomous drone swarms. It uses a combination of indigenously developed unguided rockets and precision micro-missiles to intercept and destroy aerial threats.
Its two-layer design allows it to tackle different types of drone threats using different weapons. The system employs a hard-kill approach, meaning it physically destroys hostile drones rather than relying on electronic methods such as jamming communication signals or disrupting navigation systems. This makes it particularly relevant against autonomous drones that may continue operating even when their communication links are disrupted.
Mounted on vehicles, Bhargavastra can be moved and deployed according to operational requirements. It is designed to operate across different geographical conditions, including deserts, plains and high-altitude areas of up to 5,000 metres above mean sea level, making it suitable for deployment across India's varied border terrain.
How Bhargvastra detects and destroys drones
Bhargavastra's Command and Control Centre acts as the system's brain, bringing together information from multiple sensors to detect and track incoming aerial threats.
The system is equipped with radar capable of detecting drones at distances of up to 10 km, along with Electro-Optical/Infrared (EO/IR) surveillance systems and passive radio frequency (RF) sensors. These technologies help identify the presence of drones, track their movement and classify threats.
ALSO READ: Bullets, blasts and 28 soldiers: India's new armoured bus has a surprise under the hood
Once a drone or swarm is detected, the command-and-control system analyses the information and provides operators with a real-time picture of the aerial threat. It can then assign targets to the launcher, enabling the system to respond to incoming drones.
The ability to detect and track multiple drones is particularly important as drone swarms can overwhelm conventional air defence systems by approaching in large numbers. Bhargavastra is designed to address this challenge by providing a dedicated capability to counter such attacks. The system is also designed to integrate with the Indian Armed Forces' Command, Control, Communication and Intelligence (C4I) networks, allowing it to operate as part of a broader military surveillance and defence network.
The completion of the latest in-house development trials at Pokaran marks a further milestone in the development of Bhargavastra, an indigenous system aimed at addressing the rapidly evolving threat posed by drones and drone swarms on the battlefield.

title: Centre seeks Parliament sitting from November 30 amid buzz over delimitation, women's reservation
description: The Centre has sought to reconvene Parliament from November 30, fuelling speculation over a fresh push for delimitation and women's reservation. The proposed sittings come amid efforts to secure the two-thirds majority required to pass constitutional amendments after the government's unsuccessful attempt in April.
author: Business Today Desk
content:
The proposed sittings would effectively extend the Monsoon Session, which has not been formally prorogued since August. The 108-day gap between sittings would surpass the previous record of 87 days set in 2008.
Delimitation back in focus
The development comes amid speculation that the Centre could revive its proposal to redraw parliamentary constituencies and operationalise the 33% reservation for women under the Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam, passed in 2023.
The earlier proposal sought to increase the Lok Sabha's strength from 543 to 850 seats, with approximately 283 seats reserved for women on a rotational basis.
The government had verbally assured political parties of a uniform 50% increase in parliamentary seats across states to preserve their relative representation. However, this assurance was not incorporated into the proposed legislation.
NDA's numbers challenge
According to NDTV, the NDA has reportedly secured the support of 319 MPs, including 241 BJP lawmakers, against an estimated requirement of around 360 votes, depending on attendance.
MUST READ: UP elections: ₹5,000 unemployment allowance, 25 lakh government jobs - Can Akhilesh Yadav's promises pass the fiscal test?
Support from eight NCP (Sharadchandra Pawar) MPs and 22 DMK lawmakers could strengthen the government's position, although their backing remains uncertain.
NCP(SP) leader Supriya Sule has indicated that her party could support the legislation if parliamentary representation increases uniformly across states without regional bias.
Opposition's four conditions
The Congress-led INDIA bloc, DMK and Aam Aadmi Party have outlined four conditions for supporting the legislation. These include retaining the Lok Sabha's existing strength of 543 seats, maintaining each state's current representation, reserving 182 existing seats for women and freezing this arrangement for 25 years through a constitutional amendment.
The Opposition has argued that women's reservation should be implemented independently of delimitation, while the government has accused rival parties of obstructing women's political empowerment.
Time remains a crucial factor. Any further delay in securing parliamentary approval could complicate efforts to complete the delimitation exercise and conduct the 2029 Lok Sabha elections under revised constituency boundaries.

title: UP elections: ₹5,000 unemployment allowance, 25 lakh government jobs - Can Akhilesh Yadav's promises pass the fiscal test?
description: The manifesto, titled Sattais Ka Sankalp: PDA Ka Pran Patra, promises two to three crore employment opportunities across other sectors, an immediate farm loan waiver, free electricity and restoration of the Old Pension Scheme (OPS).
author: Business Today Desk
content:
The manifesto, titled Sattais Ka Sankalp: PDA Ka Pran Patra, also promises two to three crore employment opportunities across other sectors, an immediate farm loan waiver, free electricity and restoration of the Old Pension Scheme (OPS).
How much could the unemployment allowance cost?
Under the proposed unemployment allowance, eligible graduates would receive ₹5,000 every month until they secure employment, translating into an annual financial assistance of ₹60,000 per beneficiary.
The overall expenditure would depend on eligibility criteria, the number of registered unemployed graduates and the duration for which beneficiaries receive assistance.
If 10 lakh graduates qualify, the annual expenditure could reach ₹6,000 crore. With 20 lakh beneficiaries, the financial burden would double to ₹12,000 crore annually.
Over five years, assuming a constant beneficiary base of 20 lakh, the scheme could cost the state ₹60,000 crore.
However, these are illustrative estimates, as the party has not disclosed detailed beneficiary projections or expenditure calculations in the information available.
The cost of creating 25 lakh government jobs
The promise of creating 25 lakh government jobs over five years translates into an average of five lakh recruitments annually.
Assuming an average monthly salary of ₹30,000 per employee, the annual salary expenditure for five lakh additional employees would amount to ₹18,000 crore.
Once all 25 lakh positions are filled, the annual salary bill could reach ₹90,000 crore, assuming these represent additional employees rather than replacements for existing staff.
This excludes allowances, pension liabilities, annual increments, healthcare benefits and administrative expenditure, which could increase the overall financial commitment.
Other welfare commitments
Employment-related expenditure represents only one component of the manifesto's broader financial commitments.
The SP has also proposed a ₹15,000 crore corpus to facilitate timely payments to sugarcane farmers, ₹1.5 lakh crore for rural infrastructure, ₹10 lakh health insurance for BPL families and up to 300 units of free electricity for rural households.
Restoring the Old Pension Scheme could create additional long-term pension liabilities.
Can Uttar Pradesh afford these promises?
The financial viability of these commitments would depend on growth in tax collections, central transfers, expenditure rationalisation and the state's borrowing capacity.
While employment generation and welfare spending could stimulate consumption and economic activity, large recurring commitments could also constrain capital expenditure and widen the fiscal deficit without corresponding revenue growth.
A definitive fiscal assessment would require detailed cost estimates, recruitment plans, beneficiary projections and a credible funding roadmap.

title: అఖిలేశ్ కూడా ఆరు నెలలు జైలుకు వచ్చి ఉంటే.. వేదికపైనే మనసులో మాట చెప్పిన ఆజం ఖాన్
description: సమాజ్‌వాదీ పార్టీ (ఎస్పీ) సీనియర్ నేత ఆజం ఖాన్ మరోసారి తన జైలు జీవితాన్ని గుర్తుచేసుకున్నారు. పార్టీ అధినేత అఖిలేశ్ యాదవ్ సమక్షంలోనే ఆయన చేసిన వ్యాఖ్యలు ఇప్పుడు చర్చనీయాంశమయ్యాయి.
author: ABN
content:
అఖిలేశ్ కూడా ఆరు నెలలు జైలుకు వచ్చి ఉంటే.. వేదికపైనే మనసులో మాట చెప్పిన ఆజం ఖాన్
ABN , Publish Date - Nov 26 , 2026 | 09:47 PM
సమాజ్‌వాదీ పార్టీ (ఎస్పీ) సీనియర్ నేత ఆజం ఖాన్ మరోసారి తన జైలు జీవితాన్ని గుర్తుచేసుకున్నారు. పార్టీ అధినేత అఖిలేశ్ యాదవ్ సమక్షంలోనే ఆయన చేసిన వ్యాఖ్యలు ఇప్పుడు చర్చనీయాంశమయ్యాయి.
ఇంటర్నెట్ డెస్క్: సమాజ్‌వాదీ పార్టీ (ఎస్పీ) సీనియర్ నేత ఆజం ఖాన్ మరోసారి తన జైలు జీవితాన్ని గుర్తుచేసుకున్నారు. పార్టీ అధినేత అఖిలేశ్ యాదవ్ సమక్షంలోనే ఆయన చేసిన వ్యాఖ్యలు ఇప్పుడు చర్చనీయాంశమయ్యాయి. అఖిలేశ్ యాదవ్ కూడా ఆరు నెలల పాటు జైలులో ఉంటే అక్కడి బాధలు ఆయనకు తెలిసేవని తన కుమారుడితో అంటుండేవాడినని చెప్పారు. ఐదున్నరేళ్ల జైలు జీవితం తన శరీరం, మనసుపై తీవ్ర ప్రభావం చూపిందని ఆయన ఆవేదన వ్యక్తం చేశారు (Azam Khan Jail Story).
ఉత్తరప్రదేశ్ అసెంబ్లీ ఎన్నికల మేనిఫెస్టో విడుదల కార్యక్రమంలో అఖిలేశ్ యాదవ్‌తో పాటు ఆజం ఖాన్ కూడా పాల్గొన్నారు. ఈ సందర్భంగా తన జైలు అనుభవాలను ఆజం ఖాన్ వివరించారు. 'ఒకసారి జైలు నుంచి మరో ప్రాంతానికి తరలించే సమయంలో నన్ను, నా కుమారుడు అబ్దుల్లాను వేర్వేరు వాహనాల్లో తీసుకెళ్లేందుకు అధికారులు ఏర్పాట్లు చేశారు. మమ్మల్ని వేర్వేరుగా ఎందుకు తీసుకెళ్తున్నారని ప్రశ్నించినా అధికారులు సమాధానం చెప్పలేదు. అప్పుడు అబ్దుల్లాతో.. ఇదే మన చివరి కలయిక కావచ్చని చెప్పా. ఇక్కడ మళ్లీ కలవకపోతే మరో లోకంలో కలుసుకుందామని చెప్పా. ఈ ఘటన నా జీవితంలో మర్చిపోలేని బాధాకరమైన అనుభవం' అని ఆజంఖాన్ వివరించారు (Azam Khan Speech).
'ఐదున్నరేళ్ల జైలు జీవితం నన్ను మానసికంగా, శారీరకంగా తీవ్రంగా కుంగదీసింది (Uttar Pradesh Elections). నా భార్య, కుమారుడు కూడా ఎన్నో కష్టాలు ఎదుర్కొన్నారు. ఒకవేళ అఖిలేష్ యాదవ్ కూడా జైలుకు వస్తే.. ఇక్కడ ఎలా ఉంటారు? రాత్రులు ఎలా గడుస్తాయి? ఎదురయ్యే పరిస్థితులు ఏమిటి? అన్నది స్వయంగా తెలుసుకునేవారని అనుకునేవాడిని. నన్ను, నా కుటుంబాన్ని ప్రభుత్వం, ఎన్‌ఫోర్స్‌మెంట్ డైరెక్టరేట్ (ఈడీ) వంటి దర్యాప్తు సంస్థలు తీవ్రంగా వేధించాయి' అని ఆజంఖాన్ పేర్కొన్నారు.
ఇవి కూడా చదవండి..
అమెరికాను వదిలేయాలి లేదా ఉద్యోగం మానేయాలి.. హెచ్-1బీ ఉద్యోగులకు ఐబీఎం షాక్..
అమితాబ్ ఇంటికి మరోసారి బాంబు బెదిరింపు.. ముంబైలో మరిన్ని ప్రాంతాలకు హెచ్చరిక..

title: ఈ నెల 30 నుంచి లోక్‌సభ సమావేశాలు.. తెరపైకి పునర్విభజన, మహిళా రిజర్వేషన్‌ బిల్లులు?
description: ప్రత్యేక పార్లమెంట్ సమావేశాలు ప్రారంభం కాబోతున్నాయి. లోక్‌సభను ఈ నెల (నవంబర్) 30న, రాజ్యసభను వచ్చే నెల (డిసెంబర్) 3న సమావేశపరచాలని లోక్‌సభ స్పీకర్, రాజ్యసభ చైర్మన్‌ను కేంద్రం కోరింది.
author: ABN
content:
ఈ నెల 30 నుంచి లోక్‌సభ సమావేశాలు.. తెరపైకి పునర్విభజన, మహిళా రిజర్వేషన్‌ బిల్లులు?
ABN , Publish Date - Nov 26 , 2026 | 08:31 PM
ప్రత్యేక పార్లమెంట్ సమావేశాలు ప్రారంభం కాబోతున్నాయి. లోక్‌సభను ఈ నెల (నవంబర్) 30న, రాజ్యసభను వచ్చే నెల (డిసెంబర్) 3న సమావేశపరచాలని లోక్‌సభ స్పీకర్, రాజ్యసభ చైర్మన్‌ను కేంద్రం కోరింది.
ఇంటర్నెట్ డెస్క్: ప్రత్యేక పార్లమెంట్ సమావేశాలు ప్రారంభం కాబోతున్నాయి. లోక్‌సభను ఈ నెల (నవంబర్) 30న, రాజ్యసభను వచ్చే నెల (డిసెంబర్) 3న సమావేశపరచాలని లోక్‌సభ స్పీకర్, రాజ్యసభ చైర్మన్‌ను కేంద్రం కోరింది. ఈ మేరకు కేంద్ర పార్లమెంటరీ వ్యవహారాల మంత్రి కిరణ్ రిజిజు ఎక్స్‌లో పోస్ట్ చేశారు. ఈ సమావేశాలు డిసెంబర్ మూడో తేదీ వరకు ఉంటాయని ఆయన తెలిపారు. ప్రభుత్వ అత్యవసర కార్యకలాపాల కోసం ఈ సమావేశాలను ఏర్పాటు చేస్తున్నట్టు పేర్కొన్నారు. నియోజకవర్గాల పునర్విభజన, మహిళా రిజర్వేషన్లకు సంబంధించిన బిల్లుల ఆమోదం దిశగా బీజేపీ కసరత్తులు చేస్తోందనే ఊహాగానాల నడుమ కిరణ్ రిజిజు ఈ ప్రకటన చేశారు.
అయితే ప్రత్యేక పార్లమెంట్ సమావేశాల్లో ప్రవేశపెట్టే బిల్లుల వివరాలను కిరణ్ రిజిజు వెల్లడించలేదు. అయినప్పటికీ నియోజకవర్గాల పునర్విభజన, మహిళా రిజర్వేషన్ల బిల్లుల ఆమోదం కోసమే కేంద్రం ఈ సమావేశాలను ప్రారంభించబోతోందని సమాచారం. కాగా మహిళా రిజర్వేషన్ల అమలుతో పాటు లోక్‌సభ నియోజకవర్గాల పునర్విభజనకు సంబంధించిన రాజ్యాంగ సవరణ బిల్లు-2026ను ఏప్రిల్ 17న కేంద్రం లోక్‌సభలో ప్రవేశపెట్టింది. అయితే అవసరమైన మద్దతును కూడగట్టడంలో కేంద్రం విఫలం కావడంతో ఆ బిల్లు వీగిపోయింది. దీంతో ఈ ప్రతిపాదనలను మరోసారి పార్లమెంట్ ముందుకు తీసుకురావాలని కేంద్రం ప్రయత్నిస్తోంది.

title: రాహుల్ గాంధీ ఫొటో పెడితే బ్లాక్ చేస్తున్నారు.. మెటాపై కోర్టుకెక్కిన కాంగ్రెస్..
description: సోషల్ మీడియా దిగ్గజ సంస్థ మెటాతో కాంగ్రెస్ పార్టీ వివాదం మరింత ముదిరింది. తమ పార్టీ నాయకులు, కార్యకర్తలు రాహుల్ గాంధీ పేరుతో లేదా ఆయన ఫొటోలతో పెట్టే పోస్టులను మెటా సంస్థ ఉద్దేశపూర్వకంగా బ్లాక్ చేస్తోందని కాంగ్రెస్ ఆరోపిస్తోంది.
author: ABN
content:
రాహుల్ గాంధీ ఫొటో పెడితే బ్లాక్ చేస్తున్నారు.. మెటాపై కోర్టుకెక్కిన కాంగ్రెస్..
ABN , Publish Date - Nov 26 , 2026 | 07:26 PM
సోషల్ మీడియా దిగ్గజ సంస్థ మెటాతో కాంగ్రెస్ పార్టీ వివాదం మరింత ముదిరింది. తమ పార్టీ నాయకులు, కార్యకర్తలు రాహుల్ గాంధీ పేరుతో లేదా ఆయన ఫొటోలతో పెట్టే పోస్టులను మెటా సంస్థ ఉద్దేశపూర్వకంగా బ్లాక్ చేస్తోందని కాంగ్రెస్ ఆరోపిస్తోంది.
ఇంటర్నెట్ డెస్క్: సోషల్ మీడియా దిగ్గజ సంస్థ మెటాతో కాంగ్రెస్ పార్టీ వివాదం మరింత ముదిరింది. తమ పార్టీ నాయకులు, కార్యకర్తలు రాహుల్ గాంధీ పేరుతో లేదా ఆయన ఫొటోలతో పెట్టే పోస్టులను మెటా సంస్థ ఉద్దేశపూర్వకంగా బ్లాక్ చేస్తోందని కాంగ్రెస్ ఆరోపిస్తోంది. ఈ వ్యవహారంపై ఇప్పటికే మెటా కార్యాలయాల ఎదుట కాంగ్రెస్ కార్యకర్తలు ఆందోళనలు చేశారు. తాజాగా మెటాపై కాంగ్రెస్ న్యాయపోరాటానికి దిగింది (Congress vs Meta).
మెటాతో పాటు కేంద్ర ప్రభుత్వాన్ని కూడా ఇండియన్ యూత్ కాంగ్రెస్ ఢిల్లీ హైకోర్టులో సవాలు చేసింది. రాజకీయ భావప్రకటన స్వేచ్ఛను అడ్డుకునేలా నిబంధనలు ఉన్నాయని ఆరోపించింది. కాంగ్రెస్ కార్యకర్తలు రాహుల్ గాంధీ పేరుతో, ఆయన ఫొటోలతో సోషల్ మీడియాలో పోస్టులు పెడితే వాటిని మెటా ఆటోమేటిక్ విధానంలో గుర్తించి బ్లాక్ చేస్తోందని పిటిషన్‌లో పేర్కొంది. పుట్టినరోజు శుభాకాంక్షలు, నివాళులు, పెళ్లి ఆహ్వాన పత్రిక వంటి సాధారణ పోస్టులు కూడా తొలగింపునకు గురయ్యాయని కాంగ్రెస్ అసహనం వ్యక్తం చేసింది (Meta Content Moderation).
కేంద్ర ప్రభుత్వం ఫిబ్రవరి 2026లో సమాచార సాంకేతిక నిబంధనలను సవరించడం వల్లే ఇలా జరుగుతోందని కాంగ్రెస్ పేర్కొంది (Facebook Content Blocking). ఈ నిబంధనలను రద్దు చేయాలని, తొలగించిన పోస్టులను పునరుద్ధరించాలని, కంటెంట్‌ను పరిమితం చేయడానికి ఉపయోగిస్తున్న ప్రమాణాలను వెల్లడించాలని కోర్టును కోరింది. కాగా, నవంబరు 20 నుంచి ఇండియన్ యూత్ కాంగ్రెస్ కార్యకర్తలు పలు నగరాల్లో మెటా కార్యాలయాల ఎదుట నిరసనలు చేపట్టారు. హైదరాబాద్, ముంబై, గురుగ్రామ్‌లలో ఆందోళనలు నిర్వహించారు. హైదరాబాద్‌లోని గచ్చిబౌలి కార్యాలయం వద్ద జరిగిన నిరసన సందర్భంగా పోలీసులు పలువురిని అదుపులోకి తీసుకున్నారు.
ఇవి కూడా చదవండి..
అమెరికాను వదిలేయాలి లేదా ఉద్యోగం మానేయాలి.. హెచ్-1బీ ఉద్యోగులకు ఐబీఎం షాక్..
అమితాబ్ ఇంటికి మరోసారి బాంబు బెదిరింపు.. ముంబైలో మరిన్ని ప్రాంతాలకు హెచ్చరిక..

title: నిజమైన ముస్లిం ఎవరనేది అల్లా నిర్ణయిస్తాడు... మనుషులు కాదు: మద్రాస్ హైకోర్టు
description:
మసీదులో నమాజు చేయకుండా ఏ ముస్లింనూ అడ్డుకోలేరని మద్రాస్ హైకోర్టు స్పష్టం చేసింది. రాజకీయ పార్టీలతో సంబంధం లేకుండా ఎవరైనా మసీదులోకి వెళ్లి ప్రార్థనలు చేసుకోవచ్చని జస్టిస్ వి లక్ష్మీనారాయణ గురువారం ( నవంబర్ 26 ) తీర్పు ఇచ్చారు. ఎవరు నిజమైన ముస్లిం అనేది దేవుడు నిర్ణయిస్తాడని, సాధారణ మనుషులు కాదని ఆయన వ్యాఖ్యానించారు.

బీజేపీ మైనారిటీ మోర్చా నాయకుడు సయ్యద్ ఇబ్రహీం దాఖలు చేసిన పిటిషన్ విచారణ సందర్భంగా ఈమేరకు కీలక వ్యాఖ్యలు చేసింది ధర్మాసనం. సేలంలోని ఒక మసీదులో తనను నమాజు చేయకుండా ఐయూఎంఎల్ కార్యకర్త సయ్యద్ మూసా అడ్డుకుంటున్నారని ఇబ్రహీం ఆరోపించారు. దీనిపై స్పందించిన జడ్జి, మసీదులోకి ప్రవేశించే ముందు రాజకీయాలను, ఇతర విభేదాలను బయట వదిలి రావాలని సూచించారు.

మసీదు అల్లాకు అంకితం

మసీదులు అల్లాకు అంకితం చేసినవని, వాటికి మనుషులు కేవలం నిర్వాహకులు మాత్రమేనని పేర్కొంది కోర్టు. ఎవరో ఒకరు విరాళం ఇచ్చినంత మాత్రాన అది వారి సొంతం కాదని... అల్లా నిర్ణయం ప్రకారం పిటిషనర్ ముస్లిం అయితే, దానికి భిన్నంగా నిర్ణయించే అధికారం మనుషులకు లేదని స్పష్టం చేసింది కోర్టు.

మసీదు లోపల నమాజు చేయించే ఇమామ్ మాత్రమే ముందు వరుసలో ఉంటారని... మిగిలిన వారు వారి సామాజిక, ఆర్థిక హోదాలతో సంబంధం లేకుండా ఒకరినొకరు తాకుతూ కలిసి ప్రార్థనలు చేస్తారని తెలిపింది కోర్టు. అటువంటి ప్రార్థనా స్థలాల్లో రాజకీయాలకు చోటు ఉండకూడదని పేర్కొంది కోర్టు.
