title: Women's Quota And Delimitation Bill Connection: What Opposition Is Saying
description: Congress, Samajwadi Party and TMC leaders have questioned the government's delimitation plan, arguing that women's reservation is already law and raising concerns over constituency boundaries and representation
author: Shvetank Maurya
content:
- Jairam Ramesh said women's reservation is already law, accusing the government of using it to push delimitation.
- P Chidambaram argued deleting Article 334A could enable immediate implementation of the women's quota.
- Akhilesh Yadav called delimitation BJP's “biggest political mistake”, while Opposition leaders questioned its impact on representation.
The Opposition has questioned the government's decision to link the implementation of women's reservation with delimitation, arguing that the exercise could alter the electoral map and affect the political representation of states.
With Parliament scheduled to meet for a four-day sitting from November 30, the issue has triggered a fresh political confrontation, with Congress, the Samajwadi Party and other Opposition leaders challenging the government's stated rationale.
The debate centres on whether the proposed legislative changes are necessary to implement the Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam, passed in 2023, or whether delimitation is the principal objective of the upcoming parliamentary session.
Jairam Ramesh: Women's Reservation Already Has Legal Backing
Congress general secretary Jairam Ramesh alleged that Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Home Minister Amit Shah were misleading the public by presenting the Special Session as being about women's reservation.
In a post on X, Ramesh said the Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam, providing one-third reservation for women, was passed unanimously in Parliament in September 2023. He recalled that the Congress president had demanded its immediate implementation, but the demand was rejected.
Ramesh claimed that the law was not notified until 10:40 pm on April 16, 2026, and argued that the Special Session was therefore not required to enact women's reservation, which was already law.
He maintained that the session was instead intended to advance delimitation. Ramesh also questioned the role of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, alleging that the electoral roll preparation process had been compromised and that the integrity of elections had been damaged.
According to him, entrusting delimitation to the election machinery under Kumar would allow those accused of electoral irregularities to influence constituency boundaries.
P Chidambaram: Delete Article 334A To Implement Quota
Former Union minister P Chidambaram argued that the government could implement women's reservation immediately by removing Article 334A of the Constitution.
In his post on X, Chidambaram said the 106th Constitutional Amendment inserted Article 334A, linking women's reservation to delimitation after the next Census.
He said the Congress and other Opposition parties had opposed the provision during parliamentary debates because it created two hurdles: the Census and delimitation after the Census.
Chidambaram accused the BJP of insisting on the provision and said deleting Article 334A would allow women's reservation to be implemented without waiting for those processes.
Akhilesh Yadav: BJP’s Biggest Political Mistake
Samajwadi Party president Akhilesh Yadav also criticised the proposed delimitation exercise, describing it as the “biggest mistake” in the BJP’s politics.
In a post on X, Yadav said, "Delimitation will prove to be the biggest mistake in the BJP’s politics."
His remarks come amid Opposition concerns over the possible impact of redrawing constituencies on the political representation of states, particularly those that have controlled population growth.
Sagarika Ghose Questions TMC MPs’ Voting Rights
Trinamool Congress MP Sagarika Ghose raised a separate question over the parliamentary process, alleging that disqualification petitions against 20 TMC MPs had remained pending before the Lok Sabha Speaker for six months.
Ghose said the Speaker had not ruled on the petitions despite Supreme Court directives. She questioned whether the MPs would be allowed to vote on the delimitation Bill in the Lok Sabha and whether their votes would be legally valid if they were supposed to have been disqualified.
She also accused the government of weakening democracy, criticising what she described as the media's portrayal of its decisions as a “master stroke”.
What Is Delimitation And How Is It Linked To Women’s Reservation?
Delimitation is the process of redrawing electoral constituency boundaries and determining how many Lok Sabha seats each state gets. Article 82 of the Constitution provides for the readjustment of seats and constituencies after every Census.
India has undertaken delimitation four times. The first exercise, in 1952, fixed 494 Lok Sabha seats based on the 1951 Census. The total increased to 522 in 1963 and 543 in 1973.
Since 1976, the distribution of Lok Sabha seats among states has been based on the 1971 Census. A constitutional amendment froze the allocation until the first Census after 2000, while a subsequent amendment extended the freeze until the first Census after 2026. The stated objective was to encourage states to pursue population control.
The Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam, passed in 2023, provides for one-third reservation for women in the Lok Sabha and state legislative assemblies. However, its implementation is linked to a delimitation exercise based on the first Census conducted after the law came into force.
The government’s proposed April legislation sought to use the latest available Census data, effectively the 2011 Census, to facilitate implementation of the quota by the 2029 general election. While ministers have said no state would lose seats, Opposition parties have argued that the exercise could disadvantage southern states.

title: Amish Tripathi Backs Warrior Sita, Says She Killed A More Powerful Ravana
description: Author Amish Tripathi has defended the portrayal of Sita as a warrior in Ramayana, pointing to the ancient Adbhuta Ramayana as an example of a version in which she kills a more powerful Ravana
author: Outlook Entertainment Desk
content:
- Amish Tripathi cites Adbhuta Ramayana to defend Sita’s warrior portrayal.
- The author says Sita killed a more powerful Ravana in one version.
- Tripathi also questions Western perspectives in Indian history textbooks.
Author Amish Tripathi has weighed in on the debate surrounding Sita’s portrayal in Nitesh Tiwari’s Ramayana: Part 1, arguing that the character has been depicted as a warrior in ancient versions of the epic. His remarks come after sections of the audience, including actor Mukesh Khanna, questioned the film’s depiction of Sita wielding a sword and fighting asuras. Speaking in an interview with SCREEN, Tripathi pointed to the Adbhuta Ramayana to explain why the portrayal is not a modern invention.
Amish Tripathi cites Adbhuta Ramayana
Tripathi, who wrote Sita: Warrior of Mithila in 2017, said that different versions of the Ramayana are not widely discussed or taught. He cited three versions attributed to Valmiki and explained that Sita takes on a warrior role in one of them.
“Because we’re not taught the Ramayana and the Mahabharata through our education system, we’re not aware of all the versions. There’s a version called the Adbhuta Ramayana, credited to Valmiki. He wrote three versions — Valmiki Ramayana, Adbhuta Ramayana, and Ananda Ramayana. In Adbhuta Ramayana, the elder, more powerful Ravana was killed by Sita. She was a warrior in that version. It’s not a new version. It’s an ancient version credited to Valmiki,” Tripathi said.
He also argued that ancient Indian texts should be understood through a wider historical perspective, rather than being dismissed because they contain elements that may appear fantastical.
Amish Tripathi on history, mythology and Sita’s portrayal
The author compared the debate around Indian epics with the changing understanding of Homer’s Odyssey and the discovery of Troy. He said that while some details in ancient narratives may have been embellished, their central events should not automatically be dismissed.
Tripathi also criticised the way Indian history is taught, arguing that textbooks often privilege a Western perspective and overlook the achievements of ancient Indian societies. He said that greater awareness of indigenous history could help dispel misconceptions about the past.
The author further maintained that ideas of equality between men and women were not alien to Indian traditions. “Men and women being equal isn’t a Western idea. It’s actually being true Indian,” he said.
Tripathi’s comments add to the ongoing discussion around Sai Pallavi’s portrayal of Sita in Ramayana: Part 1, which has drawn both criticism and support since the film’s release.

title: Exclusive | Jo Bachey Hain Sang Samet Lo Row: FWICE Threatens To Pull Out Members From Netflix Shoots From This Week
description: The Federation of Western India Cine Employees has threatened to withdraw its members from any ongoing Netflix shoots if Pakistani show  Jo Bachey Hain Sang Samet Lo Row is not banned from being released in India. As many as 20-25 projects can get affected
author: Yashika Mathur
content:
Pakistani series Jo Bachay Hai Sang Samet Lo's release in India is under scrutiny.
FWICE President BN Tiwari has issued a warning to Netflix to ban the show in India.
FWICE has threatened to call back all its members from every Netflix project being shot currently if the ban on the show is not implemented.
In a bid to stop Pakistani show Jo Bachay Hain Sang Samet Lo from getting screened in India via OTT giant Netflix, film union body the Federation of Western India Cine Employees has threatened to pull out all its members from any ongoing Netflix shoot. FWICE President BN Tiwari tells us that he has sent a letter to Netflix on Thursday, warning the platform that the union would take action if the Pakistani show is not stopped from releasing in India.
'They Made anti-India Statements During Operation Sindoor'
Talking about their decision to issue this warning, Tiwari tells Outlook India, "Netflix should stop this series on priority because in India, Pakistani shows or artistes are not welcomed. Until there is peace with our country. Fawad Khan and Hania Aamir's statement during Operation Sindoor was so wrong. When it happened, they made such anti-India statements when they had gone from India after earning from India. They should have stayed silent or said something against terrorism, but they were supporting it, so why should we look at the faces of such people?"
Tiwari adds, "We urge Netflix not to let any content from the show in India or else FWICE will pull out its members from where their shows are being shot. For us, the nation is first, and we have good relations with Netflix. They shouldn’t have shown the promo. Either they reply, or from tomorrow we will stop working with them."
India's decision not to work with Pakistani artistes was made after the 2016 Uri Attack. This decision was reinstated after the 2025 Pahalgam Terror Attack, when India retaliated with Operation Sindoor.
Tiwari is of the opinion that Pakistani artistes find fame because of Indians around the world.
"Our cultures are similar, so we don’t find their content bad, but that country’s behaviour is problematic, and we oppose anything that's against our country. Their shows are worldwide famous, and Indians are everywhere around the world. Unko jo dekha jar raha hai India ki wajeh se dekha ja raha hai. Aaj bhi jo unke shows hote hai in America, London, Dubai mein, Indian artistes go with them and make them even more famous," he says.
How Netflix Gets Affected
For those who may not be familiar, FWICE has 38 film and tv union organisations as members with as many as 4 lakh people from the film fraternity, ranging from spot boys to camerapersons and actors.
The film body head also questions the need to show Pakistani content when India is producing magnum opuses like Ramayana.
"20-25 shoots will get affected around the country, and all of them will be affected. The producers will suffer losses, artistes will suffer. These are mass losses, and ek zidd ke liye it's not ok to sacrifice so many people," says Tiwari.
Asked about the deadline given to Netflix to take a decision, Tiwari concludes by saying, "We sent a letter yesterday. Our deadline given to them has already started. If a decision is not taken, we will start pulling out our members from tomorrow"
We reached out to Netflix for a comment but didn't get any response at the time of publishing this.

title: Man Stabbed To Death After Rash Driving Row In Delhi's Shakurpur
description: Victim Yogesh Attacked With Knife During Argument; Accused Flee
author: Our Correspondent
content:
Man Stabbed To Death After Rash Driving Row In Delhi's Shakurpur
Victim Yogesh Attacked With Knife During Argument; Accused Flee
A man was allegedly stabbed to death by an occupant of a car following an argument between the two sides over rash driving in northwest Delhi's Shakurpur area in the early hours of Friday, police said.The two sides knew each other and belonged to the same locality.
Around 1 am, Yogesh, a resident of JJ Colony in Shakurpur, and his friends were standing on G-Block Road when they had an argument with the occupants of a Hyundai i20 over alleged rash driving, a senior police officer said. The argument escalated into a violent confrontation and one of the occupants of the car allegedly pulled out a knife and stabbed Yogesh in the neck before fleeing with the others, police said.
They said Yogesh sustained a critical injury and was rushed to Maharaja Agrasen Hospital, where doctors declared him dead. The hospital informed police about the incident, following which a team reached the spot and initiated an investigation, they said.
"We have established the identities of the accused and are conducting raids to apprehend them. A case has been registered," the officer said. Police are also examining the sequence of events leading to the stabbing and the role of each person present in the car, the officer said.

title: Mizoram Students' Union Chief Hospitalised During Hunger Strike
description: MSU President Demands MPSC Chief's Resignation; Two Leaders Join Protest
author: Our Correspondent
content:
Mizoram Students' Union Chief Hospitalised During Hunger Strike
MSU President Demands MPSC Chief's Resignation; Two Leaders Join Protest
Mizoram Students' Union president Laldinsanga was hospitalised on the fourth day of his indefinite fast, demanding the resignation of Mizoram Public Service Commission chairperson R Lalramnghaka, while two leaders of the outfit have joined the hunger strike.Lalramnghaka expressed willingness to step down from the post "if God commands him". He also said that he has long been thinking about retiring from the post to devote his time to church activities.
Laldinsanga was taken to Ebenezer Hospital's emergency department around 8.40 pm on Thursday following health complications, according to the student body. However, the Mizoram Students' Union (MSU) chief said he would not call off the hunger strike.
The MSU has accused the Mizoram Public Service Commission (MPSC) of making repeated errors, delays and administrative lapses that have distressed job seekers.
Following Laldinsanga's hospitalisation, MSU General Secretary Lalrampanmawia and Secretary in-charge of Games and Sports Johan Lalremruata joined the hunger strike on the MPSC office premises from Thursday night.
The MSU said students and job-seeking youths had lost confidence in the MPSC and held its chairperson responsible for causing distress to job aspirants over the past two years. Upping the ante, the organisation said that it would picket outside the commission's office on Friday to prevent the chairperson from attending office.
It also warned of holding a massive rally in Aizawl on November 30 if Lalramnghaka does not step down as MPSC chairperson on moral grounds. The MSU has claimed the commission had issued more than 24 corrigenda in job-related issues since Lalramnghaka assumed office in May 2024.
MPSC chairperson Lalramnghaka said he would step down if "God commands him". He also said that he has long been thinking about retiring from the post to devote his time to church activities. MSU General Secretary Lalrampanmawia said a delegation of the outfit urged Mizoram Governor Vijay Kumar Singh to initiate steps for the removal of the MPSC chairperson.
The governor told the delegation that he was aware of the difficulties faced by youths appearing for MPSC examinations and recent controversies surrounding the commission, according to Lalrampanmawia.
He said Singh expressed sympathy for those affected and assured the delegation that he would initiate steps to address the issue and discuss the matter with Chief Minister Lalduhoma. The governor also said that he would meet the MPSC chairman as necessary.

title: Three Teenagers Killed As Police Vehicle Rams Bike In Maharashtra
description: Locals Block Traffic In Gondia To Protest Negligent Driving
author: Our Correspondent
content:
Three Teenagers Killed As Police Vehicle Rams Bike In Maharashtra
Locals Block Traffic In Gondia To Protest Negligent Driving
Three teenagers riding a motorcycle were killed when a speeding police vehicle collided with their two-wheeler in Gondia district of Maharashtra, prompting locals to block traffic at the accident site, officials said.The accident took place on the Gondia-Tirora Road near the Dandegaon Bus Stand within the jurisdiction of Gangazhari Police Station on Wednesday night, they said.
The impact of the collision was so severe that all three teenagers on the motorbike, Kartik Brijlal Bisen (14), Shivprasad Kamble and Jitendra Bawankar (both aged 16), were killed on the spot, police said on Thursday.
The trio was travelling towards Gangazhari from Ekodi when a speeding police 112 ERSS (Emergency Response Support System) vehicle went out of control while attempting to overtake a tipper truck and collided head-on with their two-wheeler, they added.
Local residents gathered at the crash site and briefly disrupted traffic to protest the negligent driving of the police vehicle. Looking at the severity of the fatal accident and anger among people, additional police force was deployed on Thursday at Gangazhari under the guidance of Additional SP Abhay Dongre to maintain peace and order.
Superintendent of Police Gorakh Bhamare assured a fair probe into the accident. Local MLA Vinod Agrawal promised to make efforts to arrange financial help from the government for the kin of the deceased.
In the meantime, police have registered a case against Amit Mahule, who was driving the offending vehicle, under Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) sections related to rash driving and causing death by negligence.

title: Today's Children Are Tomorrow's Scientists and Innovators: Ponnam Prabhakar
description: Ponnam urged parents and teachers to motivate children to move beyond spending time playing games on mobile phones and instead focus on creativity, knowledge and innovation.
author: DC Correspondent
content:
Today's Children Are Tomorrow's Scientists and Innovators: Ponnam Prabhakar
Ponnam urged parents and teachers to motivate children to move beyond spending time playing games on mobile phones and instead focus on creativity, knowledge and innovation.
Hyderabad: Science fairs are important platforms for nurturing creativity, scientific temper and curiosity among students while bringing out their innovative abilities, said State Transport and BC Welfare Minister Ponnam Prabhakar. He urged students to continuously nurture their curiosity and spirit of scientific inquiry, stating that today's children are tomorrow's scientists and innovators.
On Friday, the Minister inaugurated the 54th Hyderabad District-Level Children's Science Exhibition at Zilla Parishad High School in Irrum Manzil. He later inspected various scientific models and experiments developed by students and enquired about their functioning, applications and methods of preparation. He appreciated the students for their creativity, scientific knowledge and innovative thinking.
Speaking on the occasion, the Minister said that showcasing 392 scientific exhibits through five different programmes in Hyderabad district was a matter of pride. He appreciated the efforts of students, teachers, headmasters, principals and education department officials in organising the exhibitions.
He said science fairs should not be limited to marks, prizes and competitions. Instead, they provide students with opportunities to apply scientific principles learnt in textbooks and find innovative solutions to everyday problems. Such exhibitions help develop observation, analytical, questioning and experimental skills among students, he added.
Appreciating the talent of government school students, the Minister said it was particularly noteworthy that they had developed all 167 exhibits in the Science and Social Studies categories. He said the exhibits reflected students' awareness of environmental protection, sustainable development and civic responsibilities.
He informed that 30 models were being showcased under a programme aimed at bringing out the technical skills of government school students. The Rashtriya Bal Vaigyanik Pradarshan featured models demonstrating the practical application of scientific principles in everyday life, while the INSPIRE-MANAK Science Exhibition featured 90 exhibits. Two exhibits were also presented by PM SHRI schools.
The Minister said the projects developed by students on themes such as historical heritage, environmental protection, democracy and the Constitution, social justice, economic development, Telangana's society, culture and development reflected their social awareness, creative thinking and vision for the State's progress.
Highlighting the importance of scientific innovations, Ponnam Prabhakar said inventions such as artificial intelligence (AI), robots, smartphones and electric vehicles, along with the electric bulb, radio, aeroplane, penicillin and printing press, were the outcomes of ideas, research and experimentation. He also referred to the C.V. Raman Effect, stressing that curiosity, questioning and continuous exploration were the driving forces behind every innovation.
He emphasised that acquiring knowledge and exploring new subjects beyond formal education were equally important. Stating that age and background were no barriers to talent, he said even young children possessed remarkable intellectual abilities. He urged students not to treat science fairs as mere formalities but to use them as opportunities to showcase their hidden talent, curiosity and research-oriented thinking.
The Minister recalled that students from Hyderabad district had secured two positions among the Best 60 exhibits at the national level in the past.
Recollecting his political journey, Ponnam Prabhakar said he had used his opportunity as a Member of Parliament from Karimnagar in the 15th Lok Sabha to fight for the formation of Telangana. He observed that the achievements of prominent personalities across various fields demonstrated that education, rather than wealth, caste or land, was the primary foundation of progress.
Describing teachers as sculptors who shape the future of students and hold a place of respect next only to parents, he said teachers should identify the unique abilities of every student, provide proper guidance and encourage them to excel.
He urged parents and teachers to motivate children to move beyond spending time playing games on mobile phones and instead focus on creativity, knowledge and innovation. He also appreciated teachers for their efforts in identifying and encouraging students' talents.
The Minister said that despite the prevailing economic challenges, Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy, who holds the Education portfolio, was striving to strengthen government schools and provide quality education to every poor student. He urged teachers to discharge their responsibilities effectively, increase enrolment in government schools and strengthen parents' confidence in the public education system.
Ponnam Prabhakar expressed hope that students would continue to nurture their creativity, research interests and scientific thinking and grow into eminent scientists and innovators, bringing laurels to Telangana and the country.
Rajya Sabha MP Anil Kumar Yadav, MLC Mirza Riyaz Ul Hassan, District Education Officer Yadaiah, Science Officer Dharmender, Khairatabad Tahsildar Prem Kumar, other education department officials, teachers and students participated in the programme.

title: Delimitation Row: Stalin Says Tamil Nadu Must Retain 7.18% Seat Share
description: DMK firm on 7.18 pc share of seats in Lok Sabha
author: PTI
content:
Delimitation Row: Stalin Says Tamil Nadu Must Retain 7.18% Seat Share
DMK firm on 7.18 pc share of seats in Lok Sabha
Chennai: Amid the buzz over delimitation as the Parliament has been reconvened, DMK president MK Stalin on Friday asserted that under no circumstances should Tamil Nadu's existing 7.18 per cent share of seats in the Lok Sabha be reduced. The Dravidian party chief also said that the existing proportion of Parliamentary representation among states, as determined based on the 1971 Census and frozen earlier, must remain frozen for another 25 years.
In a statement, Stalin said that the DMK is firm on the demands of a 7.18 per cent share of seats and proportion of representation.
"No change in position, no compromise," the party chief said on the expected delimitation move of the Centre.
( Source : PTI )

title: TDB Chief K Jayakumar Denies Low Turnout at Sabarimala
description: TDB president K Jayakumar says more spot booking centres need HC nod and the board was not currently witnessing any artificial blocking of booking slots or bulk cancellations
author: PTI
content:
TDB Chief K Jayakumar Denies Low Turnout at Sabarimala
TDB president K Jayakumar says more spot booking centres need HC nod and the board was not currently witnessing any artificial blocking of booking slots or bulk cancellations
Thiruvananthapuram: TDB president K Jayakumar on Friday denied allegations that the number of devotees visiting the Lord Ayyappa temple at Sabarimala in the current pilgrimage season was low and said a decision on opening more spot booking centres would be taken only after discussions with the Kerala High Court and with its approval. The Travancore Devaswom Board (TDB) president said nearly 80,000 devotees visited the hill shrine on Thursday, indicating that the pilgrim turnout had returned to normal after a relatively low number of visitors during the first two or three days of the ongoing pilgrimage season.
"There have been demands for more spot booking centres, but we cannot decide on that in a hurry. The matter has to be informed to the court and its permission obtained," Jayakumar told reporters here.
He said the board was not currently witnessing any artificial blocking of booking slots or bulk cancellations, which had reportedly affected devotees during the initial days of the season.
Devotees could now get slots when they logged in, and adequate spot-booking facilities were also being provided, he said.
Jayakumar said the turnout had gradually increased from the fourth day of the season and more than 80,000 devotees were now visiting the shrine daily.
There was no basis for the campaign that pilgrim numbers were low, he added.
Referring to the difference in the number of devotees between the first seven days of the 2025 and 2026 seasons, he said the board was examining the reasons for the relatively low turnout in the first two or three days this year.
The police cyber wing was investigating whether slots had been artificially blocked or manipulated during the initial days, but no conclusion had been reached so far, he said.
The board had introduced a system under which cancelled slots would be released only after eight hours.
Jayakumar said the cancelled slots were now gradually being filled, rather than being taken in bulk, which he described as a positive sign. There was no abnormality in the booking pattern at present, he added.
On possible software changes during the ongoing season, Jayakumar said major modifications would not be undertaken while the system was in operation. Only minor adjustments to the opening and closing timings and other practical aspects could be considered.
Asked about the fall in revenue during the initial days and its possible impact on the functioning of other temples, he said he did not wish to speculate on hypothetical situations.
"The number of people coming for Ayyappa's darshan was lower during the initial days. But devotees will come, have darshan and return happily. The offerings and donations come from their happiness," he said.
He said the board was not running the temple as a business establishment where daily profits and losses were the primary criteria. Its main objective was to ensure that devotees could have a smooth and satisfying darshan.
Jayakumar said the board had a responsibility to inform the public about the total revenue generated through offerings, sales and other sources after the pilgrimage season ended.
However, he did not want to assess the temple's functioning on the basis of daily income and expenditure.
Jayakumar also said the board was taking steps to address complaints that devotees booking rooms online at Sabarimala were facing delays of one or two weeks, and sometimes longer, in getting their security deposits refunded.
He said discussions had already been held with Dhanlaxmi Bank and a final decision was expected on Friday.
"It is only fair that a devotee who books a room online, stays there, has darshan, returns home, gets the deposit back within 24 hours or, at the most, 48 hours," he said, describing the delay as a source of disappointment for pilgrims.
Jayakumar said the board had also achieved some improvement in preventing devotees from discarding clothes in the Pampa river.
Though the practice had not stopped completely, the quantity of clothes dumped there had fallen from five or six truckloads during the initial days to less than one truckload, he said.
He attributed the improvement to continuous public announcements, awareness campaigns, display boards, efforts by board employees and fellow devotees, and social media campaigns.
The board had also announced a fine of Rs 5,000 for the offence.
Jayakumar clarified that the fine had not been imposed on anyone so far.
The initial phase was focused on creating awareness that discarding clothes in the river was a punishable offence. At the same time, enforcement and collection of fines would follow in the next phase, he said.
The over two-month-long annual pilgrimage season at the hill shrine commenced on November 17.

title: फेक वीडियो, डीपफेक और पाकिस्तान कनेक्शन, भारत के खिलाफ सोशल मीडिया दुष्प्रचार का सामने आया नया पैटर्न
description: भारत के खिलाफ सोशल मीडिया पर फेक वीडियो, डीपफेक और पाकिस्तान कनेक्शन से जुड़े दुष्प्रचार का नया पैटर्न सामने आया है. इसमें सेना, शीर्ष नेतृत्व और संवेदनशील मुद्दों को निशाना बनाकर अस्थिरता फैलाने की कोश‍िश की जा रही है.
author: शैलेंद्र वांगू
content:
फेक वीडियो, डीपफेक और पाकिस्तान कनेक्शन, भारत के खिलाफ सोशल मीडिया दुष्प्रचार का सामने आया नया पैटर्न
Last Updated:
भारत के खिलाफ सोशल मीडिया पर फेक वीडियो, डीपफेक और पाकिस्तान कनेक्शन से जुड़े दुष्प्रचार का नया पैटर्न सामने आया है. इसमें सेना, शीर्ष नेतृत्व और संवेदनशील मुद्दों को निशाना बनाकर अस्थिरता फैलाने की कोश‍िश की जा रही है.
भारत के राजनीतिक, सैन्य और सामाजिक मुद्दों को लेकर सोशल मीडिया पर दुष्प्रचार की एक व्यापक और लगातार चलने वाली गतिविधि सामने आई है. इन पोस्ट्स में देश के शीर्ष नेतृत्व, सेना, सुरक्षा प्रतिष्ठान और संवेदनशील घरेलू मुद्दों को निशाना बनाया जा रहा है. मकसद अलग-अलग घटनाओं को जोड़कर भारत में अस्थिरता, तनाव और संस्थानों के प्रति अविश्वास का माहौल बनाने की कोशिश करना बताया जा रहा है.
इस दुष्प्रचार में सांप्रदायिक तनाव, कश्मीर, मणिपुर, पंजाब, जातीय और क्षेत्रीय विभाजन, विरोध प्रदर्शन जैसे मुद्दों का इस्तेमाल किया जा रहा है. कई बार वास्तविक घटनाओं के वीडियो और तस्वीरों को गलत संदर्भ में पेश कर उनके जरिए भ्रामक दावे फैलाए जाते हैं.
पुराने वीडियो को नया बताकर फैलाने का खेल
दुष्प्रचार का एक प्रमुख तरीका पुराने वीडियो और तस्वीरों को नए घटनाक्रम के रूप में पेश करना है. मध्य प्रदेश, झारखंड और पंजाब-हरियाणा बॉर्डर से 2022 और 2024 के पुराने वीडियो कथित तौर पर नवंबर 2026 में नए घटनाक्रम बताकर प्रसारित किए गए.
Advertisement
इन वीडियो के साथ फर्जी कैप्शन, बदली हुई ऑडियो, गलत तारीखें और नकली न्यूज टिकर जोड़कर लोगों को भ्रमित करने की कोशिश की गई. ऐसे मामलों में वीडियो की वास्तविकता जानने के लिए रिवर्स इमेज सर्च और वीडियो की मूल फुटेज की जांच बेहद अहम है.
सेना और सैन्य नेतृत्व को भी निशाना
भारतीय सेना और शीर्ष सैन्य अधिकारियों की छवि को नुकसान पहुंचाने वाले कई भ्रामक दावे भी सामने आए हैं.
एक वीडियो में CDS के नाम से कथित तौर पर यह दावा किया गया कि पाकिस्तान हवाई, थल, नौसेना और साइबर युद्ध में भारत से आगे है. वहीं एक डीपफेक वीडियो में NSA के नाम से विवादित बयान प्रसारित किया गया. इसके अलावा सेना प्रमुख को हटाए जाने की कथित खबर और एक असंबंधित तस्वीर-वीडियो के जरिए सिख रेजिमेंट के अधिकारी को मेक्सिको में आपराधिक घटना से जोड़ने का दावा भी किया गया.
इन उदाहरणों से संकेत मिलता है कि फर्जी और भ्रामक सामग्री के जरिए सैन्य नेतृत्व तथा सुरक्षा संस्थानों की विश्वसनीयता पर सवाल खड़े करने की कोशिश की जा रही है.
हिंसा और धार्मिक तनाव के फर्जी दावे
सोशल मीडिया पर पुलिस कार्रवाई, धार्मिक स्थलों को गिराने और समुदायों पर हमले से जुड़े दावे भी प्रसारित किए गए.
कुछ पोस्ट में दावा किया गया कि गाजियाबाद में पांच मस्जिदें गिरा दी गईं और नमाजियों पर पुलिस ने गोलीबारी की. एक अन्य पोस्ट में कोलकाता में नमाज के दौरान पुलिस फायरिंग में पांच लोगों की मौत का दावा किया गया. उपलब्ध सामग्री से इन दावों की पुष्टि नहीं हुई.
इस तरह के फर्जी दावे खास तौर पर संवेदनशील होते हैं, क्योंकि गलत जानकारी धार्मिक और सामुदायिक तनाव को बढ़ा सकती है.
भारतीय पहचान के नाम पर फर्जी अकाउंट?
कुछ सोशल मीडिया अकाउंट भारतीय नामों, स्थानीय पहचान, जाति और क्षेत्रीय संदर्भों का इस्तेमाल कर खुद को सामान्य भारतीय यूजर के तौर पर पेश करते दिखाई देते हैं.
‘अनुषी तिवारी’ नाम की एक कथित ऑनलाइन पहचान से जुड़े अकाउंट्स, जिनमें @annu2030 और @cutegirlindia21 का उल्लेख है. अलग-अलग मुद्दों पर आरोप और दावे प्रसारित करते पाए जाने की बात सामने आई है. हालांकि किसी अकाउंट के पीछे वास्तविक व्यक्ति या नेटवर्क की पहचान तय करने के लिए स्वतंत्र और ठोस सबूत जरूरी हैं.
अलग-अलग मुद्दों को एक ही नैरेटिव में जोड़ना
कुछ अकाउंट्स कथित तौर पर एक ही सप्ताह में सांप्रदायिक मुद्दों, सिख पहचान, करतारपुर, कश्मीर, दिल्ली पुलिस और सेना से जुड़े अलग-अलग विषयों पर पोस्ट करते हैं.
ऐसे पैटर्न की जांच इस बात को समझने में मदद कर सकती है कि क्या अलग-अलग घरेलू घटनाओं को एक व्यापक अस्थिरता के नैरेटिव में जोड़ने की कोशिश हो रही है.
एक पोस्ट से कई प्लेटफॉर्म तक पहुंच
कई बार दुष्प्रचार केवल एक अकाउंट तक सीमित नहीं रहता. पोस्ट को दूसरे अकाउंट्स रीपोस्ट करते हैं और कुछ मामलों में पाकिस्तानी मीडिया हैंडल्स और वेबसाइट्स भी इसे आगे प्रसारित करते हैं.
किसी दावे का कई जगह दिखाई देना उसकी सत्यता का प्रमाण नहीं है. कई अकाउंट्स एक ही मूल पोस्ट को साझा कर सकते हैं, जिससे ऐसा भ्रम पैदा होता है कि दावे की स्वतंत्र रूप से पुष्टि हो चुकी है.
सोशल मीडिया यूजर्स के लिए क्या है सबक?
डिजिटल दुष्प्रचार से बचने का सबसे प्रभावी तरीका है क‍िसी भी वायरल पोस्ट को तुरंत सच मानने या आगे बढ़ाने से पहले उसके स्रोत, तारीख, वीडियो और दावे की जांच करना.
पुराने वीडियो, एडिटेड फुटेज, डीपफेक और फर्जी पहचान के जरिए वास्तविक घटनाओं को गलत संदर्भ में पेश किया जा सकता है. ऐसे में  सवाल पूछना, स्रोत की जांच करना और तथ्यों के आधार पर प्रतिक्रिया देना जरूरी है, ताकि भ्रामक जानकारी को आगे फैलने से रोका जा सके.

title: गुरुग्राम में ED का ताबड़तोड़ एक्शन, वाटिया कंपनी की 545 करोड़ की संपत्ति कुर्क, प्लॉट आवंटन में किया था बड...
description: Gurugram News: हरियाणा के गुरुग्राम में मनी लॉन्ड्रिंग केस में ईडी ने वाटिका कंपनी पर बड़ा एक्शन लिया है और 545 करोड़ की प्रॉपर्टी कुर्क कर ली है. 14 साल पुराना यह मामला है, जिसमें अब तक प्लाट आवंटन नहीं हो पाया है और कंपनी के मालिकों को भी ईडी ने गिरफ्तार कर लिया था.
author: Vinod Kumar Katwal
content:
गुरुग्राम में ED का ताबड़तोड़ एक्शन, वाटिया कंपनी की 545 करोड़ की संपत्ति कुर्क, प्लॉट आवंटन में किया था बड़ा खेल
Edited by:
Agency:भाषा
Last Updated:
Gurugram News: हरियाणा के गुरुग्राम में मनी लॉन्ड्रिंग केस में ईडी ने वाटिका कंपनी पर बड़ा एक्शन लिया है और 545 करोड़ की प्रॉपर्टी कुर्क कर ली है. 14 साल पुराना यह मामला है, जिसमें अब तक प्लाट आवंटन नहीं हो पाया है और कंपनी के मालिकों को भी ईडी ने गिरफ्तार कर लिया था.
गुरुग्राम. गुरुग्राम में रियल एस्टेट कंपनी वाटिका समूह पर ईडी ने बड़ी कार्रवाई की है. प्रवर्तन निदेशालय (ईडी) ने गुरुग्राम में कंपनी की 545 करोड़ की संपति कुर्क की है.प्रवर्तन निदेशालय (ईडी) ने बताया कि कंपनी ने घर खरीदारों के साथ कथित धोखाधड़ी और मनी लॉन्ड्रिंग की थी. कुर्क संपत्तियों में दक्षिण दिल्ली में स्थित एक फार्महाउस भी शामिल है.
केंद्रीय एजेंसी के अनुसार, ये संपत्तियां वाटिका समूह के चेयरमैन एवं प्रबंध निदेशक अनिल भल्ला, उनकी पत्नी कंचन भल्ला और समूह की अन्य कंपनियों की हैं.
ईडी ने धनशोधन निवारण अधिनियम (पीएमएलए) के तहत जारी कुर्की आदेश के तहत कंचन भल्ला का दिल्ली के महरौली स्थित एक फार्महाउस भी कुर्क किया है. एजेंसी ने एक बयान में बताया कि कुर्क की गई संपत्तियों का कुल मूल्य 545.96 करोड़ रुपये है. ईडी ने कंपनी के एक अन्य प्रवर्तक गौतम भल्ला और अनिल भल्ला को सितंबर में गिरफ्तार किया था. दोनों फिलहाल न्यायिक हिरासत में हैं.
क्या है मामला
ईडी का मामला दिल्ली पुलिस की आर्थिक अपराध शाखा (ईओडब्ल्यू) की ओर से वाटिका समूह और उसके प्रवर्तकों के खिलाफ दर्ज प्राथमिकी पर आधारित है. प्राथमिकी में धोखाधड़ी करके निवेश के लिए प्रेरित करने, आवासीय भूखंडों का कब्जा नहीं देने, एक ही भूखंड को दो बार बेचने और अन्य संबंधित अपराधों के आरोप लगाए गए हैं. 14 साल पुराना यह मामला है, जिसमें अब भी प्लॉट के लिए लोग इंतजार कर रहे हैं.
पैसे ले लिए, लेकिन प्लॉट नहीं दिए गए
Advertisement
25 नवंबर 2026 को धन शोधन निवारण अधिनियम में केस दर्ज किया गया था. बताया जा रहा है कि वर्ष 2010 से 2012 के बीच सात खरीदार संस्थाओं ने वटिका कंपनी को करीब 266.95 करोड़ रुपये का भुगतान किया था. इसमें वटिका इंडिया नेक्स्ट-2 में करीब 1.10 लाख वर्ग गज जमीन पर लगभग 90 करोड़ रुपये में खरीदे एक भी प्लॉट की 14 साल बाद भी डिलीवरी नहीं की गई. वटिका इंडिया नेक्स्ट में भी प्लॉट की डिलीवरी आंशिक रूप से हुई और 140.73 करोड़ रुपये के प्लॉट खरीदारों को नहीं दिए गए. परियोजनाओं के लिए 22 समूह कंपनियों के जरिये जमीन दी गई. हालांकि, इनके पास कुछ नहीं था.

title: क्या पेरम्बूर सीट गंवा सकते हैं विजय? मद्रास हाईकोर्ट ने मतदाता की चुनाव याचिका पर सुनवाई जारी रखने की दी अ...
description: मद्रास हाईकोर्ट ने तमिलनाडु के मुख्यमंत्री विजय की पेरम्बूर सीट पर जीत को चुनौती देने वाली याचिका पर सुनवाई जारी रखने की अनुमति दे दी है. अदालत ने विजय की वह अर्जी खारिज कर दी जिसमें याचिका रद्द करने की मांग की गई थी.
author: प्रिया गौतम
content:
क्या पेरम्बूर सीट गंवा सकते हैं विजय? मद्रास हाईकोर्ट ने मतदाता की चुनाव याचिका पर सुनवाई जारी रखने की दी अनुमति
Written by:
Agency:moneycontrol.com
Last Updated:
मद्रास हाईकोर्ट ने तमिलनाडु के मुख्यमंत्री विजय की पेरम्बूर सीट पर जीत को चुनौती देने वाली याचिका पर सुनवाई जारी रखने की अनुमति दे दी है. अदालत ने विजय की वह अर्जी खारिज कर दी जिसमें याचिका रद्द करने की मांग की गई थी.
तमिलनाडु के मुख्यमंत्री सी जोसेफ विजय के सामने मुश्किल खड़ी हो गई है. सीएम विजय को अब पेरम्बूर विधानसभा सीट से अपनी जीत को दी गई चुनौती का सामना करना होगा. मद्रास हाईकोर्ट ने शुक्रवार को इस मामले को शुरुआती चरण में ही खारिज करने से इनकार कर दिया और सुनवाई जारी रखने की अनुमति दे दी है. इसके साथ ही जस्टिस वी लक्ष्मीनारायणन ने विजय की वह अर्जी खारिज कर दी, जिसमें पेरम्बूर के मतदाता एस दिनेश की याचिका को रद्द करने की मांग की गई थी.
अदालत ने कहा कि मुख्यमंत्री के चुनावी हलफनामे में कथित गड़बड़ियों के आरोप ऐसे सवाल उठाते हैं, जिन्हें सिर्फ पूरी सुनवाई में ही परखा जा सकता है. जज के अनुसार याचिका में कार्रवाई का आधार बनता है और उसमें आय व संपत्ति का ब्योरा छिपाने या गलत देने के विशिष्ट आरोप हैं हालांकि इसका मतलब यह नहीं है कि अदालत ने विजय को संपत्ति छिपाने या चुनाव कानून तोड़ने का दोषी मान लिया है. अभी तक ऐसा कुछ भी नहीं है.न ही उनकी जीत रद्द हुई है.
क्या हैं विजय पर आरोप
याचिकाकर्ता दिनेश का आरोप है कि टीवीके प्रमुख ने नामांकन के साथ दिए हलफनामे में कुछ संपत्ति लेनदेन की पूरी और सही जानकारी नहीं दी. प्रमुख आरोपों में जनवरी 2026 में पनरुटी में 30 करोड़ रुपये में तीन एकड़ जमीन खरीदना शामिल है, जिसे ठीक से हलफनामे में घोषित नहीं किया गया. याचिका में पडी की एक व्यावसायिक संपत्ति पर भी सवाल उठाया गया है, जिसे फरवरी 2026 में 35 करोड़ रुपये में बेचने का आरोप है, पर हलफनामे में यह लेनदेन सही तरह से नहीं दिखाया गया. तीसरा विवाद कोडाइकनाल के 50 सेंट के प्लॉट का है, जिसे विजय ने अपनी कृषि भूमि बताया, जबकि राजस्व रिकॉर्ड में वह सरकारी पोरंबोक जमीन दर्ज है.
Advertisement
याचिकाकर्ता का तर्क है कि इन कथित गड़बड़ियों से मतदाताओं को सोच-समझकर चुनने के लिए जरूरी जानकारी नहीं मिली. उन्होंने जन प्रतिनिधित्व कानून, 1951 की धारा 123(2) का हवाला देते हुए इसे अनुचित प्रभाव, यानी भ्रष्ट चुनावी आचरण, बताया है.
दोनों पक्षों की दलीलें
विजय के वकीलों का कहना था कि याचिकाकर्ता जरूरी तथ्य साबित नहीं कर सका. उनके मुताबिक कुछ संपत्तियों के ब्योरे में अंतर को अपने आप भ्रष्ट आचरण नहीं माना जा सकता, खासकर तब जब विजय ने 600 करोड़ रुपये से ज्यादा की संपत्ति घोषित की थी. बचाव पक्ष ने यह भी पूछा कि याचिकाकर्ता ने क्षेत्र का मतदाता होना ठीक से साबित किया या नहीं. दिनेश के वकील एनसी अशोक कुमार ने कहा कि ये आरोप मुकदमा शुरू होने से पहले तय नहीं हो सकते. जानबूझकर चूक हुई या नहीं और उसका चुनाव पर असर पड़ सकता था या नहीं, यह सबूतों से ही तय होगा.
अन्य चुनौतियां
विजय ने अप्रैल 2026 में पेरम्बूर और तिरुचिरापल्ली ईस्ट से चुनाव लड़ा और दोनों जीते, फिर तिरुचिरापल्ली ईस्ट छोड़ दी. पेरम्बूर में उन्हें 1,20,365 वोट मिले और उन्होंने डीएमके के आरडी शेखर (66,650 वोट) को 53,715 वोटों से हराया. इस नतीजे को डीएमके उम्मीदवार शेखर और एक अन्य मतदाता टीएन लक्ष्मी नरसिम्हन ने भी हाईकोर्ट में चुनौती दी है. ताज़ा फैसला उन याचिकाओं के नतीजे तय नहीं करता.

title: ग्रेटर नोएडा वेस्ट वालों की बल्ले-बल्ले! 2,390 करोड़ रुपये से बनेगा नया मेट्रो कॉरिडोर, 8 स्टेशनों से आसान होगा सफर
description: Greater Noida West Metro: ग्रेटर नोएडा वेस्ट में रहने वाले लोगों को अकसर घंटों जाम का सामना करना पड़ता है. इससे परेशान होकर वहां के निवासी बीते लगभग 10 सालों से सरकार से मेट्रो की मांग कर रहे हैं. अब ये सपना पूरा होने वाला है.
author: Deepika Pandey
content:
Greater Noida West Metro: ग्रेटर नोएडा वेस्ट में रहने वाले लाखों लोगों के लिए आने वाले दिन बड़ी राहत लेकर आ सकते हैं. रोजाना जाम से जूझना, ऑफिस पहुंचने के लिए घंटों सड़क पर बिताना और सार्वजनिक परिवहन के सीमित विकल्पों पर निर्भर रहना अब बीते दिनों की बात हो सकती है. दरअसल, इलाके में मेट्रो नेटवर्क का विस्तार करने की तैयारी तेज हो गई है. करीब 2,390 करोड़ रुपये की लागत से नया मेट्रो कॉरिडोर बनाया जाना प्रस्तावित है. इस परियोजना को लेकर दिसंबर में प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी के हाथों शिलान्यास कराए जाने की योजना है.
8.5 किलोमीटर का होगा नया मेट्रो रूट
इस परियोजना की सबसे खास बात यह है कि मेट्रो के जरिए नोएडा और ग्रेटर नोएडा वेस्ट के बीच सफर पहले के मुकाबले काफी आसान हो सकेगा. प्रस्तावित कॉरिडोर नोएडा के सेक्टर-61 से शुरू होकर ग्रेटर नोएडा वेस्ट के सेक्टर-4 तक जाएगा. इस पूरे रूट की लंबाई करीब 8.5 किलोमीटर होगी. इसके निर्माण पर लगभग 2,390 करोड़ रुपये खर्च होने का अनुमान है. इस कॉरिडोर पर कुल आठ मेट्रो स्टेशन बनाए जाने का प्रस्ताव है. इससे आसपास की आवासीय सोसायटियों में रहने वाले लोगों को सार्वजनिक परिवहन का बेहतर विकल्प मिल सकेगा.
मेट्रो के कई रूट पर तैयारी
नोएडा और ग्रेटर नोएडा में कनेक्टिविटी सुधारने के लिए दूसरे रूट पर भी काम करने की योजना है. इसमें बॉटेनिकल गार्डन से सेक्टर-142 तक मेट्रो विस्तार का प्रस्ताव शामिल है.
- सेक्टर-61 से सेक्टर-4: करीब 8.5 किलोमीटर लंबा कॉरिडोर, अनुमानित लागत 2,390 करोड़ रुपये और आठ स्टेशन.
- बॉटेनिकल गार्डन से सेक्टर-142: लगभग 12.56 किलोमीटर लंबा मेट्रो रूट, अनुमानित लागत 2,354.35 करोड़ रुपये.
- सेक्टर-51 से सेक्टर-4: ग्रेटर नोएडा वेस्ट तक मेट्रो कनेक्टिविटी बढ़ाने की भी योजना प्रस्तावित है.
जाम से मिलेगी राहत, बचेंगे रोजाना के घंटे
मेट्रो का विस्तार होने से सबसे बड़ा फायदा उन लोगों को मिल सकता है, जिन्हें रोजाना नौकरी या कारोबार के सिलसिले में नोएडा और दिल्ली की ओर जाना पड़ता है. अभी कई इलाकों में लोगों को सड़क मार्ग पर निर्भर रहना पड़ता है. ऐसे में मेट्रो शुरू होने से यात्रा के लिए एक अतिरिक्त और सुविधाजनक विकल्प मिलेगा.
मिल सकेंगे कई फायदे
- सड़कों पर निजी वाहनों का दबाव कम होगा.
- रोजाना आने-जाने में लगने वाला समय बचेगा.
- पेट्रोल और डीजल पर होने वाला खर्च घट सकता है.
- प्रदूषण कम करने में मदद मिलेगी.
- आसपास के इलाकों में व्यापार और रोजगार को बढ़ावा मिल सकता है.
रियल एस्टेट को भी मिलेगा नया बूस्ट
दादरी विधायक तेजपाल नागर ने मेट्रो परियोजना को क्षेत्र के विकास के लिए महत्वपूर्ण बताते हुए प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी और मुख्यमंत्री योगी आदित्यनाथ का आभार जताया है. विशेषज्ञों का मानना है कि बेहतर मेट्रो कनेक्टिविटी से ग्रेटर नोएडा वेस्ट में प्रॉपर्टी की मांग बढ़ सकती है. नए निवेशकों और कारोबारियों की दिलचस्पी भी इस क्षेत्र में बढ़ने की संभावना है.

title: NCR में रैपिड रेल का महाविस्तार! गाजियाबाद बनेगा नमो भारत का सबसे बड़ा हब, 4 नए कॉरिडोर से जुड़ेगा जेवर समेत कई शहर
description: NCR Rapid Rail Expansion: दिल्ली-एनसीआर में रैपिड रेल का एक्सटेंशन होने जा रहा है. इसके तहत मेट्रो रूट लगभग 160 किलोमीटर तक फैल जाएगी. गाजियाबाद पहले से ही दिल्ली-मेरठ नमो भारत कॉरिडोर का प्रमुख स्टेशन है.
author: Deepika Pandey
content:
NCR Rapid Rail Expansion: दिल्ली-NCR में आने वाले समय में सफर की तस्वीर पूरी तरह बदल सकती है. अभी जिन शहरों तक पहुंचने में सड़क पर घंटों लग जाते हैं, वहां नमो भारत रैपिड रेल के जरिए पहुंचना काफी आसान हो सकता है. इस नेटवर्क के विस्तार में गाजियाबाद सबसे अहम भूमिका निभाने जा रहा है. दिल्ली-मेरठ कॉरिडोर के बाद यहां से खुर्जा, हापुड़ और जेवर एयरपोर्ट तक नए कॉरिडोर बनाने की योजना है. इसके अलावा गुरुग्राम, फरीदाबाद, नोएडा और ग्रेटर नोएडा को भी इस नेटवर्क से जोड़ने की तैयारी है.
गाजियाबाद बनेगा NCR का बड़ा ट्रांजिट हब
गाजियाबाद पहले से ही दिल्ली-मेरठ नमो भारत कॉरिडोर का प्रमुख स्टेशन है. अब प्रस्तावित नए रूट इसे NCR के बड़े ट्रांसपोर्ट केंद्र में बदल सकते हैं. इन परियोजनाओं में कुछ की विस्तृत परियोजना रिपोर्ट (DPR) तैयार की जा रही है. वहीं कुछ प्रस्तावित चरण में हैं.
गाजियाबाद से जेवर एयरपोर्ट पहुंचना होगा आसान
सबसे अहम प्रस्तावित रूट गाजियाबाद से नोएडा इंटरनेशनल एयरपोर्ट तक का है. करीब 72.45 किलोमीटर लंबे इस कॉरिडोर में कुल 22 स्टेशन प्रस्तावित हैं. इनमें 12 रैपिड रेल और 10 मेट्रो स्टेशन शामिल होंगे. यह रूट सिद्धार्थ विहार, ग्रेटर नोएडा वेस्ट, सूरजपुर, परी चौक और यमुना एक्सप्रेसवे क्षेत्र से होकर जेवर एयरपोर्ट तक पहुंचेगा. योजना के मुताबिक, गाजियाबाद से एयरपोर्ट का सफर करीब 60 से 70 मिनट में पूरा हो सकेगा. इसके लिए 2030 तक का लक्ष्य बताया गया है.
हापुड़ और खुर्जा तक भी दौड़ेगी रैपिड रेल
गाजियाबाद-हापुड़ कॉरिडोर करीब 57 किलोमीटर लंबा प्रस्तावित है. इसमें तीन मुख्य स्टेशन बनाने की योजना है. इससे नौकरीपेशा लोगों और कारोबारियों को फायदा मिल सकता है. वहीं, गाजियाबाद से खुर्जा तक करीब 83 किलोमीटर का रूट प्रस्तावित है. इसके चार स्टेशनों के जरिए बुलंदशहर और खुर्जा के औद्योगिक क्षेत्रों को जोड़ने की योजना है.
दिल्ली-मेरठ रूट से बढ़ेगी कनेक्टिविटी
दिल्ली-गाजियाबाद-मेरठ नमो भारत कॉरिडोर NCR की पहली चालू RRTS सेवा है. करीब 82 किलोमीटर के इस रूट पर दिल्ली से मेरठ तक का सफर लगभग 55 मिनट में पूरा होता है. आगे इसके विस्तार की योजनाओं पर भी काम हो रहा है.
बड़े शहरों को जोड़ने की तैयारी
गुरुग्राम, फरीदाबाद, नोएडा और ग्रेटर नोएडा को भी नमो भारत नेटवर्क से जोड़ने की योजना है. इन परियोजनाओं के पूरा होने पर NCR के अलग-अलग शहरों के बीच आवाजाही आसान हो सकती है. हालांकि, प्रस्तावित कॉरिडोर अभी निर्माण और मंजूरी की प्रक्रिया से गुजरेंगे.

title: Haryana News: शादी में घुड़चढ़ी के दौरान हर्ष फायरिंग, दूल्हे की बहन के सिर में लगी गोली; दो बच्चों के सिर से उठा मां का साया
description: Haryana News: हरियाणा के बहादुरगढ़ में शादी समारोह के दौरान हर्ष फायरिंग में दूल्हे की 30 साल की बहन मनीषा की मौत हो गई. सिर में गोली लगने से खुशियां मातम में बदल गईं.
author: Preeti Rajput
content:
Haryana News: हरियाणा के बहादुरगढ़ से एक बेहद दुखद घटना सामने आई है. यहां शादी की खुशियां उस समय मातम में बदल गईं, जब घुड़चढ़ी की रस्म के दौरान हुई हर्ष फायरिंग में दूल्हे की बहन की गोली लगने से मौत हो गई. बताया जा रहा है कि महिला अपने भाई की शादी में खुशी से डांस कर रही थी. इसी दौरान दूल्हे के एक दोस्त ने कथित तौर पर गोली चला दी, जो सीधे महिला के सिर में जा लगी. परिजन उसे तुरंत अस्पताल लेकर पहुंचे, लेकिन डॉक्टरों ने उसे मृत घोषित कर दिया. इस घटना के बाद शादी समारोह में चीख-पुकार मच गई.
घुड़चढ़ी के दौरान हुई फायरिंग
जानकारी के मुताबिक, घटना गुरुवार रात बहादुरगढ़ शहर की कुबेर कॉलोनी में हुई. मूल रूप से छारा गांव का रहने वाला परिवार यहां रहता है. परिवार के बेटे अमनदीप की शादी के चलते घर में उत्सव का माहौल था. रात में घुड़चढ़ी की रस्म चल रही थी. परिवार के सदस्य और रिश्तेदार ढोल-नगाड़ों पर नाच रहे थे. दूल्हे की 30 वर्षीय बहन मनीषा भी खुशी से डांस कर रही थी. इसी दौरान आरोप है कि दूल्हे का दोस्त दीपक हर्ष फायरिंग कर रहा था. अचानक चली गोली मनीषा के सिर में लग गई.
अस्पताल पहुंचने से पहले ही टूट गई सांसें
गोली लगते ही समारोह में अफरा-तफरी मच गई. परिवार के लोग घायल मनीषा को लेकर तुरंत नागरिक अस्पताल पहुंचे. हालांकि, वहां डॉक्टरों ने जांच के बाद उसे मृत घोषित कर दिया. कुछ ही पलों में शादी की खुशियां चीख-पुकार और मातम में बदल गईं. मनीषा की करीब 10 साल पहले रेवाड़ी निवासी खुशीराम से शादी हुई थी. वह दो बच्चों की मां थी. पत्नी की अचानक मौत से पति खुशीराम का रो-रोकर बुरा हाल है. वहीं, परिवार के अन्य सदस्यों का भी दुख से बुरा हाल है.
पुलिस ने शुरू की मामले की जांच
घटना की सूचना मिलते ही एसीपी प्रदीप नैन और एसीपी रमेश गुलिया नागरिक अस्पताल पहुंचे. पुलिस अधिकारियों ने घटनास्थल का निरीक्षण किया है. मामले की जांच के लिए कई टीमें लगाई गई हैं. पुलिस परिजनों के बयान दर्ज कर रही है. शुक्रवार को नागरिक अस्पताल में शव का पोस्टमार्टम कराया जाएगा. इसके बाद आगे की कानूनी कार्रवाई की जाएगी.

title: BSF ने पाकिस्तानी घुसपैठिए को बॉर्डर पर मार गिराया
description: फिलहाल मामले से जुड़ी अन्य जानकारियों का इंतजार है। फिलहाल इलाके को घेर लिया गया है साथ ही सर्च ऑपरेशन और निगरानी बढ़ा दी गई। पंजाब के पठानकोट में भारत-पाकिस्तान सीमा पर BSF ने घुसपैठ की कोशिश नाकाम करते हुए पाकिस्तानी घुसपैठिए को मार गिराया।
content:
सुदर्शन के राष्ट्रवादी पत्रकारिता को सहयोग करे
Donation
पाकिस्तान की ओर से नापाक हरकत लगातार जारी है.. यहां भारतीय सीमा में घुसपैठ की कोशिशें थमने का नाम नहीं ले रही हैं। हालांकि, सीमा पर तैनात भारतीय सुरक्षा बल हर बार दुश्मन की इन नापाक कोशिशों को नाकाम कर रहे हैं। ताजा मामला पंजाब के पठानकोट से सामने आया है, जहां सीमा सुरक्षा बल (BSF) के जवानों ने अंतरराष्ट्रीय सीमा पार कर भारत में दाखिल हुए एक पाकिस्तानी घुसपैठिए को ढेर कर दिया। BSF ने ये कार्रवाई 27 नवंबर 2026 (शुक्रवार) की सुबह करीब 2 बजकर 25 मिनट के आसपास की है
मिली जानकारी के अनुसार, ये घटना पठानकोट में उझ नदी के किनारे स्थित बीओपी पहाड़ीपुर पोस्ट के पास हुई। बताया जा रहा है कि पाकिस्तान की ओर से आया घुसपैठिया अंतरराष्ट्रीय सीमा पार कर भारतीय क्षेत्र में करीब 120 मीटर तक अंदर दाखिल हो चुका था। इसी दौरान सीमा पर तैनात बीएसएफ जवानों की उस पर नजर पड़ गई।
जवानों ने उसे रुकने की चेतावनी दी, लेकिन उसने जवानों की बातों को अनसुना करते हुए भारतीय सीमा की ओर बढ़ना जारी रखा। इसके बाद सुरक्षा की दृष्टि से बीएसएफ जवानों ने गोलीबारी की, जिसमें घुसपैठिया मारा गया।
जिस स्थान पर यह घटना हुई, वह उझ नदी के किनारे का संवेदनशील इलाका है। सीमा की निगरानी और घुसपैठ रोकने के लिए यहां आधुनिक तकनीकी उपकरणों से लैस स्मार्ट फेंसिंग भी लगाई गई है। फिलहाल मामले से जुड़ी अन्य जानकारियों का इंतजार है। फिलहाल इलाके को घेर लिया गया है साथ ही सर्च ऑपरेशन और निगरानी बढ़ा दी गई।

title: UPIના 10 વર્ષ નાનકડા QR કોડથી વિશ્વની સૌથી મોટી રિયલટાઇમ પેમેન્ટ સિસ્ટમ સુધી ભારતની ઐતિહાસિક સફર
description: ભારતના ડિજિટલ વ્યવહારોમાં UPIનો 84 ટકા હિસ્સો ભારતના ડિજિટલ વ્યવહારોમાં UPIનો 84 ટકા હિસ્સો
content:
सुदर्शन के राष्ट्रवादी पत्रकारिता को सहयोग करे
Donation
ભારતમાં ચાની લારી હોય, શાકભાજીની દુકાન હોય, રિક્ષા હોય કે મોટું શોપિંગ મોલ—આજે ચુકવણી માટે એક નાનકડો QR કોડ પૂરતો છે. ગ્રાહક મોબાઇલ કાઢે છે, QR કોડ સ્કેન કરે છે અને થોડી જ ક્ષણોમાં વેપારીના ખાતામાં પૈસા પહોંચી જાય છે. ₹20ની ચાથી લઈને હજારો રૂપિયાની ખરીદી સુધી Unified Payments Interface એટલે કે UPI આજે ભારતીયોના રોજિંદા જીવનનો અભિન્ન ભાગ બની ગયું છે.
દસ વર્ષ પહેલાં આ દૃશ્ય સામાન્ય નહોતું. રોકડ વ્યવહારોમાં છૂટા પૈસાની સમસ્યા, ₹500ની નોટ સામે બાકી રકમ પરત કરવાની ગણતરી અને કાર્ડ પેમેન્ટ માટે POS મશીન જેવી જરૂરિયાતો સામાન્ય હતી. પરંતુ છેલ્લા એક દાયકામાં UPIએ ભારતની ચુકવણી કરવાની રીતમાં જ મોટો ફેરફાર લાવી દીધો છે.
25 ઑગસ્ટ 2016ના રોજ નેશનલ પેમેન્ટ્સ કોર્પોરેશન ઑફ ઇન્ડિયા (NPCI) દ્વારા ભારતીય રિઝર્વ બેન્કની દેખરેખ હેઠળ શરૂ થયેલી UPI વ્યવસ્થાએ હવે દસ વર્ષની સફર પૂર્ણ કરી છે. માત્ર પેમેન્ટ ટેક્નોલોજી તરીકે શરૂ થયેલી આ વ્યવસ્થા આજે ભારતના ડિજિટલ પેમેન્ટ ઇકોસિસ્ટમનો આધારસ્તંભ બની ગઈ છે.
UPIની શરૂઆતના આંકડા અને આજના આંકડાઓ વચ્ચેનો તફાવત ભારતની ડિજિટલ ક્રાંતિનું કદ દર્શાવે છે. ઑગસ્ટ 2016ના પ્રથમ મહિનામાં UPI મારફતે માત્ર 90 હજાર વ્યવહારો થયા હતા અને શરૂઆતના તબક્કામાં માત્ર 21 બેન્કો આ સિસ્ટમ સાથે જોડાયેલી હતી.
નાણાકીય વર્ષ 2016-17 દરમિયાન આખા વર્ષમાં UPI મારફતે આશરે 1.78 કરોડ વ્યવહારો નોંધાયા હતા. પરંતુ ત્યારબાદ સ્માર્ટફોનનો વધતો ઉપયોગ, બેન્કોની ભાગીદારી, સરળ પેમેન્ટ એપ્સ અને નાના-મોટા વેપારીઓ સુધી પહોંચેલા QR કોડે UPIના વિસ્તરણને અભૂતપૂર્વ ગતિ આપી.
FY 2016-17ના 1.78 કરોડ વાર્ષિક વ્યવહારોની સરખામણીએ FY 2025-26માં UPI ટ્રાન્ઝેક્શનની સંખ્યા વધીને 24,162 કરોડથી વધુ થઈ ગઈ. PIBના આંકડા પ્રમાણે આ લગભગ 13,000 ગણો ઉછાળો દર્શાવે છે.
UPIની સફળતા માત્ર ટ્રાન્ઝેક્શનની સંખ્યા સુધી મર્યાદિત નથી. તેના માધ્યમથી ટ્રાન્સફર થતી કુલ રકમમાં પણ ઐતિહાસિક વધારો થયો છે.
FY 2016-17 દરમિયાન UPI મારફતે થયેલા વ્યવહારોનું કુલ મૂલ્ય આશરે ₹0.07 લાખ કરોડ હતું. FY 2025-26માં આ આંકડો વધીને લગભગ ₹314 લાખ કરોડ સુધી પહોંચી ગયો. એટલે કે એક દાયકામાં ટ્રાન્ઝેક્શન વેલ્યૂમાં 4,000 ગણાથી પણ વધુનો વધારો નોંધાયો.
આ આંકડા દર્શાવે છે કે UPI હવે માત્ર એક મોબાઇલ પેમેન્ટ વિકલ્પ નથી, પરંતુ ભારતીય અર્થતંત્રના રોજિંદા નાણાકીય વ્યવહારોનું મહત્ત્વપૂર્ણ માળખું બની ગયું છે.
UPIની વૃદ્ધિ 2026માં પણ સતત આગળ વધી રહી છે. વર્ષ 2026 દરમિયાન UPI પર દરરોજ સરેરાશ 66 કરોડ વ્યવહારો થઈ રહ્યા છે.
જુલાઈ 2026માં એક જ મહિનામાં 2,366 કરોડ UPI ટ્રાન્ઝેક્શન નોંધાયા, જે તેના દસ વર્ષના ઇતિહાસનો સૌથી મોટો માસિક આંકડો છે. મે 2026માં પહેલી વખત માસિક UPI ટ્રાન્ઝેક્શન 2,300 કરોડના સ્તરને પાર કરી ગયા હતા.
આ આંકડાની પાછળ કરોડો સામાન્ય ભારતીયોના નાના-મોટા વ્યવહારો રહેલા છે—ચા, દૂધ, શાકભાજી, પેટ્રોલ, ભોજન, રિક્ષા, દવાઓ, શોપિંગથી લઈને વ્યક્તિથી વ્યક્તિ પૈસા મોકલવા સુધી.
UPIની સૌથી મોટી સફળતાઓ પૈકી એક નાના મૂલ્યના વ્યવહારોનું ડિજિટાઇઝેશન છે. અગાઉ ડિજિટલ પેમેન્ટને મોટા વેપારીઓ, કાર્ડ મશીન અથવા શહેરી ગ્રાહકો સાથે જોડીને જોવામાં આવતું હતું. UPI અને QR કોડે આ સમીકરણ બદલી નાખ્યું.
FY 2025-26માં વ્યક્તિથી વેપારી એટલે કે P2M ટ્રાન્ઝેક્શન કુલ UPI વોલ્યુમના 63 ટકા રહ્યા. તેમાં પણ 86 ટકા P2M વ્યવહારો ₹500થી ઓછી રકમના હતા.
આ આંકડો બતાવે છે કે UPIની સફળતા માત્ર મોટા ટ્રાન્ઝેક્શનથી નથી આવી. દેશભરમાં ચાની લારી, કરિયાણાની દુકાન, ફળ-શાકભાજીના વેપારી અને નાના સર્વિસ પ્રોવાઇડર સુધી QR કોડ પહોંચવાથી ડિજિટલ ચુકવણી સામાન્ય ભારતીયના જીવનમાં પ્રવેશી છે.
એક તરફ નાના વેપારીઓને કરવામાં આવતા P2M વ્યવહારો સંખ્યાની દૃષ્ટિએ આગળ છે, તો બીજી તરફ P2P એટલે વ્યક્તિથી વ્યક્તિ ટ્રાન્ઝેક્શન કુલ UPI ટ્રાન્ઝેક્શન વેલ્યૂમાં લગભગ 71 ટકા હિસ્સો ધરાવે છે.
આ રીતે UPI બે જુદી જરૂરિયાતોને એકસાથે પૂરી કરે છે. એક તરફ ₹20, ₹50 કે ₹100 જેવી નાની દૈનિક ખરીદી માટે સરળ પેમેન્ટ સુવિધા આપે છે, જ્યારે બીજી તરફ વ્યક્તિઓ વચ્ચે મોટી રકમના તાત્કાલિક ટ્રાન્સફર માટે પણ તેનો ઉપયોગ થાય છે.
UPIની સફળતામાં તેની interoperability એટલે કે વિવિધ બેન્કો અને એપ્લિકેશનો વચ્ચે સરળતાથી કામ કરવાની ક્ષમતા મહત્વપૂર્ણ રહી છે.
2016માં માત્ર 21 બેન્કો સાથે શરૂ થયેલી UPI વ્યવસ્થા સાથે જુલાઈ 2026 સુધીમાં 741 બેન્કો જોડાઈ ચૂકી હતી. તેમાં સરકારી બેન્કો, ખાનગી બેન્કો, સ્મોલ ફાઇનાન્સ બેન્કો, પેમેન્ટ બેન્કો અને સહકારી બેન્કોનો સમાવેશ થાય છે.
આ વિશાળ બેન્કિંગ નેટવર્કને કારણે UPI કોઈ એક બેન્ક કે એક એપ્લિકેશન પૂરતું મર્યાદિત ન રહીને સમગ્ર ડિજિટલ પેમેન્ટ ઇકોસિસ્ટમનું પ્લેટફોર્મ બની શક્યું છે.
ભારતમાં ઐતિહાસિક સફળતા મેળવ્યા બાદ UPI હવે વૈશ્વિક સ્તરે પણ ભારતની ડિજિટલ ક્ષમતાનું પ્રતીક બની રહ્યું છે.
PIB અનુસાર વર્ષ 2025માં વિશ્વના કુલ રિયલ-ટાઇમ પેમેન્ટ ટ્રાન્ઝેક્શન વોલ્યુમમાં UPIનો હિસ્સો આશરે 49 ટકા હતો. આંતરરાષ્ટ્રીય નાણાં ભંડોળ (IMF) દ્વારા પણ UPIને વિશ્વની સૌથી મોટી રિયલ-ટાઇમ પેમેન્ટ સિસ્ટમ તરીકે ઓળખવામાં આવી છે.
આ સફળતા દર્શાવે છે કે ભારતે માત્ર પોતાના નાગરિકો માટે ડિજિટલ પેમેન્ટ વ્યવસ્થા વિકસાવી નથી, પરંતુ મોટા પાયે ઉપયોગ કરી શકાય તેવું ડિજિટલ પબ્લિક ઇન્ફ્રાસ્ટ્રક્ચર મોડલ પણ વિશ્વ સમક્ષ મૂક્યું છે.
ભારતમાં વિકસાવાયેલી UPI વ્યવસ્થા હવે આંતરરાષ્ટ્રીય સ્તરે પણ વિસ્તરી રહી છે. UAE, ફ્રાન્સ, ભૂટાન, શ્રીલંકા, નેપાળ, સિંગાપોર, મોરેશિયસ, કતર, કંબોડિયા, ગ્રીસ અને માલદીવ સહિત 11 દેશોમાં UPIની હાજરી થઈ ચૂકી છે.
વિદેશ પ્રવાસ કરતા ભારતીયો માટે સરળ ડિજિટલ પેમેન્ટ અને વિવિધ દેશો વચ્ચે પેમેન્ટ કનેક્ટિવિટી વધારવાની દિશામાં આ વિસ્તરણ મહત્ત્વપૂર્ણ માનવામાં આવે છે.
UPIની વૈશ્વિક સ્વીકૃતિ ભારતના Digital Public Infrastructure મોડલની વધતી અસરનું પણ ઉદાહરણ છે.
દસ વર્ષની સફરમાં UPI ભારતના ડિજિટલ પેમેન્ટ ક્ષેત્રમાં સૌથી પ્રભાવશાળી વ્યવસ્થાઓમાંથી એક બની ગયું છે. 2026 સુધીમાં દેશના ડિજિટલ વ્યવહારોના વોલ્યુમમાં તેનો હિસ્સો લગભગ 84 ટકા સુધી પહોંચી ગયો છે.
તેનો અર્થ એ છે કે UPI હવે કોઈ વૈકલ્પિક પેમેન્ટ પદ્ધતિ નહીં પરંતુ ભારતની ડિજિટલ અર્થવ્યવસ્થાના મુખ્ય પાયામાંનું એક બની ગયું છે.
UPIની દસ વર્ષની સફળતાને માત્ર 24,162 કરોડ ટ્રાન્ઝેક્શન, ₹314 લાખ કરોડના વ્યવહાર, 741 બેન્કો અથવા 11 દેશોના આંકડા સુધી મર્યાદિત કરીને જોવી યોગ્ય નહીં બને.
તેની સૌથી મોટી સફળતા એ છે કે ટેક્નોલોજી સામાન્ય માણસના જીવનમાં એટલી સરળતાથી ભળી ગઈ કે આજે ₹20નું પેમેન્ટ પણ ડિજિટલ કરવું અસામાન્ય લાગતું નથી.
દસ વર્ષ પહેલાં UPI એક નવી પેમેન્ટ સિસ્ટમ હતી. આજે તે ભારતની ટેક્નોલોજી, નાણાકીય સમાવેશ અને Digital Public Infrastructureની ક્ષમતાનું વૈશ્વિક ઉદાહરણ બની ગયું છે.
એક મોબાઇલ ફોન, સામે લાગેલો QR કોડ અને થોડી જ ક્ષણોમાં પૂર્ણ થતું પેમેન્ટ—દેખાવમાં આ એક નાનકડો વ્યવહાર છે. પરંતુ તેની પાછળ છેલ્લા દસ વર્ષમાં બદલાયેલા ભારતની એક વિશાળ ડિજિટલ કહાની છુપાયેલી છે.

title: UPI 10 Years  ભારતની ડિજિટલ પેમેન્ટ ક્રાંતિના 10 વર્ષ પૂર્ણ, PM મોદીએ કહ્યું દરેક ભારતીય માટે ગર્વની ક્ષણ
description: યુનિફાઇડ પેમેન્ટ્સ ઇન્ટરફેસ (UPI)એ તેની 10મી વર્ષગાંઠની ઉજવણી કરી. પ્રધાનમંત્રી નરેન્દ્ર મોદીએ કહ્યું કે, દરેક ભારતીયને દેશની ડિજિટલ ચુકવણી ક્રાંતિ પર ગર્વ હોવો જોઈએ. તેમણે UPIના લોન્ચને ભારતના ડિજિટલ ચુકવણી ઇતિહાસમાં સૌથી નિર્ણાયક ક્ષણ ગણાવી. યુનિફાઇડ પેમેન્ટ્સ ઇન્ટરફેસ (UPI)એ તેની 10મી વર્ષગાંઠની ઉજવણી કરી. પ્રધાનમંત્રી નરેન્દ્ર મોદીએ કહ્યું કે, દરેક ભારતીયને દેશની ડિજિટલ ચુકવણી ક્રાંતિ પર ગર્વ હોવો જોઈએ. તેમણે UPIના લોન્ચને ભારતના ડિજિટલ ચુકવણી ઇતિહાસમાં સૌથી નિર્ણાયક ક્ષણ ગણાવી.
content:
सुदर्शन के राष्ट्रवादी पत्रकारिता को सहयोग करे
Donation
ભારતની ડિજિટલ પેમેન્ટ ક્રાંતિનું પ્રતિક બની ચૂકેલા યુનિફાઇડ પેમેન્ટ્સ ઇન્ટરફેસ (UPI)ને 25 ઓગસ્ટ, 2026ના રોજ 10 વર્ષ પૂર્ણ થયા છે. આ પ્રસંગે પ્રધાનમંત્રી નરેન્દ્ર મોદીએ UPIની એક દાયકાની સફરને ભારતની ડિજિટલ ચુકવણી યાત્રાનો સૌથી નિર્ણાયક તબક્કો ગણાવ્યો છે. તેમણે UPIના વ્યાપ, સરળતા અને તેની દેશવ્યાપી સ્વીકાર્યતા પર ગર્વ વ્યક્ત કરતાં દેશવાસીઓને પોતાના UPI અનુભવ શેર કરવાની અપીલ પણ કરી છે.
UPIએ છેલ્લા એક દાયકામાં માત્ર ભારતમાં રોકડવિહોણા વ્યવહારોને પ્રોત્સાહન આપ્યું નથી, પરંતુ ભારતને વૈશ્વિક રિયલ-ટાઇમ પેમેન્ટ ક્ષેત્રમાં અગ્રણી સ્થાન અપાવ્યું છે. નાણા મંત્રાલયના આંકડા મુજબ FY 2016-17માં 1.78 કરોડ રહેલી વાર્ષિક ટ્રાન્ઝેક્શન સંખ્યા FY 2025-26માં વધીને 24,162 કરોડથી વધુ થઈ ગઈ છે.
પ્રધાનમંત્રી નરેન્દ્ર મોદીએ સોશિયલ મીડિયા પ્લેટફોર્મ X પર UPIની 10 વર્ષની સફરનો ઉલ્લેખ કરતાં કહ્યું કે એક દાયકા પહેલાં શરૂ થયેલી આ વ્યવસ્થાએ ભારતની ડિજિટલ પેમેન્ટ યાત્રામાં નિર્ણાયક ભૂમિકા ભજવી છે. PM મોદીએ UPIના સ્કેલ અને પહોંચને દરેક ભારતીય માટે ગર્વનો વિષય ગણાવ્યો છે.
નાના વેપારીથી લઈને મોટા વ્યવસાય સુધી, શહેરી વિસ્તારોમાંથી લઈને ગામડાં સુધી અને સામાન્ય દૈનિક ખરીદીથી લઈને મોટા નાણાકીય વ્યવહારો સુધી UPIનો વ્યાપ ઝડપથી વધ્યો છે. આ કારણે આજે મોબાઇલ ફોન મારફતે સેકન્ડોમાં બેંક-ટુ-બેંક પેમેન્ટ કરવું સામાન્ય જીવનનો ભાગ બની ગયું છે.
પ્રધાનમંત્રી મોદીએ દેશવાસીઓને UPI સાથે જોડાયેલા પોતાના અનુભવો શેર કરવા પણ કહ્યું છે. તેમણે લોકોને જણાવવા માટે પ્રોત્સાહિત કર્યા કે UPIના આગમન બાદ તેમની રોજિંદી ચુકવણીની આદતોમાં શું ફેરફાર આવ્યો અને ડિજિટલ પેમેન્ટ્સે તેમના જીવનને કેવી રીતે સરળ બનાવ્યું છે.
UPIના કારણે અલગ-અલગ બેંકો વચ્ચે તરત જ નાણાં ટ્રાન્સફર કરી શકાય છે. QR કોડ અને મોબાઇલ આધારિત પેમેન્ટને કારણે નાના દુકાનદારો, રિક્ષાચાલકો, ફેરિયાઓ અને નાના વ્યવસાયોને પણ ડિજિટલ પેમેન્ટ સ્વીકારવાની સરળ સુવિધા મળી છે.
નાણા મંત્રાલયના 24 ઓગસ્ટ, 2026ના સત્તાવાર આંકડા પ્રમાણે UPIના વાર્ષિક ટ્રાન્ઝેક્શન વોલ્યુમમાં એક દાયકામાં અસાધારણ વધારો થયો છે. FY 2016-17 દરમિયાન UPI પર માત્ર 1.78 કરોડ ટ્રાન્ઝેક્શન થયા હતા, જ્યારે FY 2025-26માં આ આંકડો વધીને 24,162 કરોડથી વધુ ટ્રાન્ઝેક્શન સુધી પહોંચ્યો છે. આ લગભગ 13,000 ગણો વધારો દર્શાવે છે.
આ જ સમયગાળામાં UPIનો ઉપયોગ સતત વધતાં આજે તે ભારતની સૌથી મહત્વપૂર્ણ રિટેલ પેમેન્ટ સિસ્ટમોમાંની એક બની ચૂકી છે.
UPIની વૃદ્ધિ માત્ર ટ્રાન્ઝેક્શનની સંખ્યામાં જ નહીં, પરંતુ કુલ મૂલ્યમાં પણ નોંધપાત્ર રહી છે. FY 2016-17માં UPI મારફતે થયેલા કુલ વ્યવહારોનું મૂલ્ય અંદાજે ₹0.07 લાખ કરોડ હતું. FY 2025-26માં આ વધીને લગભગ ₹314 લાખ કરોડ સુધી પહોંચી ગયું છે. એટલે કે ટ્રાન્ઝેક્શન મૂલ્યમાં એક દાયકામાં 4,000 ગણાથી વધુ વધારો થયો છે.
FY 2025-26 દરમિયાન વોલ્યુમમાં વાર્ષિક ધોરણે 30 ટકા અને ટ્રાન્ઝેક્શન મૂલ્યમાં લગભગ 21 ટકા વૃદ્ધિ નોંધાઈ હતી.
UPIના વ્યાપનો અંદાજ તેના દૈનિક ટ્રાન્ઝેક્શન પરથી પણ લગાવી શકાય છે. સત્તાવાર આંકડા અનુસાર 2026માં UPI પર દરરોજ સરેરાશ 66 કરોડ ટ્રાન્ઝેક્શન નોંધાયા છે. જુલાઈ 2026માં UPIએ 2,366 કરોડના રેકોર્ડ માસિક ટ્રાન્ઝેક્શન અને ₹29.88 લાખ કરોડનું માસિક ટ્રાન્ઝેક્શન મૂલ્ય નોંધાવ્યું હતું.
આ આંકડા દર્શાવે છે કે UPI હવે માત્ર એક વૈકલ્પિક ડિજિટલ પેમેન્ટ વિકલ્પ નથી, પરંતુ દેશના રોજિંદા આર્થિક વ્યવહારોનું મુખ્ય માધ્યમ બની ગયું છે.
NPCIના સત્તાવાર રેકોર્ડ મુજબ UPIનો પાઇલટ પ્રોજેક્ટ 11 એપ્રિલ, 2016ના રોજ શરૂ થયો હતો, જ્યારે 25 ઓગસ્ટ, 2016થી 21 બેંકો સાથે UPI ગ્રાહકો માટે લાઇવ થયું અને બેંકોએ પોતાની UPI-સક્ષમ એપ્સ ઉપલબ્ધ કરાવવાનું શરૂ કર્યું હતું.
એક દાયકાની અંદર UPI સાથે જોડાયેલી બેંકોની સંખ્યા પણ નોંધપાત્ર રીતે વધી છે. FY 2016-17માં 44 બેંકો UPI પર લાઇવ હતી, જ્યારે FY 2025-26 સુધીમાં આ સંખ્યા વધીને 703 થઈ ગઈ હતી.
UPIને ભારતની Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI)નું સૌથી સફળ ઉદાહરણ માનવામાં આવે છે. UPIની ઇન્ટરઓપરેબિલિટીનો અર્થ એ છે કે ગ્રાહક એક એપનો ઉપયોગ કરીને અલગ-અલગ બેંકોના ખાતાઓ વચ્ચે તરત નાણાં મોકલી અને મેળવી શકે છે.
આ મોડેલે માત્ર ડિજિટલ પેમેન્ટ્સને સરળ બનાવ્યા નથી, પરંતુ નાણાકીય સમાવેશને પણ પ્રોત્સાહન આપ્યું છે. નાણા મંત્રાલય અનુસાર જૂન 2026 સુધીમાં લગભગ 55.49 કરોડ વપરાશકર્તાઓ UPI પ્લેટફોર્મ સાથે જોડાઈ ચૂક્યા હતા.
UPIની સફળતાને આંતરરાષ્ટ્રીય સ્તરે પણ માન્યતા મળી છે. નાણા મંત્રાલય મુજબ આંતરરાષ્ટ્રીય નાણાકીય ભંડોળ (IMF)એ ટ્રાન્ઝેક્શન વોલ્યુમના આધારે UPIને વિશ્વની સૌથી મોટી રિયલ-ટાઇમ પેમેન્ટ સિસ્ટમ તરીકે માન્યતા આપી છે.
સત્તાવાર આંકડા અનુસાર 2025માં વૈશ્વિક રિયલ-ટાઇમ પેમેન્ટ ટ્રાન્ઝેક્શન વોલ્યુમમાં UPIનો હિસ્સો લગભગ 49 ટકા હતો. આ ભારતના ડિજિટલ પેમેન્ટ ઇન્ફ્રાસ્ટ્રક્ચરના વૈશ્વિક પ્રભાવને દર્શાવે છે.
UPI હવે ભારતની સરહદ સુધી મર્યાદિત નથી. નાણા મંત્રાલયના તાજેતરના ડેટા મુજબ UPI હાલમાં 11 દેશોમાં કાર્યરત છે અને ક્રોસ-બોર્ડર ડિજિટલ પેમેન્ટ માટે વૈશ્વિક પ્લેટફોર્મ તરીકે વિકસી રહ્યું છે.
UPIની આ દસ વર્ષની સફર ભારતની ટેક્નોલોજીકલ ક્ષમતા, નાણાકીય સમાવેશ અને ડિજિટલ જાહેર માળખાની સફળતાનું મહત્વપૂર્ણ ઉદાહરણ બની છે. રોજિંદા નાના પેમેન્ટથી લઈને કરોડો વપરાશકર્તાઓ અને લાખો કરોડ રૂપિયાના વાર્ષિક વ્યવહારો સુધી પહોંચેલી UPIની આ યાત્રાએ ભારતના પેમેન્ટ ઇકોસિસ્ટમની તસવીર બદલી નાખી છે.

title: Gujarat ATS operation in Vadodara leads to arrest of suspected Jaish operative, AK-47 seized
description: Investigators are also trying to determine whether the arrested man was carrying the weapon for an individual or a wider network operating in the region. The possibility of other people being involved is also being examined.
content:
The Gujarat Anti-Terrorism Squad (ATS) has arrested a man suspected of having links with Pakistan-based terror organisation Jaish-e-Mohammed (JeM) in Vadodara district. An AK-47 rifle and 23 live cartridges were recovered during the operation, according to preliminary reports.
The operation was conducted near Jarod Bus Station in Vadodara district, where ATS personnel intercepted a vehicle and detained the suspect. The man is reportedly a native of Assam and is being questioned over his alleged association with the banned terror outfit.
The recovery of an assault rifle and live ammunition has prompted investigators to examine the circumstances under which the weapons reached Gujarat and what they were intended to be used for.
What is Gujarat ATS investigating?
A key focus of the investigation is to establish the origin of the AK-47 and trace the chain through which it was allegedly procured and transported.
Investigators are also trying to determine whether the arrested man was carrying the weapon for an individual or a wider network operating in the region. The possibility of other people being involved is also being examined.
Trending Stories
The suspect’s alleged links with Jaish-e-Mohammed are under investigation. Further questioning is expected to help security agencies establish the nature and extent of his connections with the terror organisation.
Jaish-e-Mohammed under security agencies’ scanner
The latest arrest comes amid continued scrutiny of suspected Jaish-e-Mohammed networks and their activities in Gujarat.
In July 2026, Gujarat ATS, along with local police, had carried out a coordinated operation resulting in the arrest of eight people suspected of links with the terror outfit across Gujarat and Madhya Pradesh.
Investigators will now examine whether the latest case has any connection with previously identified networks or represents a separate operation.
The investigation is ongoing, and further details about the suspect, the recovered weapon and possible links are awaited.

title: India-US trade deal ‘close to culmination’: Piyush Goyal says amid fresh tariff threat
description: India-US trade deal is nearing finalisation, Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal said, even as Washington proposed fresh tariffs of up to 25 per cent on Indian goods.
content:
Union Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal on Friday (Nov 27) said the India-US trade agreement was nearing finalisation, even as Washington proposed fresh tariffs of up to 25 per cent on Indian goods over alleged excess manufacturing capacity. Addressing the India Debt Capital Market Summit 2026 virtually, Goyal said the two countries were making progress on the process required to conclude the agreement.
“The US trade deal is close to culmination. The process and pathway, which was always something which held back finalising the deal, is now taking some shape,” he said.
US proposes fresh tariffs on Indian goods
The US Trade Representative has proposed tariffs of up to 25 per cent on Indian goods under a Section 301 investigation into alleged structural excess capacity in manufacturing. Washington has indicated that the proposed rate could be lowered to 17 per cent if India reaches a reciprocal trade agreement addressing its findings.
The proposals are subject to public comments and hearings beginning January 25, 2027. India has disputed the US findings.
India-EU trade deal expected this year
Trending Stories
Goyal also said the India-European Union free trade agreement was expected to be signed later this year and could come into effect by March or April 2027.
India has finalised nine free trade agreements over the past five years, covering 38 developed countries and providing preferential market access to economies with a combined GDP of $70 trillion. Another eight or nine agreements under negotiation could increase this figure to $85 trillion, he said.
India on track to achieve $1 trillion export target
On the domestic economy, Goyal said India had maintained its growth momentum despite geopolitical conflicts, oil price fluctuations and tariff-related disruptions.
India recorded 7.8 per cent growth in the first quarter of the current financial year. Gross fixed capital formation increased by around 12 per cent, while bank credit grew at approximately 19 per cent.
Exports reached nearly $570 billion in the first seven months of the financial year, while October exports touched a record close to $90 billion.
“I think we are well on track to achieve our USD 1 trillion target,” Goyal said.
Goyal calls for greater use of bond markets
He added that investments in semiconductor fabrication, electricity grids, data centres and ports would increase demand for capital.
Goyal urged large corporates, public sector undertakings and infrastructure developers to make bond markets their first choice for capital expenditure. He also called on institutional investors to support long-term debt and “look beyond just the AAA”.
Calling for easier trading of bonds, he said, “Make bonds easy to trade. It should be just like the share market, instantaneous.”

title: India-US trade deal nears final stage, India-EU pact expected to take effect from March-April 2027, says Piyush Goyal
description: India-US trade deal: Goyal said that despite uncertainties, the country had managed to deliver trust at the global level.
author: ET Now Digital
content:
Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal has said that the India-US trade deal is close to culmination, signalling progress in trade negotiations between the two countries. He also expressed hope that the India-EU trade agreement would be signed later in 2026 and come into effect from March or April.
Speaking about India's position in global trade, Goyal said that despite uncertainties, the country had managed to deliver trust at the global level. He expressed confidence in India's export prospects and said he hoped the country's exports would cross the USD1 trillion mark in FY27.
"The US trade deal is close to culmination. The process and pathway, which was always something which held back finalising the deal, is now taking some shape," Goyal said while addressing the India Debt Capital Market Summit 2026 virtually.
The remarks came after the latest US Trade Representative's (USTR) report proposed 25 per cent tariffs on imports from India, with a provision to cap them at 17 per cent if the two countries agree to a bilateral trade deal, giving it a slight edge over Asian competitors.
India-US trade deal close to culmination
Goyal said the India-US trade agreement was nearing its final stage. The development comes amid efforts by both countries to strengthen bilateral trade ties and resolve issues affecting their economic relationship.
The Commerce Minister's remarks indicate that discussions have made progress, although the final details and formal announcement of the agreement are awaited.
India-EU trade deal likely later in 2026
On the proposed India-European Union (EU) trade agreement, Goyal said he hoped the deal would be signed later in 2026.
He also indicated that the agreement could come into effect from March or April. The proposed pact is expected to be an important step in expanding India's trade and economic engagement with European markets.
India targets USD1 trillion exports in FY27
Goyal expressed optimism about India's export performance and said he hoped the country would cross $1 trillion in exports in FY27.
He highlighted that India had maintained global confidence despite uncertainties in the international economic environment. According to the minister, India's ability to deliver trust at the global level remains an important factor in strengthening its trade position.
Achieving the USD1 trillion export target would mark a significant milestone for India's external trade ambitions.
December MPC meeting: Rate hike expectations rise
Commenting on monetary policy expectations, Goyal said it appeared that more people were expecting a rate hike at the Reserve Bank of India's (RBI) December Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) meeting.

title: IGI shares rise over 3% after Rs 280-crore block deal; promoter cuts 1.55% stake
description: Around 67.16 lakh shares of International Gemological Institute changed hands at Rs 417 apiece in a pre-market block deal on NSE; promoter reportedly trims stake to comply with minimum public shareholding requirements.
author: Shahnaz Parveen
content:
IGI shares rise over 3% after Rs 280-crore block deal; promoter cuts 1.55% stake
Around 67.16 lakh shares of International Gemological Institute changed hands at Rs 417 apiece in a pre-market block deal on NSE; promoter reportedly trims stake to comply with minimum public shareholding requirements.
Shares of International Gemological Institute rose more than 3 per cent in early trade on Friday after a Rs 280-crore block deal involving 67.16 lakh shares, or 1.55 per cent of the company's equity, was executed on the National Stock Exchange (NSE).
Promoter stake sale to meet MPS norms
The block deal comes after reports that the company's promoter planned to pare its stake to comply with the Securities and Exchange Board of India's (SEBI) minimum public shareholding (MPS) requirement.
Listed companies in India are required to maintain at least 25 per cent public shareholding. Promoters often dilute their holdings through block deals, offer for sale (OFS), or other market transactions to meet these regulatory norms.
Loading social widget...
IGI share price performance
As of 9:45 am, shares of International Gemological Institute were trading over 3 per cent higher at Rs 436.30 after a Rs 280-crore block deal involving 67.16 lakh shares, representing 1.55 per cent equity was executed on the NSE.
The stock opened at Rs 427.60, compared with its previous close of Rs 423.25 and traded near its 52-week high of Rs 453.45.

title: Layoffs on the cards? Massive 10,000 jobs at risk as this company plans AI-led restructuring
description: Company plans layoffs: The company has asked all its departments to identify areas for potential cuts, with particular focus on product and engineering and sales verticals. The restructuring exercise would likely impact nearly 9% of the European software major's global workforce.
author: Shubhobrota Devroy
content:
This German company plans to cut 10,000 jobs in AI-led restructuring (Image source: Shutterstock-representational/ET Now)
Company plans layoffs: 10,000 jobs at risk! German software major SAP is now weighing a massive AI-led restructuring after reorganising its executive board twice this year.
According to a Bloomberg report, the company has asked all its departments to identify areas for potential cuts, with particular focus on product and engineering and sales verticals.
SAP’s restructuring likely to impact 9% of global workforce
SAP SE plans to slash around 10,000 jobs as it seeks to transform its software business for the artificial intelligence era, the Bloomberg report said.
The restructuring exercise would likely impact nearly 9% of its global workforce. However, the exact number of job cuts will be finalised after labour negotiations, the report added. 
Charting the AI-first strategy
The European giant reorganised its executive board twice this year as part of a push by Chief Executive Officer Christian Klein to promote an AI-first strategy. Two of six board members will leave the Walldorf, Germany-based company in March, the Bloomberg report said.
Will AI displace 24 million knowledge-worker jobs in next 5 years?
Amid the rising adoption of technology by businesses, a JP Morgan Wealth Management’s report has claimed that AI might displace jobs of 24 million knowledge-workers globally in the next five years.
The report, as cited by ANI, estimates that nearly 1.3 per cent of the global knowledge workforce could be impacted annually over five years following the displacement.
"Much of the AI adjustment could come through roles left unfilled rather than layoffs,” the report said, adding that job displacement if concentrated in particular occupations or regions could trigger larger risks. 
The scale of the possible impact is also significant for the United States. If two-thirds of the displaced roles were located there, the country could see around 16 million workers affected over five years, or roughly 3 million annually.
"Every job is ultimately a collection of tasks, and to date, AI can automate or augment only a portion of them," the report said.
It added that the adoption of AI across the economy would take time and remain uneven and gradual, which could help limit the risk of widespread job displacement.
The report further noted that AI adoption remains at an early stage. Only 6 per cent of work hours in the United States are currently AI-assisted, even though two-thirds of tasks may be theoretically exposed to the technology.
It said wider adoption beyond the technology sector would be necessary for AI investments to deliver the expected returns.

title: Mahanadi Coalfields: आईपीओ ने किया निवेशकों को निराश, डिस्काउंट पर लिस्टिंग; पहले दिन हुआ इतना नुकसान

Mahanadi Coalfields IPO: Coal India की सब्सिडियरी महानदी कोलफील्ड्स (Mahanadi Coalfields) के शेयरों ने शुक्रवार, 27 नवंबर को शेयर बाजार में दस्तक दे दी। लेकिन IPO में पैसा लगाने वाले निवेशकों को लिस्टिंग के दिन निराशा हाथ लगी। कंपनी के शेयर इश्यू प्राइस से नीचे लिस्ट हुए, जिससे निवेशकों को पहले ही दिन नुकसान उठाना पड़ा। आईपीओ को कुल मिलाकर 1.5 गुना सब्सक्रिप्शन मिला था, लेकिन बाजार में इसकी शुरुआत उम्मीद के मुताबिक नहीं रही।
डिस्काउंट पर हुई Mahanadi Coalfields की लिस्टिंग
Mahanadi Coalfields का शेयर BSE पर 133.15 रुपये पर लिस्ट हुआ। यह कंपनी के 136 रुपये के इश्यू प्राइस से 2.85 रुपये यानी करीब 2.10% नीचे रहा। वहीं, NSE पर शेयर 134 रुपये पर खुला, जो इश्यू प्राइस के मुकाबले 1.47% डिस्काउंट है। इस तरह IPO में निवेश करने वाले शेयरधारकों को लिस्टिंग के साथ ही नुकसान का सामना करना पड़ा।
कंपनी ने IPO के लिए 129 रुपये से 136 रुपये प्रति शेयर का प्राइस बैंड तय किया था। निवेशकों को एक लॉट में 110 शेयरों के लिए आवेदन करना था। अपर प्राइस बैंड पर एक लॉट के लिए 14,960 रुपये निवेश करने पड़े थे। कंपनी का यह आईपीओ पूरी तरह ऑफर फॉर सेल (OFS) था, यानी इसमें नए शेयर जारी नहीं किए गए। Coal India ने अपनी हिस्सेदारी बेचकर IPO के जरिए पैसा जुटाया है।
1.5 गुना सब्सक्रिप्शन, संस्थागत निवेशकों का रहा सहारा
Mahanadi Coalfields के IPO को कुल 1.5 गुना सब्सक्रिप्शन मिला था। हालांकि, इस मांग में संस्थागत निवेशकों की भूमिका सबसे अहम रही। क्वालिफाइड इंस्टीट्यूशनल बायर्स (QIBs) के लिए आरक्षित हिस्से को 4.95 गुना सब्सक्रिप्शन मिला। वहीं, रिटेल निवेशकों का हिस्सा केवल 0.46 गुना सब्सक्राइब हुआ। गैर-संस्थागत निवेशकों (NII) की श्रेणी में भी करीब 66% ही बोली मिली।
कोल सेक्टर में कंपनी की मजबूत स्थिति
Mahanadi Coalfields को कोल इंडिया की प्रमुख सहायक कंपनियों में गिना जाता है। वित्त वर्ष 2026 में कंपनी का देश के कुल कोयला उत्पादन में करीब 21% योगदान रहा। कंपनी के पास करीब 9.8 अरब टन कोयला भंडार है और कोल इंडिया की सहायक कंपनियों में इसकी उत्पादन लागत सबसे कम बताई गई है। ऐसे में कंपनी की मजबूत कारोबारी स्थिति पर निवेशकों की नजर रहेगी, लेकिन कमजोर लिस्टिंग ने फिलहाल बाजार का रुख दिखा दिया है।
