title: “Does Parliament Belong to Modi-Shah?”: Gaurav Gogoi Slams 4-Day Session
description: National | His comments came a day after the Union Cabinet approved a proposal to raise the strength of the Lok Sabha by 50 per cent in every state.
author: PratidinTime National Desk
content:
Congress MP Gaurav Gogoi on Friday questioned the Centre's plan to expand the Lok Sabha and its decision to hold a four-day sitting of Parliament without Question Hour, Zero Hour or Private Members' Bills. In two posts on X, he asked whether a House of more than 800 members would really give the country better representation, more productive debates and greater accountability.
In the first post, Gogoi raised concerns about what a much bigger Parliament would do to legislative scrutiny and to the protection of the Constitution. He alleged that the proposal served the interests of Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Union Home Minister Amit Shah and not the national interest.
Do you believe that a Parliament of 800 plus MPs will be able to represent the people of India better than the current one ?
Will discussions be more productive ? 
Will successive governments be held more accountable ? 
Will the laws and regulations be open to closer scrutiny…
— Gaurav Gogoi (@GauravGogoiAsm) November 27, 2026
His comments came a day after the Union Cabinet approved a proposal to raise the strength of the Lok Sabha by 50 per cent in every state. The proposal also freezes each state's share of seats until 2051, and the Centre has linked it to the rollout of 33 per cent women's reservation in Parliament.
In the second post, the Congress leader turned to the schedule of the coming sitting. He pointed to the bulletin issued by the Lok Sabha Secretariat on Thursday, November 26, a day when the country was paying tribute to Dr BR Ambedkar on Constitution Day.
"No question hour, no zero hour, no Private Members' Bill in Parliament. Yesterday when the entire country paid homage to Dr Baba Saheb Bhim Rao Ambedkar, the Lok Sabha issued a bulletin for a short 4-day Parliament session without any question hour, zero hour or private member bill," Gogoi wrote.
No question hour, No zero hour, No Private Members bill in Parliament.
Yesterday when the entire country paid homage to Dr. BabaSaheb Bhim Rao Ambedkar, the Lok Sabha issued a bulletin for a short 4 day Parliament session without any question hour, zero hour or private member… pic.twitter.com/CVLZMzb6oR
— Gaurav Gogoi (@GauravGogoiAsm) November 27, 2026
He then asked, "Does the Parliament belong to Modi-Shah?"
The Eighth Session of the 18th Lok Sabha is set to begin on Monday, November 30. The sitting in the Rajya Sabha is scheduled to begin on December 2. According to the schedule issued by the Parliament secretariats, both Houses are expected to wrap up on December 3, and the government has described the business as "essential".
The two posts add to the growing political debate over the proposed expansion of Lok Sabha seats and the government's plan to advance women's reservation through constitutional amendments.

title: '50% Increase In Seats, 25-Year Freeze': Centre Clears Revised Delimitation Bill
description: National | The Union Cabinet on Friday approved a revised delimitation-linked women's reservation bill, which is likely to be introduced during the special sitting of Parliament beginning November 30.
author: PratidinTime News Desk
content:
The Union Cabinet on Friday approved a revised delimitation-linked women's reservation bill, which is likely to be introduced during the special sitting of Parliament beginning November 30.
The revised proposal includes two major changes. It provides for a uniform 50 per cent increase in Lok Sabha seats across states and extends the freeze on using the 1971 Census as the basis for determining each state's proportional representation for another 25 years.
The proposed amendments seek to address concerns raised by southern states, including Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, over the possible loss of their relative parliamentary representation under population-based delimitation.
The bill, which aims to increase the Lok Sabha's strength to 850 seats, failed to secure the required two-thirds majority in April. The government is now expected to bring it back during the special parliamentary sitting scheduled from November 30 to December 3.
Meanwhile, Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge has called a meeting of Opposition floor leaders on Saturday to discuss a joint strategy.
Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav criticised the proposal, while Rajya Sabha MP Kapil Sibal alleged that the BJP was attempting to consolidate political power through delimitation and defections. Sibal also raised concerns over the proposed 131st Constitutional Amendment Bill and the participation of MPs facing disqualification proceedings in the crucial vote.

title: Red Alert on Junk Food: SC Orders Separate Warning Labels for High Sugar, Salt and Fat
description: SC tells FSSAI to put separate red hexagon warnings on foods high in sugar, salt or fat, and gives the regulator four months to draft rules | National | Top Stories
author: Ankita Sharma
content:
Red Alert on Junk Food: SC Orders Separate Warning Labels for High Sugar, Salt and Fat
The Supreme Court has ordered separate front-of-pack warnings on packaged foods high in sugar, salt or fat. The FSSAI has four months to draft the rules. It must also count total sugar and saturated fat and revisit thresholds the court called too low
NEW DELHI: Packaged foods high in sugar, salt or fat will soon need a separate warning label on the front of the pack for each of those nutrients. The Supreme Court of India ordered the change Thursday and said public health must come before the interests of the food industry.
A bench of Justices J B Pardiwala and K Vinod Chandran told the Centre and the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) to require a red hexagon-shaped warning for each nutrient that goes over the prescribed limit. Each warning must carry a standard symbol and the words "HIGH FAT," "HIGH SUGAR" or "HIGH SALT."
This goes further than the regulator's own proposal. The FSSAI had planned a single hexagon that would list every nutrient of concern together.
The court gave its 132-page judgment on November 26, which is Constitution Day. It gave the FSSAI four months to publish draft amendments to its labelling regulations.
One label for each nutrient
Under the court's order, a product that goes over the limit for more than one nutrient must show a separate hexagon for each. A combined warning will not be allowed.
A product that goes over the limit for even one nutrient must also carry a warning. The FSSAI had first planned a phased rollout. That plan would have covered only products high in two or more nutrients in its first stage.
The warnings must cover at least 4 percent or 5 percent of the principal display panel, depending on the product. The court said they must be prominent, conspicuous, and easy to read.
Reports say the labels are likely to show red hexagons on a white background on the upper left side of the pack. The text is expected to be at least one point larger than the type in the nutrition table on the back.
The aim is simple. Shoppers should be able to spot unhealthy products without turning the packet over to read the fine print.
Total sugar, not added sugar
The court also changed how the nutrients will be measured. It told the FSSAI to use total sugars and saturated fat, along with salt, as the nutrients of concern. The regulator had proposed using added sugar and added fat.
The bench said the FSSAI had not properly explained why it dropped its own 2021 position. In 2021, the regulator had concluded that total sugars were better suited to front-of-pack labelling because of health concerns, international acceptance and easier testing.
For the same reason, the court said the thresholds in the Dietary Guidelines for Indians 2024 cannot be used as they are. Those limits were worked out for added sugar and added fat.
Thresholds 'neither too low nor too high'
The judges said nutrient thresholds must rest on scientific evidence. They warned against setting them too low or too high.
If limits are too low, almost every packaged food would carry a warning, and buyers would soon start to ignore the labels. If limits are too high, most products would escape a warning altogether.
The court cited a study of 44,109 packaged-food records. It found that 94.1 percent went over at least one nutrient threshold under the 2024 guidelines, and 85.3 percent went over two or more.
The bench said the thresholds now on record are too low and must be revisited so the warning system stays meaningful.
Four-month deadline
The FSSAI must publish draft amendments within four months and invite public comments for 60 days. It must then finalise the regulations.
The court said the process must not be delayed again in the name of building consensus among stakeholders.
The court said, "The trajectory of this matter thus far, and the absence of any real urgency exhibited on the part of the authorities, cannot be overlooked."
It also explained why it had stepped in. The judgment said, "If an effective FoPNL is not brought into force in a timely manner, that delay would itself significantly hinder the effective realisation of the fundamental rights on which we have placed so much emphasis."
The court upheld the 365-day transition period for food businesses to comply. It turned down the petitioners' request for immediate enforcement.
It said that period must be strictly followed, with no further extensions in the ordinary course. The FSSAI must also watch for companies stockpiling products without warning labels during the transition.
The regulator must also prepare a full list of exempt foods, with reasons for each exemption. It must make sure manufacturers do not use additives or other ingredients to dodge the warnings.
'Double standards'
The bench criticised multinational food companies that it said follow different standards in India and abroad, including in product composition and nutritional information.
The court said, "Such companies comply with, and in some instances voluntarily adopt, FoPNL requirements in other jurisdictions, yet resist similar measures here … such double standards are deeply troubling."
It added, "A consumer in India is entitled to no less protection, and no less information, than a consumer in the United States or the United Kingdom."
A right under Article 21
The court linked the case to Article 21 of the Constitution, which protects the right to life. It held that the rights to health, food and informed choice place a positive duty on the State to protect public health.
The bench said children's vulnerability, poor nutrition information on packaged foods and the rising burden of non-communicable diseases go to the core of the right to health.
The court said, "The rhetoric of rights would mean little if it did not translate into meaningful change in the lives of people, especially for the most vulnerable."
Focus on schools
The court also told the Centre to strictly enforce the Food Safety and Standards (Safe Food and Balanced Diets for Children in School) Regulations, 2020.
It asked the government to build practical nutrition education into school curricula, including interactive workshops and co-curricular activities.
The matter will be listed again after 10 weeks. The FSSAI must then file an affidavit on how it has complied.
Years of delay
The case began with a public interest petition filed in 2024 by Kerala-based nonprofit 3S and Our Health Society. It sought mandatory warning labels so consumers could identify packaged foods high in nutrients linked to health risks.
The FSSAI's 2022 draft regulations proposed a star-rating system instead of warning labels. In April 2025, the court directed the regulator to finalise its recommendations.
In February 2026, the FSSAI told the court it would withdraw the draft and carry out more research. After the court criticised the delay, the regulator proposed warning labels using hexagons. The bench reserved its verdict on September 28.
Reactions regarding the SC order
Rajiv Shankar Dvivedi, the lawyer for the petitioners, welcomed the timing.
He told the media, "There could not have been a better day to pronounce this judgment than Constitution Day, because it is going to take forward the basic ethos and principles of the Constitution." He called the ruling "one of the biggest landmarks in the nutritional history of India."
Arun Gupta, convener of the think tank Nutrition Advocacy in Public Interest, also praised the verdict.
Gupta said, "Today, public health won in the Supreme Court. For years, the food regulator treated 'lack of consensus' as a reason to do nothing. The Supreme Court has now said that consensus is not a prerequisite for public health."
He said the next fight would be over the limits themselves. He said, "The real battle now shifts to the thresholds," urging the FSSAI to adopt science-based limits like those used in Chile, Mexico and by the World Health Organisation.
Gupta said, "FSSAI now has four months, and the court is watching."
What it means for industry
The ruling could have wide effects on India's packaged food and beverage industry, which is worth about 100 billion dollar. The industry has long resisted stricter front-of-pack warnings.
Health advocates say clear labels will help shoppers make better choices. They also expect the warnings to push manufacturers to cut sugar, salt and fat in their products.
The verdict comes as India faces rising rates of obesity, diabetes and high blood pressure. Children are increasingly exposed to packaged snacks, sugary drinks and highly processed foods.

title: Cabinet Approves 50 Per Cent Increase in Lok Sabha Seats, New Ceiling to Remain Until 2051
description: The Union Cabinet has approved a proposal to increase the strength of the Lok Sabha by 50% across states, with the revised ceiling set to remain in place until 2051. | Politics | National | Top Stories |
author: DY365
content:
Cabinet Approves 50 Per Cent Increase in Lok Sabha Seats, New Ceiling to Remain Until 2051
The Union Cabinet has approved a proposal to increase the strength of the Lok Sabha by 50% across states, with the revised ceiling set to remain in place until 2051
New Delhi: The Union Cabinet, chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, on Friday approved a proposal to increase the strength of the Lok Sabha by 50 per cent across states, with the revised ceiling set to remain in place until 2051, reports stated.
The decision came ahead of the special session of Parliament scheduled to begin on November 30. During this session, the government is expected to take up amendments to the Women's Reservation Bill linked to the delimitation exercise.
The proposed expansion is understood to be part of the government's efforts to address concerns over the potential impact of delimitation on the political representation of states, particularly those in southern India.
Earlier reports had suggested that the government was considering a formula to increase Lok Sabha seats by 50 per cent across all states while retaining their existing share of parliamentary representation based on the 1971 Census.
The formula, according to government officials, is intended to ensure that states do not lose their relative representation in Parliament following the proposed expansion, amid concerns that states with higher population growth could gain a disproportionate advantage under a population-based delimitation exercise.
The Cabinet meeting was convened at 1 pm at Sewa Teerth, with all Union ministers asked to remain present, reports said.

title: Gujarat ATS Arrests Assam Man With AK-47 Over Alleged JeM-Backed Vadodara Attack Plot
description: ATS arrested a 22-year-old man from Assam for an alleged terror plot to strike at a crucial security installation in Gujarat I National I Guwahati I Top Stories
author: DY365
content:
Gujarat ATS Arrests Assam Man With AK-47 Over Alleged JeM-Backed Vadodara Attack Plot
The man identified as Mohammad Saharul Islam Kabiruddin was apprehended near Golden Chowkdi on Halol-Vadodara Road, and an AK-47 style rifle along with two empty magazines and 23 live cartridges were seized from his possession.
GANDHINAGAR/SRIBHUMI: The Gujarat Anti-Terrorism Squad (ATS) has arrested a 22-year-old youth from Assam's Sribhumi district for allegedly plotting a terror attack on a major security installation in Gujarat at the behest of a Pakistan-based handler linked to Jaish-e-Mohammed (JeM).
The accused, identified as Mohammad Saharul Islam, hails from East Tongibari village in the Ratabari area of Sribhumi district, Assam. His father's name is Kabir Uddin.
He was apprehended near Golden Chowkdi on the Halol-Vadodara Road. An AK-47-style rifle, two empty magazines and 23 live cartridges were recovered from his possession. The ATS also seized a Jaish-e-Mohammed flag, two mobile phones with SIM cards and approximately Rs 20,000 in cash.
Addressing the media, Gujarat ATS Deputy Inspector General (DIG) Sunil Joshi said the agency had received intelligence inputs that a person linked to Jaish-e-Mohammed from outside Gujarat was likely to enter the state within a few days with an automatic weapon to target a significant security installation.
Following the intelligence input, an ATS team was constituted to track the suspect and prevent the alleged attack.
Mobile Tracking Led to Arrest
During the investigation, officials discovered that Saharul had switched off his regular mobile phone and checked into a hotel in Vadodara.
According to additional information about the operation, he was staying at Milan Hotel and allegedly left after paying the hotel bill before the ATS team reached the premises.
The investigators subsequently tracked another mobile phone being used by him. His location was traced to Gujarat's Dahod, following which he was found moving back towards Vadodara.
The ATS arranged road blockades along the route and eventually apprehended him near Golden Chowkdi on the Halol-Vadodara Road in the presence of official witnesses.
Pakistan-Based Handler Allegedly Directed Attack
According to the ATS, Saharul was allegedly in contact with a Pakistan-based Jaish-e-Mohammed handler identified as Mufti Rafiq, alias Ibn Abdullah.
Investigators said the handler had instructed him to carry out the terror strike and subsequently attempt to cross over into Pakistan.
The handler had allegedly provided him Rs 50,000 to purchase a new mobile phone and cover hotel accommodation and travel expenses.
Vadodara Air Force Station Under Surveillance
Digital evidence retrieved from Saharul's electronic devices reportedly contained reconnaissance footage of the Vadodara Air Force Station, marked locations on maps and videos demonstrating the functioning of rifles.
According to the investigation, Saharul had allegedly conducted reconnaissance of the Air Force Station and collected information about sensitive security installations.
Officials suspect that he was preparing to carry out a lone-wolf attack on the installation before fleeing to Pakistan.
Investigators are also examining his digital communications and alleged links with Jaish handlers. Preliminary findings point towards his contact with the terror outfit over an extended period.
Central intelligence agencies and the Gujarat ATS had reportedly been monitoring his activities through technical and physical surveillance.
FIR Registered Under UAPA, BNS and Arms Act
The ATS has registered a case against Saharul under the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act (UAPA), the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) and the Arms Act.
He is scheduled to be produced before a court.
Investigations are underway to identify the source of the recovered automatic weapon and determine who was supposed to receive it. Security agencies are also examining his activities, contacts and possible links within and outside Gujarat to establish whether any local network or logistical support was involved.
Gujarat ATS Had Arrested Eight JeM Suspects in July
Earlier, in a separate operation in July, the Gujarat ATS arrested eight people from different districts of Gujarat and Madhya Pradesh over their alleged links with Pakistan-based Jaish-e-Mohammed.
The arrested individuals were suspected of operating through religious and educational institutions, which investigators believed were being used as cover for radicalisation and logistical activities.
The ATS subsequently arrested five more people during the same month over their alleged links with the terror outfit.

title: 'You may as well not have a Parliament': Shashi Tharoor slams Centre's 850-seat Lok Sabha plan
description: Congress MP Shashi Tharoor criticises the Centre's proposed expansion of the Lok Sabha to 850 seats, warning that fewer Parliament sittings will weaken democratic debate.
author: DNA Web Team
content:
INDIA
Congress MP Shashi Tharoor criticises the Centre's proposed expansion of the Lok Sabha to 850 seats, warning that fewer Parliament sittings will weaken democratic debate.
Congress MP Shashi Tharoor on Friday criticised the Union government's move to link women's reservation with expanding the Lok Sabha to 850 seats, warning that a bigger Parliament with fewer sitting days would weaken democratic debate and reduce MPs to silent spectators.
Speaking ahead of the continuation of the unprorogued Monsoon Session, sitting from November 30 to December 3, Tharoor said the Congress is "100% in favour" of women's reservation and wants it enforced immediately after passage, accusing the government of falsely tying women's representation to delimitation.Tharoor rejected the premise that women’s reservation cannot take effect without redrawing constituencies, calling the linkage "a complete travesty" and arguing that the two issues have "nothing to do" with each other.
"As far as the women's reservation is concerned, we're 100 % in favour. We have said so from the beginning. And when it was initially passed, we wanted it implemented immediately. Government sat on it for three years before they actually notified it. And now to imagine that women's reservation can only be implemented if there is this Delimitation is a complete travesty. That is simply not accurate. Delimitation has nothing to do with women's reservation and vice versa. So women's reservation is not the issue," he said.
Since the Monsoon Session was adjourned sine die on August 13 without being prorogued, the government has summoned a short extension sitting from November 30 (Lok Sabha) and December 2 (Rajya Sabha) through December 3 to take up "essential government business".
Political attention is focused on the government's move to revive its delimitation-linked constitutional amendment and legislative package, after an earlier attempt fell short of the required two-thirds majority in April 2026.
Under the proposed framework, the Lok Sabha's maximum strength would expand from 543 to up to 850 seats, paving the way to implement the 33% women's quota under the Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam. On November 27, the Union Cabinet cleared a revised delimitation plan envisaging a 50% seat increase across states while keeping current inter-state representation ratios frozen until 2051.
"Delimitation, on the other hand, poses a very severe problem at various levels. First, it is taking place without a grand national conversation that should also include the states. You can't settle a matter like this only in the national legislature without taking the opinions of the chief ministers of the states who are going to be affected. Secondly, you are creating a situation where you have an 850-member House. As it is, this government has been reducing the number of days that Parliament meets year after year. Now we're down to 70. We're not even sure if there is even going to be a winter session. So if you have an 850-person House and a 50-day Parliament, you may as well not have a Parliament. It is going to be a travesty," added Tharoor.
He faulted the Centre for attempting a structural overhaul of national representation without a "grand national conversation" or formal consultation with state chief ministers whose states would be directly affected. Pointing to shrinking parliamentary calendars, down to roughly 70 days a year, with uncertainty over a full Winter Session, Tharoor warned that packing 850 MPs into a 50-day calendar would leave more than 800 members unable to speak in four-hour debates, question ministers, or raise local issues during Zero Hour.
"Most of the Members will not get a chance to speak. Most of the Members will not have an opportunity to question ministers, to raise their constituency issues under zero hour under matters of public importance and so on. And when debates take place, if you allot four hours to a topic, imagine you have so many parties in the House at most 15 16, maybe 20 people will speak. What are you to do with the rest of the 830 people left? It's going to be a real problem to have a House like this," said Tharoor.
He compared such an oversized, passive chamber to China’s consultative body, saying, "It will resemble the Chinese people's consultative chamber which specialises in thumping the desks when the great leader comes in. That's the idea that the BJP has; it's shameful," said Tharoor.
Responding to Home Minister Amit Shah's argument that population growth since the 1970s justifies expanding the 543-seat House, Tharoor said direct constituency-level representation would be better served by increasing MLAs in state assemblies, for instance, expanding Uttar Pradesh's 400-member assembly to 500, rather than bloating the national legislature.
"There are larger questions which should have been addressed as part of delimitation. There is, for example, the question of small states versus big states and the relative proportion. Right now, UP has, if I get it right, about five or six times the population of Kerala, but only four times the number of MPs. Is that an argument to give them more MPs? So the BJP thinks, but if the problem is our population has grown so much nationally that MPs are not able to fully represent their voters, the solution lies not in creating more MPs, but in giving the MLAs the responsibility of being in direct contact with their people and with their voters. So UP can have a much larger legislature. At the moment, they have 400 seats, Kerala is 140. Why don't we have a situation where they have 500 seats? How does it matter? Let there be More MLAs to look after the interests of their constituents, but don't burden Parliament with that responsibility. In the debate In April, our Home Minister said that India's Population has grown so much since the level of 543 was established in the 1970s. He is right. But that doesn't mean you have to keep expanding the House. There is no legislature in the world which has 850 people. No Democratic parliamentary legislature exists that is that large. What you need is to accept that sometimes you have to draw a line," said Tharoor.
He cited the US House of Representatives, which has remained capped at 435 seats since 1929 despite the US population more than tripling from 120 million to 380 million."In the US, the House of Representatives was frozen at 435 seats in 1929. Their population has tripled since then. It was 120 million then. It's 380 million today. They have not tried to increase the House of Representatives. Why is it that only India needs to keep on having more MPs per voter?" questioned Tharoor.
Questioning the government’s behind-the-scenes effort to assemble a two-thirds majority in the House, Tharoor warned that "numbers are not always right" and argued that pushing through such a consequential bill without public or federal consensus would leave unresolved institutional questions for the nation."I think it's a complete waste and what is worse about it is that there has been no serious discussion. There has been no serious consultation. There has been no effort made to take the people along. It has truly been a disgraceful performance by the government. Obviously, everyone says they're bringing this Bill because they're sure they have the votes. They have managed to cajole people into agreeing to them. We'll find out. But even if they get it, let me tell you that numbers are not always right. And the issues I have raised just now in talking to you are issues the nation will need to confront sooner or later. We'll try and fight for the right thing. We'll fight for justice. But I really, really despair that the process has been conducted so badly," added the Congress leader.
(Except for the headline, the article hasn't been edited by DNA staff but is directly published from ANI)

title: Mamata Banerjee gets big boost as Calcutta HC cancels Ritabrata Banerjee's appointment as leader of opposition
description: Speaking after the ruling in Kolkata, Srisarnno Bannerjee, counsel for Trinamool Congress MLA Sovandeb Chattopadhyay, said the High Court had allowed Chattopadhyay's petition.
author: ANI
content:
INDIA
Speaking after the ruling in Kolkata, Srisarnno Bannerjee, counsel for Trinamool Congress MLA Sovandeb Chattopadhyay, said the High Court had allowed Chattopadhyay's petition.
A single-judge bench of Justice Krishna Rao at the Calcutta High Court on Friday set aside the West Bengal Assembly Speaker's decision to recognise breakaway leader Ritabrata Banerjee as Leader of the Opposition in the Assembly.
The court also quashed MLA Akhruzzaman's appointment as Chief Whip and directed the Speaker to take a fresh decision within 10 days.
"Today, the court has set aside the order of the Speaker in which he had engaged Ritabrata Banerjee as the Leader of Opposition and Akhruzzaman as the Chief Whip and has directed the Speaker to take a decision within 10 days as to who shall be the Leader of Opposition. Therefore, the petition filed by Sovandeb Chattopadhyay, who was originally chosen by the All India Trinamool Congress as leader of opposition, has been allowed by the court... I hope Ritabrata Banerjee now takes good advice from his advocate friend, Akhruzzaman, whose name I have not seen in a single legal journal so far...."
The High Court order came on the same day that the first oral hearing began at the Election Commission of India (ECI) in the rival Trinamool Congress faction dispute, where Abhishek Banerjee, Kalyan Banerjee, and Derek O’Brien represented Mamata Banerjee’s camp, while Ritabrata Banerjee and Akhruzzaman appeared for the rival faction.
After the 2026 West Bengal Assembly elections ended 15 years of Trinamool Congress rule, sharp internal rifts fractured the party into competing camps, including a breakaway faction led by Ritabrata Banerjee.
Mamata Banerjee’s faction nominated veteran MLA Sovandeb Chattopadhyay as Leader of the Opposition, whereas the Speaker recognised Ritabrata Banerjee as LoP and named Akhruzzaman as Chief Whip—a move Chattopadhyay challenged before the High Court.
Alongside the 10-day window given to the Speaker to reconsider the LoP question, the ECI’s first hearing marks a pivotal front over party control, symbol rights, and organisational legitimacy.

title: Who is lying?': Akhilesh Yadav questions UP's missing voter figures, alleges electoral fraud
description: Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav accuses the BJP and Election Commission of conspiring to add millions of fake voters to Uttar Pradesh's electoral rolls.
author: DNA Web Team
content:
INDIA
Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav accuses the BJP and Election Commission of conspiring to add millions of fake voters to Uttar Pradesh's electoral rolls.
Samajwadi Party (SP) chief Akhilesh Yadav on Friday accused the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and the Election Commission of India (ECI) of conspiring to add millions of fake voters to the electoral rolls in Uttar Pradesh, alleging that claims about missing voters were part of a calculated strategy to prevent questions over a sudden increase in voter numbers when the final list is published.Yadav alleged that the BJP and the ECI were creating a narrative around missing voters to justify the addition of names to the final electoral roll.
"The BJP, in collusion with the ECI, is getting the names of millions of fake voters added to the final electoral roll or is in the process of doing so. This is why there is a pre-emptive outcry about millions of voters having 'gone missing'; the intent is to ensure that when the final electoral roll is released, no one questions how millions of voters were suddenly added in the span of a single month," he said.
He further alleged that rumours were being spread to create an atmosphere in which the addition of many names would not invite scrutiny."These rumours are being spread as part of a calculated strategy. An atmosphere is being manufactured, a narrative is being crafted, suggesting that a vast number of voters have 'disappeared' and that efforts must be made to 'add' them back," Yadav said.
Questioning the figures cited by the Uttar Pradesh government and the ECI regarding missing voters, the SP chief referred to statements made on November 8, 17 and 25.
“The Chief Minister stated that 1 crore 27 lakh Hindu voters had been removed from the electoral rolls. Just a few days ago, this point was raised by the Election Commission. They are claiming that 2.5 crore voters are missing. Who is lying? On November 8, the Chief Minister himself stated that the names of approximately 1 crore 27 lakh Hindu voters were missing from the electoral rolls in Uttar Pradesh. Subsequently, on November 17, the Election Commission responded, clarifying that it does not release data based on religion or caste. Then, on November 25, the Chief Electoral Officer stated that the names of 2.5 crore people are missing from the electoral rolls in Uttar Pradesh," he said.
Referring to the Chief Minister's recent attempt to score in basketball, Yadav took a swipe at him, saying he would have succeeded had he used a bulldozer instead."The game we are playing is the one that has the govt worried. They play it every single day, tossing the 'ball' over to our side constantly. You must have seen our Chief Minister’s own 'game'. He tried to score in basketball but failed. If he had used a bulldozer, he would have surely succeeded! What is his favourite thing? A bulldozer," he said.
Yadav also claimed that a party worker had shown him documents indicating that his house in Gorakhpur had been demolished using a bulldozer."An SP Party worker just showed me documents. His house in Gorakhpur was demolished by a bulldozer. These are destructive people; they thrive on ruin. They were meant to serve the public while in power, but instead, they are using that power to instil fear," he added.
"Can anyone even imagine someone losing their life to a bulldozer? They are filing cases against political party workers, with the Chief Minister himself overseeing the process. When he felt that his own kinsmen hadn't managed to frame people effectively enough, he brought in new officers through transfers and postings," he said.
He alleged that the Chief Minister was rattled by the PDA movement and that cases were being registered against party workers, often naming unknown persons as accused.
He also warned officials against acting under pressure and said the party was currently focused on correcting voter lists."I advise them: do not provoke us. Do not push us too far, because we are currently focused on refining our voter lists. You see, the BJP knows they are losing the election; they realise the public is no longer with them. Now, they are left with only one option—and they certainly have the money for it," Yadav said.
(Except for the headline, the article hasn't been edited by DNA staff but is directly published from ANI)

title: 'जिनकी 5% आबादी वो 40 फीसदी पदों पर काबिज!' जजों की नियुक्तियों में झोल पर पूर्व CJI की राष्ट्रपति से गुहार
description: Ex CJI गवई ने बताया कि पिछले 5 सालों में यानी जनवरी 2021 से जनवरी 2026 के बीच, कॉलेजियम की सिफारिशों में अगड़े समुदायों का हिस्सा लगभग 80% रहा है, जबकि अन्य पिछड़ा वर्ग का प्रतिनिधित्व लगभग 14% रहा है।
author: Pramod Praveen
content:
'जिनकी 5% आबादी वो 40 फीसदी पदों पर काबिज!' जजों की नियुक्तियों में झोल पर पूर्व CJI की राष्ट्रपति से गुहार
Ex CJI गवई ने बताया कि पिछले 5 सालों में यानी जनवरी 2021 से जनवरी 2026 के बीच, कॉलेजियम की सिफारिशों में अगड़े समुदायों का हिस्सा लगभग 80% रहा है, जबकि अन्य पिछड़ा वर्ग का प्रतिनिधित्व लगभग 14% रहा है।
Ex CJI BR Gavai: देश के पूर्व मुख्य न्यायधीश (Ex CJI) जस्टिस बीआर गवई ने राष्ट्रपति द्रौपदी मुर्मू को एक चिट्ठी लिखी है, जिसमें उन्होंने उच्च न्यायपालिकाओं में जजों की नियुक्तियों और स्थानांतरण में योग्यता, विविधता और समावेशिता के सिद्धांतों की बढ़ती अनदेखी पर चिंता जाहिर की है। इसके साथ ही जस्टिस गवई ने आरोप लगाया है कि कॉलेजियम द्वारा की जाने वाली सिफारिशें समाज के दूसरे वर्गों की कीमत पर एक खास समुदाय का पक्ष ले रही हैं। 27 नवंबर को लिखे एक पत्र में, जस्टिस गवई ने राष्ट्रपति से इस मुद्दे को स्वीकार करने और भारतीय लोकतंत्र के सबसे महत्वपूर्ण स्तंभों में से एक में समान प्रतिनिधित्व के संवैधानिक कर्तव्य को बनाए रखने के लिए उचित समझे जाने पर दखल देने का अनुरोध किया है।
जस्टिस गवई ने तीन पन्नों की चिट्ठी में आरोप लगाया कि 'समाज के एक खास वर्ग' के उम्मीदवारों को इन नियुक्तियों में तरजीह दी जा रही है। उन्होंने किसी खास समुदाय का नाम लिए बिना कहा कि देश की आबादी में 5% से भी कम हिस्सेदारी वाले एक खास समुदाय का उच्चतम न्यायालय में 40 फीसदी से अधिक प्रतिनिधित्व रहा है। पूर्व मुख्य न्यायाधीश ने सरकार के आंकड़ों का हवाला देते हुए कहा कि 2018 से अब तक उच्च न्यायालयों में नियुक्त किए गए 715 न्यायाधीशों में से केवल 22 अनुसूचित जाति, 16 अनुसूचित जनजाति, 89 अन्य पिछड़ा वर्ग और 37 अल्पसंख्यक समुदायों से थे। उन्होंने पत्र में लिखा है कि संवैधानिक अदालतों के मोटे तौर पर हर चार में से तीन जज सामान्य वर्ग से हैं।
चिंताजनक ट्रेंड हाइलाइट करने के लिए चिट्ठी
जस्टिस गवई खुद भी कॉलेजियम के सदस्य रह चुके हैं और बाद में वह देश के मुख्य न्यायाधीश यानी कॉलेजियम के हेड भी रह चुके हैं। उन्होंने कहा कि वह एक जागरूक नागरिक और पूर्व CJI के तौर पर एक चिंताजनक ट्रेंड को हाइलाइट करने के लिए ये चिट्ठी लिख रहे हैं, ताकि सभी स्टेकहोल्डर्स तुरंत सुधार के उपाय करें। कॉलेजियम में अपने समय को याद करते हुए, गवई ने कहा कि उन्होंने हमेशा सामाजिक विविधता और समावेशिता के सिद्धांत का अनुसरण किया है और हाई कोर्ट्स और सुप्रीम कोर्ट में प्रमोशन के लिए कैंडिडेट्स की सिफारिश करते समय अनुसूचित जातियों, अनुसूचित जनजातियों, अन्य पिछड़े वर्गों, अल्पसंख्यकों, महिलाओं और दूसरे हाशिए पर पड़े समुदायों सहित समाज के अलग-अलग वर्गों का सही प्रतिनिधित्व पक्का किया था।
समावेशिता के सिद्धांतो की पूरी तरह से अनदेखी
हालांकि, उन्होंने कहा कि हाल के दिनों में हुई परेशान करने वाली घटनाओं से पता चलता है कि इन सिद्धांतो की पूरी तरह से अनदेखी की गई है, जिसमें समाज के एक खास वर्ग के उम्मीदवारों को कथित तौर पर सिफारिशों और प्रमोशन के लिए पसंद किया जा रहा है, जबकि दूसरों को जबरन बाहर रखा जा रहा है। उन्होंने कहा, "मुझे इस बात की चिंता बढ़ती जा रही है कि सिफारिशें एक ही समुदाय को खुश करने और इनाम देने पर फोकस करके की जा रही हैं।" यह साफ करते हुए कि वह ज्यूडिशियल अपॉइंटमेंट के लिए अगड़े समुदायों के उम्मीदवारों पर विचार किए जाने के खिलाफ नहीं हैं, गवई ने कहा कि उनकी कोशिश हमेशा समाज के सभी वर्गों के बीच संतुलन बनाने की रही है।
आकंड़ों में क्या?
संसदीय आंकड़ों का हवाला देते हुए, पूर्व CJI ने कहा कि, मार्च 2025 में केंद्रीय कानून मंत्री द्वारा दी गई जानकारी के अनुसार, 2018 से नियुक्त 715 हाई कोर्ट जजों में से केवल 22 अनुसूचित जाति, 16 अनुसूचित जनजाति, 89 अन्य पिछड़ा वर्ग और 37 अल्पसंख्यक समुदायों से थे। उन्होंने कहा कि कानून मंत्रालय ने एक संसदीय समिति को बताया था कि उच्च न्यायपालिकाओं में “पिछड़े और अल्पसंख्यक समुदायों का असमान प्रतिनिधित्व” है।
पिछले पांच साल में ज्यादा गड़बड़ी
जस्टिस गवई ने आगे बताया कि पिछले पांच सालों में यानी जनवरी 2021 से जनवरी 2026 के बीच, कॉलेजियम की सिफारिशों में अगड़े समुदायों का हिस्सा लगभग 80 फीसदी रहा है, जबकि अन्य पिछड़ा वर्ग का प्रतिनिधित्व लगभग 14 प्रतिशत रहा है। उन्होंने सुप्रीम कोर्ट में जजों की नियुक्ति में एक खास समुदाय के प्रतिनिधित्व पर भी चिंता जताई और कहा कि देश की आबादी में 5% से भी कम हिस्सा रखने वाले समुदाय को हाल ही में सुप्रीम कोर्ट में 40 फीसदी पद दिए गए हैं।
उन्होंने कहा कि हालांकि सुप्रीम कोर्ट में नियुक्ति के लिए उम्मीदवारों की जाति का आधिकारिक रिकॉर्ड नहीं रखा जाता। उन्होंने कहा कि यही कमी सबसे बड़ी समस्या है जो समावेशिता के सिद्धांत को कमजोर कर रही है। सुप्रीम कोर्ट के पहले चार दशकों पर प्रोफेसर जॉर्ज गैडबोइस की स्टडी का ज़िक्र करते हुए, गवई ने कहा कि एक समुदाय, जो आबादी का लगभग 19वां हिस्सा है, ने 1950 और 1989 के बीच सुप्रीम कोर्ट के सभी जजों में से एक-तिहाई से ज्यादा पदों पर कब्जा किया था। उन्होंने कहा कि भारतीय गणतंत्र के सात दशक बीत जाने के बावजूद, सुप्रीम कोर्ट की प्रोफ़ाइल में मुश्किल से ही कोई बदलाव आया है। उन्होंने कहा कि जान-पहचान, नेटवर्क और सुप्रीम कोर्ट के जज कौन "जैसा दिखता है" इस बारे में बिना जांचे-परखे विचार ऐसे पैटर्न को बनाए रखते हैं।

title: ऑटो ड्राइवर का मांगा मोबाइल, कॉल करके DK शिवकुमार और विधानसभा को बम से उड़ाने की दी धमकी
description: यह बुकिंग कार्तिक के नाम से की गई थी। इसमें अरमाने नगर के 18वें क्रॉस से राजराजेश्वरी नगर स्थित बीएचईएल लेआउट तक जाने की बात कही गई थी। बुकिंग मिलने के बाद ऑटो ड्राइवर बताए गए पिकअप प्वाइंट पर पहुंचा।
author: Niteesh Kumar
content:
ऑटो ड्राइवर का मांगा मोबाइल, कॉल करके DK शिवकुमार और विधानसभा को बम से उड़ाने की दी धमकी
यह बुकिंग कार्तिक के नाम से की गई थी। इसमें अरमाने नगर के 18वें क्रॉस से राजराजेश्वरी नगर स्थित बीएचईएल लेआउट तक जाने की बात कही गई थी। बुकिंग मिलने के बाद ऑटो ड्राइवर बताए गए पिकअप प्वाइंट पर पहुंचा।
कर्नाटक की राजधानी बेंगलुरु में मुख्यमंत्री डीके शिवकुमार के आवास, उनके काफिले और विधानसभा को बम से उड़ाने की धमकी दी गई। पुलिस ने इस मामले में 20 साल के युवक को गिरफ्तार किया है। आरोपी ने इस वारदात को अंजाम देने के लिए ऑटो ड्राइवर के मोबाइल फोन का इस्तेमाल किया था। हैरानी की बात यह है कि ऑटो ड्राइवर को इस पूरी साजिश की भनक तक नहीं थी। पुलिस ने जांच के बाद आरोपी की पहचान कार्तिक आर के रूप में की है। वह बेंगलुरु का रहने वाला है और फिलहाल बेरोजगार बताया जा रहा है। पुलिस ने उसे 7 नवंबर को गिरफ्तार किया था। फिलहाल वह न्यायिक हिरासत में है।
पुलिस में दर्ज FIR के मुताबिक, यह घटना 5 नवंबर की शाम करीब 7:20 बजे हुई थी। 26 साल का ऑटो ड्राइवर मल्लेश्वरम इलाके में पैलेस ग्राउंड के पास सवारी का इंतजार कर रहा था। इसी दौरान उसे नम्मा यात्री ऐप के जरिए बुकिंग मिली। यह बुकिंग कार्तिक के नाम से की गई थी। इसमें अरमाने नगर के 18वें क्रॉस से राजराजेश्वरी नगर स्थित बीएचईएल लेआउट तक जाने की बात कही गई थी। बुकिंग मिलने के बाद ऑटो ड्राइवर बताए गए पिकअप प्वाइंट पर पहुंचा। वहां होम नाम की जगह के पास पहुंचने के बाद उसने ग्राहक को फोन किया, ताकि उसकी सही लोकेशन की जानकारी मिल सके। फोन उठाने वाले व्यक्ति ने खुद को मुख्यमंत्री के आवास के अंदर मौजूद बताया।
ऑटो ड्राइवर को कैसे झांसे में फंसाया
कॉल करने वाले व्यक्ति ने ऑटो ड्राइवर से कहा कि वह अपना मोबाइल फोन वहां सुरक्षा बैरिकेड के पास तैनात पुलिसकर्मी को दे दे, ताकि उसे सवारी की सही लोकेशन बताई जा सके। ग्राहक की बात पर भरोसा करके ड्राइवर ने अपना फोन वहां मौजूद पुलिसकर्मी को सौंप दिया। पुलिसकर्मी ने फोन पर उस व्यक्ति से बातचीत की। हालांकि, बातचीत के कुछ ही देर बाद पुलिसकर्मियों ने ऑटो की जांच शुरू कर दी। अचानक हुई इस कार्रवाई से ड्राइवर हैरान रह गया। जब उसने पुलिसकर्मियों से इसकी वजह पूछी तो उसे बताया गया कि फोन करने वाले व्यक्ति ने मुख्यमंत्री के आवास और विधान सौधा में बम लगाने की धमकी दी है। उसने यह भी दावा किया था कि मुख्यमंत्री का काफिला जब उस इलाके से गुजरेगा, तब धमाका किया जाएगा।
पूरी घटना की जांच में जुटी पुलिस
रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, यह सुनकर ऑटो ड्राइवर ने तुरंत पुलिस को बताया कि उसका धमकी देने वाले व्यक्ति से कोई संबंध नहीं है। उसने नम्मा यात्री ऐप पर हुई बुकिंग की जानकारी भी दिखाई और बताया कि वह केवल सवारी लेने के लिए वहां पहुंचा था। घटना के बाद ऑटो ड्राइवर ने पुलिस को शिकायत देने की बात कही, लेकिन परिवार के एक सदस्य की मेडिकल इमरजेंसी के कारण वह तुरंत थाने नहीं जा सका। इसके बाद उसने 7 नवंबर को पुलिस में औपचारिक शिकायत दर्ज कराई और सवारी बुक करने वाले व्यक्ति के खिलाफ कार्रवाई की मांग की।
शुरुआत में पुलिस ने इस मामले में नॉन-कॉग्निजेबल रिपोर्ट (NCR) दर्ज की। इसके बाद अदालत से इजाजत मिलने पर एफआईआर दर्ज की गई। पुलिस ने मामले की जांच शुरू की और कॉल व बुकिंग से जुड़े सुरागों के आधार पर आरोपी तक पहुंच गई। जांच के बाद कार्तिक आर को गिरफ्तार कर लिया गया। पुलिस अब इस बात की भी पड़ताल कर रही है कि उसने ऑटो ड्राइवर के फोन का इस्तेमाल करके धमकी देने की योजना क्यों बनाई थी और इस पूरी घटना के पीछे उसका मकसद क्या था। शुरुआती जांच में पुलिस को संकेत मिले हैं कि आरोपी मानसिक स्वास्थ्य से जुड़ी किसी समस्या से जूझ रहा हो सकता है।

title: डिलिमिटेशन बिल पर मोदी सरकार का सपोर्ट करेगी शरद पवार की NCP, INDIA अलायंस में बड़ी फूट
description: शरद पवार की एनसीपी-एसपी मोदी सरकार की ओर से लाए जा रहे डिलिमिटेशन बिल का सपोर्ट करने जा रही है। शरद पवार से मुलाकात करने के बाद जितेंद्र आव्हाड ने यह ऐलान किया है।
author: Madan Tiwari
content:
डिलिमिटेशन बिल पर मोदी सरकार का सपोर्ट करेगी शरद पवार की NCP, INDIA अलायंस में बड़ी फूट
शरद पवार की एनसीपी-एसपी मोदी सरकार की ओर से लाए जा रहे डिलिमिटेशन बिल का सपोर्ट करने जा रही है। शरद पवार से मुलाकात करने के बाद जितेंद्र आव्हाड ने यह ऐलान किया है।
शरद पवार की एनसीपी (एसपी) संसद में आने जा रहे डिलिमिटेशन बिल पर मोदी सरकार का सपोर्ट करने जा रही है। अब तक इंडिया अलायंस का हिस्सा रहने वाली एनसीपी (एसपी) के रुख बदलने से राहुल गांधी को बड़ा झटका लगेगा। कांग्रेस समूचे विपक्ष को एकजुट करने की कोशिश कर रही है, लेकिन एनसीपी एसपी ने डिलिमिटेशन बिल सपोर्ट करने का फैसला किया है। यह इंडिया अलायंस में बड़ी फूट मानी जा रही है। इससे पहले, शुक्रवार दोपहर को डिलिमिटेशन बिल को मोदी कैबिनेट से मंजूरी मिल गई।
मुंबई के अस्पताल में भर्ती शरद पवार से मुलाकात करने के बाद एनसीपी एसपी के नेता जितेंद्र आव्हाड ने ऐलान किया है। इससे पहले, पवार की बेटी सुप्रिया सुले भी यह संकेत दे चुकी थीं कि उनकी पार्टी बिल के पेश होने के बाद फैसला लेगी। इससे माना जा रहा था कि उनकी पार्टी बिल को सपोर्ट कर सकती है। न्यूज एजेंसी एएनआई के अनुसार, शरद पवार के साथ अपनी बातचीत पर NCP-SP नेता जितेंद्र आव्हाड ने कहा, "बातचीत हमारी पार्टी के ऑफिशियल स्टैंड के बारे में नहीं थी। आम तौर पर यह कहा जा रहा था कि डिलिमिटेशन प्रोसेस एक संवैधानिक जरूरत है। डिलिमिटेशन प्रोसेस को सपोर्ट करने का फैसला किया गया है, और हम सच में इसका सपोर्ट करेंगे। हम डिलिमिटेशन को सपोर्ट करेंगे।"
इंडिया अलायंस की बैठक से सुप्रिया सुले ने बनाई थी दूरी
सुप्रिया सुले ने कहा था कि वह संसद की विशेष बैठक में विपक्ष की रणनीति पर चर्चा के लिए शनिवार को बुलाई गई 'इंडियन नेशनल डेवलपमेंटल इंक्लूसिव अलायंस' (इंडिया) की बैठक में शामिल नहीं होंगी, क्योंकि उनके पिता शरद पवार अस्वस्थ हैं। बारामती से लोकसभा सदस्य सुले ने कहा कि पवार के अस्पताल में भर्ती होने के कारण वह मुंबई में ही रहेंगी। उन्होंने अपने वॉट्सऐप स्टेटस पर लिखा, ''मैं (संसद की विशेष) बैठक में भाग लेने के लिए सोमवार सुबह दिल्ली जाऊंगी।'' शरद पवार को शरीर में पानी की कमी (डिहाइड्रेशन) के कारण गुरुवार को दक्षिण मुंबई के एक अस्पताल में भर्ती कराया गया था।
'मसौदा पढ़ने के बाद ही लेंगे फैसला'
इससे पहले, सुप्रिया सुले ने डिलिमिटेशन बिल पर कहा था कि उनकी पार्टी पहले बिल के मसौदे को पढ़ेगी और उसके बाद ही अपना रुख स्पष्ट करेगी। संसद की विशेष बैठक 30 नवंबर से बुलाई गई है, जिसमें जरूरी कामकाज निपटाए जाने की बात सरकार की ओर से की गई है। ऐसे संकेत मिल रहे हैं कि सरकार इस बैठक के दौरान महिला आरक्षण लागू करने की प्रक्रिया को डिलिमिटेशन से जोड़ने वाले संविधान संशोधन विधेयक को पेश कर सकती है।

title: Balod News:14 महीने तक दी महतारी वंदन की राशि, अब वापस लौटने महिला को नोटिस थमाया
description: Mahatari Vandan: महतारी वंदन योजना के तहत 14 महीने तक एक हजार रुपए प्रतिमाह पाने वाली महिला को अब 14 हजार रुपए लौटाने का नोटिस मिला है।
author: Love Sonkar
content:
महतारी वंदन योजना की हितग्राही महिला
(photo Patrika)
Balod Mahatari Vandan: महतारी वंदन योजना के तहत 14 महीने तक नियमित राशि मिलने के बाद अब हितग्राहियों को 14 हजार रुपए लौटाने के नोटिस जारी किए जाने का मामला सामने आया है। शासन की ओर से पहले पात्र मानकर राशि जारी करने और बाद में वसूली की कार्रवाई शुरू करने से हितग्राहियों की परेशानी बढ़ गई है। इनमें ऐसे परिवार भी शामिल हैं, जो पहले से ही आर्थिक और स्वास्थ्य संबंधी संकट से जूझ रहे हैं।
पति पैरालिसिस से पीडि़त
यह मामला उस समय सामने आया, जब संजारी बालोद की विधायक एवं प्रदेश महिला कांग्रेस की कार्यकारी अध्यक्ष संगीता सिन्हा के समक्ष एक पीडि़त महिला हितग्राही ने अपनी समस्या रखी। महिला ने बताया कि दो साल पहले उसके पति पैरालिसिस से पीडि़त हो गए, जिसके कारण वे काम पर जाने में असमर्थ हैं। परिवार की आर्थिक स्थिति पहले से ही खराब है। ऐसे में 14 महीने तक मिली महतारी वंदन योजना की राशि खर्च करने के बाद अब 14 हजार रुपये लौटाने का नोटिस मिला है।
राशि वसूली के संबंध में पत्र जारी
महिला के दिखाए गए विभागीय दस्तावेज के अनुसार कार्यालय परियोजना अधिकारी, एकीकृत बाल विकास परियोजना बालोद की ओर से 21 अक्टूबर को राशि वसूली के संबंध में पत्र जारी किया गया है। इसमें शासन के निर्देशों का हवाला देते हुए शासकीय सेवक के परिवार की महिला सदस्य को अपात्र एवं मृत हितग्राही के खाते में राशि आवंटित होने जैसे कारणों से संबंधित हितग्राहियों से वसूली की बात कही गई है।
अन्य हितग्राहियों की सूची सामने आने का दावा
दस्तावेज में ग्राम पंचायत भेडिय़ा नवागांव निवासी राजेश्वरी का नाम दर्ज है और 14 हजार रुपए की वसूली का उल्लेख है। इसके अलावा अन्य हितग्राहियों के नामों की सूची भी सामने आई है। पीडि़त महिला ने अपनी परेशानी बताते हुए कहा कि परिवार में इलाज और रोजमर्रा के खर्च के लिए ही पर्याप्त पैसे नहीं हैं। ऐसे में 14 हजार रुपए लौटाना संभव नहीं है। बातचीत में बेटियों की नौकरी अथवा शादी के बाद दूसरे स्थान पर चले जाने के बावजूद वसूली की स्थिति और आंगनबाड़ी कार्यकर्ताओं पर भी दबाव बनाने की बात सामने आई। विधायक ने मामले को गंभीर बताया। उन्होंने कहा कि संबंधित अधिकारियों से चर्चा करने के साथ महिला एवं बाल विकास मंत्री के समक्ष भी मुद्दा उठाया जाएगा।

title: Bihar Politics: अनंत सिंह से लेकर आनंद मोहन तक, तेज प्रताप यादव का बवाल मचाने वाला बयान
description: Bihar Politics: तेज प्रताप यादव ने अनंत सिंह की बेटी की शादी में हुए खर्च पर सवाल उठाते हुए ED और CBI जांच की मांग की। वहीं, आनंद मोहन के सरेंडर और अपराधियों की गिरफ्तारी को लेकर भी बड़ा बयान दिया।
author: Mukul Kumar
content:
Hindi News / National News / Bihar Politics: अनंत सिंह से लेकर आनंद मोहन तक, तेज प्रताप यादव का बवाल मचाने वाला बयान
Bihar Politics: अनंत सिंह से लेकर आनंद मोहन तक, तेज प्रताप यादव का बवाल मचाने वाला बयान
Bihar Politics: तेज प्रताप यादव ने अनंत सिंह की बेटी की शादी में हुए खर्च पर सवाल उठाते हुए ED और CBI जांच की मांग की। वहीं, आनंद मोहन के सरेंडर और अपराधियों की गिरफ्तारी को लेकर भी बड़ा बयान दिया।
मोकामा विधायक अनंत सिंह की बेटी की शादी में हुए खर्च को लेकर विवाद बढ़ता ही जा रहा है। अब जनशक्ति जनता दल के राष्ट्रीय अध्यक्ष तेज प्रताप यादव ने अनंत सिंह पर निशाना साधते हुए शादी में हुए खर्च पर सवाल उठाए हैं।
उन्होंने कहा कि सरकार को इस मामले का संज्ञान लेना चाहिए और प्रवर्तन निदेशालय (ईडी) तथा केंद्रीय जांच ब्यूरो (सीबीआई) से जांच करानी चाहिए।
तेज प्रताप ने सवाल उठाया कि आखिर इतनी बड़ी रकम कहां से आई और शादी में हुए खर्च का इंतजाम किस पैसे से किया गया? उन्होंने कहा कि कम से कम ED और CBI को इस मामले में जांच शुरू करनी चाहिए।
अनंत सिंह की बेटी की शादी के खर्च पर उठाए सवाल
पटना में मीडिया से बातचीत के दौरान तेज प्रताप यादव ने अनंत सिंह की बेटी की शादी में हुए खर्च को गलत बताया। उन्होंने कहा कि इतना अधिक पैसा खर्च नहीं किया जाना चाहिए था।
तेज प्रताप ने कहा- यह गलत था। उन्हें इतना खर्च नहीं करना चाहिए था। सरकार को इस पर संज्ञान लेना चाहिए। आखिर इतना पैसा कहां से आ रहा है? इस खर्च के लिए रकम का इंतजाम कहां से किया गया? कम से कम ED और CBI को जांच शुरू करनी चाहिए।
आनंद मोहन के सरेंडर पर भी उठाए सवाल
तेज प्रताप यादव ने पूर्व सांसद आनंद मोहन से जुड़े मामले पर भी अपनी प्रतिक्रिया दी। सुप्रीम कोर्ट की ओर से आनंद मोहन को एक महीने के भीतर सरेंडर करने के आदेश के सवाल पर उन्होंने कहा कि जब अदालत ने निर्देश दिया है तो अब तक इसका पालन क्यों नहीं हुआ?
उन्होंने कहा कि अगर सरकार कानून-व्यवस्था बनाए रखने का दावा करती है तो उसे ऐसे मामलों में कार्रवाई करनी चाहिए। तेज प्रताप ने अपराधियों की गिरफ्तारी की मांग करते हुए आरोप लगाया कि ऐसे कई लोग सत्ताधारी दल के भीतर भी मौजूद हैं।
उन्होंने कहा- वे सरेंडर क्यों नहीं कर रहे हैं? ऐसे सभी अपराधियों को गिरफ्तार किया जाना चाहिए। अगर कोई सरकार कानून-व्यवस्था बनाए रखने का दावा करती है तो उसे कार्रवाई करनी चाहिए। खासकर तब, जब इनमें से आधे से ज्यादा अपराधी उनकी अपनी पार्टी में मौजूद हैं।

title: समर्थन मूल्य पर धान बेचने से चूक सकते हैं 600 किसान, पामेड़ के 35 गांवों में क्यों गहराया संकट? जानें वजह
description: Paddy Registration: छत्तीसगढ़ के नक्सल प्रभावित पामेड़ क्षेत्र में वनाधिकार पट्टा मिलने के बाद भी किसानों की मुश्किलें कम नहीं हुई हैं। यहां 35 गांवों के करीब 500 से 600 किसान एग्रीस्टैक पोर्टल में नाम दर्ज नहीं होने से धान पंजीयन नहीं करा पा रहे हैं।
author: Khyati Parihar
content:
किसानों का पंजीयन अटका (फोटो सोर्स- पत्रिका)
Paddy Procurement: नक्सल प्रभावित पामेड़ क्षेत्र में किसानों को खेती की जमीन का वनाधिकार पट्टा मिलने के बाद भी उनकी मुश्किलें कम नहीं हुई हैं। सालभर खेतों में मेहनत कर धान की फसल तैयार करने वाले नए वनाधिकार पट्टाधारक अब अपनी उपज बेचने के लिए सरकारी पोर्टल में नाम दर्ज कराने की जद्दोजहद कर रहे हैं। एग्रीस्टैक पोर्टल में नाम दर्ज नहीं होने के कारण इन किसानों का किसान पंजीयन और धान पंजीयन अटक गया है। ऐसे में समर्थन मूल्य पर धान बेचने का उनका अधिकार संकट में पड़ता दिखाई दे रहा है।
गौरतलब है कि पामेड़ धान खरीदी केंद्र के अंतर्गत आने वाली सात ग्राम पंचायतों के करीब 35 गांवों में 500 से 600 किसानों को नए वनाधिकार पट्टे वितरित किए गए हैं। इनमें पामेड़, धर्माराम, उड़तामल्ला, पालागुड़ा, कंवरगट्टा और दारेली सहित आसपास के गांवों के किसान शामिल हैं। किसानों का कहना है कि पट्टा मिलने के बावजूद उनके नाम एग्रीस्टैक पोर्टल पर दर्ज नहीं हो पाए हैं। इसके चलते ऑनलाइन प्रक्रिया पूरी नहीं हो रही और धान बेचने के लिए जरूरी पंजीयन भी अटक गया है।
इस समस्या को लेकर प्रभावित किसानों ने कलेक्टर के नाम आवेदन सौंपकर एग्रीस्टैक और धान पंजीयन कराने की मांग की है। किसानों को आशंका है कि समय रहते पोर्टल में नाम दर्ज नहीं हुए तो खरीदी शुरू होने के बावजूद वे अपनी उपज सरकारी केंद्रों पर नहीं बेच पाएंगे।
सापेड़ के हरीश कुंजाम, जारपल्ली के कारमधर देव, सैंड्राबोर के कुर्सुम मुत्ता, कंवरगट्टा के मडक़म नंदा और धर्माराम के सोढ़ी भुजंगरा सहित अन्य किसानों का कहना है कि उन्हें खेती के लिए पट्टा तो मिल गया, लेकिन अब सरकारी खरीदी में शामिल होने के लिए जरूरी पंजीयन नहीं हो पा रहा है। किसानों का सवाल है कि जब उन्हें जमीन पर खेती करने का अधिकार मिल चुका है तो अपनी उपज बेचने के लिए जरूरी सरकारी प्रक्रिया में उनका नाम क्यों नहीं जुड़ पा रहा है?
इस समस्या का दूसरा पहलू और भी गंभीर है। पामेड़ क्षेत्र तेलंगाना की सीमा से लगा हुआ है। यहां सरकारी खरीदी की सुविधा से वंचित किसानों के सामने अपनी उपज बेचने के विकल्प सीमित हैं। ऐसे में उन्हें तेलंगाना की ओर सक्रिय कोचियों के पास धान बेचने के लिए मजबूर होना पड़ सकता है। किसानों के मुताबिक, कोचिए उनसे करीब 800 से 900 रुपए प्रति ङ्क्षक्वटल की दर से धान खरीदते हैं, जबकि सरकारी खरीदी में समर्थन मूल्य का लाभ मिलता है। खेती में बीज, खाद, मजदूरी और परिवहन पर खर्च करने के बाद इतनी कम कीमत पर धान बेचना किसानों के लिए घाटे का सौदा साबित होगा।
प्रभावित किसानों ने जिला प्रशासन से मांग की है कि नए वनाधिकार पट्टाधारकों के नाम एग्रीस्टैक पोर्टल पर दर्ज कराने के लिए विशेष व्यवस्था की जाए, ताकि वे समय रहते धान पंजीयन करा सकें और समर्थन मूल्य पर अपनी उपज बेचने के लाभ से वंचित न रहें।
जारपल्ली, धर्माराम, सापेड़ और पामेड़ क्षेत्र के किसान इस समस्या से जूझ रहे हैं। इनमें पड़ा गुताम्मा, कट्टम अदम्मा, कुंजाम कोसी, करतम लखमू, हरीश कुंजाम, कारम दरैया, बद्रमा कारम, गडप्पली मुक्तमा, नागमणी पोडियामी, कट्टम जानकम्मा, सोढ़ी बुजगरांव, सवलम दुरो, कारम वैंकेया, करतम अर्जुन, तेलम इरमा और कल्लूरी चलपती सहित अन्य किसान शामिल हैं।
विश्वदीप तुस्सावाल, कलेक्टर के मुताबिक, बीजापुर जिले में अब तक 20 हजार से अधिक किसानों का पंजीयन हो चुका है। जो किसान एग्रीस्टैक और धान पंजीयन से छूट गए हैं, उनका पंजीयन कराने के लिए प्रशासन पूरा प्रयास करेगा। उन्होंने कहा कि कोशिश रहेगी कि कोई भी पात्र किसान समर्थन मूल्य पर धान बेचने और बोनस के लाभ से वंचित न रहे।

title: NCP (SP) Backs Delimitation Bill, Jitendra Awhad Confirms After Meeting Sharad Pawar
description: NCP (SP) has backed delimitation, with Jitendra Awhad confirming the decision after meeting Sharad Pawar. Meanwhile, Shashi Tharoor has questioned the DMK's position and the link with women's reservation.
author: Ashish Rana
content:
NCP (SP) Backs Delimitation Bill, Jitendra Awhad Confirms After Meeting Sharad Pawar
The Nationalist Congress Party (Sharadchandra Pawar) has decided to support the proposed delimitation exercise, adding an important development to the political debate over the issue. Party leader Jitendra Awhad confirmed the decision on Friday after meeting NCP chief Sharad Pawar in Mumbai.
AI-generated summary, reviewed by editors
Speaking outside Breach Candy Hospital, Awhad said the party's decision was based on constitutional provisions and had been taken after discussions involving senior leaders and MPs.
"As per constitutional provisions, delimitation has to be done. Supriyatai and the MPs have taken a decision. Our party will support it," Awhad said.
NCP (SP) Takes Stand On Delimitation
Awhad's announcement comes amid growing political differences over the proposed delimitation process. The issue has triggered discussions among opposition parties, particularly over its possible impact on the representation of different states in Parliament.
Shashi Tharoor Questions Link With Women's Reservation
Congress MP Shashi Tharoor has criticised attempts to connect women's reservation with delimitation. He said Congress has consistently supported women's reservation and wanted it implemented immediately after the legislation was initially passed.
"And now to imagine that women's reservation can only be implemented if there is this Delimitation is a complete travesty. That is simply not accurate. Delimitation has nothing to do with women's reservation and vice versa," Tharoor said.
Tharoor Disappointed With DMK's Position
Tharoor also expressed disappointment over the DMK's conditions for supporting the Delimitation Bill in Parliament. He recalled the party's earlier opposition to Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas in Tamil Nadu over concerns about Hindi being taught in the state.
"Now such a party to surrender on the specious grounds that the increase is proportionate without looking at the larger agenda of the BJP behind it, is, I think, an abdication of responsibility to the people in whose name they claim to speak," he said.
Although Tharoor acknowledged having good working relations with DMK leaders, he said the party's current position was unlikely to find support among genuine Dravidian supporters.

title: 33% Women's Reservation: How Many Lok Sabha Seats Could Women Get In Each State After Delimitation?
description: The Centre's proposed Delimitation Bill could increase Lok Sabha seats by 50% across states and pave the way for 33% women's reservation. Here's how many seats women could get in Uttar Pradesh, Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra, West Bengal and other states.
author: Swastika Sruti
content:
33% Women's Reservation: How Many Lok Sabha Seats Could Women Get In Each State After Delimitation?
The Union Cabinet has cleared a fresh delimitation-linked constitutional amendment proposal that seeks to increase Lok Sabha seats by 50 per cent across states. The proposal is also aimed at bringing the 33 per cent reservation for women into effect ahead of the 2029 Lok Sabha elections.
AI-generated summary, reviewed by editors
Under the proposed arrangement, the number of Lok Sabha seats could increase from the current 543 to 815 seats allocated to states, while Union Territories could get up to 35 seats. Of the 815 seats allocated to states, approximately 272 would be reserved for women.
The proposal is significant because it would increase the number of women representatives without reducing the existing proportion of parliamentary representation held by individual states.
What Does 33% Women's Reservation Mean?
The Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam, passed by Parliament in 2023, provides for one-third reservation for women in the Lok Sabha and state Legislative Assemblies.
However, the law linked the implementation of the reservation to a delimitation exercise following the first Census conducted after the Act came into force. This meant that the women's quota could be delayed until the Census and subsequent delimitation process were completed.
The Centre's latest proposal seeks to change this timeline and facilitate the implementation of women's reservation before the 2029 general elections.
The reservation will apply to constituencies rather than simply adding a separate category of nominated seats. Around one-third of the seats will be reserved for women, including women belonging to Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes.
Why Has The Centre Proposed A 50% Increase In Lok Sabha Seats?
The suggested increment of seats uniformly would be done to deal with the apprehension that an exercise of delimitation on the population will tilt the scales for the parliamentary representation of the states. In fact, southern states like Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh and Telangana have been expressing concern that states who managed to control population growth would end up being marginalized in the Parliament on the basis of only population.
As per the proposal by the Centre, each state would be allotted 50 percent extra seats of Lok Sabha, keeping intact their share of representation.
Government has also recommended that there should be a freeze on state-wise proportional representation till 2051.
YSRCP Signals Support, DMK Maintains Its Conditions
The revised proposal has triggered fresh political discussions, particularly in southern India. The YSRCP has indicated that it may support the Bill, but only if the law helps preserve regional balance and political representation of states.
According to YSRCP MP P V Midhun Reddy, the party is backing the proposal due to the 50 percent hike in the number of seats as well as the safeguard for Andhra Pradesh's seat representation.
On the other hand, DMK has continued to hold the view that Tamil Nadu's share of 7.18 per cent of Lok Sabha seats should not be reduced at all. The DMK chief M K Stalin has further demanded the existing representation of parliamentary seats among states be frozen for another 25 years.
Despite speculation of the DMK backing the modified proposal once the party's conditions are met, Stalin reaffirmed on November 27 that DMK's stance remained unchanged.

title: Lok Sabha Seats To Rise By 50%? Modi Government Clears Key Delimitation Bill Amendments
description: The Modi government has cleared key amendments to the proposed Delimitation Bill, including a uniform 50% increase in Lok Sabha seats across states and a 25-year extension of the 1971 Census freeze. Here's what the proposal means and why southern states are concerned.
author: Swastika Sruti
content:
Lok Sabha Seats To Rise By 50%? Modi Government Clears Key Delimitation Bill Amendments
In the latest development, the Narendra Modi led NDA government has cleared key amendments to the proposed Delimitation Bill, taking an important step towards expanding the strength of the Lok Sabha and revisiting the framework for the exercise.
AI-generated summary, reviewed by editors
According to sources, the amendments propose a uniform 50% increase in Lok Sabha seats across all states. They also seek to extend the freeze on using the 1971 Census to determine the proportional representation of states in the Lower House by another 25 years.
The proposed changes address a major concern raised by several southern states. These states have argued that a delimitation exercise based on population figures could affect their share of parliamentary representation, despite their efforts to control population growth.
What Is The Proposed Increase In Lok Sabha Seats?
The Draft Delimitation Bill proposes to raise the present ceiling strength of the Lok Sabha of 550 seats to 850 seats under the constitution.
As per the present system, the Lower House may comprise a maximum of 530 members from states and 20 from Union Territories. The present Constitution (131st Amendment) Bill aims to raise the strength to 815 and 35 from states and UTs respectively.
The amendments approved by the government apparently envisage an equal 50% increase in the strength of all the states. This is expected to resolve the apprehension about any disparity in the political representation through a population-based exercise.
The final allocation will obviously depend upon the criteria used in the delimitation exercise.
What Is Delimitation And Why Is It Important?
Delimitation is the process of redrawing the boundaries of parliamentary and Assembly constituencies and deciding how seats are distributed among states and Union Territories.
The exercise is carried out by an independent Delimitation Commission under the constitutional framework, including Articles 81, 82 and 170.
One of its main objectives is to ensure that constituencies have broadly balanced population sizes so that voters receive fair representation. The process also involves reviewing the allocation of seats reserved for Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes.
The exercise has become politically sensitive because changes in population-based seat allocation can affect the number of representatives elected from different states.
Why Are Southern States Concerned?
Several southern states have raised concerns about the possible impact of delimitation on their representation in Parliament.
States that have made progress in population control fear that a fresh exercise based heavily on population figures could increase the parliamentary strength of states with larger populations while reducing their relative share.
The proposed extension of the freeze on using the 1971 Census for determining each state's proportional representation is significant in this context. It seeks to retain the existing population-based reference framework for another 25 years.
The issue has therefore become a wider debate about balancing population-based representation with the interests of states that have followed population-control measures.
Special Parliament Sitting From November 30
It has been reported that the Secretariat of the Lok Sabha has declared that the second session of the 18th Lok Sabha will start on November 30. This session is scheduled to continue till December 3, subject to the legislation of the government.
According to Union Minister of Parliamentary Affairs, Kiren Rijiju, the government has appealed to the Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla and the Chairman of the Rajya Sabha, CP Radhakrishnan to resume proceedings of both the Houses.
As per the schedule, the Lok Sabha will hold its meeting on November 30, whereas the Rajya Sabha is scheduled to resume proceedings on December 2.

title: Congress open to UP seat-sharing with SP only on ‘respectable’ terms: Imran Masood
description: We Will Not Compromise On Our Self-respect. They Have Their Respect, And We Have Ours Too. It Cannot Happen At The Cost Of Our Self-respect, Says Masood
author: PTI
content:
The Congress will accept a seat-sharing arrangement with the Samajwadi Party for the Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections only if it is "respectable and acceptable", the party's working president Imran Masood said on Friday, barely a day after party chief Mallikarjun Kharge's ''work more, talk less'' advice to him.
Speaking to PTI over the phone from Delhi amid rumours of the Congress asking for 105 more seats to contest, Masood said he had already made his position clear to the Congress leadership and was putting forward his demands accordingly.
"We already contested 107 seats in 2017. An alliance deal should be respectable and acceptable. Otherwise, let there be no alliance. We will not compromise on our self-respect. They have their respect, and we have ours too. It cannot happen at the cost of our self-respect," he said.
Masood's remarks came a day after Kharge visited the Uttar Pradesh capital on Constitution Day, amid ongoing seat-sharing negotiations between the two INDIA bloc allies and reports of growing differences over the number of constituencies to be contested by the Congress.
During his Lucknow speech, Kharge had made clear that the alliance between the Samajwadi Party and the Congress was aimed at thwarting the BJP and advised Masood to "work more, talk less".
Asked to comment on Kharge's advice for him, Masood said, "Kharge sahib has praised me. I am also saying that the alliance is there. But it cannot be at the cost of our self-respect."
In a separate interaction with PTI Videos in Delhi, Masood hit back at Samajwadi Party leaders who had reportedly dismissed his remarks, saying that only the party leadership would decide the seat-sharing arrangement.
"I don't need certificates from Samajwadi Party leaders. They should keep their wisdom to themselves. I am fighting for my party and will continue to speak and fight for my party," he said.
Questioning the viability of the 26 seats reportedly offered to the Congress, he asked whether the Samajwadi Party had applied the winnability criterion while selecting those constituencies.
"Why should we contest unviable seats? You can contest them yourself. Of the 26 seats, if you have said six are for us, you can contest the remaining 20. Why are you trying to give us unviable seats?" he said.
Masood said the Congress is willing to contest the seats offered to it but wanted constituencies where its candidates had a genuine chance of winning.
"If we are saying that we will take the seats, we also want good seats. We cannot be expected to accept whatever you decide and take the entire responsibility of defeating the BJP upon ourselves while surrendering our own interests," he said.
He also called for honesty in the alliance negotiations, saying that if the two parties wanted to fight the BJP together, they should ensure adequate political space for each other.
The Samajwadi Party is understood to have offered 26 seats to the Congress so far, while the latter has been seeking more than 100 seats for the 2027 polls.
Samajwadi Party president Akhilesh Yadav had recently told an HT Leadership Summit in Delhi that the Congress had sought 181 seats during the initial round of discussions, adding that a seat-sharing arrangement could be worked out on the basis of the winnability of candidates.
On Thursday, senior Samajwadi Party leader Shivpal Yadav had said that 26 seats had been offered to the Congress, while the remaining constituencies were being finalised through discussions between the two parties.
The two parties are seeking to contest the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections together against the BJP-led National Democratic Alliance, which is aiming to retain power in the politically crucial state, even as the first round of talks for seat-sharing remained inconclusive.

title: Indian teen Raul John Aju meets Vladimir Putin at Moscow AI conference, selfie goes viral
description: Kochi-based Teenager Met The Russian President At The AI Journey Conference, Where Young Technology Innovators From Several Countries Gathered
author: PTI
content:
A selfie of 17-year-old Indian AI entrepreneur Raul John Aju with Russian President Vladimir Putin at an international conference in Moscow has gone viral on social media, bringing the young tech entrepreneur into the spotlight.
Aju, founder and Chief Technology Officer of Kochi-based AIRealm Technologies, met Putin at the AI Journey conference, where he got an opportunity to interact with the Russian leader. He later asked Putin for a selfie, and the Russian president readily obliged.
Sharing the experience on social media, Aju expressed his excitement over the meeting.
"Still trying to process this. From being a little kid making videos for fun to meeting President Putin at 17, life has given me opportunities I never even knew to dream of," Aju posted on social media.
Known as the 'AI Kid of India', Aju said he had "so much more to learn, so much more to do", while expressing gratitude to everyone who had been part of his journey.
His projects include ThinkCraft, an AI learning platform, RESQ AI, JustEase, NyayaSathi and Project 47X, which aims to simplify legal information.
The Russian Embassy in India also highlighted Aju's meeting with the Russian president, saying the teenager was among the young AI talents who met the presidents of Russia and Kazakhstan.
"During a meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin, Indian schoolboy Raul John Aju, who created the ThinkCraft platform, took a selfie with the Russian leader," it posted on social media.
The AI Journey Conference was held in Moscow from November 26 to 28, 2026, with a focus on the impact of artificial intelligence on society, business and science.
Putin and Kazakhstan's President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev attended the conference's plenary session on November 26.
More than 300 experts from India, Russia, Kazakhstan, China, Serbia and Brazil, among other countries, participated in the event.

title: Climate change could unleash 140% more lightning: Tropics, forests and power grids in the firing line
description: The Biggest Increases Are Expected In The Tropics, Particularly The Amazon, Southeast Asia And Oceania, While Alaska Could See Lightning Strikes Rise By As Much As 594 Per Cent
author: PTI
content:
Globally, lightning could get 76 per cent to 140 per cent more common by the end of the century than between 1995 and 2014 -- roughly 30 per cent more lightning per degree of global warming, new research reveals.
Cloud-to-ground lightning -- dangerous bolts that touch down to earth, sparking wildfires and damaging powerlines and other infrastructure -- kills several thousand humans and burns down hundreds of millions of trees around the world each year.
Lightning may not change in the same way everywhere, researchers, including those from the Technical University of Munich in Germany, said.
The study, published in the journal Earth's Future, projected the total number of strikes rising most in the tropics, where lightning is already the most common, especially in the Amazon, southeast Asia and Oceania.
"... with continued climate change, CG (cloud-to-ground) lightning could increase by 76-140 per cent by century's end -- roughly 30 per cent more lightning per degree of global warming," the authors wrote.
The study's figures far outstrip previous estimates, the highest of which project cloud-to-ground lightning frequency rising between 8 per cent and 17 per cent per degree of warming, the researchers said.
The discrepancy stems mostly from different mathematical approaches to estimate future lightning frequency and the new study's use of a newer, more robust global lightning dataset, they said.
"I was quite surprised that the projections were so high. I expected smaller changes," lead author Andreas Krause, an Earth system scientist at the Technical University of Munich, said.
The biggest relative changes from historical conditions could occur at higher latitudes where lightning is currently rare, according to the study.
The team's model projections showed the density of lightning strikes more than doubling in many regions -- Alaska, for instance, could get 116 per cent to 594 per cent more ground-striking lightning than during the baseline period, when most of the state's total ground area received, on average, less than one bolt per square kilometre per year.
When air near Earth's surface warms up and rises above, stirring the cold atmosphere above, the turbulence disturbs tiny ice crystals in the frigid mid-atmosphere clouds, where they collide and exchange electric charge.
Eventually, the lighter crystals loft upwards relative to the larger, heavier ones, carrying their different charges in opposite directions and creating an electric field. Once the field gets big enough, lightning is formed, the researchers explained.
With climate change warming air temperatures globally, more convection stirs up the clouds, potentially generating more lightning.
However, warmer air could also mean fewer ice crystals high up in the atmosphere, making it harder for strong electric fields -- and, by extension, lightning itself -- to form.
"It's not quite clear which of these is more important," Krause said.

title: Noida: 164 foreigners rescued from cyberfraud racket
description: Lured by IT job promises, the victims were allegedly forced into cybercrime, police say.
author: Azadeh Moshiri
content:
India busts cyberfraud and trafficking network rescuing 164 foreigners
- Published
Police in India say they have uncovered an international cyberfraud and human trafficking operation on the outskirts of capital city Delhi and rescued 92 Indonesian and 72 Malaysian nationals.
They were allegedly lured to India with promises of lucrative IT jobs, but forced into cyber crime, according to police.
Police say the scheme was exposed after a Malaysian worker managed to escape and revealed the operation.
Dozens of foreign nationals have alleged that once they arrived in India, their passports were confiscated and they were held against their will in Noida - a Delhi suburb that is a major IT and business hub in northern India and home to several call centres.
Instead of the jobs and high salaries promised, police say, they were forced to pose as women online to lure unsuspecting victims into fake investment platforms.
So far one Malaysian national has been arrested in connection with the crime, and nearly 550 desktop computers, laptops and mobile phones have been confiscated, police say.
An investigation has now been launched into a potential wider global cyberfraud network.
Police and Indian banks have been trying to contend with an alarming rise in cyber fraud operations in recent years.
A paper, external by the Reserve Bank of India warned against rising digital fraud and "the manipulation of users through social engineering, coercion, or impersonation".
Figures from India's National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal show 2.8 million cyber fraud complaints were recorded in 2025, with losses of about 22,495 crore rupees, external ($2.42bn; £1.85 bn). It's a dramatic rise in complaints by more than 4,000% since 2021.
The federal government said most cases involved fake investment and trading scams.
In fake investment scams, fraudsters approach victims through social media, messaging groups or phone calls, posing as financial experts and promising high returns.
They lure victims to fake trading platforms that show fictitious profits. Some are allowed to withdraw small amounts to build trust, but when they try to cash out larger sums, they are blocked or asked to pay more. The fraudsters eventually disappear with their money.
The Noida case is the latest in a series of international cyberfraud call centres busted in north India in recent months, with police raids in Lucknow and Delhi's Pitampura area.
In July, Lucknow Police arrested 119 people after raiding a fake international call centre targeting US citizens. Employees allegedly posed as representatives of major companies and US government agencies to defraud victims.
